jobs.excerpt: Own Sherman's investment thinking and carry it to the world.
jobs.description:
Own Sherman's investment thinking and carry it to the world.

Role: Head of Investment Research (Full-Time)
Team: Investment Research
Company: Sherman Research

Location: Remote (US), with regular travel for conferences, media, and advisor events

Reports to: President & CEO

Compensation: $220,000-$260,000 on-target earnings (salary + bonus), depending on experience

Who we are

Sherman Research has been doing this since 1999. We're based in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, and we build signal-driven research, model portfolios, and technology for financial professionals.

At the core is a patented set of six proprietary indicators that track short, medium, long, and seasonal timeframes. When momentum shifts in either direction, the system triggers a real-time signal. Advisors use those signals to make disciplined allocation decisions instead of guessing. That research sits underneath more than fifty tactical allocation portfolios, plus the Sherman Launch System, the Command Module, and the Portfolio Toolkit.

Roughly 300 independent advisors, RIA firms, broker-dealers, and platform partners use our work, representing close to $2 billion in client assets.

Two things to know before you apply.

We're a research firm first. Everything we publish sits next to an investment process people have real money in. Accuracy comes first.

Our work is worship. Sherman is a mission-driven, values-led company. We hire for character alongside competence. We run on a purpose beyond profit: we launch financial strategies that propel lives for Christ. That's why we donate 51% of our profits to advance the gospel.

Why this role exists

Research is the heart of Sherman's value. We need a leader who owns that research and can carry it to the world.

This is a rare two-sided role. You have the depth to own our investment thinking, test new ideas, and defend every decision with evidence. You also have the presence to stand on a conference stage, sit down with a news anchor, or lead a webinar for hundreds of advisors, and leave people clearer and more confident than when they arrived.

We're looking for an optimist. Not a cheerleader, and not a doom forecaster. Someone who studies the data honestly, has a clear view of where things are going, and helps advisors and their clients act on it with confidence.

You'll be Sherman's public voice on markets. You'll speak from a believer's perspective, in a way that wins the hearts and minds of believers and non-believers alike.

What you'll be building

  • A research engine. A documented investment philosophy and process, a research agenda, and new methods that grow the depth and breadth of what Sherman brings to advisors.
  • A public voice. Sherman as a recognized, trusted voice on markets: webinars, conferences, shows, podcasts, news outlets, and our own channels.
  • An advisor education practice. Clear, simple explanations of complex strategies, so advisors know what to do and why.
  • A research practice that scales. Work that is documented and repeatable, and does not depend on any one person.

Core responsibilities

1) Research and R&D

  • Own and articulate Sherman's investment philosophy and methodology.
  • Lead ongoing research across markets, asset classes, and strategies.
  • Find, test, and validate new approaches. Pressure-test ideas and guard against bias and overfitting.
  • Grow the depth and breadth of our research, including diversifiers beyond equities such as managed futures, gold, and Treasuries.
  • Review and vet new strategies before they go to market, and decide how they should be explained.

2) Thought leadership and public voice

  • Lead Sherman's monthly Client Briefing webinar for advisors.
  • Represent Sherman on financial shows, podcasts, and with news outlets.
  • Speak at industry conferences, including alongside economists and other market voices.
  • Publish steady commentary: written pieces, social posts, and short video market updates. Think in public and grow an audience for Sherman.
  • Share a clear, forward-looking view: "Here's where we think things are going, and here's what it means for you."

3) Advisor education and support

  • Turn complex research into simple, useful guidance. Lead with the takeaway and keep the detail ready for anyone who wants it.
  • Own the advisor and client education roadmap: what we teach, in what order, and in what format.
  • Answer the deep research and model questions that advisors bring to our team.

4) Partnership with Product, Machine Learning, and Growth

  • Work with Product and Machine Learning to put research methods into production.
  • Make sure our models reflect sound investment reasoning, not just statistics.
  • Help the Growth team market new strategies clearly and accurately.
  • Help advisors find the right Sherman solution for their clients, including our models on the True Freedom Investing TAMP.

5) Research operations and leadership

  • Document methods, data sources, and decisions so the work can be repeated. Cite every source.
  • Set research quality standards and review practices.
  • Direct the research work of our analysts and help them grow.

What success looks like (first 90 days)

  • You're leading the monthly Client Briefing webinar.
  • Sherman's investment philosophy and process are documented in your words.
  • You've reviewed the strategies in our pipeline and have a plan to bring them to advisors simply.
  • A prioritized research agenda is in motion.
  • Your first public pieces are published, and your first media or conference appearances are on the calendar.

What success looks like (ongoing)

  • Advisors trust the thinking behind our portfolios and know what to do with it.
  • Sherman is a recognized voice on markets in the media, at conferences, and online.
  • Our research grows in depth and breadth, and every decision is defensible and documented.
  • More advisors and their clients choose Sherman's models.
  • The research practice scales beyond any one person.

Who you are

  • An optimist with depth. Your hope comes from the evidence, not from ignoring it.
  • Dynamic and deep. You can go three layers into the data, then explain it to a room in two minutes.
  • Mission-aligned. You share Sherman's purpose, and you speak from a biblical worldview with grace and conviction. This one is non-negotiable.
  • A strong communicator. Verbal, written, on camera, and on stage.
  • A teacher. People leave your webinars smarter and more confident, not more confused.
  • Humble and honest. You follow the evidence, not your ego, and you say "I was wrong" when you were.

How you work (standards and values)

  • Intellectual honesty: you follow the evidence, not the ego.
  • Rigor: reproducible methods, tested assumptions.
  • Clarity: you explain the "why" in plain language.
  • Discipline: you stay anchored to process under market pressure.
  • Stewardship: you remember real clients are on the other side.
  • Character: our culture is built on the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23).

Required

  • 10+ years in investment research (asset management, RIA, broker-dealer, or research firm), including senior leadership of research strategy or a research team.
  • Deep expertise in momentum, trend-following, and tactical asset allocation, including building and leading tactical model portfolios.
  • Strong understanding of portfolio construction and markets.
  • Quantitative rigor and sound statistical judgment.
  • A proven track record as an industry expert and speaker: conference talks, media interviews, podcasts, webinars, or video you can show us.
  • Excellent writing, with published research or commentary.
  • High standards for documentation and reproducibility.
  • Alignment with Sherman's mission and values.

Strong pluses

  • CFA or CMT, or equivalent depth.
  • Experience as a chief investment officer, chief market strategist, or head of research.
  • Experience with systematic or multi-asset strategies.
  • An existing audience on YouTube, X, Substack, LinkedIn, or a podcast.
  • Regular appearances on financial TV, radio, or podcasts.
  • Experience presenting to financial advisors.
  • Experience working with quant or machine learning teams.

What this role is not

  • A behind-the-scenes analyst who never presents.
  • A pundit who chases headlines or promises returns.
  • A pessimist who leads with fear.

Tools you'll use

  • Research, data, and analytics tools
  • Notion (research notes and methodology docs)
  • Portfolio and modeling systems (with Product and Machine Learning)
  • Zoom, plus camera and audio for webinars and video

Reporting and collaboration

  • Reports to: President & CEO
  • Works closely with: Product Development, Machine Learning, Advisor Success, and Growth

Guardrails

Public commentary goes through our compliance review. Views on the future are shared as views, not guarantees. No performance promises and no personalized advice.

How we hire

We're taking our time with this hire, because it matters. Expect several conversations, a short research work sample, a recorded or live 10-minute market briefing for an advisor audience, and time with our team and our CEO.

How to apply

Apply through this posting. Along with your resume, please share links to talks, media appearances, webinars, or published research you would like us to see.

The role in one line

The Head of Investment Research owns Sherman's investment thinking and carries it to the world: deep research, a clear and hopeful view of where things are going, and the presence to share it with advisors, the media, and the conference stage.

jobs.description:
About the Organization

The Momentus Capital branded family of organizations - which includes Capital Impact Partners,CDC Small Business Finance, and Momentus Securities (an SEC-registered broker-dealer, MSRB-registered municipal advisor, a FINRA-approved municipal advisor and municipal securities broker-dealer, FINRA/SIPC member) - are transforming how capital and investments flow into communities to provide people access to the capital and opportunities they deserve.

We are working to reinvent traditional financial systems and advance locally-led solutions that create economic mobility and generational wealth. Through our continuum of financial,knowledge, and social capital, we offer a comprehensive package of loan products, impact investment opportunities, training and business advising programs, and technology solutions.

Our holistic and streamlined approach offers comprehensive solutions for small business entrepreneurs, real estate developers, community-based organizations, and local leaders at every stage of growth, from inception to expansion. When these leaders have the opportunity to succeed, their communities, their residents – and our country – thrive.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Loan Officer position is part of the Community Development Lending (CDL) team under Capital Impact Partners (CIP). While the position is remote, candidates residing in Los Angeles, CA or Oakland, CA are strongly preferred. This individual will contribute to projects nationwide, with a primary focus on transactions within CIP's Western region.

The ideal candidate is passionate about community and economic development, and impact investing.

The Loan Officer is responsible for originating and underwriting acquisition/predevelopment, construction, lines of credit, and term loans to support projects in Capital Impact’s key sectors: housing, healthcare, education, healthy food, aging, and cooperatives. The position also involves closing transactions that utilize New Markets Tax Credits (NMTCs).

In accordance with Capital Impact’s lending policies and procedures, the Loan Officer prepares and presents loan narratives and credit memos to the loan committee or other approved Momentus Loan Administration groups for closing. Additionally, they collaborate with the Momentus portfolio management team on ongoing asset management. The role also supports the achievement of lending work plan goals, markets Momentus products, and manages relationships with borrowers, lending partners, technical assistance providers, government agencies, and public officials.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS:

The Loan Officer reports to the NMTC & Structuring Market Manager. The Loan Officer works closely with the Capital Deployment team, Business Development Officers, and Underwriters on loan closings. They also work with Underwriters and Portfolio Managers on asset management. The Loan Officer communicates regularly with borrowers, third-party lenders, attorneys, and other external stakeholders. Additionally, they attend loan committee meetings and represent Momentus/CIP to outside groups as needed.

Essential Responsibilities

Marketing/Business Development:

  • Supports the team in developing the lending pipeline by: helping to screen inquiries for mission and strategic alignment, feasibility, and project readiness; identifying and responding to new business opportunities; and meeting regularly with current CIP clients, potential borrowers, and lending partners to discuss their development pipelines and credit needs.
  • Attends various industry and client functions, representing Momentus/CIP as a part of the client team.
  • Maintains current knowledge of local, regional and national trends and conditions in the real estate development sector, including policy initiatives that will affect the underwriting, financing, and development processes.
  • Contributes to new product development including researching and analyzing market needs and analyzing credit risk of new product opportunities.

Underwriting:

  • Structures loans both to meet customers’ needs and to comply with internal guidelines based on extensive review and analysis of information gathered from the potential borrower and other sources and in consultation with the Head of Community Development Credit, the SVP of CDL, the Community Solutions team, and other relevant Momentus/CIP staff.
  • Performs due diligence review and evaluation of loan requests, which sometimes include a grant component, including conducting site inspections, analyzing cash flow projections, reviewing appraisals, assessing entitlement status, reviewing environmental reports, understanding market and operating strategy for community facility projects, reviewing organizational capacity and leadership, and spreading/analyzing sponsor financial statements, etc.
  • In consultation with the Manager, negotiates with borrowers on all aspects of loans, prepares a credit memo, and secures the appropriate level of approvals from internal staff and/or the appropriate loan committee with a recommendation for action.
  • Collaborates with co-lenders and third-party participants on co-lending and participations, respectively. In these cases, the Loan Officer mediates between the borrower and co-lender or participant and negotiates all aspects of the loan in accordance with Capital Impact’s agreement with the third party.

Closing:

  • Following financing approval, drafts an approval letter and coordinates loan documentation and work performed by attorneys and other Momentus/CIP staff.
  • When a portion of CIP’s loan will be shared with another financial institution, coordinates the distribution of information needed for the other lender to underwrite, approve, and close the loan.
  • Working in close collaboration with the assigned Underwriter, guides the transaction through closing. The Loan Officer is responsible for ensuring that the business terms of the transaction as reflected in the loan documents are consistent with the underwriting of the loan.
  • With the Underwriter, develops and maintains files to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • After loan closing, provides ongoing support to successful transition to the Portfolio Management Officer.
  • Coordinates closely with the applicable Underwriter and Portfolio Manager as part of the relationship management team for each client.

Other Responsibilities:

  • The Loan Officer must consistently provide excellent external relationship management and work closely with all internal lending and operations staff to ensure excellent customer service throughout the client’s relationship with Momentus/CIP.
  • The Loan Officer must maintain knowledge of all products across Momentus Capital products and refer prospective clients and partners to other Momentus teams when applicable.

Requirements

Professional Skills, Education and Experience

  • A degree in finance, real estate, urban planning, public policy, business administration, or a related field is preferred. However, education and experience are considered holistically.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years of lending experience. Community development lending or mission-driven work is preferred.
  • Experience in community development or real estate lending, including credit analysis, deal structuring, underwriting, and due diligence. Familiarity with loan documentation is required.
  • Familiarity with federal, state, and local development programs, including NMTCs and Community Development Financial Institutions (CDFIs), is a plus.
  • Proficiency in analyzing financials for nonprofit organizations and for-profit developers.
  • Strong communication skills, including public speaking.
  • Knowledge of community facilities is preferred. Knowledge of funding sources for charter schools, health centers and community facilities (e.g., childcare centers, food markets, shelters, and social services).
  • Experience managing multiple projects under tight deadlines and developing innovative products for diverse borrowers.
  • Self-motivated, dedicated, and flexible, with strong time management and collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20%.

Benefits

This role is eligible for remote work; however, it is preferred that the selected candidate resides in the Los Angeles or Oakland areas.

The salary range for this position is $85,896 – $127,412 and is eligible for an annual discretionary incentive.

  • Structure A: $85,896 to $114,671 All locations except Structures B and C
  • Structure B: $95,440 to $127,412 Washington, D.C.; Maryland; Virginia (DMV); non-Bay Area California markets; and Massachusetts

All employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The company will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

jobs.description:
We're seeking a Junior Administrative Assistant to provide administrative support with a strong focus on client file organization, deadline tracking, and basic bookkeeping support via QuickBooks. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills and exceptional attention to detail, ensuring that administrative systems support timely compliance with financial and tax obligations. This position is closely aligned with accounting services and plays a key role in maintaining structured and efficient organizational practices by bridging the gap between administrative tasks and initial financial data entry.

Requirements

  • Proficiency in QuickBooks (Online or Desktop): Ability to perform basic tasks such as entering expenses, categorizing transactions, and generating basic reports.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in a professional setting.
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy in administrative and financial record-keeping.
  • Ability to sort and manage email correspondence by client.
  • Intermediate proficiency in spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets).
  • Capable of maintaining accurate and up-to-date contact databases.
  • Proactive in identifying and implementing organization systems to increase productivity.
  • Organize and categorize client emails to ensure efficient access and follow-up.
  • Create and maintain a spreadsheet for corporate clients tracking fiscal year-end dates and filing deadlines.
  • Develop and maintain a structured digital and/or physical filing system.
  • Support the accounting team by implementing organizational methods and assisting with preliminary data reconciliation in QuickBooks.
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities without constant supervision.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

    Schedule: Monday to Friday 02:00 pm -04:00 pm (GMT -8-00) Pacific Time (US & Canada)

Benefits

  • Competitive pay in US Dollars.
  • You'll get to work with some amazing, respected business professionals.
  • We really value and encourage input from our team members.
  • We offer different payment methods (Zelle, Face Bank, Binance)
  • You'll get paid every two weeks.
  • Birthday and work anniversary celebrations.
  • Alliances with many brands grant extra benefits to freelancers.
  • Weekly recreation dynamics that foster a healthy work environment.

📌 Before You Apply, Please Read:

At Freelance Latin America, we’re excited to connect you with meaningful remote opportunities. However, we want to be clear:

⏰ These are professional roles with set schedules defined by the client.
Consistent availability is expected. You will have a set work schedule determined by the client, and you are expected to be present during those hours.

🤝 You will be part of the client’s team.

You’ll follow their company guidelines, communication practices, and workflows, ensuring seamless collaboration.

📈 KPIs and goals matter.

Your performance will be measured to ensure alignment with client expectations and project objectives.

🧑‍🏫 Training may be required.

You might need to complete training to fully understand your role, tools, and client processes.

🎯 Commitment and responsibility are essential.
We work with clients who rely on your dedication to deliver consistent, high-quality results. This is key to building trust and long-term partnerships.

🚀 Ready to grow your career with us?

Apply only if you are ready to commit, learn, and take ownership of your role.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Platform
jobs.excerpt: Worth AI, a leader in the computer software industry, is looking for a talented and experienced Product Manager to join their innovative team.
jobs.description:
Worth AI, a leader in the computer software industry, is looking for a talented and experienced Product Manager to join their innovative team. At Worth AI, we are on a mission to revolutionize decision-making with the power of artificial intelligence while fostering an environment of collaboration, and adaptability, aiming to make a meaningful impact in the tech landscape. Our team values include extreme ownership, one team and creating reaving fans both for our employees and customers.

We’re seeking a Platform Product Manager who is passionate about building the dataand machine learning foundations that enable transformative digital experiences. Inthis role, you’ll own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of our data and ML platform focusing on the core infrastructure, tooling, and services that power analytics, intelligent features, and product personalization at scale. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of product, data, and engineering. You are both technically fluent and deeply user-focused, with a strong ability to define scalable, privacy-conscious solutions that align with business strategy. You’ll partner closely with engineering, data science, design, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, extensible, and high-impact platform capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve the vision and roadmap for our internal data and ML platform, ensuring it supports current and future product needs.
  • Collaborate with engineering, data science, and infrastructure teams to build scalable pipelines, APIs, services, and tooling for ML model development, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Gather and synthesize requirements from internal users (product teams, data scientists, analysts, etc.) to inform feature development and prioritization.
  • Drive the operationalization of ML models into production workflows, ensuring robust performance, scalability, and observability.
  • Define and maintain clear success metrics for platform features, including data quality, latency, reliability, and model impact.
  • Manage the product backlog and ensure timely, well-scoped, and technically feasible user stories for engineering teams.
  • Partner with design and engineering to improve internal UX for platform tools, data access, and workflows.
  • Establish and promote best practices around data governance, documentation, and developer experience.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure effective model integration, A/B testing, and measurement frameworks.
  • Lead platform-level initiatives such as self-serve data tooling, experimentation infrastructure, and data cataloging.
  • Support platform adoption by enabling documentation, training, and onboarding resources.
  • Serve as a key voice for platform product strategy in leadership forums and cross-functional planning sessions.

Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience as a product manager, preferably in platform, data infrastructure, or ML tooling
    • Deep understanding of data platforms and modern data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, Spark)
    • Strong grasp of ETL/ELT workflows, ML model lifecycle, and platform architecture
    • Hands-on experience working with data engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists in cross-functional teams
    • Proficiency in SQL and comfort navigating complex datasets to drive product insight
    • Proven ability to translate technical requirements into business value and vice versa
    • Excellent communication skills with experience presenting to technical and non-technical stakeholders
    • Demonstrated track record of delivering platform products or services that enable broader team productivity and innovation
    • Strong prioritization, execution, and decision-making skills in fast-paced, evolving environments
    • Curious, collaborative, and growth-oriented mindset

Benefits

    • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
    • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
    • Life Insurance
    • Unlimited Paid Time Off
    • 9 paid Holidays
    • Family Leave
    • Work From Home
    • Free Food & Snacks (Access to Industrious Co-working Membership!)
    • Wellness Resources

jobs.title: Marketing - First Hire (m/f/d), German Speaking
jobs.excerpt: About The Company At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.
jobs.description:
About The Company

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
  • Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

  • Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression
  • Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.
  • Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
  • Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
  • Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
  • Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

  • Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals
  • Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements

What We're Looking For

(You don't need to know it all - but you should be ready to dive in, learn fast, and take initiative.)

  • Experience in B2B marketing: Ideally in financial services or at an AI / enterprise startup
  • You can create a brand, not just run one: you've built positioning and narrative for a product or category, ideally while the product was still moving
  • Creative and strong at storytelling: You can draft an explanatory case study, a press pitch that lands, and a job description that pulls. Without slipping into FinTech buzzwords
  • Extroverted and a strong communicator: You build real relationships with journalists, candidates and event coordinators
  • Existing PR network or demonstrable track record in media work is a big plus
  • Data-driven: You think in KPIs and processes, and use them to make the work sharper
  • Experimental: You actively try new channels and formats, like AI search, new social formats, distribution plays
  • You treat candidates as an audience: you can write a role description that makes people apply, shape how NaroIQ shows up to talent, and equip hiring managers with a story worth telling
  • A taste-led approach to brand: you can hold a consistent visual and verbal system across surfaces and push back on output that breaks it
  • Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team
  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to have: existing relationships with FinTech or asset-management journalists; experience building a careers brand from scratch; familiarity with growth tooling (SEO, attribution, growth-hacking stacks).

Why NaroIQ

We're building something ambitious - and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that's low-ego, high-impact, and genuinely excited about what they're doing.

Here's what we care about:

🔑 High Ownership
We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🚫 No Bullshit, No Ego
We're too small for politics, posturing or competing agendas. We care about doing the right thing, not being right.

🧘‍♂️ Flexibility
Exceptional work doesn't require relocation or fixed office hours. Have dinner with your family. Get that dog. Move to the Alps. We're remote-first and trust people to manage their own time.

🧳 Sometimes We Leave the House
We do make time for real-life moments, like quarterly offsites or in-person team sessions, to solve stuff together or just hang out.

🦸🏻‍♀️ Hire for Spikes
We don't expect you to be good at everything. We care about your superpower. We're building a team of nerds who are world-class in wildly different areas.

🛠 Default to Rethink
We don't accept "that's just how it is." We dig deep, think from scratch and always believe there's a better way. First Principles isn't a buzzword for us.

💅🏼 Give Yourself a Little Treat
We offer benefits via hrmony, so you can spend up to €50/month on the little things that bring you joy: Urban Sports, DAZN, Mediamarkt, Thalia, whatever suits you.

🤓 Your Learning Curve is Our Investment
Everyone at NaroIQ gets €1,000 per year for courses, books, coaching, or whatever helps them grow.

jobs.excerpt: • Opracowywanie, wdrażanie i aktualizowanie standardów oraz procedur operacyjnych w obszarze logistyki zwrotnej.

  • Umiejętność wykorzystywania narzędzi AI do analizy danych i usprawniania codziennej pracy.
  • Umiejętność tworzenia i prowadzenia prezentacji biznesowych oraz przedstawiania wniosków i rekomendacji.
  • Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną komunikację.
  • Wykształcenie wyższe, preferowane kierunki związane z logistyką lub analityką danych.
  • Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności analityczne oraz zdolność identyfikowania obszarów wymagających optymalizacji.
  • Umiejętność skutecznej komunikacji, współpracy z różnymi interesariuszami oraz wywierania wpływu bez formalnej podległości służbowej.
  • Samodzielność, proaktywność oraz bardzo dobra organizacja pracy w dynamicznym środowisku.
  • Gotowość do odbywania podróży służbowych na terenie Polski.

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu lub koordynowaniu projektów związanych z optymalizacją procesów logistycznych.
  • Znajomość specyfiki logistyki zwrotnej oraz funkcjonowania sieci oddziałów logistycznych.
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z systemami WMS lub narzędziami do raportowania i wizualizacji danych.
  • Wykształcenie kierunkowe w obszarze analityki danych.
  • Znajomość języka angielskiego w stopniu biegłym.

To, co zapewniamy:

  • Zatrudnienie w ramach umowa o pracę
  • Samochód Służbowy
  • System kafeteryjny, w którym to pracownik sam wybiera benefity, z których korzysta (np. Multisport, prywatna opieka medyczna, bony do sklepów, bilety na wydarzenia sportowe i muzyczne i wiele, wiele więcej )
  • Możliwość rozwoju w ramach struktury firmy
  • Stabilną pracę w firmie, która jest liderem na rynku
  • Możliwość poszerzenia swoich kompetencji oraz zdobywania nowych
  • Dostęp do platformy e-learningowej GoodHabitz, na której znajduje się mnóstwo inspirujących szkoleń
  • Dostęp do aplikacji do nauki języków obcych eTutor

Nasze wartości
W InPost nasze wartości wyznaczają kierunek wszystkiego, co robimy:

  • START WITH THE CUSTOMER: Każda decyzja i działanie zaczyna się od myśli o kliencie. Staramy się nie tylko spełniać oczekiwania, ale je przekraczać.
  • THIS IS YOUR COMPANY – ACT LIKE IT: Wykazujemy się inicjatywą i bierzemy pełną odpowiedzialność za swoje działania. Gdy widzimy, że coś jest nie tak, reagujemy od razu – niezależnie od tego, czyja to działka.
  • CREATE, TEST, GROW: Stawiamy na przedsiębiorczość, ambicję i podejście budowniczego. Innowacja to próbowanie, porażki, wyciąganie wniosków, ulepszanie i wspólne osiąganie sukcesu.
  • ADAPT, LEARN, MOVE ON: Dobrze radzimy sobie w zmieniającym się otoczeniu. Działamy szybko, ale nie na oślep. Stale analizujemy, uczymy się i dostosowujemy. Tempo ma znaczenie, ale wygrywa tempo mądre i skoordynowane.
  • OUR TEAMS WIN, TOGETHER: Ostatecznie liczą się ludzie. Łączy nas zwycięska mentalność i pasja do naszej misji, a wyjątkowe wyniki osiągamy dzięki współpracy, docenianiu się nawzajem i świętowaniu sukcesów, dużych i małych.

Jak pewnie wiesz, w InPost bardzo dużo się dzieje! Głównym corem naszej działalności są urządzenia Paczkomat, które od lat produkujemy i projektujemy we własnym zakresie. Dodatkowo, stale rozwijamy nasze portfolio usług i wprowadzamy nowe rozwiązania, takie jak InPost Fresh, Fulfillment czy InPost Pay, ułatwiające życie milionom naszych klientów.

Praca w naszej firmie to praca wśród najlepszych liderów w międzynarodowym środowisku. Jako InPost Group działamy pod dwoma markami InPost i Mondial Relay, na rynku w Europie, w tym w Polsce, Francji, Wielkiej Brytanii, Hiszpanii, Portugalii, Włoszech i w krajach Beneluxu. Jesteśmy innowacyjni, konkretni, proaktywni, a przede wszystkim, zorientowani na efekt biznesowy naszych działań.

jobs.description:
Are you an organized, customer-focused professional who enjoys solving account and operational issues?

Would you like to help sales teams stay focused on customer relationships, retention, and growth?


About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at


About Our Team

Our sales organization partners with customers to address complex risk, fraud, identity, compliance, and customer data management challenges. The team works collaboratively with Market Planning, Legal, Pricing, Sales, and other internal partners to develop strategic opportunities, negotiate customer agreements, and deliver solutions that support customer and business growth.


About the Role

As a Sales Support Specialist, you will serve as a key operational partner to the field sales organization, providing day-to-day support that enables Account Managers and sales leadership to focus on customer relationships, retention, and revenue growth. You will coordinate customer and sales support needs from initial inquiry through resolution, including billing and invoice inquiries, account and service issues, contract research, account maintenance, reporting, customer troubleshooting, and coordination with internal support teams.


Responsibilities

  • Provide proactive day-to-day operational support to assigned Account Managers, sales teams, and sales leadership.
  • Research and resolve customer account questions and operational issues, coordinating requests across internal teams to support timely resolution.
  • Research account history, agreements, contracts, and other customer information needed by the sales organization.
  • Help sales representatives navigate internal processes, systems, and support channels.
  • Research and assist with customer billing, invoicing, collections/dunning, service concerns, account discrepancies, and other customer-impacting issues.
  • Maintain ownership of issues through resolution and communicate status and next steps clearly to sales partners and, where appropriate, customers.
  • Prepare, maintain, and distribute reports that help Account Managers and sales leadership manage their books of business.
  • Support Top Account Reviews, booked-versus-billed tracking, invoice audits, and account and ID management activities.
  • Analyze available account information to identify issues requiring sales or operational attention.
  • Support regional and national sales campaigns and initiatives by coordinating information, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Build productive working relationships with Account Managers, sales leadership, customer support, billing, operations, and other internal teams.
  • Facilitate communication between sales and operational teams, escalate complex or high-impact customer issues through appropriate channels, and maintain documentation and follow-up on outstanding requests.
  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and sales support.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience preferred.
  • Experience in sales support, customer service, account management support, sales operations, or a related business function.
  • Demonstrated experience researching and resolving customer or account-related problems.
  • Strong customer service orientation and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, research, troubleshooting, organizational, and follow-through skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities.
  • Sound judgment regarding escalation and issue resolution.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales professionals, customers, and cross-functional business partners.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced sales environment and ability to learn and navigate multiple internal systems and processes.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Teams, and related business productivity tools.
  • Ability to interpret account, billing, and operational information and communicate findings clearly.

Working for you:

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Health Benefits: Comprehensive, multi-carrier program for medical, dental and vision benefits
  • Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with match and an Employee Share Purchase Plan
  • Wellbeing: Wellness platform with incentives, Headspace app subscription, Employee Assistance and Time-off Programs
  • Short-and-Long Term Disability, Life and Accidental Death Insurance, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
  • Family Benefits, including bonding and family care leaves, adoption and surrogacy benefits
  • Health Savings, Health Care, Dependent Care and Commuter Spending Accounts
  • In addition to annual Paid Time Off, we offer up to two days of paid leave each to participate in Employee Resource Groups and to volunteer with your charity of choice

What you'll do

As an AI Engineer, you develop MAIA further and help decide from the start how we solve problems.

What you can work on:

  • From concept to feature. Together with product management, you sharpen rough concepts and own features from prototype to continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data.

  • Chat and agents. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context and letting agents complete multi-step tasks, with traceable progress and verifiable results.

  • Unlocking company knowledge. You connect external systems and make knowledge from many different file formats usable. This way, MAIA finds the right passages, delivers answers with sources and respects existing access rights.

  • Models and quality. You integrate new language models and compare quality, cost and speed. With evals, you detect errors and systematically improve answers and agents.

  • Secure, fast and stable. You build isolated environments for running code and tools and improve response times and data processing, so that MAIA runs reliably even with large knowledge bases.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built and shipped backend systems and operated them in production over a longer period. Architecture, API design, data modelling and asynchronous processing are familiar to you. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built real applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects. You know RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling from practice, including where they fail. You try out new models and frameworks on your own initiative and separate substance from hype. Production experience with LLM systems is a big plus.

  • Measure, don't guess. You know how to test and evaluate systems that don't always give the same answer to the same question. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem. Additional retrieval stages, prompt chains or abstractions only come in when measurements justify them.

  • Product thinking. You think about the person who needs to finish a quote under time pressure or clarify a technical question with MAIA. You like to get involved early in product management's concepts, ask the right questions and contribute your own ideas, even when not everything is settled yet.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Security-minded. Our customers trust us with their internal knowledge. Tenant isolation, access rights and secure development are second nature to you.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. You explain technical topics clearly, including to product management, customer success and sales. You are fluent in English. German is a plus.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Send us your CV and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

jobs.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Ireland, UK, Sweden, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium or Italy.

About the team

Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to help customers transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role and it is not a features team. It is a multi-disciplined deployment unit operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.

You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with customers from warehouse floor to executive sponsor designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi-disciplinary, and self-directed. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.

Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy.

What you will do

  • Own customer solutions end-to-end. Rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy solutions in live operational environments where the stakes are real and the timeline is short.
  • Deliver relentless customer value. Build trusted relationships from the IC level to the executive sponsor and become the technical face of our company in the room.
  • Run multiple threads. Carry several customer engagements in parallel based on customer priorities and pod capacity. Set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when reality shifts, operate without close supervision, and own the outcome.
  • Operate as a SEAL team. A small, tight, multi-disciplinary unit with focus and urgency tasks are traded seamlessly to whoever is closest to the skills needed.
  • Make the product better. Partner with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings into durable platform capabilities not one-off scripts.
  • Drive adoption and lead the change. Mentor customer operators and guide their teams through solution transitions, so the new way of working actually sticks.

What we are looking for

  • AI & Agentic Development
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications RAG systems, multi-agent workflows, tool-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
  • Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns when to use single vs. multi-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.
  • Software Engineering
  • Solid, hands-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
  • Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.
  • Data Engineering & Platforms
  • Ability to build and maintain data pipelines ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
  • Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals.
  • Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real-world data in production environments.
  • Supply Chain Domain (Nice to Have)
    • Prior exposure to supply chain planning, logistics, or operations domains is a genuine plus not a requirement
  • 2 – 5 years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, solutions engineering, or a technical-founder role. Strong candidates at either end of that range are welcome to apply.

  • Prior exposure to customer-facing technical roles solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats is a strong signal, though not a requirement.

How to succeed in this role

  • You measure your own success in business outcomes efficiency gains, exception reduction, SLA improvements not lines of code shipped.
  • You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities.
  • You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end-to-end without requiring close supervision.
  • You are curious and pragmatic you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new.
  • You communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business stakeholders written, verbal, and in the room.
  • You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours no waiting for perfect clarity.
  • You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver without being told.
  • Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
  • You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
  • Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric and you still ship.
  • You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
  • Ability to travel as required up to 50%

#Associate; #Intermediate #Senior

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

Ability to adapt to change and support organizational transformation initiatives.

They are comfortable with outbound outreach, motivated by activity and progress, and able to stay focused in a deadline-driven environment. They are also strong collaborators who communicate clearly, follow through on details, and take ownership of how their work contributes to the broader sales organization. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build a foundation in sales, learn from experienced leaders, and grow into future opportunities within LocaliQ. High-performance culture with recognition and Career progression opportunities

Flexibility remote work environment Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

PTO time off, including paid holidays

401(k) with company match

Structured onboarding to help you build confidence quickly

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

If you’re motivated, coachable, organized, and ready to learn the fundamentals of business development and digital marketing sales, we encourage you to apply. jobs.excerpt: Wir sind cinify – ein junges, KI-getriebenes Start-up, das das Gesundheitswesen datenintelligent macht.
jobs.description:
Wir sind cinify – ein junges, KI-getriebenes Start-up, das das Gesundheitswesen datenintelligent macht. Wir verbinden Praxisverwaltungs-, Radiologie- und Terminsysteme, führen ihre Daten zusammen und machen daraus Dashboards, Reports und zunehmend KI-gestützte Anwendungen, die Praxen und Radiologiezentren wirklich weiterbringen.

Wir denken AI-first. Ein Großteil unseres Codes, unserer SQL-Queries und Dashboards entsteht heute schon mit KI, und genau so wollen wir weiterwachsen. Wir suchen Menschen, die KI nicht als Spielerei sehen, sondern als selbstverständliches Werkzeug, mit dem sie schneller, besser und kreativer arbeiten.

In deiner Rolle arbeitest du eng mit Kunden aus dem Gesundheitswesen zusammen, nimmst ihre Anforderungen auf und entwickelst mit SQL und KI maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Dabei bist du nicht nur technischer Umsetzer, sondern auch Projektmanager, der seine Projekte eigenständig organisiert und zum Erfolg führt.

Tipp: Auf unserer Webseite unter „Jobs“ findest du ein kurzes Video, in dem unsere Data Analysts von ihrem Job erzählen. Schau gern vorbei!

Aufgaben

Als Data-Analyst bei cinify ist es Deine Aufgabe, komplexe Sachverhalte möglichst greifbar und verständlich für unsere Kunden aufzubereiten.

  • Du stehst im direkten Kundenkontakt, berätst und setzt Anforderungen direkt um.

  • Du baust Dashboards, Reports und Workflows und nutzt dafür konsequent KI-Tools, um vom Datenmodell bis zum fertigen Dashboard schneller ans Ziel zu kommen.

  • Du integrierst, validierst und optimierst Daten aus unterschiedlichsten Quellsystemen.

  • Du entwickelst unser Produkt aktiv weiter, inklusive neuer KI-Anwendungen für unsere Kunden.

  • Du arbeitest im Team an Standardlösungen für den Gesundheitsmarkt und hilfst dabei, unsere AI-first-Arbeitsweise stetig zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, bringst Du folgende Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium und/oder erste Berufserfahrung im kaufmännischen oder IT-Bereich

  • Routinierter Umgang mit SQL

  • Erfahrung mit BI-Lösungen wie Power BI, Qlik oder Tableau

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) und Lust, deinen Arbeitsalltag damit neu zu denken

  • Datenaffinität und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten zu verstehen und ansprechend zu visualisieren

  • Selbstständigkeit und den Antrieb, unser Produkt immer besser zu machen

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Remote-first

  • Falls gewünscht EGYM-Wellpass und Corporate Benefits

  • Mitwirken bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer innovativen BI-Lösung

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Engagiertes, modernes und kreatives Arbeitsumfeld in einem aufstrebenden Start-up

  • ca. 1x im Quartal Team-Events (unsere letzten Team-Events: Weihnachtsmarkt, Escape-Room, VIP-Lounge Basketball Alba Berlin, Spielshow, Beachvolleyball)

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss

Standort:

Unser Büro ist in Bochum. Der Großteil des Teams ist aber Deutschlandweit aktiv. Unter anderem: Berlin, München, Stuttgart, Frankfurt und Düsseldorf.

Teamwork:

Unser Teamgeist ist uns besonders wichtig. Wir legen viel Wert auf gegenseitige Unterstützung und offene Kommunikation. Eine offene Fehlerkultur gehört bei uns dazu – wir lernen aus Fehlern und wachsen gemeinsam daran. Wir sind kein Konzern mit starren Strukturen, sondern ein dynamisches Start-up, bei dem du direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens hast. Du gestaltest den Weg von cinify aktiv mit und siehst, wie deine Arbeit echten Impact hat. Wenn du eine Umgebung suchst, in der dein Beitrag zählt und du gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchtest, dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Ablauf der Bewerbung:

  1. SQL-Test: Im ersten Schritt bekommst du von uns einen kurzen SQL-Test, da wir solide SQL-Grundlagen voraussetzen.

  2. Gespräche: Danach führst du voraussichtlich zwei Gespräche mit unseren Gründern und aktuellen Data Analysts, in denen wir gemeinsam herausfinden, ob cinify und du ein Match seid.

jobs.title: Head of Payments & Payment Strategy
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Head of Payments who has run payments from the merchant's seat.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Head of Payments who has run payments from the merchant's seat. You have owned checkout, billing and fraud for a global online business, and you were accountable for the revenue those decisions produced.

You will own how our customers pay in every market we sell in: what the payment page looks like, which methods and currencies it offers by region, how transactions are routed and retried, and where we set the line on fraud. Success is measured in checkout conversion, approval rates, recovered revenue, fraud losses and cost per transaction.

This is a hands-on operating role. You will be in the data every day, finding where approvals drop or customers abandon, and fixing it with Product, Engineering, Finance and Risk.
You will work closely with CentroBill, our internal billing and acquiring arm. CentroBill provides the gateway, acquiring relationships and payment method coverage. You are its merchant-side counterpart: you set the requirements, review performance together and push for the routing, coverage and commercial terms the business needs.

About Us

Centro is an international product company with over 20 years of expertise in product development, affiliate marketing and online technologies. Our team of 300+ professionals across Europe and North America builds products used by millions of users worldwide.

What You Will Manage Daily

  • Checkout conversion by market, device, traffic source and product, from payment page load to successful charge.
  • Approval and decline rates by region, acquirer, card type and issuer, split by initial sales, trial conversions, upsells and renewals.
  • Decline reason codes, and the routing, cascading and retry rules that respond to them.
  • Payment method and currency mix in each region, so customers see the options they trust and expect locally.
  • Fraud rules and 3DS settings, watching false declines as closely as fraud losses.
  • Chargebacks, pre-dispute alerts and refunds, tracked against card scheme monitoring thresholds.
  • Recurring billing health: renewal success, failed rebills, retry schedules and involuntary churn.
  • CentroBill and provider performance: uptime, incidents, cost and the fallback when something underperforms.

Key Responsibilities

Checkout and payment page optimization

  • Own the payment page experience across web and mobile: layout, form fields, method ordering, error messaging and localization.
  • Add and tune express checkout options such as Apple Pay and Google Pay where they lift conversion.
  • Run a continuous testing program on checkout flows and report results in conversion and revenue terms.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to prioritize and ship checkout and billing improvements.

Regional payment strategy

  • Decide which cards, wallets, bank transfers and local payment methods to offer in each market, based on customer behavior and unit economics.
  • Set currency, pricing presentation and local acquiring strategy by region to lift approval rates and reduce cross-border costs.
  • Launch payments in new markets and retire methods that do not earn their place.

Authorization and revenue optimization

  • Drive improvements in authorization rates, payment conversion and transaction success rates.
  • Own payment routing, cascading and retry logic across providers.
  • Identify revenue leakage and fix it: soft declines, failed renewals, abandoned payments and avoidable fees.

Subscription and recurring billing

  • Improve trial-to-paid conversion and renewal success rates.
  • Optimize rebill timing, retry schedules, card updater and network token usage, and dunning communication.
  • Reduce involuntary churn and raise payment recovery rates.

Fraud, risk and chargebacks

  • Set fraud rules and 3DS strategy by region, balancing acceptance, fraud exposure and customer experience.
  • Oversee chargeback prevention, pre-dispute alerts, dispute handling and win rates with Risk and Compliance.
  • Keep dispute and fraud ratios within card scheme monitoring program thresholds across every merchant account.
  • Keep checkout and billing flows compliant with card scheme rules, PCI DSS and PSD2.

CentroBill partnership and provider management

  • Act as the business's primary partner to CentroBill, our internal billing and acquiring arm, representing merchant-side needs in its roadmap and priorities.
  • Source and bring forward new acquirers where they improve coverage, approvals or cost. CentroBill is the primary partner, and you are free to go outside it when another acquirer serves the business better. Work with CentroBill on merchant account structure, routing and payment method coverage in each region.
  • Run regular performance reviews with CentroBill on approvals, declines, chargebacks, uptime and cost, and agree the actions that follow.
  • Select and manage any third-party fraud, dispute and checkout vendors the business uses.
  • Own the merchant-side payment roadmap and total cost of payments.

Leadership and reporting

  • Define payment KPIs, build the dashboards that track them and review performance daily.
  • Build and lead the payments team as the function grows.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance and Risk on payment initiatives.
  • Bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to senior leadership.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in digital payments, with a substantial part of that spent merchant-side at an international e-commerce, subscription or digital goods business.
  • Direct ownership of checkout and payment page performance, with before-and-after numbers you can walk us through on conversion, approval, renewal or recovery rates.
  • Experience building payment strategy by region: local payment methods, wallets, currencies, local acquiring and regulatory requirements such as SCA and 3DS.
  • Deep understanding of recurring billing, trial and subscription payments, payment recovery, routing and cascading.
  • Hands-on experience setting fraud rules and managing chargebacks, pre-dispute alerts and card scheme monitoring programs, including the trade-off between fraud losses and false declines.
  • Experience sourcing acquirers and running multiple merchant accounts across them, and working with a gateway or acquiring partner as a demanding, constructive merchant.
  • Self-sufficient in data: you pull and analyze transaction-level data yourself and turn findings into measurable results.
  • Experience with high-risk industries, subscription-based businesses or complex online merchant environments.
  • Strong commercial judgment and stakeholder management across Product, Engineering, Finance and Risk.

Why Work With Us

  • Competitive salary that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Growth and development, with support for your professional development.
  • High level of autonomy, ownership and accountability.
  • No bureaucracy or micromanagement. We value autonomy and initiative.
  • Educational programs to expand your knowledge and skills.
  • Team-building activities and opportunities to attend industry events.
  • Paid holidays, vacation, personal days and sick leave.

jobs.excerpt: Bluebird Auto Rental Systems builds cloud car rental management software for rental operators, dealership loaner fleets, franchises and airport locations.
jobs.description:
Bluebird Auto Rental Systems builds cloud car rental management software for rental operators, dealership loaner fleets, franchises and airport locations. It has a cloud-based rental software used by more than 1,000 operators across 70+ countries. It runs the full rental workflow in one system: reservations, rental agreements, e-signature, rate management, counter operations, fleet, payments and claims. Customers range from dealership loaner fleets and airport counters to franchise, regional, corporate, truck rental and luxury operators. Bluebird is headquartered in New Jersey.

Aspire Software is the operating group of Valsoft Corporation, the Montreal-based company founded in 2015 that buys and grows vertical market software businesses. Aspire runs Valsoft's portfolio of more than 100 companies, with over 3,000 employees in 20+ countries. Each business keeps its own leadership and gets Aspire's resources, support and expertise to grow long term. Car rental is a core vertical: Aspire operates Valsoft's car rental software portfolio and keeps investing in innovation and digital tools for the industry.

Role overview

As Account Manager, you own the customer relationship for a portfolio of 200 named accounts and are accountable for keeping and growing them. You will be the trusted advisor each customer turns to, working alongside Customer Success and Support to deliver an excellent client experience.

You will learn how each account's systems perform today and where its business is headed. You will then align Bluebird's new AI tools and software capabilities to those goals, driving renewals and expansion.

Key responsibilities

Own the customer relationship

  • Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for 200 named accounts, building relationships with decision-makers, users and executive sponsors.
  • Build and maintain account plans that capture each customer's goals, stakeholders, risks and growth opportunities.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with each client to report on value delivered, system performance and the roadmap ahead.
  • Support and attend relevant industry and client events to strengthen relationships and represent Bluebird.

Drive retention and renewals

  • Manage the full renewal cycle for your portfolio, from early forecasting through negotiation and signature.
  • Spot churn risk early using usage data, support trends and customer sentiment, and lead recovery plans with Customer Success.
  • Maintain all renewal and expansion forecasts, and log every client engagement, in HubSpot CRM so records stay accurate and current.

Grow the portfolio

  • Become an expert on the functionality and value proposition of RentWorks Plus and all relevant modules.
  • Run discovery calls to uncover upsell and cross-sell opportunities, then close them, including added users or locations and new modules.
  • Introduce Bluebird's new AI tools and software capabilities where they solve a clear customer problem or advance a business objective.
  • Build a healthy expansion pipeline and move opportunities through it with discipline.

Understand the customer's business

  • Assess each account's current system performance, adoption and pain points.
  • Learn each customer's growth plans and business objectives, and map Bluebird solutions to them.
  • Bring customer feedback to Product and leadership to shape the roadmap.

Deliver an excellent client experience

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and Support to resolve issues quickly and keep customers informed.
  • Coordinate internal resources so the customer sees one joined-up Bluebird team.

How success is measured

Your performance is measured primarily on renewal rate and expansion sales across your portfolio. Key measures:

  • Renewal rate
  • New revenue from upsell, cross-sell, and adoption of AI tools and new capabilities
  • Renewal and expansion forecasts versus actual results
  • QBRs and account plans completed across the portfolio
  • Satisfaction and health scores, shared with Customer Success

Who you are

  • A natural customer advocate who champions the client's interests inside Bluebird.
  • Curious and eager to learn, drawn to exploring and solving hard challenges.
  • An insatiable appetite for growth, matched by a will to win.

Required qualifications

  • 3+ years in account management, customer-facing sales or a similar role at a B2B software or SaaS company.
  • A track record of retaining and growing customers, including turning around at-risk accounts.
  • Commercial sense: you spot an upsell or a renewal risk without being prompted, and you are comfortable negotiating.
  • Experience managing a large portfolio of accounts and prioritizing time across them.
  • Ability to understand how a rental operator makes money, and to talk credibly about revenue, costs and ROI.
  • The desire to become an expert in car and commercial truck rental workflows, from reservations and rental agreements to inventory and fleet management, across both retail and commercial sectors.
  • Ability to present application functionality and deliver complete software demonstrations.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills, including with senior executives.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot CRM or a similar CRM, using data to forecast and manage a pipeline.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling or positioning AI-enabled software or automation tools.
  • Experience in the automotive rental industry.
  • A bachelor's degree in business, technology or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Our client is seeking an outgoing, confident and highly motivated Lead Generation Specialist to join its team.

You will primarily be reaching out to nursing home owners and key decision-makers to introduce the business, generate interest and arrange meetings for the sales team.

You will not be responsible for closing sales. Instead, your main focus will be getting conversations started, identifying potential opportunities and booking qualified meetings.

No previous experience is required. We are looking for someone with the right personality, confidence, communication skills and willingness to learn..


Interested? Check out the steps below:




➡️ Click here to complete your video

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Outbound Calling & Lead Generation

  • Make a high volume of outbound calls to prospective clients.

  • Cold call nursing home owners and key decision-makers.

  • Identify potential business opportunities and suitable leads.

2. Email Outreach & Prospecting

3. Appointment Setting & Business Development Support

4. Lead Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate records of calls, emails and interactions.

  • Provide regular updates on lead generation activities and results.

Minimum Requirements

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

  • Confident and comfortable speaking to new people.

  • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

  • Willingness to make cold calls and approach prospective clients.

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

  • Good organisational and time-management abilities.

  • Self-motivated, driven and target-oriented.

  • Comfortable using email and basic computer systems.

  • Ability to follow up consistently and work independently.

Previous experience is not required. Candidates from customer service, call centres, sales, hospitality or other customer-facing environments are welcome to apply.

Preferred Personality Traits

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Outgoing: Naturally enjoys speaking to people and starting conversations.

  • Confident: Comfortable approaching business owners and senior decision-makers.

  • Self-motivated: Takes initiative and does not need constant supervision.

  • Email outreach activity.

  • Number of leads generated.

  • Number of qualified meetings booked.

  • Consistency of follow-ups.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

AI-First Growth Marketer

Location: Remote – Chile

About the Role

We are hiring an AI-First Growth Marketer for a U.S.-based private direct lender that funds business-purpose real estate loans nationwide, including fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction and DSCR rental loans across a wide range of loan sizes. The company markets to two audiences: real estate investors who borrow and loan brokers who refer deals.

As the company's first dedicated marketing hire, you will own the function end to end. You write a short, data-backed plan, a company partner approves it, and you build and ship it yourself. Over time, you will run marketing entirely, reporting directly to a partner.

Above all, we are looking for an AI power user backed by real marketing experience. You use Claude and other AI tools every day to research, build, automate and produce work, and your experience tells you where to aim them. Where you lack depth, you learn fast with AI or direct and check a specialist; outside help is the exception.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Be the first marketing hire and build the function your way, with a clear path to running all of marketing

  • Spend your time building: CRM workflows, live dashboards, SEO content, community engagement and PR, not decks or long strategy documents

  • Freedom to test better tools and drop anything that isn't earning its cost

  • A direct line between your work and qualified leads, broker sign-ups and funded loans

What You'll Do

CRM, Email & SMS Automation (top priority)

  • Build GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, lead routing, nurture sequences and a recurring newsletter for borrowers and brokers

  • Create segments such as borrowers by loan type, experience and state, and brokers by deal volume

Tracking, Attribution & Live Reporting

  • Capture first- and last-touch source from WordPress (Gravity Forms) into the CRM without either being overwritten

  • Own UTMs, Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Microsoft Clarity

  • Build live dashboards on lead quality, AI mentions, traffic, form submissions, broker sign-ups, referral sources and funded loans; no manual reports
