  • Build lead magnets and A/B test landing pages, starting with the application and broker pages

  • Build backlinks at scale and source, pitch and write PR, feature and guest post placements

Social Media & Community

  • Share helpful, non-spammy content on LinkedIn, BiggerPockets, Reddit, Quora, investor forums and Facebook groups from a monthly calendar

  • Lightly manage the existing reviews setup

AI Content & Sales Enablement

  • Produce emails, landing pages, graphics, direct mail, one-pagers, term sheets, case studies and broker kits with AI

  • Maintain the brand guidelines and prompts the AI follows, and turn each funded deal into multiple content formats

  • Check all output for accuracy, loan terms and brand voice before it goes out

Data, Direct Mail, Automation & Paid Ads

  • Build targeted lists and enrich the CRM with data enrichment providers, and run hyper-personalized, measured direct mail campaigns

  • Replace manual work with automation and AI through Make.com, Zapier and GoHighLevel's AI tools

  • Later, once baselines exist, own paid ads (likely through GoHighLevel), including cost per lead and lead quality by channel

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • AI power user first: heavy daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or similar, with AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built yourself

  • 3+ years as the only or second marketer at a small company or startup, covering several channels long term

  • Hands-on CRM automation (GoHighLevel ideal; HubSpot or ActiveCampaign also count)

  • Make.com, Zapier or n8n, with enough understanding of APIs and webhooks to troubleshoot

  • GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTMs and attribution, including live dashboards used by leadership

  • SEO work with measurable results, plus working knowledge of AEO and WordPress

  • Proven growth of a brand on social media and in online communities

  • Ability to produce creatives and sales materials with AI tools and Canva

  • Track record of finding, testing and rolling out new marketing tools with results that justified them

  • Strong data sense to catch errors in AI output and data; self-directed without a playbook

  • C1+ English (written and spoken) and full, exclusive commitment during U.S. Eastern hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Lending, real estate, fintech or B2B lead generation experience, including the ability to explain fix-and-flip, bridge and DSCR loans

  • Paid ads on Google or Meta, including through GoHighLevel

  • Direct mail campaign experience

  • Gravity Forms and WordPress-to-CRM integrations

  • Lightweight internal tools built with Claude Code or Cursor

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:

  • Concrete examples of AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built

  • Measurable results in SEO, lead generation and community growth

  • Technical fluency with CRM automation, attribution and integrations

  • Accuracy and judgment when reviewing AI output and data

  • Autonomy, speed of learning and clear communication in English

How Success Is Measured

  • By Day 14: Productive in the tools, with the first quick wins shipped.

  • By Day 30: CRM, website and tracking audited; a 6-month plan approved; at least 3 quick wins live.

  • By Day 90: First- and last-touch source captured on every new lead; a live baseline dashboard running; borrower and broker nurture plus a monthly newsletter in place.

  • By Day 180: Targets set for qualified leads and broker sign-ups; SEO/AEO program running; weekly community posting with leads tracked; at least one direct mail campaign tested.

  • After Month 6: Success is judged by growth in qualified borrower and broker leads and funded loans from marketing.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote, full-time role with a U.S.-based direct lender

  • Ownership of an entire marketing function, reporting directly to a company partner

  • Visible, measurable impact on company growth

Important Notes

  • This is a hands-on execution role: no decks, long strategy documents or waiting for direction

Knowledge, skills and abilities:

TJM Labs builds Pharmacy AI: the AI agents hundreds of pharmacies rely on to handle the repetitive work that keeps pharmacists away from patients. jobs.description:
Job Title: Specialist, Site Contracts

Job Location: Virtual Japan, Japan

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world. With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research. *SUMMARY: **The Specialist, Site Contracts is responsible for the development preparation, negotiation, and finalization or assistance in preparation, negotiation, and finalization of Site Agreements, amendments or any other document associated between sponsors and clinical research sites.* *RESPONSIBILITIES:* _Tasks may include but are not limited to:_ Local negotiation: Prepare country contract templates; Draft and send Site Agreements or any contracts associated to sites to begin negotiations; Provide site contract execution planned timelines and site negotiation status; Send items for translation, if applicable. Receive and translate items; Reviewing study budgets and costs pertaining to contract negotiation; Negotiate contract(s) language and budget(s) with each assigned site to finalization / execution; Escalate to Site Contracts Lead site requests outside of preapproved parameters, to be forwarded to the Sponsor; Escalate risks and non-responsive sites to Site Contracts Lead or internal team, as applicable; If required to provide equipment to the sites, ensure appropriate information or appendix is added in Site Agreements or any document associated; Create donation agreement, as applicable; Review Site Agreements or any contracts associated for completeness and accuracy; Finalize contract and budget with sites; Perform quality check of Site Agreements or any documents associated before signature process starts; If requested, provide draft/signed contract/budget to the regulatory team for submission purpose, where needed; Liaising with Worldwide Legal Department, Data Privacy team, study teams, Sponsor, sites, investigators etc. Facilitate contracts signature by Worldwide, when applicable; Send Fully Executed Site Agreements or any document associated to: site, eTMF, payment team, Sponsor, post to internal Sharepoint, as applicable; Negotiate Site Agreements Amendment language and budget with sites; Create termination letter or any other type of documents related, and send to sites for signature, as applicable; Maintain tracking tool with live/real-time/regular updates for functional activities; Prioritizes effectively and responds to urgent requests within internal team or Sponsor. Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. *OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:* *Contract Negotiation:* Proficient in negotiating contract terms with clinical sites and vendors. Ability to identify and address contract issues and disputes efficiently. *Regulatory Compliance*: Good understanding of international and local regulatory require-ments for clinical trials (e.g., FDA, EMA, ICH-GCP). Ensure all contracts comply with the latest regulations and guidelines. *Communication*: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective interac-tion with internal stakeholders and clinical sites. Ability to clearly explain contract terms and processes. Solid analytical skills to review and interpret contract terms and finan-cial data. Ability to identify risks and develop mitigation strategies. *Collaboration and Teamwork*: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including legal, finance, and clinical operations. Strong project management skills to handle multiple site contracts simultaneously. Ability to prioritize tasks, manage timelines, and ensure contract deliv-erables are met. *Technical Proficiency*: Proficiency in contract management software and tools. Strong problem-solving skills to address and resolve contract-related issues. Ability to think critically and strategically to overcome challenges. High level of accuracy in reviewing and drafting contracts. Ability to identify and correct discrepancies or potential issues in con-tract documentation. Understanding of budgeting and financial principles related to clinical trial contracts. Ability to negotiate cost-effective terms and manage financial aspects of contracts. Basic understanding of legal terminology and principles related to con-tracts. Ability to work closely with legal counsel to ensure all contracts meet legal and regulatory requirements. Strong time management skills to meet deadlines and manage the contract lifecycle efficiently. Ability to handle high volumes of work and work under pressure. *REQUIREMENTS:* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in business administration, finance, science or related field. 1 to 3 years of experience in Clinical Research Pharmaceutical or CRO industry working with investigator/site contracts or related legal field. Excellent verbal and written English language skills. Proficiency with MS Word, Excel and Outlook. Knowledge and understanding of ICH and GCP Guidelines, as well as local country legislation in the sphere of clinical trials and local regulatory requirements. Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently. Discover the Difference We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn. This is who we are. We’re a team of clinicians, scientists, and researchers who want to make healthcare better. We were founded on an unwavering commitment to authentic, personalized attention. And today, as CROs consolidate and the industry changes rapidly, that personalized attention is more important than ever. We all came to this industry for different reasons, from different walks of life. If you ask any one of us why we’re here, you’ll get a different answer. And that’s what makes us special. jobs.title: Senior C# Back-End Developer
jobs.excerpt: Join Revive Media to help advertisers across the country scale their localized ads.
jobs.description:
Join Revive Media to help advertisers across the country scale their localized ads. Our business is in the midst of transforming from a services agency to a product-led business with our new native platform. The platform is live with external partners, and we're expanding its reach. This role will help us build the new features that power that growth, and you'll have real ownership over what we ship next.

As a Senior Back-End Developer, your primary responsibility will be to design, develop, and maintain robust and high-performing back-end systems that meet our growing business needs. Partnered closely with the product management and front-end development teams as well as our principal architect, you will play a critical role in the entire application lifecycle, focusing primarily on coding, debugging, and testing back-end APIs and integrations into third-party systems. Your in-depth knowledge and expertise in C# and .NET frameworks will be instrumental in continuing to build a scalable and maintainable internal and customer-facing application.

We are a remote-first culture and virtual team of high-performing professionals with diverse backgrounds located across many time zones, including North America, Europe, and Asia. We prioritize asynchronous communication and documentation but come together as a team to solve hard problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Development and Coding
    • Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code in C# using .NET 10 and Entity Framework.
    • Develop and support software including applications, database integration, interfaces, and new functionality enhancements.
    • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure project meets business objectives and compliance standards.
    • Build and maintain unit and integration tests for critical software components.
  • Team Collaboration and Leadership
    • Collaborate with product managers and front-end developers to establish objectives and design more functional, cohesive codes to enhance user experience.
    • Assist product managers in determining a realistic level of effort and timeline for a given feature or scope of work.
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to fix and improve products.
    • Document development phases and monitor systems.
  • Compliance & Best Practices
    • Implement code using secure development best practices.
    • Select and update packages used within the application to ensure a high level of security and maintainability.
    • Ensure software compliance with GDPR or other regulatory standards as required.

Requirements

Technical Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 9 years of experience in back-end development, including 8+ years with C# and .NET.
  • Programming Languages: Highly proficient in C#. Familiarity with TypeScript and/or React is preferred but not required.
  • .NET Framework: Extensive experience with .NET, minimally .NET 6, with a preference for candidates who have experience with .NET 10.
  • Database Management: Proficient in SQL and experience with database design and management. Knowledge of NoSQL databases is a plus.
  • API Development: Extensive experience in developing and integrating RESTful APIs, preferably using Minimal API.
  • Dependency Injection: Thorough understanding of dependency injection concepts and experience with its implementation.
  • ORM: Experience with a modern ORM like Entity Framework.
  • Amazon AWS: Familiarity with AWS and the .NET tools used to interact with the various services like SNS, SQS, SES, S3, Lambda, Bedrock, etc.

Other Requirements

  • Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think algorithmically.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Independence: Ability to make decisions independently and collaborate where necessary.
  • Teamwork: Ability to collaborate with team members and work under pressure in a fast-paced remote environment.
  • Time Management: Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Continuous Learning: A strong commitment to continuous personal and professional development.
  • Location: Based in the United States of America

Benefits

  • Comprehensive healthcare including medical, vision & dental benefits covered at 100% for employees and 50% for dependents
  • We're fully Remote and offer a remote working stipend
  • Flexible PTO - take what you need, when you need
  • Coffee or Tea Subscription
  • Monthly 3 day weekend

Revive Media provides the wage it reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for all remote roles and as otherwise required by applicable law. The expected annual base pay for this role is $165,000 - $180,000. Actual compensation may vary within the listed range based on a wide array of factors including, but not limited to, skill set, experience, and specific geographic location. The role also includes a target annual bonus of 10%, paid out quarterly based on performance. Total compensation typically ranges from $180,000 to $200,000. All new hires have equity in the business.

Revive Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We assess all qualified candidates on the basis of skill, experience and talent.

jobs.title: Senior Export Specialist
jobs.excerpt: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and...
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The Legal Compliance Organization (LCO) provides legal guidance to further KLA’s strategic objectives and protect and preserve the company's legal, ethical and financial integrity and reputation. Drawing on expertise in corporate law, commercial law, employment law, ethics and compliance, and intellectual property, the LCO offers strategic legal counsel that is informed by a clear understanding of the company’s business objectives and knowledge of the laws and regulations relevant to the business worldwide.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.


The Senior Export Specialist is a key member of the Global Trade Compliance team responsible for ensuring compliant, efficient, and scalable import and export operations with a primary focus on U.S. export controls and export compliance, while supporting import compliance. This role is responsible for complex tariff classification, export control compliance activities, import compliance controls, analytics, audit support, process design, and cross-functional trade compliance initiatives. The position partners closely with Legal, Logistics, Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, Product Management, Customs Brokers, and regional trade teams to standardize processes, improve data quality, implement automation opportunities, and maintain compliance with export control, sanctions, and customs regulations across global trade operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support ECCN determinations, export jurisdiction/classification reviews, and support HS/HTS classifications for semiconductor equipment, spare parts, components, electronics, software, and related technologies.
  • Review and validate broker filings, internal AES filings, customs documentation, customs values, country of origin declarations, and trade remedy applicability.
  • Support export control reviews, restricted party screening escalations, license requirement assessments / decrementing, license exception analysis, and voluntary disclosure evaluations, as needed.
  • Post-clearance reviews, disclosures, and compliance inquiries.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve trade compliance processes, controls, SOPs, and governance procedures.
  • Develop exception reporting, validation controls, systemic data feeds, and compliance monitoring metrics for ECCN, license determination/decrementing, restricted party screening, HTS, origin, and clearance data.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, compliance analytics, and exception reporting to monitor key trade compliance KPIs.
  • Identify operational and regulatory risks, and drive data-driven decision making. Partner closely with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and external service providers to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, and alignment with broker instructions, service level expectations, and established standard operating procedures.
  • Lead trade compliance projects, system enhancements, and automation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Logistics teams, procurement, engineering, and manufacturing, logistics providers, customs brokers, to standardize global processes.
  • Support internal and external audits and conduct periodic reviews of trade compliance controls and records.
  • Monitor regulatory changes related to export controls, sanctions, customs, and trade remedies and present risk assessments and recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in International Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, Finance, Legal or related field.
  • Strong knowledge of EAR requirements, ECCN classification, export licensing concepts, restricted party screening, sanctions/embargo controls, and technology/software transfer considerations.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. Customs regulations, tariff classification, valuation, country of origin, and import documentation.
  • Experience responding to export control inquiries, customs audits, and regulatory inquiries.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Experience within semiconductor, electronics, advanced manufacturing, or other technology industries, especially environments involving controlled technology, software, encryption, or complex global supply chains.
  • LCB, CCS, CES, or similar certification preferred.
  • Experience with SAP GTS, SAP, ACE reporting, or trade management systems.
  • Experience designing controls, validations, automation solutions, and exception-based monitoring for export controls and import compliance.
  • Advanced Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
  • Advanced Excel skills including Power Query, Pivot Tables, and XLOOKUP.
  • Ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into business actions.
  • Experience supporting workflow automation and digital transformation initiatives across export classification, screening, licensing, and import compliance processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.



Total Rewards

Base Pay Range: $100,000.00 - $170,000.00 AnnuallyPrimary Location: USA-MI-Ann Arbor-KLA

KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave.

Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.



Use of AI Statement

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.



Equal Opportunity Statement

KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at or at +1-408-352-2808 to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Senior Manager/Assoc Dir, Product Marketing
jobs.excerpt: The AutoVitals suite of SaaS products is designed to solve many of the current hurdles faced by auto repair shops.
jobs.description:
The AutoVitals suite of SaaS products is designed to solve many of the current hurdles faced by auto repair shops. Our mission is to help auto repair shops drive profitable growth by attracting new customers, delivering superior communication and customer service, increasing shop efficiency, and raising average repair orders.

We are building product marketing as a dedicated function for the first time and looking for someone to own it and build it. This role takes our products to market: positioning and messaging across the suite, who each product is for by shop size and by role, the launch plans that turn a release into revenue, and our competitive picture. This is a hands-on role. You will write the messaging, build the plan, and sit with sales to make sure it lands. Over time you will build the function, hire and develop product marketers, and put in place the standards and playbooks it runs on. The scope of this role grows with the function you build.

Product marketing works across product, sales, and marketing. You take what is coming from Product and turn it into something Sales can sell. Before a campaign goes out, this role provides the air cover: segmented messaging and content that warms up a market so a prospect is already primed when sales makes contact. You will coordinate with demand generation and content so one message reaches each segment through one plan, not several.

Responsibilities

  • Own positioning, messaging, and value proposition for every product in the AutoVitals suite, grounded in buyer needs and differentiated by shop size and by buyer role
  • Define who we sell to by revenue band, location count, and role, and keep that segmentation and their pain points current as the product catalog and market evolve
  • Partner with Product on what is coming and translate the roadmap into market-facing language before it ships
  • Partner with Brand on product naming and identity so the product story and the company story line up
  • Own the go-to-market plan for every launch on the product roadmap, including audience, message, sequence, channels, internal readiness across sales, support, training, and shop success, and the measures of whether it worked
  • Own the launch communication plan across clients, prospects, and internal teams, including FAQs so everyone answers questions the same way
  • Own adoption of features already in market, not just what is new, so existing shops know what they have and use it
  • Own the competitive picture end to end, including who we win against, who we lose to, and why, with battlecards, win and loss themes, and positioning against the platforms shops evaluate alongside us
  • Bring the competitive read into pricing, packaging, and roadmap conversations, and keep leadership current on what is changing in the market
  • Build the material sales actually uses: decks, one-pagers, talk tracks, objection handling, and FAQs tied to the problems shops are trying to solve
  • Own the customer proof points and reference stories sales relies on, and work with content to get them produced
  • Give campaigns air cover with segmented messaging and content that runs ahead of outreach, coordinating with demand generation and content so one consistent message reaches each segment
  • Measure what you build against sales adoption and pipeline, and improve it based on what closes
  • Build product marketing into a function with defined standards, process, and an operating cadence with product, sales, and the rest of marketing so launches are planned, not reactive
  • Hire, onboard, and develop product marketers as the team grows, and define how they align to areas of the product and their product management counterparts

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product marketing at a B2B SaaS or technology company
  • Experience conducting market discovery through customer, prospect, and win and loss interviews, then translating those insights into validated market problems, buyer personas, positioning, and go-to-market decisions
  • Experience managing or developing product marketers and building the process, standards, and playbooks a function runs on, not only doing the work yourself
  • Track record owning product launches end to end, from positioning through sales readiness and results
  • Strong writer and clear communicator who can take a technical product and say plainly what it does and who it is for, across all levels of an organization
  • Experience building competitive intelligence from scratch, including research, battlecards, and win and loss analysis
  • Experience segmenting a market and building differentiated messaging by segment and by buyer role
  • Comfortable working directly with sales reps, sitting in on calls, and building what they will actually use
  • Data-literate, able to connect messaging and launch work to pipeline and bookings
  • Comfortable building from scratch in a fast-moving environment where not everything is defined yet
  • Bonus
    • Pragmatic Marketing or Product Marketing Alliance certification
    • Experience taking a multi-product platform to market
    • Experience marketing to small and medium-sized businesses, particularly in automotive, home services, or a similar vertical
    • Familiarity with Salesforce and HubSpot
    • Background or knowledge of the automotive repair industry

Salary Range Transparency

Annual Total Compensation Range: $135,000 – $155,000 OTE (On Target Earnings include 10% Bonus)

Individual compensation offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, applicable skills, educational background, relevant experience

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 401K Match
  • Flexible PTO

Représentant(e) aux ventes – E-commerce (Canada et États-Unis)

Au sein de notre équipe e-commerce, vous gérez l'ensemble du cycle de vente auprès d'entreprises B2B au Canada et aux États-Unis, de la prospection jusqu'à la signature du contrat. Vous travaillez de pair avec nos consultants en solutions, notre équipe de développement, le marketing et notre réseau de partenaires.

Ce poste s'adresse à une personne qui souhaite grandir : vous développerez votre expertise en vente de solutions et évoluerez avec nous.

Votre mission : transformer des prospects en clients en menant chaque opportunité de la première conversation jusqu'à la signature du contrat, tout en contribuant à la croissance de nos comptes et de notre marque.


Responsabilités

Prospection et qualification

  • Prospecter de nouveaux clients B2B au Canada et aux États-Unis

  • Bâtir et entretenir un pipeline de ventes solide
  • Collaborer avec le marketing sur les campagnes et proposer des idées

Cycle de vente complet

  • Obtenir les estimations auprès de l'équipe de développement
  • Préparer les propositions, négocier prix et conditions
  • Préparer les contrats et conclure les ventes
  • Utiliser les outils d'IA mis à votre disposition et contribuer à en développer de nouveaux usages pour automatiser les tâches répétitives (rédaction de courriels et de soumissions, résumés d'appels, mise à jour du CRM, recherche de prospects)

Clients, partenaires et CRM

  • Produire les prévisions de ventes
  • Soutenir occasionnellement l'équipe Account Management
  • Entretenir les relations avec nos partenaires référents et contribuer au programme de partenariat
  • Partager les retours clients avec le marketing et le produit
  • Suivre la concurrence et les tendances du marché

Profil recherché

Exigences

  • Formation : DEC ou baccalauréat en vente, marketing, administration ou domaine connexe
  • Expérience : 2 à 4 ans en vente B2B, de la prospection à la conclusion
  • Langues : français, et anglais fonctionnel à l'oral et à l'écrit pour communiquer avec clients, partenaires et collègues
  • Résultats : historique démontré d'atteinte d'objectifs de vente
  • Mobilité : déplacements occasionnels au Canada et aux États-Unis (passeport valide)
    •

Atouts

  • Vente de solutions logicielles (ERP, e-commerce, SaaS)
  • Connaissance de Microsoft Dynamics CRM
  • Pratique de la vente-conseil ou consultative
  • Expérience de vente sur le marché américain
  • Expérience en développement de partenariats ou de ventes par référence
  • Formation en techniques de vente

Qualités recherchées

  • Proactivité : vous créez les occasions au lieu de les attendre
  • Orientation résultats : vous suivez vos objectifs et les dépassez
  • Esprit d'équipe : vous travaillez main dans la main avec les autres équipes
  • Envie d'évoluer : vous voulez apprendre et grandir avec nous

Ce que nous offrons

  • Salaire de base compétitif et commissions sur les ventes
  • Assurances collectives et régime de retraite

· Possibilité de travail hybride

  • Accompagnement, formation continue et réelles perspectives d'évolution au sein d'un groupe international
  • Une équipe collaborative et un environnement stable

Seuls les candidats retenus seront contactés.


Harris Computer souscrit au principe d'équité en matière d'emploi; les candidatures des femmes, des personnes handicapées, des Autochtones et des minorités visibles sont encouragées. jobs.title: Epic Clinical Decision Support Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Prominence Advisors is actively seeking an Epic Clinical Decision Support Analyst to join our team.
jobs.description:
Prominence Advisors is actively seeking an Epic Clinical Decision Support Analyst to join our team.

Who We Are

Prominence is a healthcare and life sciences technology and consulting firm dedicated to helping leading organizations do more with their data. With deep expertise across the full ecosystem — spanning providers, payers, and life sciences — we turn complex data into actionable insight.

We deliver a full spectrum of services, including advisory, analytics, optimization, and IT staffing. Our work helps organizations operate more efficiently, improve patient outcomes, and deliver measurable financial impact through smarter use of data. Recognized as a 2x Best in KLAS organization, we partner with more than 120 health systems and 40 life sciences organizations, including 7 of the top 10 U.S. News & World Report-ranked institutions.

Through our life sciences brands, Tegra Analytics and WLH Consulting & Learning Solutions, we extend these capabilities to pharmaceutical and biotech organizations — combining data, consulting, and learning to advance commercial excellence.

By connecting strategy, data, and execution, we help organizations translate data into clarity, strategy into action, and vision into measurable results. At our core, we are a people-first, values-driven organization that believes strong teams and trusted partnerships are what ultimately make healthcare and life sciences smarter.

Job Summary

Prominence is looking for an Epic Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Analyst with deep, hands-on experience building and optimizing BestPractice Advisories (BPAs) and Health Maintenance to support a leading academic health system. This role will assess the organization’s existing clinical decision support build, modernize and optimize alerts, reduce technical debt, and partner with Nursing Informatics and clinical stakeholders to deliver smarter, more sustainable CDS workflows that support clinicians and improve patient care. This is not a general Epic application support role. The ideal candidate brings direct experience managing, building, and optimizing clinical decision support tools in Epic.

  • Review, modernize, and optimize existing BestPractice and OurPractice Advisories (BPAs/OPAs), including Discontinue and Defer functionality.
  • Clean up outdated CDS build, standardize BPA metadata, and reduce technical debt across the clinical decision support environment.
  • Address CDS-related opportunities identified through Epic Gold Stars assessments.
  • Establish and maintain an organized OPA catalog, including a regular review cycle and a process for tracking alert success.
  • Build, troubleshoot, and optimize Health Maintenance workflows.
  • Update test scripts and support new project requests (NPRs) related to clinical decision support.
  • Partner with Nursing Informatics to improve CDS workflows and establish sustainable, well-documented handoff processes.
  • Independently assess existing Epic build, identify improvement opportunities, and implement changes.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience as an Epic analyst.
  • Active Epic certification in EpicCare Inpatient or EpicCare Ambulatory.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and optimizing BestPractice Advisories (BPAs) and other CDS alerts.
  • Experience with Health Maintenance build and clinical decision support workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently assess existing Epic build, identify improvements, and implement changes.
  • Experience collaborating with Nursing Informatics and clinical stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain build decisions and recommendations to clinical and non-technical audiences.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience leading alert optimization, alert fatigue reduction, or CDS governance initiatives.
  • Experience addressing recommendations from Epic Gold Stars or similar Epic-led optimization assessments.
  • Experience building or managing an alert catalog with defined review cycles and success metrics.
  • Experience writing and executing test scripts and supporting new project requests (NPRs).
  • Certification in both EpicCare Inpatient and EpicCare Ambulatory, or additional Epic certifications.
  • Experience using Epic reporting tools (such as Reporting Workbench or Radar dashboards) to measure alert performance.
  • Experience supporting a large academic medical center or multi-hospital health system.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Thermal-Fluid Systems
jobs.excerpt: About Skyven At Skyven Technologies, we are replacing industrial boilers with electric heat pumps that make process steam at a lower cost than burning fuel.
jobs.description:
About Skyven

At Skyven Technologies, we are replacing industrial boilers with electric heat pumps that make process steam at a lower cost than burning fuel. Under the hood, our Arcturus heat pump is an open-cycle mechanical vapor recompression (MVR) system: we flash hot water to low-pressure steam, then compress that steam with multi-stage centrifugal machinery up to the pressure the plant needs. We give our customers two options to deploy the heat pump: (A) a traditional CAPEX purchase, and (B) an innovative Energy-as-a-Service (EaaS) model with zero CAPEX and savings from day one. Either way, customers save money and reduce emissions while minimizing risk.

We are past the lab: our first commercial systems are in execution at industrial customer sites, and we keep pushing the technology at our Demo Center. This is a role for someone who wants to do serious engineering in a startup environment: move quickly, think deeply, work with strong people, and help turn ambitious concepts into equipment that works in the field.

Why This Role

  • You will be the lead mechanical engineer on the first commercial units of a new class of multi-megawatt industrial machine, not the next copy of a proven design.
  • Your designs get built and run in operating plants, and your decisions will carry into every unit that follows.
  • You get both halves of engineering: first-principles design on novel equipment, and the rigor of real industrial execution.
  • Small team, real influence: you work directly with the CTO, and your judgment shapes the product.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer who exemplifies strong engineering judgment combined with strong practical mechanical engineering capability. We especially value engineers who have spent time close to real hardware in the field and know the difference between what looks good on paper and what really works.

You will own the mechanical side of our first commercial deployments, from P&ID through vendor selection, drawings, fabrication, and startup. Most of your time will go to project execution, with the rest on product development for future sites. You will bring deep practical mechanical judgment to the team’s system-level and conceptual thinking, turning ambitious concepts into designs that can actually be built, commissioned, operated, and maintained. This is an individual contributor role, but we are looking for someone with the maturity and breadth to grow into the technical lead for our mechanical systems.

This role is for someone who is energized by understanding how an entire system works, not just producing drawings or sourcing parts. You should be the kind of engineer who wants to understand the “why” behind requirements, spot weaknesses in a design, ask hard questions early, and improve a system’s performance, operability, reliability, and cost. One day that may mean digging into system architecture, operability, or failure modes. Another day it may mean reviewing a P&ID, building CAD, tightening a spec, challenging a vendor design, or catching issues in a drawing package before they become field problems.

What You’ll Work On

Arcturus is an industrial steam system, not an HVAC unit. The hardware and physics you will own include:

  • Saturated water and steam systems from vacuum up to tens of bar: flash vessels, hot water recirculation, condensate return, venting, and draining
  • Multi-megawatt, multi-stage centrifugal steam compression (larger systems exceed 10 MWe), plus the motors, VFDs, and controls around it
  • Heat exchangers, pumps (including low-NPSH service), control valves, relief devices, steam traps, strainers, and instrumentation
  • Skidded and modular packages, pressure vessels, and the piping, supports, and thermal growth that tie them together
  • Integration into operating plants: utility tie-ins, battery limits, outdoor installation, and freeze protection

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as lead mechanical engineer on a commercial Arcturus project, owning the inside-battery-limits (ISBL) mechanical design and coordinating with our engineering firm on the site side
  • Help develop and refine industrial thermal-fluid systems with a strong eye toward buildability, operability, maintainability, and cost
  • Create and maintain P&IDs, system layouts, piping concepts, mechanical arrangements, and equipment designs
  • Create CAD models, assemblies, and drawings for fabricated items in SolidWorks, not just review them
  • Help bring rigor to PDM and drawing control as we move from conceptual into detailed design
  • Critically review prints, layouts, and design packages and catch issues before they reach fabrication or the field
  • Review engineering firm deliverables, including site (OSBL) design and any ISBL checks we ask them to do
  • Work across process, mechanical, electrical, controls, and field considerations rather than staying narrowly inside one discipline
  • Develop technical specifications, datasheets, and RFQ packages for major mechanical equipment, valves, instrumentation, and supporting components
  • Lead technical vendor engagement: work directly with suppliers and fabricators to compare quotes, review submittals and designs, answer RFIs, and make sound judgments on open-ended engineering questions
  • Lead and contribute to HAZOP and FMEA reviews to find what we have missed
  • Support installation, commissioning, and startup, including time on site when it matters
  • Identify opportunities to standardize or automate parts of the design process, including AI tools, engineering tools, design workflows, drawing generation, or CAD workflows
  • Help raise the technical level of the team through strong review, clear reasoning, and high standards while keeping an eye on speed and pragmatism

The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here

This role is a strong fit for someone who:

  • Thinks from first principles and wants to understand how the system really works
  • Has strong intuition for mechanical design, field realities, and failure modes
  • Takes ownership, notices what others miss, and is comfortable speaking up
  • Makes sound engineering calls in ambiguous, first-of-a-kind, or cross-disciplinary situations
  • Communicates clearly with engineers, vendors, fabricators, and leadership

How We Use AI

AI lets a small team do the work of a much larger one, and we use it extensively, every day, across all of engineering. We use it to research unfamiliar equipment, run and check calculations, draft specifications and reports, review drawings and vendor data, and automate repetitive work.

We expect you to already use AI tools regularly in your engineering work, and to push that further here. Use it to go faster and cover more ground. Also know exactly which outputs you have independently verified and which you have not. AI produces plausible-looking errors, and catching them takes real engineering judgment. You own the result either way.

Our interview process includes a hands-on exercise where AI use is expected. If you are skeptical of AI or prefer not to use it in your work, this role is not a good fit.

How Fast We Move

Your work turns into real hardware quickly. We work in weeks, not quarters. Taking a concept package to RFQ-ready should take a small team a few weeks, not several months. Reviews are short and focused, and decisions get made by the people doing the work.

We care a lot about rigor. Speed and rigor are compatible when engineers understand the physics and know what level of detail each stage of a design actually needs. If you are used to large-company timelines and approval layers, expect an adjustment.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years designing or specifying industrial thermal-fluid or process equipment: steam, hot water, refrigeration, process, oil and gas, chemical or power plant systems. Component-level, vehicle, consumer product or building HVAC experience alone is not a match.
  • Strong fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer, and the ability to reason from first principles about water and steam systems
  • Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals across piping, pressure vessels, materials, heat exchangers, rotating equipment, skidded systems, bearings, and fabrication
  • Skill creating and modifying P&IDs and translating system intent into practical hardware
  • Strong 3D CAD capability, ideally SolidWorks (Creo, NX or Inventor are fine), including creating models and drawings yourself
  • Experience writing specifications and working directly with vendors and fabricators
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your engineering work, with good habits for verifying what they produce
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites and vendor shops (up to about 10%), with more during installation and commissioning
  • Live in and authorized to work in the US, without sponsorship

Especially Valuable

The engineers who do best here usually have both of these in their background:

  • R&D or first-of-a-kind product development, where you had to figure out how something should work rather than follow an established standard
  • Real industrial execution at an EPC, an equipment OEM, a heavy equipment company, or in plant engineering, where you learned how equipment actually gets specified, built, installed, and maintained

Also valuable:

  • Experience in an industrial startup or fast-moving product development environment
  • Hands-on field, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, or plant support experience
  • Experience with pumps, compressors, turbomachinery, steam systems, MVR, evaporators, industrial heat pumps, or other thermal-fluid systems
  • Working knowledge of relevant codes and standards such as ASME (B31.1, B31.3, Section VIII) and API
  • HAZOP and FMEA experience
  • Owning or administering PDM (SolidWorks PDM or similar)
  • Experience reviewing or developing piping layouts, supports, stress/life considerations, materials selections, and fabrication details
  • Strong print review instincts: the ability to find issues, inconsistencies, and bad assumptions in mechanical design packages
  • Experience improving engineering workflows through Python, scripting, automation, design tools, or model-based approaches

What We Value

We value engineers who are curious, rigorous, hard to fool, and hard to impress. We are especially interested in people who combine first principles thinking with practical mechanical depth, independent thinking, and high ownership. We also want people who respect the codes, standards, and practices that make industrial equipment safe and buildable. A great idea that ignores the rules won’t get built, and a design that only follows the rules won’t be good enough to build.

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO
  • Stock options
  • Medical, dental, and 401k benefits
  • Salary range: $130,000 to $160,000

Location

  • We are a remote-first organization; this role is fully remote.
  • The candidate must be currently based in and have the right to work in the United States.
  • We are not able to sponsor or transfer visas, including H-1B transfers.

jobs.excerpt: Protect Democracy is seeking an experienced entrepreneurial Program Manager to join the Neighbors Lead team at an important moment in the program's launch and growth.
jobs.description:
Protect Democracy is seeking an experienced entrepreneurial Program Manager to join the Neighbors Lead team at an important moment in the program's launch and growth.

At Protect Democracy, we anchor our work in service to our mission: to prevent American democracy from declining into a more authoritarian form of government. Neighbors Lead is a pilot initiative built on a simple idea: when community members work together across lines of difference, trust grows, and strong, resilient communities follow. In partnership with trusted local organizations, we recruit, train, and support Civic Captains, community members who lead civic projects in their own communities. The program is underway in Mecklenburg County, NC, and is expanding to Kenosha County, WI, and additional sites.

If you're someone who thrives at integrating strategy across several workstreams, such as evaluation, scaling, and communications, but doesn't want to lose touch with the community members the work is for, this role was designed with you in mind.

As a member of the Neighbors Lead team, you will help us answer two questions: what is this pilot teaching us, and how do we tell that story well? You will make sure our evaluation work and our communications are on track and of high quality, working with the partners and colleagues driving the underlying work. You will also manage program delivery at an assigned site, including its cohort recruitment and onboarding, and be a thought partner to the head of the program as we work through what it would take to grow Neighbors Lead if the evidence supports it.

This role is a good fit for someone who is equally comfortable in a spreadsheet as they are in a conversation with a community partner, who enjoys building systems while a program is still taking shape, and who cares about getting both the relationships and our need for rigor right. Occasional travel to program sites is expected.

The Program Manager for Learning and Outreach will:

Manage program delivery at an assigned site

  • Serve as the Program Manager for an assigned pilot location in 2027—upcoming locations are in WI, GA, and NC—working closely with the site's Program Coordinator and local partner organization across the cohort cycle;

  • Make sure what we learn from the data and from your site’s cohort feeds back into how we recruit, onboard, and support our next cohort, and share those lessons with the rest of the team.

Oversee data and evaluation work across all sites

  • Work with our evaluation partners to keep evaluation work consistent, high quality, and on schedule across sites;

  • Oversee Civic-Captain-focused data collection and quality across our pilot sites, keeping data practices consistent as new sites come online;

  • Make sure analysis of Civic Captain relationship and network data is done well and translated into insights the team can use.

Oversee communications

  • Oversee communications for Neighbors Lead, including recruitment and outreach materials, partner and community messaging, and the program's brand and website, primarily by working with the partners and colleagues who produce the core work;

  • Serve as the connective link across those partners and workstreams, making sure materials are produced on time, reflect the program's goals, and can speak to community members and partners from a wide range of backgrounds and viewpoints.

Help shape how and if the program grows

  • Partner with the Program Lead on questions of scale: what the evidence suggests, what the operations would require, and what we should test next.

The ideal candidate brings:

  • Six or more years of relevant professional experience, such as administering a community engagement program, with a track record of owning complex work with limited supervision;

  • Experience overseeing evaluation, research, or data work carried out by others, such as staff, vendors, or external partners, including setting expectations, holding the work to quality standards and timelines, and turning results into decisions and clear reporting;

  • Strong project management skills, with proven ability to keep several workstreams and partners on schedule at once, including day-to-day program delivery at a site;

  • Skill in building and maintaining relationships with external partners, vendors, and community organizations, including when interests and timelines differ;

  • Excellent writing and communications judgment, including experience shaping messaging for varied audiences and guiding others who produce communications materials;

  • Familiarity with community engagement or grassroots approaches, and curiosity about how community-level change happens;

  • Sound judgment and discretion, with a high degree of integrity in handling sensitive and confidential information, including information about program participants;

  • Passion for protecting and improving our democracy and for building trust in communities, and enthusiasm for working with people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives;

  • Comfort in a fast-paced, evolving environment where processes are still being built, and a growth mindset with comfort giving and receiving feedback up, down, and sideways;

  • Willingness to work in alignment with 501(c)(3) requirements and to maintain a strictly nonpartisan posture in all program work;

  • Ability to travel to program sites, particularly in the lead-up to program launch in that location.

Pluses, but not requirements:

  • Enough comfort with survey data and quantitative reporting to question evaluation partners' methods and results, and the ability to explain findings to non-technical colleagues;

  • Deep experience as a community or relational organizer;

  • Familiarity with data tools, such as statistical software or CRM and database platforms;

  • Experience with brand, website, or content management.

We don't expect any one candidate to meet every qualification listed here. What matters most is an ability to lead complex, multi-partner programs with limited supervision, sound judgment with sensitive information, and a real interest in building trust in communities. jobs.description:
Who is PX

PX is a customer acquisition technology platform that connects consumers who are actively shopping for insurance, Medicare, mortgages, solar, home services, and more with the businesses that can help them. Our real-time marketplace verifies, checks consent on, and routes millions of consumer inquiries a month from vetted publishers to buyers ranging from national brands to local agents. Founded by lead generation operators who launched the platform in 2015 to build the infrastructure they wished they'd had, PX is headquartered in New York and still led by its founders. We're growing our presence across internal media, and we're looking for someone to assist that growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Paid Media – Social to own paid acquisition across social advertising networks from strategy through execution, expansion, and optimization. You'll drive annual gross margin growth for your channel while maintaining strict compliance standards in the insurance lead generation space, operating with full ownership: building scalable systems, shaping creative direction within our brand standards, and partnering cross-functionally to lift lead conversion and overall marketplace performance. This is a role for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who wants to drive their channel's results and build something repeatable

What You'll Do

Revenue & Margin Ownership

  • Own and achieve annual gross margin targets for your channel(s) and vertical(s)
  • Develop and execute channel expansion strategies to accelerate growth
  • Manage and optimize multiple traffic networks to maximize profitability
  • Communicate the resources and growth levers needed to hit performance goals

Strategy & Performance Leadership

  • Lead strategy across social paid acquisition
  • Develop the creative vision for the channel within company branding and quality standards
  • Continuously test, iterate, and optimize campaign structure, targeting, and creative
  • Drive consistent multi-vertical growth aligned with seasonality and long-term scaling goals
  • Maintain best-practices documentation to build repeatable systems

Website & CRO Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Website Marketing team to improve lead conversion rates
  • Keep site vision aligned with traffic strategy
  • Provide performance insights that inform the landing page testing roadmap

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure campaigns and messaging stay compliant with regulatory and carrier requirements
  • Proactively monitor network and regulatory changes to mitigate risk
  • Keep documentation of best practices, learnings, and processes organized

Stakeholder Communication

  • Present progress toward goals clearly and concisely to leadership
  • Report on margin performance, testing velocity, and growth initiatives
  • Advocate for your channel and back your strategic decisions with data

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • 6+ years in performance/direct-response media, with meaningful time spent in lead generation (insurance a plus), not just brand or ecommerce
  • Expert-level, hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns on Meta and other major social advertising networks
  • A track record managing significant monthly media spend on social
  • Proven ability to manage multiple paid traffic networks simultaneously

Lead Gen Expertise

  • Deep fluency in lead gen economics - CPL, CPA, lead-to-sale conversion, and how traffic quality translates to downstream margin, not just platform-reported ROAS

Leadership & Communication

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and a full ownership mentality
  • Highly organized and process-driven, with a habit of documenting what works
  • Clear, confident communication with the ability to present performance to stakeholders
  • Experience coaching and developing team members is a plus

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field preferred

How Success Is Measured

  • Achievement of annual gross margin targets
  • Consistent year-over-year multi-vertical growth aligned with seasonal demand
  • Expansion of channel capacity and scalability
  • Development and refinement of systems and tools to create efficiency.

jobs.description:
Für unseren Kunden, ein führendes Unternehmen im Versicherungsumfeld, suchen wir einen erfahrenen Adobe AEM Forms Developer / Engineer zur Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung einer geschäftskritischen eForms-Plattform.

Im Mittelpunkt steht die Ablösung einer bestehenden Java-EE-basierten Prozess-Engine durch eine moderne, skalierbare und wartungsfreundliche Architektur. Die Plattform übernimmt zentrale Funktionen wie die Verarbeitung digitaler Formulare, Datenvorbefüllung, PDF-Generierung, E-Mail-Kommunikation und Integration verschiedener Umsysteme.

Neben der technischen Neugestaltung der Plattform verantwortest du gemeinsam mit dem Team den stabilen und sicheren Betrieb der bestehenden AEM-Forms-Landschaft.

Entwicklung & Modernisierung der eForms-Plattform

  • Analyse bestehender JEE-Prozesse, Systemarchitekturen und technischer Abhängigkeiten
  • Konzeption und Implementierung einer modernen Architektur zur Ablösung der bestehenden JEE-Prozess-Engine
  • Evaluation geeigneter Technologien und Lösungsansätze, insbesondere AEM OSGi, Flowable und AEM-Standardfunktionen
  • Entwicklung zentraler Services für Formularverarbeitung, Submission, Queueing, Auditing, Prefilling und PDF-Generierung
  • Konzeption und Implementierung von Schnittstellen zu CRM-, Kafka-, ECM- und weiteren Umsystemen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Monitoring, Health-Checks und technischen Dashboards
  • Sicherstellung einer skalierbaren, performanten und wartungsfreundlichen Lösungsarchitektur

Migration, Testing & Deployment

  • Migration bestehender Formulare und Prozesse auf die neue Plattform
  • Aufbau und Automatisierung von Build- und Deployment-Prozessen mittels Jenkins und CI/CD
  • Entwicklung und Durchführung automatisierter Unit-, Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests
  • Sicherstellung eines stabilen Parallelbetriebs während der Migration
  • Begleitung des Go-Lives und schrittweise Ablösung der bisherigen JEE-Infrastruktur
  • Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen und Durchführung des Wissenstransfers

Betrieb & Wartung von Adobe AEM Forms

  • Sicherstellung des stabilen Betriebs der bestehenden eForms-Plattform

  • Analyse und Behebung von Störungen sowie Verarbeitung und Nachlieferung fehlgeschlagener Formulare

  • Durchführung regelmässiger System-, Security- und Qualitätsprüfungen

  • Analyse und Behebung von Schwachstellen mithilfe von SonarQube, Qualys und weiteren Security-Tools

  • Installation und Validierung von Adobe-Hotfixes und Service Packs

  • Durchführung von Betriebssystem- und Infrastruktur-Upgrades auf Windows- und Linux-Servern

  • Performanceoptimierung, Fehleranalyse und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Systemstabilität

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im technischen Betrieb von Adobe Experience Manager (AEM Forms)

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, Java EE (JEE) und OSGi

  • Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung und Integration komplexer Backend-Services und APIs

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Integration von Umsystemen über REST, Messaging oder vergleichbare Schnittstellentechnologien

  • Erfahrung mit der Migration und Modernisierung bestehender Enterprise-Applikationen

  • Kenntnisse in CI/CD, Jenkins sowie automatisierten Testverfahren

  • Erfahrung im Betrieb und Troubleshooting von Anwendungen auf Linux- und Windows-Servern

  • Gutes Verständnis von IT-Security, Systemmonitoring und Performanceoptimierung

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Erfahrung mit Flowable, BPMN oder vergleichbaren Workflow-Engines (nice-to-have)

  • Kenntnisse von Apache Kafka und Event-driven Architectures (nice-to-have)

  • Erfahrung mit Adobe AEM Forms JEE und dessen Migration auf modernere Architekturen (nice-to-have)

  • Kenntnisse in SonarQube, Qualys und Security-Scanning (nice-to-have)

  • Erfahrung mit PDF-Generierung, dynamischen Formularen und Prefilling-Prozessen (nice-to-have)

Simplified Chinese AI Product Evaluator/ 简体中文 - AI 产品评估员

The Project

Productive Playhouse is building a talent pool of Simplified Chinese speakers for an upcoming project testing and evaluating leading AI chatbots. The objective is to enhance response quality through direct user interaction with the various AI models.

Open to freelancers based outside the U.S and China.

This is more than one job. Apply once, and we'll keep you in mind for this project — and future ones that need your language skills.

The Details

We’re looking for independent contractor engagement (task-based - project-based).

  • Pay Rate: $11.00 USD per hour
  • You choose which tasks to take, set your own hours, and are free to work with other clients any time. You can stay flexible as the project evolves.
  • This is an iterative project, work arrives in batches (there may be pauses between them).

What You’ll Do

As an AI Evaluator, you'll play a critical role in shaping and improving the next generation of Generative AI. You'll participate in structured, hands-on evaluations by interacting directly with various AI models to assess their capabilities, safety, and helpfulness. Your insights and data will directly inform model development and optimization.

Exact tasks vary by project and will be spelled out in that project's Statement of Work (SOW) before you start. Depending on the role, your work may include:

  • Testing and evaluating AI chatbots or language models through structured conversations, using assigned goals and prompts.
  • Voice-based interactions with AI models — for projects that involve this, sessions are recorded, and audio may be shared with the client as part of the evaluation deliverable.
  • Submitting deliverables (write-ups, ratings, screenshots, or recordings) in the format each task specifies.

What We're Looking For

  • Native or expert-level fluency in Simplified Chinese, as spoken in Mainland China
  • Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills - assessment maybe required
  • 18 years of age or older
  • Hands-on experience using AI models or large language models
  • Comfortable with both written and voice-based conversation — and good at asking sharp follow-ups
  • Your own smartphone, computer, reliable internet, and comfort with web-based tools
  • Able to pass a language proficiency and technical literacy assessment
  • Responsive communicator — quick replies move you through onboarding faster
  • Able to start within 48 hours

Why PPH?

Your language skills are the whole point — and this project pays for them

Apply once, get contacted directly when a spot opens — no chasing

Work from anywhere, on your own schedule, alongside any other work you do

Clear task specs, no ongoing oversight, no micromanagement

Real project experience with a global data and language services company

Work that actually improves how AI understands your language

About Productive Playhouse

We started by teaching kids through award-winning programming. We grew into a global data and language services company trusted by clients worldwide. But the mission never changed: keep language alive.

Transcription, translation, localization, linguistic analysis, AI evaluation — it all comes back to preserving languages and the cultures they carry.

All engagements are contingent upon successful completion of identity verification. Productive Playhouse is an equal opportunity organization headquartered in California and committed to diversity and inclusion across our global workforce. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and abilities, regardless of location or engagement type. For accommodations or inquiries, please contact HR.

Candidate Privacy: Productive Playhouse collects and processes personal information as part of our recruiting process. Before applying, please review our Candidate Privacy Policy to learn what we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

jobs.title: Head of Digital Acquisition
jobs.excerpt: FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets.
jobs.description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.

In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents.

To gain deeper insights into FairMoney's pivotal role in reshaping Africa's financial landscape, we invite you to watch this informative video.

THE MANDATE

As our product offering expands, we are looking for marketing leader to help FairMoney reach more customers and scale acquisition efficiently — growing customer volumes while making every acquisition budget work harder.

You will lead FairMoney's digital function, owning paid acquisition across Google, Meta, affiliates and other performance channels. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the acquisition strategy, manage substantial budgets and develop the in-house team, while working directly in advertising platforms, reviewing campaign data and identifying the changes needed to improve results.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Set the paid acquisition strategy across lending and banking products, translating business priorities into channel plans, campaigns and measurable targets.
  • Lead and personally optimise Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, including mobile app acquisition, bidding, targeting, budget pacing and campaign structure.
  • Own the acquisition budget: planning, forecasting and allocation — monitoring spend and returns, and scaling investment across channels and campaigns based on performance.
  • Own acquisition efficiency and quality: track and improve CAC, CPA, conversion rates, ROAS and cost per activated customer, using cohort and lifetime-value insights to judge the quality of customers acquired.
  • Run structured experiments across creatives, messaging, audiences, bidding strategies and conversion events, and partner with Brand and Design to turn insights into effective advertising.
  • Build and manage affiliate partnerships: negotiate commercial terms and payout models, and monitor traffic quality, fraud risk and acquisition costs.
  • Keep measurement and attribution reliable: work with Data and Engineering on app tracking, attribution and conversion signals, and investigate discrepancies between platform and business results.
  • Optimise the full acquisition funnel with Product, Risk and CRM — from click and install through registration, activation and first product usage, we need the right customer at the right time.
  • Lead and coach the in-house performance marketing team, set clear goals, and present results, forecasts and recommended actions to the management team.
  • Develop new channels: evaluate new paid acquisition opportunities and scale those that demonstrate repeatable results.

Requirements

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Scaled performance marketing in financial services. Has led and scaled performance marketing in fintech, consumer lending, digital banking or other consumer financial services. Emerging-markets experience is preferred.
  • Senior acquisition leadership. 7+ years in performance marketing or digital acquisition, including leading a team and owning acquisition outcomes in a B2C business.
  • Deep, hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads expertise. A recent, proven record of scaling mobile app or consumer acquisition campaigns.
  • Budget ownership at scale. Has managed substantial paid marketing budgets, including planning, forecasting, allocation and performance reporting.
  • Proven efficient growth. Can show where they improved acquisition efficiency while increasing customer volumes, with clear examples and measurable results.
  • Strong affiliate marketing experience. Including partner management, commercial negotiations and traffic-quality assessment.
  • Technical measurement fluency. Strong understanding of mobile attribution, app events, conversion tracking and value-based bidding; able to troubleshoot measurement issues with technical teams.
  • Strong analytical judgment. A practical command of CAC, CPA, ROAS, LTV, payback and cohort performance.
  • Builder and player-coach. Can build and develop an in-house team while staying closely involved in campaign execution and optimisation.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Attribution and analytics tooling. Experience with Adjust, AppsFlyer or similar platforms, alongside Firebase, GA4 and business intelligence tools.
  • Advanced analysis and automation. SQL or other advanced analytical skills, and practical use of AI or automation to improve campaign analysis, creative testing or reporting.

EXPECTATION ON AI

  • Plan in AI-era timelines. Challenge campaign and testing plans that assume pre-AI cycle times, and compress launch, test and learning loops from weeks into days.
  • Make the team AI-native operators. Expect marketers to use AI directly for creative variants, copy, audience analysis, reporting and campaign diagnostics.
  • Redesign the acquisition workflow. Jointly define with Data, Design and Engineering where AI is used across creative production, testing, bidding, measurement and reporting.
  • Measure AI leverage. Track creative testing velocity, time-to-insight, output per marketer and acquisition efficiency against pre-AI baselines.
  • Scale what works. Turn successful AI-native practices into playbooks, tooling and operating standards across the Growth team.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Efficient growth

  • New-customer volumes grow materially while CAC and CPA improve across channels.

Quality customers

  • Acquired cohorts activate and use our products, with LTV and payback improving across lending and banking.

A team that owns outcomes

  • Attribution is trusted, budget moves on evidence, and each team member owns clear channel targets.

Benefits

  • 25 days paid vacation, Sick & Public Holidays to B2B contractors
  • Remote (timezone must have significant overlap with CET)
  • Training & Development budget
  • Paid company business trips

Recruitment Process:

  • Screening session with a member of the recruitment team.
  • Technical Interview with the Chief Growth Officer
  • Case Study
  • Panel Session to discuss case study
  • Final Interview with the executive team
