jobs.excerpt: About OpenSesame OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI.
jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services, embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems, to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You'll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.

As a Sales Intern, you'll join our high-performing sales team and work on real projects that contribute directly to OpenSesame's growth and revenue goals. You'll gain experience in prospecting, pipeline building, and sales strategy while collaborating across departments and engaging with our leadership.

AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You'll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we'll encourage you to use them to research accounts, analyze market trends and competitors, prepare sales materials, and build. You'll see how human connection and AI innovation combine to win business.

Intern AI Hackathon

As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You'll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.

About the Sales Team

At OpenSesame, our Sales Team is the driving force behind helping businesses tackle their training challenges and build the world's most productive and admired workforces. We go beyond selling. We are trusted partners who use market trends, competitor insights, and AI-driven analysis to craft tailored solutions for the evolving needs of our customers.

Join a team that thrives on discovery, trusted relationships, and turning customer challenges into results, and help shape the future of workforce learning sales.

Performance Objectives

By 2 Weeks

  • Learn OpenSesame's sales process, tools, workflows, and product offerings.
  • Get set up with our internal AI tools and learn how the team uses them day to day.
  • Explore competitor strategies and analyze market trends to build a point of view on our customers' training challenges.
  • Begin engaging with the sales team and prospects to understand key customer needs.

By 30 Days

  • Support active sales efforts by preparing materials, researching accounts, identifying opportunities, and refining strategies.
  • Use AI tools, including Claude, to research prospects, draft outreach and proposals, and analyze data, and share what works with the team.
  • Assist in creating and delivering solutions that address customer training needs.
  • Collaborate with the team to turn insights into ongoing deals and customer conversations.
  • Join the intern hackathon team and build a working prototype.
  • Learn more about our organization-wide training program, OpenSesame Qualified.

By 60 Days

  • Take ownership of a project that improves sales processes, sales enablement materials, or customer engagement strategies, using data or AI-driven findings.
  • Establish yourself as a key resource for the team by providing actionable insights and support to inform decisions.
  • Develop and propose inventive recommendations to improve overall sales effectiveness and customer impact.

Not selected for this role? You’re still in the running. We’ll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we’ll reach out to you directly.

Application and Creative Project

Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide. It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.

To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.

We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.

You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:

  • How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
  • What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
  • Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
    • Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
    • Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.

We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.

Additional Program Details

Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027

Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation: $20 an hour

Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.

Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame's internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You'll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.

Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they're being considered for.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

CPRA (California candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Head of Client Operations to take full ownership of client delivery, campaign performance, client retention, and operational execution for a fast-growing outbound lead generation business.

This is not a traditional account management or project coordination role. You will be responsible for ensuring clients achieve measurable outcomes by improving campaign performance, optimizing operational systems, and maintaining exceptional delivery standards.

Working directly with the founder, you’ll thrive in a fast-paced startup where priorities evolve quickly, ownership is expected, and execution matters more than theory. You’ll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution—solving problems, improving systems, and building long-term client relationships.

If you’re experienced in cold email operations, outbound lead generation, and client success, and enjoy building scalable operational processes, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Client Ownership & Retention

  • Manage a portfolio of 20–30 client accounts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client delivery, campaign performance, and strategic discussions.
  • Lead client meetings, quarterly reviews, escalation management, and account planning.
  • Build trusted relationships while proactively managing client expectations.
  • Identify account risks early and implement retention strategies before issues escalate.
  • Own client satisfaction, retention, and long-term account success.

Campaign Performance & Delivery

  • Monitor and optimize cold email campaign performance.
  • Diagnose and resolve deliverability issues, inbox placement challenges, low reply rates, messaging performance, and list quality concerns.
  • Conduct quality assurance reviews before campaign launches.
  • Continuously improve deliverability, engagement, reply rates, and conversion performance.
  • Ensure clients consistently receive measurable business outcomes.

Hands-On Cold Email Execution

  • Refine outbound messaging, campaign strategy, and email sequences.
  • Optimize subject lines, value propositions, calls-to-action, and email copy.
  • Improve outbound infrastructure and inbox placement.
  • Work directly within platforms including:
    • Apollo.io
    • Smartlead.ai
    • Instantly.ai
  • Troubleshoot campaigns and implement recovery and optimization strategies.

Systems, SOPs & Operational Scaling

  • Design and improve scalable operational systems and delivery workflows.
  • Develop SOPs, playbooks, and standardized processes.
  • Track and improve SLAs, client health metrics, delivery quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Continuously refine workflows to support company growth.
  • Drive practical process improvements through ongoing iteration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with outreach teams, developers, infrastructure teams, and leadership.
  • Coordinate the resolution of technical issues, automation challenges, and infrastructure concerns.
  • Maintain visibility into campaign performance, operational risks, and delivery bottlenecks.
  • Ensure smooth communication and accountability across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You thrive in fast-paced startup environments.
  • You take ownership without requiring constant direction.
  • You enjoy solving complex operational problems.
  • You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • You communicate confidently with clients, founders, and cross-functional teams.
  • You focus on measurable results and continuous improvement.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • Proven experience leading client delivery, client operations, account management, or operational execution.
  • Background in cold email agencies, outbound lead generation, growth marketing, or similar high-volume outbound environments.
  • Experience working in startup or rapidly scaling businesses.

Technical & Operational Skills

  • Strong understanding of:
    • Cold email strategy
    • Deliverability
    • Inbox placement
    • Email infrastructure
    • Outbound copywriting
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve campaign performance issues independently.
  • Experience with APIs, workflow automation, and operational systems.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and automation platforms.

Communication & Leadership

  • Excellent client-facing communication and relationship management skills.
  • Comfortable handling difficult conversations and managing expectations.
  • Strong decision-making and operational judgment.
  • Able to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience scaling client delivery or account management teams.
  • Experience working directly with founders or executive leadership.
  • Familiarity with:
    • DNS configuration
    • Domain management
    • Email warming
    • Outbound infrastructure
  • Exposure to RevOps, automation systems, and outbound analytics.
  • Experience in growth-stage startup environments.

Tools & Platforms

Candidates should have experience with:

  • Apollo.io
  • Smartlead.ai
  • Instantly.ai
  • CRM platforms
  • ChatGPT and AI tools
  • Slack
  • Google Workspace
  • Automation and API platforms

What Success Looks Like

  • High client retention and reduced churn.
  • Strong campaign deliverability and reply rates.
  • Excellent client satisfaction and account health.
  • Consistent SLA adherence and delivery quality.
  • Fast, effective resolution of campaign and operational issues.
  • Increased revenue retention through successful client outcomes.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Founder Interview
  • Final Discussion
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows the founder and hiring team to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an operations leader who can own client outcomes end-to-end, optimize cold email campaigns, improve operational systems, and thrive in a fast-moving startup environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build a scalable client delivery operation that drives measurable business results.

jobs.title: Research Fellow
jobs.excerpt: OVERVIEW The Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA) is hiring a Research Fellow to build the data-driven case for FGA’s reforms.
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

The Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA) is hiring a Research Fellow to build the data-driven case for FGA’s reforms. In this role, you’ll produce just-in-time research tied to FGA’s legislative agenda in the states and in Washington, D.C.

Unlike in most policy research jobs, you’ll build each paper for a specific reform at a specific moment. You’ll find the hard-to-get data a policymaker partner needs before a hearing or a vote, write the paper, and see it through to launch. Then you’ll watch it show up in bills, executive orders, federal rules, testimony, and national media.

If you want to spend months on a single deep white paper, this role is not for you. If you want to work fast and stay close to the action, you’ll love it here. The ideal candidate brings three or more years in policy research, writing, or analysis. This role is remote and reports to the Research Director.

CULTURE AND FIT

The people who consistently succeed at FGA are those whose actions and behavior reflect our five Core Values. If you adhere to these values and answer “yes” to each of the following questions, you may be a fit.

1) Candid to Solve: Being willing to have tough conversations in order to solve issues and build trust.

  • Do you seek out constructive feedback—and provide it to others—to solve issues and build trust with coworkers?

2) Grow or Die: We don’t have a neutral gear; we must consistently challenge ourselves and each other to grow in our talents and skills.

  • Are you aware of your strengths and weaknesses, and do you seek out complementary skills and growth in order to mitigate your weaknesses?

3) Politically Savvy: Policy doesn’t change in a vacuum, but in a political reality that we must understand and account for.

  • Do you agree that embracing the realities of politics is necessary to change public policy?

4) Partnership-Oriented: Internal and external relationships are not transactional. That starts with our team members and the perspective that we need the rest of the team to succeed in order to win personally.

  • Are you comfortable creating your own structure for work, such as setting work hours, your own priorities, and creating clarity and a work plan from a broad goal?

5) Bought in to Win: We’re at FGA because we want to change policy. No one is counting hours or widgets. We are here to get results, and sometimes, that will require going the extra mile or doing a job that isn’t technically ours.

  • Do you fully support FGA’s mission and believe that lives are improved through work, not welfare, and that free markets create more freedom and opportunity than government control?

These values shape how we hire and how we work together. Expect to talk about them openly during the interview process.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As Research Fellow, you will have four primary areas of responsibility:

1) Build the Case for FGA’s Reforms

  • Write detailed outlines before drafting, and find original and hard-to-find data.
  • Master new reform areas quickly and pull in the outside sources that make FGA’s arguments stronger.

2) Write Papers That Move Policy

  • Draft two to three research papers and other products per quarter in FGA’s style, fast enough for lawmakers to use while a bill is moving.
  • Hand off clean, accurate drafts with complete citations, written for the audience that will use them.

3) Take Every Product to Launch

  • Run quality control with the Policy and Data teams, and keep the Design and Communications teams moving toward launch.
  • Review web versions before launch so papers go live without errors.

4) Put FGA Research to Work

  • Write memos, talking points, and testimony on request, and answer data and research questions from teammates and outside partners.
  • Turn your papers into op-eds and exclusives with the Communications team, and deliver presentations and briefings as needed.

REQUIREMENTS

🔹 Three or more years in policy research, writing, or analysis.

🔹 Excellent writer who turns complex policy into clear, persuasive writing.

🔹 Skilled at finding and analyzing data, and precise in presenting it.

🔹 Curious, critical thinker who picks up new policy areas fast and hits tight deadlines.

🔹 Comfortable using AI tools to speed up research and drafting.

🔹 Able to travel one to two times per quarter for team meetings and occasional briefings.

🔹 Match FGA’s Core Values (described above).

TIMING, LOCATION, AND COMPENSATION

FGA is seeking to fill this position as soon as possible.

FGA’s headquarters are in Naples, FL, but nearly all of our staff work remotely from across the country. We build our systems and culture around clarity, flexibility, and strong communication. Key elements include:

  • Quarterly in-person team meetings at which you’ll build deeper relationships, set clear goals aligned with FGA’s big vision, and brainstorm how to seize new opportunities
  • An intensive 90-day orientation to familiarize you with the FGA team, our policies, and how we operate
  • Home office setup, including equipment and communication tools you need to hit the ground running

FGA offers a competitive salary between $80,000–$110,000, depending on experience and qualifications, along with a benefits package that includes a six percent retirement match, health benefits, and generous paid leave.

Company Overview

Founded in 1947, Pulpdent Corporation is an industry-leading dental research and manufacturing company. Pulpdent’s corporate headquarters, research laboratory, and manufacturing facilities are located in Watertown, Massachusetts, in the Boston metro area. Its products are distributed globally. Pulpdent is a third-generation, family-owned business widely respected for its innovative products and authentic company culture, which promotes work-life balance, employee retention, and product excellence. The enduring hallmarks of the Pulpdent brand are imagination, dedication, and empowerment, each inspiring the daily work of Pulpdent’s employees.
To meet the continued demand for our dental materials in the United States, we are hiring a Strategic Accounts Manager to develop and grow strategic relationships with Dental Service Organizations (DSOs), community health centers, and other key group accounts. To learn more about Pulpdent, including its breakthrough advances in bioactive dental materials and commitment to ethical business practices, visit pulpdent.com.

Job Description

The Strategic Accounts Manager is an ambitious, self-motivated leader eager to define – and continuously refine – Pulpdent’s channel sales strategy in a rapidly changing commercial landscape. This business development professional blends relationship-building skills with analytical acumen to target key accounts, build relationships, and negotiate contracts with DSOs, CHCs, GPOs, and universities.
The Strategic Account Manager owns the revenue attainment objectives for the Multisite, Government, and Education Markets. The SAM is responsible for developing and executing the sales strategy that identifies growth opportunities, strengthens customer relationships, expands portfolio adoption and aligns Pulpdent's objectives with Dealer partners in this segment of the market.
The SAM builds trusted relationships with segment decision markers, champions, influencers, and dealer partners that lead to a sustained, meaningful presence for Pulpdent in the market.
Working collaboratively with the Pulpdent Commercial team and reporting to the North American Sales Director; the SAM translates segment priorities, organizational structures, competitive dynamics, and emerging opportunities into commercial strategies and executable initiatives.

    • Develop and execute customized strategic account plans in collaboration with the North American Sales Director

Client Success Manager

Location: Remote, Canada (preferred) or United States
Employment Type: Full-Time, Independent Contractor
Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 9 AM–5 PM (Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time)
Base Compensation: USD $60,000–$70,000 per year
Target OTE: Approximately USD $80,000–$90,000 per year, negotiable based on experience
Performance Incentives: Mainly tied to quarterly client retention, with additional bonuses for client testimonials

About the Company

Our client is a done-for-you Meta advertising and appointment-setting agency. It supports medspas and aesthetic wellness businesses across the United States. As its client portfolio grows, the agency is hiring a dedicated Client Success Manager to build a consistent, proactive experience for clients after the sale.

The Opportunity

You’ll own the experience of about 40 agency clients. That covers onboarding, campaign launch, ongoing service, retention, and renewal support. You’ll be clients’ main point of contact and the bridge between them and the creative, media buying, appointment-setting, sales, and operations teams.

This is a client relationship and coordination role. It is not a hands-on media buying position. You’ll also help shape the agency’s first dedicated Client Success function, including the processes and playbook the team will rely on as it scales.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead structured client onboarding, coordinate handoffs from sales to delivery, set expectations, and document client goals and success metrics.
  • Manage a portfolio of about 40 client relationships through scheduled check-ins.
  • Respond to client Slack messages within 24 hours on business days.
  • Keep CRM records accurate and up to date.
  • Spot dissatisfaction and at-risk accounts early, coordinate recovery plans, and support renewals and retention.
  • Turn client concerns into clear actions for the creative, media buying, appointment-setting, and operations teams, and follow through until they’re resolved.
  • Prepare client-facing performance updates and maintain a portfolio health dashboard that leadership can see.
  • Improve onboarding checklists and SOPs, and build a repeatable Client Success playbook.
  • Track retention, NPS trends, response times, and onboarding SLAs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Annual client retention of 93% or higher.
  • Every new-client onboarding completed within agreed SLAs.
  • Every client contacted according to the established check-in schedule.
  • Client interactions logged in the CRM within 24 hours, and churn risks identified before they escalate.

Your First 90 Days

  • Days 1–30: Learn the client journey, tools, account history, and existing team workflows.
  • Days 31–60: Begin managing about 10–20 accounts on your own, set up regular check-ins, and track account health.
  • Days 61–90: Work toward full portfolio ownership, report on retention health, and recommend process improvements.

Earning Potential

  • Base: USD $60,000–$70,000 per year.
  • Variable: Performance incentives are mainly tied to quarterly client retention, with additional bonuses for client testimonials. Detailed retention bonus tiers will be shared before the offer stage.
  • Target OTE: The total target earning opportunity is approximately USD $80,000–$90,000 per year, negotiable based on experience. Earnings above base depend on performance and are not guaranteed.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • About 1–2 years of relevant experience in client success, account management, customer service, or a client-facing agency role. Exceptional transferable experience will also be considered.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with confident client communication.
  • Empathy, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Strong organization and follow-through while managing multiple accounts and competing priorities.
  • Proactive problem-solving and comfort working with distributed teams in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to understand basic marketing performance reports and explain practical next steps to clients.
  • Based in Canada (preferred) or the United States.
  • Available Monday–Friday, approximately 9 AM–5 PM Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with medspas, aesthetics, or wellness, or experience supporting growth at a medspa.
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel, ClickUp or similar project management tools, and Meta Ads Manager. These platforms can be taught.

Benefits

  • Fully remote role for candidates in Canada or the United States.
  • Consistent Monday–Friday daytime schedule.
  • Competitive USD base compensation of $60,000–$70,000 per year.
  • Performance incentives tied to quarterly client retention, plus bonuses for client testimonials. Target OTE is approximately USD $80,000–$90,000.
  • Training on the agency’s platforms, including GoHighLevel, ClickUp, and Meta Ads Manager.
  • Chance to help build the agency’s first dedicated Client Success function and shape its processes and playbook.
  • Room to grow as the agency scales, with potential paths to Senior Client Success Manager and Head of Client Success.

About Relay

Relay is hiring remote outbound SDRs to book meetings for our B2B clients. We care more about what you have done on the phone than what your job title said. If you can show us your numbers, we would love to hear from you.

The work

You will make outbound calls, on our dialler, to book qualified meetings for Relay’s clients. You choose how you work, as long as you deliver. This is a fully remote role where you provide your own computer, internet connection, and headset.

The expectation is 50 conversations a week with decision makers. Dials are vanity metrics, we care about conversations, and meetings that actually take place.

What we remove

In most other sales roles, the calling gets squeezed by everything around it. At Relay, we have eliminated that. We handle the enriched list building and the research behind the scenes. We take care of the emails and the follow-up, even the follow-ups. We do everything. We even have AI taking the notes from your call transcripts, so you do not have to write notes in the CRM. Everything that bogs you down day to day in another SDR or sales role, we have removed, so you can focus on what you do best: great conversations.

What we want to see

Performance is what matters here, so we will ask about results rather than titles:

  • How many conversations do you hold, and with whom?

  • How many meetings have you booked, and over what period?

  • Did you hit target? By how much?

  • How did you rank against your peers?

Be honest with us. Real numbers, even modest ones, tell us far more than a polished CV, and they help us both work out quickly whether this is the right fit.

We look for tenacity (sustained activity and output), curiosity (the questions you actually ask), and resilience (what you do after a no, and whether you keep going).

What we offer

This is an uncapped commission-led opportunity, with 1:2:1 coaching to accelerate your growth.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote (USA). Travel up to 25%.

Reports To: Manager, Implementation

About the Role

The Implementation Lead owns each client engagement from kickoff through go-live and transition to Customer Success and Technical Support. You will run the Design phase with the client's core team, build and configure the entire account in Ottimate (backend and UI), and bring in the Enablement Consultant for UI training and adoption. When an engagement needs integration setup, custom development, or a data migration, you will scope it and work with the Technical Consultant team to deliver it.

This is a hands-on role. You should be comfortable completing an assessment to check a client's data and just as comfortable leading a workflow mapping session with a Controller. An accounting or AP background is beneficial, because you will advise clients on approval policies, coding structures, and payment processes, and you need to understand why they work the way they do.

Responsibilities

Engagement ownership

  • Own the engagement end to end: project plan, milestones, risks, status reporting, and go-live readiness
  • Build a plan around each client's entities, ERP, volume, and complexity, and keep it current as scope changes
  • Run kickoff, set expectations with executive sponsors and the client project team, and hold both sides accountable to their commitments (data, decisions, approvers, testing, etc)
  • Transition to Customer Success at the end of the engagement with clear documentation of the configuration decisions made and the reasons for them

Design phase

  • Lead the Design sessions: workflow mapping, approval policy consultation, invoice data capture consultation, payments, and integrations
  • Map each client's current AP process and recommend how to restructure it so that Ottimate's automation removes manual steps
  • Turn the decisions from these sessions into a written design and get client sign-off before building
  • Identify early which clients need integration work, custom development, or a data migration, and bring in the Technical Consultant team with a defined scope

Build & configuration

  • Build and configure the entire account, backend and UI: users and roles, approval workflows, coding and GL structures, vendor setup, invoice data capture settings, and payment configuration
  • Use required tools to analyze, validate, and correct client data and to troubleshoot configuration issues
  • Lead user acceptance testing with the client, resolve issues, and confirm go-live readiness

Technical scoping & troubleshooting

  • Evaluate each client's ERP environment and data structures to identify integration considerations
  • Triage technical issues to determine whether they are a data or mapping problem, a configuration problem, or an engineering issue, and escalate with a clear write-up when needed

Enablement & adoption transition

  • Give the Enablement Consultant the design documentation and configuration context needed to build client-specific UI training, and schedule training ahead of go-live
  • Stay involved through go-live and early adoption so the engagement ends with the client working in the platform, not just configured in it

Cross-functional collaboration

jobs.title: Group Financial Controller
jobs.excerpt: The Group Controller is responsible for overseeing the overall financial management, accounting operations, and financial reporting functions across the Group and its subsidiaries.
jobs.description:
The Group Controller is responsible for overseeing the overall financial management, accounting operations, and financial reporting functions across the Group and its subsidiaries. This role ensures the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of financial information across multiple business entities while maintaining compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
The position provides strategic financial guidance to senior management, drives financial planning and performance monitoring, strengthens internal controls, and ensures effective financial governance across the organization. The Group Controller will also lead and develop the finance and accounting teams while supporting business growth, operational efficiency, and long-term financial sustainability.
Key Responsibilities
1. Group Financial Management & Consolidation
  • Oversee the overall accounting and financial management functions across the Group and its subsidiaries.
  • Lead the preparation, review, and consolidation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of financial reporting across different business entities.
  • Monitor the financial performance of individual entities and the consolidated Group, identifying variances, risks, and opportunities.
  • Establish standardized accounting policies, procedures, and reporting practices across the organization.
2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Analysis
  • Lead the Group's annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes.
  • Monitor financial performance against approved budgets and business objectives.
  • Provide financial analysis, management reports, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.
  • Evaluate business performance, profitability, cost structures, and financial trends across subsidiaries.
  • Recommend strategies to improve financial efficiency, profitability, and resource allocation.
3. Financial Controls, Governance & Compliance
  • Establish, implement, and maintain effective financial policies, internal controls, and governance frameworks across the Group.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory requirements, and corporate policies.
  • Monitor financial processes and identify potential control weaknesses, implementing corrective measures where necessary.
  • Ensure proper financial documentation, accountability, and transparency across all entities.
  • Oversee financial risk management and ensure appropriate measures are in place to safeguard company assets.
4. Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management
  • Oversee Group-wide cash flow planning, liquidity management, and working capital requirements.
  • Monitor cash positions, funding requirements, receivables, payables, and financial obligations across subsidiaries.
  • Develop strategies to optimize cash utilization and strengthen financial stability.
  • Monitor debt exposure and support financing-related decisions in coordination with senior management.
5. Tax Management & Audit Coordination
  • Oversee tax planning, compliance, and statutory reporting across the Group.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory agencies.
  • Lead internal and external audit activities, ensuring timely completion and resolution of audit findings.
  • Ensure that all subsidiaries maintain proper accounting records and remain audit-ready.
  • Monitor changes in financial regulations and assess their potential impact on the Group.
6. Executive & Business Partnering
  • Work closely with the CFO, senior management, and business unit heads on financial strategies and business performance.
  • Present consolidated financial reports, management accounts, and financial recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Provide financial guidance on business expansion, investments, operational initiatives, and other strategic decisions.
  • Partner with different departments to ensure financial discipline and alignment with overall business objectives.
7. Leadership & Process Improvement
  • Lead, supervise, and develop the Group's finance and accounting teams.
  • Establish performance standards and ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial outputs.
  • Strengthen coordination and collaboration among finance teams across different entities.
  • Drive process improvements, standardization, and automation of accounting and financial reporting processes.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, Finance, or a related field.
  • Must be a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
  • At least 8–10 years of progressive experience in accounting and finance, with significant exposure to financial management and controllership.
  • Previous experience handling group-level finance, multi-entity accounting, or financial consolidation is highly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of financial reporting standards, accounting principles, taxation, internal controls, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and cash flow management.
  • Experience in managing external audits and implementing financial policies and control frameworks.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing and developing finance and accounting teams.
  • Strong analytical, strategic planning, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency in ERP/accounting systems and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

The Landlord Database Manager will be responsible for overseeing the successful implementation, ongoing management and maintenance of the Landlord Database across LRG.

The role will ensure that all required landlord compliance documentation and tenancy information is accurately uploaded, maintained and audited in line with regulatory requirements and agreed deadlines.

  • Oversee the upload of landlord compliance documentation and tenancy information, ensuring all required records are completed within the relevant deadlines.

  • Monitor individual and team performance against agreed KPIs and service standards.

  • Ensure appropriate records and audit trails are maintained.

  • Identify potential compliance risks and escalate concerns where necessary.

jobs.title: Head of Operations / Fund Middle Office - US
jobs.excerpt: Allocator One Group is a global investing platform redefining how institutional capital reaches private markets.
jobs.description:
Allocator One Group is a global investing platform redefining how institutional capital reaches private markets. We operate through two synergistic businesses:

  • Allocator One backs exceptional first- and second-time fund managers around the world—acting as “seed-investor + platform” for emerging VC funds.
  • Infra One, our fund-ops and tech arm, provides the regulatory, administrative, and tech infrastructure that allows those new funds to scale rapidly and globally. We are already live and serving customers in the UK, US, Austria, Germany and launching Singapore, India and Luxembourg imminently.

Together, we deliver both the capital and the structure fund managers need—and in doing so build a global ecosystem of platforms, people, and ideas that reshape private markets.

This role is one of the four foundational roles that we are hiring for to establish Infra One's US operating platform. These are not narrow, siloed functions. Each role is an architect of the Infra One US operating system—building the regulatory, operational, and financial infrastructure that will enable dozens of GPs to scale with confidence.

Tasks

The Role: Architect of Investor Onboarding & Trade Operations

You are the operational backbone of the Infra One platform. You own investor onboarding (KYC/AML), investor register management, trade capture and reconciliation, position tracking, and the coordination between GPs, fund accounting, custodians, and compliance. You are the glue between investment activity and clean operational execution.

More broadly, you are building repeatable processes and checklists for bringing new GPs into the platform and scaling to 5, 10, 20+ funds. You will mentor operations analysts and define the operating standards that enable Infra One to service multiple GPs simultaneously without error or friction.

Key Responsibilities

Investor Onboarding & Administration

  • Design and execute KYC/AML procedures: investor verification, beneficial ownership documentation, sanctions screening, ongoing monitoring.
  • Maintain investor registers: track admissions, capital commitments, account statuses, and investor contact information.
  • Coordinate investor closings: collect signatures, wire instructions, tax forms (W-8BEN, W-9, etc.), and data entry.
  • Produce investor notices, capital call communications, and distribution instructions; ensure timely and accurate delivery.

Trade Capture & Reconciliation

  • Establish procedures for capturing investment decisions from GPs and translating them into fund accounting entries.
  • Reconcile trade data between GPs, fund accounting, custodian, and investor records; flag discrepancies daily/weekly.
  • Maintain position databases and update them as investments are made, marked, exited, or distributed.
  • Coordinate with fund accounting on cutoff, accruals, and performance metrics.

Data Governance & Process

  • Design data entry standards, naming conventions, and error prevention procedures.
  • Establish backup and disaster recovery procedures for critical operational data.
  • Build repeatable onboarding checklists for new GPs: investor admissions, legal documentation handoffs, position tracking setup.
  • Coordinate with IT on operational systems and data security.

Stakeholder Management

  • Interface with GPs on investor admissions, trade confirmations, and any operational questions.
  • Coordinate with custodians on asset positioning, confirmations, and month-end reconciliation.
  • Support the CCO on compliance evidence gathering (investor records, approvals, decision logs).
  • Support fund accounting on investor reporting data and K-1 preparation.

Vendor Coordination

  • Manage relationships with third-party service providers: custodians, auditors, tax advisors.
  • Ensure service levels are met and escalate any issues to the MD.

Requirements

What You Bring

Experience & Expertise

  • 6–12 years of operations/middle office experience at a PE firm, hedge fund, venture platform, or fund administrator.
  • Hands-on experience with investor onboarding, KYC/AML, and investor register management.
  • Strong knowledge of fund operational workflows: trade capture, reconciliation, and position tracking.
  • Prior experience managing 2+ funds simultaneously and coordinating across investment, accounting, and compliance teams.
  • Exposure to fund administration platforms and workflow management tools.

Mindset & Approach

  • Operational excellence: you obsess over clean data, timely execution, and process rigor.
  • Problem-solver: you anticipate operational pain points and design solutions before they become crises.
  • Cross-functional fluency: you speak the language of investments, accounting, compliance, and GPs.
  • Teacher: you document processes, mentor junior staff, and ensure continuity even as the team scales.
  • Low ego, high ownership: you are comfortable doing hands-on work (data entry, tracking, reconciliation) while also building systems.

Nice to Have

  • FINRA Series 7 or Series 65 (not required, but valued).
  • Prior multi-fund platform experience.
  • CPA or accounting background is a plus.
  • Exposure to infrastructure or venture investing.

Benefits

  • Location: Remote (preferred US timezone overlap with San Francisco HQ)
  • Salary Range: $140,000–$210,000 base + 20% bonus
  • Equity: TBD (0.05%–0.15%)
  • Reports to: US Platform Head / Managing Director
  • Hiring Timeline: Month 2–4

Why This Role Matters

Operations is the hidden differentiator between a credible platform and a chaotic one. Clean, timely, error-free operations build institutional LP confidence and reduce friction for GPs. You are building that credibility.

Why Infra One

  • Impact: Build operational standards and processes that scale to 20+, 50+ funds.
  • Team building: Hire and mentor operations analysts as the platform grows.
  • Learning curve: Exposure to multi-fund management, LP reporting, and institutional investor relations.
  • Strategic partnership: Direct access to the MD; input into platform design and vendor selection.
  • Equity upside: Early-stage role with meaningful equity; directly tied to platform success.

About Ancestry:

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. Ancestry®, the global leader in family history, connects everyone with their past so they can discover, preserve, and share their unique family stories. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.

We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- see the full list of eligible US locations HERE). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.

Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.

Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

As a Product Management Co-op, you will spend six months working 20 hours per week on the Bridges team, working directly with the Senior Director of Product for Activate. You will own real pieces of the roadmap, run experiments, and ship to customers on the web and in the Ancestry app. You will work with product managers, designers, engineers, data scientists, DNA scientists, and user researchers.

This role is designed as a path into product management at Ancestry. Co-ops who perform strongly will be considered for a full-time product role.


What you'll do:

  • Understand DNA-first customers. Dig into research, customer feedback, and session recordings to learn why DNA customers do or don't move into family history, and where they drop off.
  • Shape and ship Bridges experiences. Help define features that connect DNA matches, origins, and grandparent-level insights to tree building and records, then write clear requirements and work with design and engineering to ship them.
  • Run experiments. Form hypotheses, set up A/B tests with analytics partners, analyze the results, and recommend next steps.
  • Improve the path to subscription. Find ways to make the moment a DNA customer meets a paywall clearer and more relevant to what they care about.
  • Measure what matters. Track Bridges metrics such as DNA-to-family-history conversion, tree creation and repeat visits, and share what you learn with the team and leadership.
  • Build with AI. Use our AI tools for discovery, prototyping, and requirements, and take part in the product org's AI Builder Weeks.

Who you are:

  • Currently enrolled in a graduate program (business, information systems, computer science, data, design, genetics, or a related field), and available immediately for part-time work for 6 months.
  • Curiosity about people and why they do what they do, shown through school projects, research, a startup, product work, or an internship.
  • Comfort with data: you can pull together a spreadsheet analysis, read an experiment result, and explain what it means in plain language.
  • Clear writing and speaking, and the ability to work with engineers, designers, and analysts without formal authority.
  • Strong ownership: you take on ambiguous problems, ask good questions, and follow through.
  • Interest in family history, genetics, personal identity, or storytelling.

Nice to have:

  • Prior product, UX, analytics, or growth internship experience, especially on a consumer app or subscription product.
  • Experience with A/B testing, SQL, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude for research, analysis, or prototyping.
  • Familiarity with DNA matching, ethnicity estimates, or genealogy research.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Director, Enterprise Retail Vertical
jobs.excerpt: At U. S.  Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best.
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.

We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.

Job Description

Enterprise Europe requires senior business development leadership with the credibility and commercial discipline to originate, shape and close complex opportunities with large, multi-market retail customers. The role brings together vertical expertise, executive engagement and end-to-end sales ownership, while ensuring that acquiring opportunities are expanded through relevant value-added solutions. Elavon Payment Gateway (EPG) is a priority proposition, and successful candidates will be expected to position gateway value early, qualify attachment potential and progress integrated acquiring and gateway outcomes wherever customer needs support this approach.


Role purpose

Own the full new-business sales journey for enterprise-scale retail prospects across Europe, from market mapping, prospecting and opportunity qualification through solution design, commercial negotiation, contracting and hand-off. Build senior customer relationships, mobilise internal specialists and create differentiated propositions that address the operational, digital and cross-border needs of grocery, luxury retail, hardware, specialist retail and other target sub-verticals. Deliver revenue goals, maintain accurate pipeline governance and achieve formal gateway commercialisation and VAS attachment targets as a core part of qualified opportunity development.


Core accountabilities

1. Enterprise business development and revenue delivery

· Build and execute a pan-European target-account plan focused on enterprise-scale prospects, priority markets and high-value opportunities.

· Self-generate opportunities, respond to strategic RFPs and lead complex sales cycles from initial engagement through signature and structured hand-off.

· Achieve agreed revenue, pipeline and conversion objectives, together with formal gateway commercialisation and VAS attachment targets, while maintaining disciplined opportunity qualification and forecasting.

2. Vertical strategy and customer relevance

· Develop deep insight into the priorities of pan-European retailers across grocery, luxury retail, hardware, specialist retail and adjacent retail segments.

· Shape propositions around store and ecommerce journeys, unified commerce, multi-country estates, platform integration, operational resilience, customer experience and cross-border growth.

· Build relevant networks across retail technology, commerce platforms, ISVs and other partners where they strengthen access, proposition differentiation or implementation outcomes.

3. Value-added solutions and EPG attachment

· Lead with customer outcomes and position the broader Elavon portfolio, not acquiring in isolation.

· Make EPG a priority consideration within each qualified opportunity; identify gateway, orchestration, integration, reporting, fraud, optimisation and other value-added solution needs.

· Work with Product, Solution Engineering, Partners, Pricing and Implementation to create commercially viable, scalable propositions with clear ownership and delivery assumptions.

· Own and track performance against formal gateway commercialisation and VAS attachment targets through pipeline, contracting and paid-live outcomes, addressing barriers that reduce attachment or customer value.

4. Executive engagement and complex deal leadership

· Build trusted relationships with C-suite, payments, finance, digital, technology, procurement and operational stakeholders across customer buying groups.

· Apply a recognised enterprise sales methodology such as MEDDICC, Challenger or SPIN to surface decision criteria, quantify value, navigate competition and maintain deal momentum.

· Lead commercial negotiation and coordinate internal decision-making across Pricing, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Credit and Risk, Product, Operations and Deployment.

5. Pipeline, forecasting and market insight

· Maintain accurate and timely CRM records, opportunity plans, next steps, risks, dependencies and forecasts.

· Provide clear market intelligence on customer needs, competitor activity, product gaps and emerging opportunities to shape vertical and proposition priorities.

· Use evidence to prioritise effort, escalate barriers early and protect capacity for the highest-value opportunities.

6. Cross-functional mobilisation and hand-off

· Create effective virtual deal teams and secure the specialist resources required to progress opportunities at pace.

· Ensure solution scope, commercial commitments, implementation dependencies and customer expectations are understood before contracting and hand-off.

· Partner with Relationship Management after hand-off to support continuity, expansion opportunities and long-term customer value.

· Work closely with U.S. Bank and the Institutional Clients Group (ICG) to identify and progress broader banking and acquiring opportunities, align customer priorities and coordinate complementary solution sets.


Skills and experience required

· Substantial senior-level experience in enterprise B2B sales, business development or strategic account acquisition, ideally in payments, fintech or a comparable regulated technology environment.

· Proven record of achieving or exceeding demanding revenue targets and closing complex, high-value, multi-stakeholder opportunities with large customers.

· Strong understanding of merchant acquiring, payment gateways and value-added payment solutions, with evidence of solution attachment and outcome-based selling.

· Experience operating across European markets and engaging customers with multi-country requirements, varied operating models and complex decision structures.

· Demonstrated use of enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDICC, Challenger or SPIN, supported by disciplined qualification, pipeline management and forecasting.

· Ability to engage C-suite stakeholders and translate technical, operational and commercial complexity into a clear customer proposition and investment case.

· Strong negotiation, pricing and commercial judgement, balancing customer value, revenue, margin, risk, scalability and implementation feasibility.

· Experience coordinating matrix teams across Product, Technology, Solution Engineering, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Deployment.

· Experience working with banking partners or within a broader banking environment is desirable, including the ability to navigate competing customer priorities, multiple solution sets and shared ownership across acquiring and wider banking opportunities.

· Excellent written and verbal English. Additional European language capability is advantageous.

· Willingness and ability to travel across Europe in line with customer and business requirements.


Preferred vertical experience

· Enterprise retail payments across grocery, luxury retail, hardware, specialist retail or other multi-site and omnichannel environments.

· Store, ecommerce and unified-commerce journeys, complex estates, platform or ISV integrations, cross-border growth and high-volume operational requirements.

Accessibility

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support.

Total Rewards

U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.

We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes:

  • Clearly defined salary ranges aligned with industry benchmarks and internal equity standards.

  • Performance-based incentives for eligible employees (as defined by relevant plan rules), awarded through transparent, objective criteria that recognize both individual and company performance.

  • Inclusive equitable benefits that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness).

  • Continuous development opportunities including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria.

  • Employee recognition programs that celebrate achievements and milestones for all.

We regularly review our compensation and benefits to ensure they remain competitive, inclusive, and responsive to employee needs and market trends. Further details of the compensation package will be provided upon application.

We encourage candidates to explore the full value of our offer, including monetary and non-monetary benefits, at Employee benefits and development | U.S. Bank | Elavon.

We aim to provide timely updates throughout the process and encourage early applications to ensure consideration.

jobs.title: Legal | Rechtsanwält/in für Bank- und Kapitalmarktrecht (x/w/m) - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Hopkins ist eine auf die Rechte von Privatpersonen spezialisierte, deutschlandweit tätige Kanzlei.
jobs.description:
Hopkins ist eine auf die Rechte von Privatpersonen spezialisierte, deutschlandweit tätige Kanzlei. Gegründet in 2019 durch Arend Liese, zuvor Rechtsanwalt bei Freshfields Bruckhaus Deringer, denkt Hopkins das Prinzip Kanzlei und Rechtsdurchsetzung täglich neu - mit großem Fokus auf moderne Technologie und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit. Mit einem Team von mehr als 150 Personen berät und vertritt Hopkins Privatpersonen deutschlandweit in allen rechtlichen Belangen.

Aufgaben

  • Du etablierst eine neue Ära der Rechtsdurchsetzung und bist Teil der Mission, juristische Prozesse zu digitalisieren und automatisieren

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Beziehung und den Kontakt zu Deinen Mandantinnen und Mandanten und führst rechtliche Beratung und Vertretung im Bank- und Kapitalmarktrecht durch

  • Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Vertretung von Bankkund:innen und Privatanleger:innen, etwa bei unberechtigten Kontoentgelten und Gebührenerhöhungen, Zinsnachberechnungen bei Sparverträgen, Vorfälligkeitsentschädigungen, Erstattungsansprüchen nach Online-Banking-Betrug sowie bei Schadensersatz wegen fehlerhafter Anlageberatung

  • Du übernimmst die Verhandlungen mit Gegenseiten sowie gegnerischen Anwälten

  • Du erstellst Klageschriften, Schriftsätze, Verträge, etc.

  • Du bearbeitest eigenständig Fälle und vertrittst unsere Mandanten sowohl außergerichtlich als auch vor Gericht

  • Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen anderen internen Teams zusammen

  • Du gibst Deine Erfahrungen und Dein Feedback in unseren Produktentwicklungsprozess mit ein und arbeitest direkt mit Produktmanagern und der Geschäftsführung an Verbesserungen in der Automatisierung von Abläufen

Qualifikation

Du bist Volljurist:in mit Zulassung zur Rechtsanwaltschaft in Deutschland oder hast diese bereits beantragt. Zudem verfügst Du über mindestens ein Jahr Berufserfahrung (idealerweise im Bank- und Kapitalmarktrecht, gern mit Erfahrung in der Vertretung von Verbraucher:innen und Anleger:innen gegenüber Banken und Finanzdienstleistern). Deine Arbeitsweise ist pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und Du hast große Lust und Energie, innerhalb eines dynamischen Arbeitsumfelds an der Zukunft des Rechtsmarkts mitzuwirken. Die Vision, in einer durch Technologie skalierbaren Kanzlei mitzuarbeiten, inspiriert Dich und Du denkst gerne darüber nach, wie sich juristische Prozesse durch die Nutzung von Daten und Software verbessern lassen. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und gewissenhaft, setzt dabei klare Prioritäten und legst eine unternehmerische und ergebnisorientierte Denkweise an den Tag. Dazu bist Du lernwillig und übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Arbeit. Deine Stärke in der Kommunikation und Dein Verhandlungsgeschick, etwa bei Vergleichsverhandlungen mit Banken und deren Rechtsabteilungen, zeichnen Dich aus.

Benefits

  • Bei uns hast Du die Möglichkeit, als Protagonist die Anwaltskanzlei der Zukunft zu formen und die Welt der Rechtsdienstleistungen für Privatpersonen grundlegend zu verändern

  • Du übernimmst schnell viel Verantwortung für unsere Kanzlei und sammelst für Deinen Fachanwaltstitel in kurzer Zeit viele relevante Fälle

  • Du arbeitest von dort, wo Du am produktivsten bist: Unser Team ist in Deutschland verteilt und arbeitet zum Großteil remote. Wir haben aber natürlich auch ein Büro in Berlin, in dem Du jederzeit willkommen bist.

  • Du bist Teil eines inspirierenden Teams bestehend aus Experten vieler verschiedener Disziplinen

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Produktmanagern und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast großen Einfluss auf die Technologie, die wir bauen

  • Wir bieten eine attraktive und leistungsbezogene Vergütung

  • Wir übernehmen alle Kosten, die mit Deiner Tätigkeit als Rechtsanwalt sowie dem Erhalt und der Aufrechterhaltung der Zulassung zusammenhängen (Versicherungen, Kammergebühren, etc.)

Insbesondere hast Du große Lust und Energie, in einem Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten zu wirken, Themen aufzubauen und zu verändern. Dabei bist Du inspiriert durch den Gedanken mit Deiner Arbeit Menschen zu ihren Rechten zu verhelfen und Zugang zu erstklassiger rechtlicher Beratung zu ermöglichen.

Wir freuen uns sehr auf ein Kennenlernen, wenn diese Herausforderung Dich anspricht.

jobs.excerpt: You will build the analytical backbone of DTC at More Nutrition, enabling structured, scalable and data-driven decision-making across all commercial levers.
jobs.description:
You will build the analytical backbone of DTC at More Nutrition, enabling structured, scalable and data-driven decision-making across all commercial levers. Your goal is to move DTC from reactive analysis to proactive performance management, while establishing robust frameworks, playbooks and scalable systems to support our next growth phase. You will leverage automation and AI as key enablers to increase speed, depth and scalability of insights across the organization. As one of the fastest-growing DTC businesses in Germany, you will play a key role in shaping how data drives our path toward €1Bn+ international expansion.

Your Mission

  • End-to-End DTC Performance Analytics
    • You own and evolve DTC performance analysis across traffic, conversion, revenue and customer behavior
    • You identify key drivers of growth across promotions, CRO, marketing channels and product portfolio
    • You translate complex data into clear, actionable business recommendations
  • Channel, Attribution & Commercial Impact
    • You analyze and quantify the impact of all channels (e.g. paid, TikTok Shop, organic, TV)
    • You assess channel interactions, overlaps and incrementality
    • You enable better budget allocation and investment decisions
  • Cross-Functional Business Analytics
    • You support key commercial questions beyond marketing
    • You analyze portfolio performance (e.g. product mix, innovation impact)
    • You evaluate promotion effectiveness
    • You support market and channel expansion decisions
    • You work closely with Performance, Influencer Marketing, CRM, eCommerce and PLM teams
  • Content & Creative Performance Insights
    • You analyze which content, formats and creators drive performance
    • You connect creative output to business impact (conversion, revenue)
    • You enable data-driven optimization of content and campaign strategies
  • Data Infrastructure, Automation & AI
    • You build scalable reporting and analytics frameworks for the DTC team
    • You reduce dependency on BI through structured, self-serve insights
    • You leverage AI and automation to improve speed, quality and scalability of analysis
    • You identify and implement high-impact AI use cases across DTC
  • Structure, Playbooks & Best Practices
    • You introduce structured ways of working (e.g. analysis frameworks, testing approaches, reporting standards)
    • You bring external best practices from leading DTC / eCommerce companies
    • You ensure analytical work is repeatable, scalable and decision-oriented

Your Qualifications

  • You have 5+ years of experience in analytics, data, or performance marketing, ideally within DTC or ecommerce environments
  • You demonstrate a proven ability to translate data into business impact and decision-making, leveraging modern tools and AI where relevant
  • You have experience working with analytics and data tools (e.g. SQL, Databricks, Tableau, Google Analytics or similar)
  • You have experience with attribution, incrementality and performance analysis across channels
  • You have a strong understanding of eCommerce / DTC metrics (conversion, CAC, LTV, retention, etc.)
  • You show strong interest and experience in AI, automation and new technologies, with a hands-on mindset to test and implement new solutions
  • You have experience working with eCommerce platforms (e.g. Shopify), which is a plus
  • You bring a hands-on, pragmatic and performance-driven mindset
  • You are fluent in English and German

Why choose us?

Being part of our team means joining a high-performing company with a diverse and inclusive culture. In our fast-growing team of over 1,200 employees, we combine our passion for sports nutrition, supplements, and healthy foods with cutting-edge technology, production, and logistics processes. All of this serves one goal: providing our customers with top-quality products to support their healthy and active lifestyle.

You can look forward to a strong sense of team spirit, ongoing opportunities for professional growth and responsibility, and an exciting work environment that blends lifestyle and career. With locations in Hamburg, Elmshorn, Kaltenkirchen/Nützen, and Elsdorf, TQG offers diverse career opportunities in areas such as technology, product development, sales, marketing, and logistics. Additionally, you’ll benefit from:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work options
  • Attractive employee discounts
  • Subsidy for the E-gym Wellpass
  • Workation
  • Corporate benefits
  • 28 days vacation/year
  • and much more

About Us

The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products, bringing together the successful brands ESN and More Nutrition since 2021.

ESN has been the German market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products like protein powders, bars, and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. Founded in 2017, More Nutrition focuses on healthy, reduced-sugar foods, providing solutions for conscious nutrition and weight management without compromise.

TQG’s vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovation, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance, and joy in life. Its agile company culture and exciting career opportunities make TQG a strong partner not only for customers but also for employees.

This is us – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!
We look forward to your application! Regardless of gender, age, background, or identity – what matters to us is who you are and what you bring to the table. Join our team and grow with us!

jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA
