About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

jobs.description:
The Business Systems Analyst supports the Adjudicators team within Senior Health, working in the Medicare Supplement (Med Supp) Claims space. This role partners with business stakeholders, technology teams, and vendors to analyze business needs, improve processes, and deliver technology solutions that support organizational objectives. The Business Systems Analyst gathers and analyzes requirements, evaluates impacts across systems and operations, supports implementation efforts, and provides recommendations that drive business value. Serving as a liaison between business and technical teams, this role helps ensure solutions align with strategic goals, operational needs, and customer expectations.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications):
    • Business Systems Analyst I: $25.50-$32.00 Hourly, plus annual bonus opportunity.
    • Business Systems Analyst II: $59,800-$76,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.
    • Business Systems Analyst III: $68,000-$87,500, plus annual bonus opportunity.
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Gather, analyze, document, and validate business requirements, data, workflows, and user needs to support business and technology initiatives.

  • Partner with stakeholders, technical teams, and vendors to evaluate solution options, develop recommendations, and support successful implementation of business solutions.

  • Conduct business process analysis and impact assessments to identify risks, dependencies, opportunities, and operational considerations across systems and business functions.

  • Develop and execute testing activities, including test planning, test script creation, test execution, defect tracking, and validation of business and functional requirements.

  • Support business case development, cost-benefit analyses, research activities, reporting, and data-driven decision-making.

  • Create and deliver communications, training materials, and change management support to facilitate adoption of new processes, systems, and technologies.

  • Provide ongoing production support, troubleshoot system issues, and identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.

  • Maintain knowledge of assigned business areas, industry trends, business analysis practices, and technology tools while supporting Agile and continuous improvement initiatives.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Knowledge of business analysis principles, methodologies, tools, and techniques.

  • Ability to analyze business and technical requirements and translate findings into effective solutions.

  • Understanding of business processes, workflow analysis, systems implementation, and process improvement methodologies.

  • Experience with requirements gathering, testing methodologies, solution validation, and stakeholder collaboration.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Knowledge of project delivery methodologies, including Agile and traditional project management practices.

  • You promote a collaborative culture, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
  • Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States.

PREFERRED:

  • Knowledge of insurance products, insurance operations, regulations, and industry practices.

  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and product delivery methodologies.

  • Knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), BABOK, IIBA, DMBOK, and related business analysis frameworks.

  • Experience with process automation, test automation, and workflow management tools.

  • Data analysis, reporting, visualization, and quantitative problem-solving capabilities.

We value unique experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

Who are you?

You're the person clients are relieved to hear from. You remember that one firm wants the exhibits sent a certain way and that another always needs things yesterday, and you handle both without breaking a sweat. You're detail-obsessed, calm when a deposition is on the line, and happiest when you've spotted a problem before anyone else knew it existed. You like owning things through to the finish, you love building real relationships, and you know how to balance a busy inbox with the bigger picture. In this role, you'll be both a trusted relationship owner and an operational partner, working side by side with Account Executives, Scheduling, Operations, Production, and Billing. This role reports to the Customer Success leadership team.

On a regular basis you will

  • Be the primary day-to-day contact for your assigned AmLaw firms, delivering white-glove, personalized service shaped around each firm's preferences and workflows
  • Partner with Account Executives to stay aligned on account priorities, client concerns, and opportunities to grow and improve the relationship
  • Review and coordinate deposition orders through daily quality checks, making sure jobs are entered accurately and tied to the right firm and location
  • Triage scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellation requests, routing them to the right teams and following through until they're done
  • Spot urgent and expedited requests, communicate the urgency clearly, and rally internal teams to meet client deadlines
  • Own first-line issue resolution, managing tickets with clear documentation, prioritization, and follow-up, and escalating high-impact issues to the right people

  • Keep clients informed with proactive updates and get ahead of questions before they become concerns
  • Share what you're seeing, from recurring errors and ticket trends to shifts in client sentiment, with AEs and leadership, and help fix root causes
  • Educate clients on Steno's products, services, and best practices, and flag opportunities for firms to get even more from our technology
  • Pitch in on scheduling inboxes and ticket queues during high-volume periods, and join our after-hours coverage rotation for urgent, last-minute deposition needs

You're gonna crush it if

  • You have 3+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or customer service in the legal industry
  • You have a client-first mindset and a track record of delivering responsive, dependable, high-touch service
  • You're known for your attention to detail and can catch discrepancies in job details, firm and location assignments, scheduling information, and documented preferences
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in writing and by phone, including through difficult conversations
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing competing deadlines and urgent requests without dropping the ball
  • You think critically, dig into root causes, and know when to escalate
  • You're comfortable moving between multiple platforms and using data to spot trends and make decisions
  • You take ownership, hand off cleanly, and see issues through to resolution
  • You're adaptable, collaborative, and energized by a changing workload
  • You're available to participate in after-hours coverage when needed
  • You're available to work core business hours in the Central timezone

Our client is a Saudi online career platform: job seekers upload their CV and the platform matches them with open vacancies that fit their experience. jobs.title: Senior Attorney - Legal
jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

As a Senior Attorney - Legal, you will join a specialized corporate, securities, and M&A law practice operating as a fractional general counsel alternative for growing companies. In this hybrid, high-ownership role. You will split your focus between substantive billable legal support and behind-the-scenes business development and proposal production.

Rather than functioning as a junior paralegal or administrative coordinator, you will operate as an experienced, versatile legal professional capable of independent first-pass drafting, legal research, and rigorous quality control under the supervision of licensed US attorneys. On the commercial side, you will translate market intelligence into tailored,persuasive proposals and presentation materials that position the firm effectively without engaging in direct one-on-one prospect sales calls.

This role demands sharp legal judgment, strong commercial writing skills, and high technical fluency across AI-assisted drafting workflows. You will thrive in a fast-moving environment where proactive escalation, disciplined documentation,and cross-matter ownership enable attorneys to deliver high-caliber client service.

Accountability

As a Senior Attorney – Legal, your success will be defined by your ability to deliver accurate, attorney-ready first-pass legal work alongside compelling, tailored business development proposals while maintaining rigorous compliance and contract records.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Billable Corporate, Transactional & Compliance Legal Support

  • Prepare corporate forms, regulatory and state filings, annual reports, and associated supporting documentation.
  • Draft and revise contracts, engagement letters, compliance materials, and new-client onboarding documents using firm templates and AI drafting tools.
  • Conduct defined legal research, organize sources, summarize findings, identify inconsistencies, and perform first-pass quality control before escalating substantive legal issues to supervising attorneys.
  • Track shareholders, share classes, shares held, signatures, and class-specific approval thresholds, maintaining accurate supporting calculations and flagging discrepancies for attorney determination.
  • Support multiple attorneys across concurrent client matters with high autonomy, maintaining accurate and accessible matter records in firm systems while attorneys retain final legal judgment and approval.

Business Development & Proposal Production

  • Identify prospective business opportunities, including fractional counsel needs, in-house counsel vacancies, and general counsel openings, and review daily leads surfaced through automated lead-sourcing workflows.
  • Research target prospects and tailor the firm’s positioning as a strategic alternative to traditional in-house legal hires.
  • Draft opportunity-specific proposals, engagement pitches, retainer-renewal materials, and Google Slides presentation copy articulating the firm’s capabilities and offerings.
  • Support LinkedIn-related prospect research and collateral creation, collaborating closely with the Chief of Staff and supervising attorneys to refine and verify all outbound materials for accuracy before delivery.

AI-Assisted Legal Drafting & Quality Control

  • Utilize Claude and the firm’s proprietary AI drafting workflows as core components of daily billable legal work to transform attorney instructions and templates into structured first and second drafts.
  • Critically audit AI-generated legal content to verify citations, facts, legal context, and completeness, eliminating inaccuracies or missing context prior to attorney review.
  • Incorporate supervising attorney feedback efficiently to increase drafting velocity without compromising legal precision.

Contract Lifecycle, Filings & Legal Systems Administration

  • Maintain the contract lifecycle management (CLM) system and support platform integration workflows alongside the Chief of Staff, tracking contracts from drafting through execution, renewal, and termination.
  • Prepare and verify DocuSign signature packages, route documents, monitor execution, preserve signed records, and maintain accurate audit trails.
  • Coordinate paper filing submissions through US-based personnel when required and maintain filing confirmations and compliance records.
  • Track registered-agent notices, entity records, and corporate compliance calendars—including annual reporting and state filing deadlines—proactively gathering required information and routing critical correspondence.

Colleagues

You will work directly with the Chief of Staff as your day-to-day manager and collaborate closely with the Managing Partner / Founder and multiple firm attorneys across corporate, transactional, and compliance matters. Because you will serve as the sole dedicated resource bridging legal execution and business development collateral, clear communication and proactive coordination with legal leadership are essential. At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Senior Attorney – Legal, your vertical strength will be corporate, transactional, and compliance legal drafting and research, while your horizontal capabilities should span persuasive commercial proposal writing, AI-assisted legal workflows, and disciplined legal operations.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: Admitted Attorney-at-Law in Sri Lanka (or equivalent licensed lawyer with common-law training; an LLB alone does not meet qualification requirements), with substantial corporate, commercial, transactional securities, employment, or compliance practice experience (litigation-only backgrounds are not suitable). Prior experience supporting US or UK law firms and company secretarial work is strongly advantageous.
  • Legal & Commercial Writing: Demonstrated ability to independently execute first-pass contract drafting, legal research, and quality control under attorney supervision, paired with exceptional written English to craft persuasive business proposals, pitch decks, and engagement materials.
  • Tools & Systems: Functional proficiency with Claude and legal AI drafting workflows (experience building Claude skills, agents, or connectors is a plus), alongside high technical adaptability across Google Slides, DocuSign contract lifecycle management platforms, Trello, and LeanLaw.
  • Process & Mindset: Disciplined documentation habits, strong attention to detail in cap table and compliance tracking, and high responsiveness during Eastern Time (ET) working hours with minimal handholding and proactive escalation of substantive legal questions.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Corporate & Transactional Legal Drafting: How have you independently drafted and reviewed contracts, corporate filings, and compliance materials under supervising attorney oversight?
  • AI-Assisted Legal Review & Judgment: How do you use AI tools like Claude to accelerate legal drafting while critically auditing outputs for hallucinations, citation accuracy, and missing context?
  • Tailored Business Development & Proposal Writing: How have you researched prospective clients and translated their business needs into persuasive proposals and presentation decks?
  • Compliance, Cap Table & Contract Lifecycle Rigor: How do you manage overlapping corporate compliance calendars, signature audit trails, and shareholder approval tracking without missing deadlines?
  • Cross-Matter Ownership & Communication: How do you prioritise tasks across multiple senior stakeholders, maintain clear system documentation, and determine when to escalate legal determinations?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

jobs.excerpt: Du verwandelst Anfragen von KMU und inhabergeführten Betrieben in Abschlüsse und greifst zum Telefon, wenn gerade keine anstehen.
jobs.description:
Du verwandelst Anfragen von KMU und inhabergeführten Betrieben in Abschlüsse und greifst zum Telefon, wenn gerade keine anstehen.

Du willst verkaufen, nicht verwalten? Du greifst lieber zum Telefon, als auf Anfragen zu warten? Dann lies weiter.

Du bist das Gesicht von Sebotics gegenüber deinen Kunden – vom ersten Anruf bis zum laufenden Servicevertrag. Du betreust inhabergeführte Betriebe und KMU, die selbst entscheiden: Restaurants, Hotels, Heime, Reinigungsfirmen. Marketing liefert dir Anfragen, du machst daraus Abschlüsse. Dabei bist du nicht allein: Der Techniker deiner Region ist dein Teampartner – deine Augen, Ohren und Hände beim Kunden. Bei technischen Fragen holst du ihn ins Teams-Gespräch; das Vertrauen, das du am Telefon aufbaust, vertieft er vor Ort.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Anfragen in Abschlüsse verwandeln: Eingehende Leads rasch und präzise bearbeiten: Bedarf klären, Lösung zeigen, Kosten transparent machen.
  • Aktiv telefonieren: Wenn keine warmen Leads anstehen, akquirierst du neue Kunden am Telefon. Das Telefon ist dein Hauptwerkzeug.
  • Im Team mit der Technik: Du holst den Techniker deiner Region dazu – ins Teams-Gespräch für die technische Beratung oder zum Kunden für Begehung, Vorführung und Fotos – und übernimmst seine Erkenntnisse sauber.
  • Zum Abschluss führen: Vorführung, Testphase, Kauf oder Miete, Installation – und vor allem Serviceverträge.
  • Ansprechperson bleiben: Läuft beim Kunden etwas nicht rund, bist du die erste Nummer, die er wählt. Du sorgst intern für die Lösung.
  • CRM lückenlos führen: Kontakte, Gespräche, Chancen und Aufträge – vollständig und am selben Tag.
  • Sichtbar auf LinkedIn: Du zeigst mit deinem eigenen LinkedIn-Profil, dass du zu Sebotics gehörst, und teilst mindestens zweimal im Monat, was in deinem Bereich passiert.

Das bringst du mit

  • Nachweisbare Verkaufserfolge, idealerweise im B2B-Telefonverkauf oder Inside Sales. Quereinsteiger/innen mit belegbaren Zahlen sind willkommen.
  • Hunger auf Erfolg: Du willst etwas erreichen und gehst dafür die Extrameile.
  • Ehrlichkeit: Du sagst, was Sache ist – auch wenn es nicht läuft. Ohne Ausreden, mit Lösungen.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Du willst unsere Roboter und die Branchen unserer Kunden wirklich verstehen.
  • Teamgeist: Du hast Freude an der Arbeit und an den Menschen um dich herum.
  • Digital fit: Sicher mit Computer, E-Mail, CRM und Videocalls (Teams). Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge wie ChatGPT oder Claude selbstverständlich im Alltag.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; Schweizerdeutsch, Französisch oder Englisch sind ein Plus.

Passt nicht, wenn du …

  • lieber verwaltest, Preislisten pflegst oder Strategien entwirfst, statt zu verkaufen,
  • Gründe suchst, warum es heute nicht klappt,
  • schon alles besser weißt, bevor du den Markt kennst,
  • dich mit CRM, E-Mail und KI-Werkzeugen schwertust – und das nicht ändern willst.

Das bieten wir

  • Warme Leads aus Marketing und Kampagnen in deiner Region – wer gut verkauft, bekommt mehr.
  • Ein Technik-Team in deiner Region, das für dich begeht, vorführt, installiert und betreut.
  • Fixlohn plus Provision nach einem transparenten Provisionsplan.
  • Geschäftshandy mit eigener Nummer, Laptop und ein CRM, das alles festhält.
  • Verkaufstrainings und eine Lernplattform zu Produkten, Preisen und Vorgehen.
  • Die Besten entwickeln wir gezielt weiter, z. B. vom Inside Sales zum Key Account.

unserer Jobseite lädst du deine Unterlagen hoch – das dauert rund zehn Minuten.

About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You’ll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.

As an intern, you’ll collaborate with experienced teammates across the company to help shape the future of OpenSesame. You’ll work on meaningful projects that bring new ideas to life, strengthen the customer experience, and help customers achieve success.

AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You’ll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we’ll encourage you to use them to research, prototype, analyze, and build. You’ll explore how AI and data can inform strategy, improve customer outcomes, and shape the future of learning technology, and see how human-centered design and AI innovation combine to create products with global impact.

Intern AI Hackathon

As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You’ll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.

About the Legal Team

Our Legal Team is where precision meets innovation. We partner across every department to ensure compliance, safeguard intellectual property, and help OpenSesame scale responsibly. From managing contracts and supporting data privacy to advising on business strategy, we combine critical thinking, collaboration, and curiosity to deliver results.

As AI transforms how organizations operate, our team is exploring new ways to integrate automation and data-driven insights into our legal work—helping us stay ahead of the curve. If you’re excited to see how modern in-house legal teams operate at the intersection of technology and business, this is the perfect place to start your journey.

Performance-Based Objectives

By 2 Weeks

  • Learn OpenSesame’s legal processes, tools, and contract management systems.
  • Review standard agreement templates and conduct research supporting compliance, privacy, and risk management.
  • Shadow the legal team to understand how we collaborate cross-functionally across departments.

By 30 Days

  • Assist with reviewing and organizing agreements in the company’s contract repository.
  • Support compliance initiatives related to privacy, intellectual property, or AI governance.
  • Collaborate with the legal team to update templates and refine internal documentation or playbooks.

By 60 Days

  • Take ownership of a project that enhances legal efficiency—such as optimizing workflows, exploring AI-assisted research, or improving contract lifecycle processes.
  • Present your findings and recommendations to the team, showcasing your ability to analyze, community.

Application and Creative Project

Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide. It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.

To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.

We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.

You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:

  • How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
  • What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
  • Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
    • Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
    • Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.

We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.

Not selected for this role? You're still in the running. We'll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we'll reach out to you directly.

Additional Program Details

Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027

Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation: $25 an hour

Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.

Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame’s internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You’ll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.

Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they’re being considered for.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process. For more information on our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion initiatives, click here.

CPRA (California candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General’s website.

Das UNITY AI Booster Team

Das UNITY AI Booster Team ist UNITYs Entwicklereinheit für die Entwicklung und Implementierung von KI-Lösungen in den Geschäftsprozessen unserer Kunden. Wir entwickeln Lösungen mit hoher Technologiebandbreite, von Machine Learning Use Cases, LLM Use Cases oder eigenen Agentenplattformen. Das erwartet dich

  • Konsequent automatisieren statt Handarbeit:Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, containerisierte, reproduzierbare Deployments.
  • Sicherheit und Compliance sicherstellen: Secrets- und Zugriffsmanagement, Guardrails, Nachvollziehbarkeit nach EU AI Act.
  • Kunden bei Architektur- und Betriebsentscheidungen beraten – als technischer Sparringspartner*, nicht als Kundenmanager*.

Was du hier lernst

  • MLOps-/LLMOps-Patterns im echten Kundenbetrieb statt im Lehrbuch.
  • Wie man KI-Systeme so baut, dass sie den EU AI Act überstehen, statt ihn nachträglich zu reparieren.
  • Den Sprung vom PoC zur produktiven, kosten- und latenzbewussten Plattform.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von Software.
    • Senior-Rolle: mehrjährige Praxis im Design und Betrieb produktiver Systeme
  • Solide DevOps-Basis: Container/Kubernetes, CI/CD, agiles Entwicklungsumfeld.
  • Cloud-Erfahrung (AWS, Azure oder GCP), Deployment als Container, API oder Serverless.
  • Praxis mit Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform, Ansible, Helm oder GitOps).
  • Python plus mindestens eine weitere Sprache (Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# oder Shell).
  • Grundverständnis von LLM-Systemen: RAG-Architekturen, Prompting, Agenten-Frameworks (z. B. LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI).

Für wen das hier nichts ist:

  • Wer Kundenkontakt komplett vermeiden will – ihr sprecht mit IT-Verantwortlichen auf Augenhöhe, das gehört dazu.

jobs.title: Founding Optimization Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Founding Optimization Engineer Build the algorithmic core of planqor.
jobs.description:
Founding Optimization Engineer

Build the algorithmic core of planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape the optimization architecture on a greenfield: custom algorithms, heuristics, OR and simulation, fast C++ with Python on top. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The algorithmic core: Design how planqor.ai represents, propagates and optimizes schedules, resources and constraints, and how it repairs them when disruptions hit.

  • Performance: Make it fast. Profile and optimize the C++ core and expose it cleanly.

  • Evidence: Build the benchmarks, instances and experiments that show what actually works and where it fails.

  • The path to production: Work with our systems engineer to turn algorithms into decisions planners trust.

  • The team: Grow into leading optimization at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our goal is not to build the most impressive optimization algorithm on paper. It is to build decision systems that remain useful when the real world changes. A strong solution that can be updated, repaired and explained quickly beats closing the last optimality gap on a static model.

So we are neither a solver wrapper nor a research lab. We use whatever works (MIP, CP, heuristics, local search, simulation, learning or something purpose-built) and let the evidence decide.

Generative AI makes this loop dramatically faster. We use it to implement ideas, explore alternatives and evolve algorithms against our benchmarks. But speed only counts if the methodology holds: representative data, adversarial tests, meaningful metrics, rigorous validation.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong modern C++ and performance engineering. You are comfortable building performance-critical algorithms, profiling them, choosing appropriate data structures, and reasoning about runtime, memory, and scalability.

  • Real experience solving optimization problems. This may come from Operations Research, combinatorial optimization, scheduling, MIP/CP, heuristics, local search, simulation, optimization under uncertainty, or related fields. You do not need to be an expert in all of them. Big plus for Sequential Decision Analytics.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual models and algorithms: how state is represented, how changes propagate, how components interact, and how the complete decision system behaves under real-world disruptions.

  • Python for experimentation and data analysis. You can build benchmark pipelines, analyze data, visualize results, and quickly investigate why an approach succeeds or fails.

  • Empirical engineering judgment. You design experiments, challenge assumptions, measure performance, and abandon approaches when the evidence says they are wrong.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

What you'll get

  • Ownership: shape the optimization architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the optimization team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

  • We equip you with the hardware, compute and tools you work best with.

  • Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

  • Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  1. Send your CV.

  2. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

More at home in backend and product? Check out our Founding Full-Stack Engineer role.

jobs.title: Oracle EPM Managed Services Consultant

jobs.description:
Ascend Partners is the Diamond Standard in EPM Advisory & Delivery. From our headquarters in New York, NY, we work with finance, planning and data leaders across North America to choose, build and run the systems they depend on. Our experienced teams help clients close faster, plan with confidence and trust their numbers, on whichever platform best fits their needs.

Ascend’s proven methodology and deep product knowledge underpin our EPM practices and have earned us recognition as an award-winning OneStream Diamond Partner. InnoFin operates as our Oracle practice, drawing on extensive platform expertise and Gold Partner credentials to guide each implementation.

Position Summary

The Oracle EPM Managed Services Consultant is responsible for the ongoing support, administration, maintenance, and enhancements of clients’ Oracle Enterprise Performance Management applications. The role requires strong Oracle EPM expertise, an understanding of finance processes, and the ability to resolve functional and technical issues. The role balances day-to-day production support and ticket resolution with planned enhancements and contributions to small-to-medium enhancement projects that improve client EPM applications.

Day-to-day responsibilities include managing incidents and service requests, monitoring integrations and application processes, maintaining configurations, supporting critical financial cycles, and delivering approved enhancements. The consultant works closely with client finance and IT teams to maintain reliable applications and meet agreed service-level commitments.

The successful candidate takes ownership of assigned client environments, communicates clearly, and operates independently while coordinating with Managed Services leadership on priorities, escalations, and matters outside the agreed support scope.

Position Responsibilities

Product Support and Issue Resolution

  • Provide ongoing functional and technical support for assigned Oracle EPM applications, including Planning (EPBCS), Financial Consolidation and Close (FCC), Account Reconciliation (ARCS), and Narrative Reporting, as applicable.
  • Manage incidents and service requests from intake through resolution, maintaining accurate ticket records and timely client updates.
  • Assess business impact and urgency to prioritize work in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Troubleshoot calculation errors, consolidation issues, data discrepancies, integration failures, reporting problems, and access issues.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents.
  • Coordinate with Oracle Support on service requests, product defects, and complex issues.
  • Escalate service risks, critical incidents, and unresolved issues promptly to Managed Services leadership.

Application Administration and Maintenance

  • Maintain dimensions, hierarchies, forms, business rules, reports, dashboards, substitution variables, and application settings.
  • Administer user access and security based on approved client requests and access-control procedures.
  • Monitor scheduled jobs, data loads, integrations, and application performance; investigate failures and validate results.
  • Maintain data mappings, integration processes, and administrative automation using relevant Oracle EPM tools.
  • Perform application snapshot, backup, and restoration activities according to documented client procedures.
  • Assess monthly Oracle EPM updates, coordinate regression testing, and communicate potential impacts.
  • Follow approved change-control procedures for testing, authorization, deployment, and post-change validation.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close, account reconciliation, budgeting, and forecasting activities.
  • Apply functional finance and accounting knowledge to diagnose issues and validate application behavior.

Prepare applications for new financial periods, planning cycles, and approved organizational changes.

Enhancements and Mini-Projects

  • Gather requirements for small enhancements and assess effort, dependencies, and impact.
  • Configure, test, and deliver approved enhancements within the managed services agreement.
  • Identify work outside the support scope and provide information needed for separate assessment and approval.
  • Recommend improvements that increase reliability, improve performance, and reduce manual effort.
  • Adhere to project plans as established for mini-projects and meet all deadlines established between client and internal teams.
  • Identify opportunities to bundle related tickets or requests into larger improvement initiatives.
  • Stay current on Oracle EPM patch releases and product updates

Client Service and Knowledge Management

  • Serve as a day-to-day support contact for assigned clients and manage expectations through clear communication.
  • Participate in service reviews, reporting on open issues, SLA performance, recurring incidents, and improvement actions.
  • Maintain support runbooks, configuration records, troubleshooting guides, and client-specific operating procedures.
  • Provide user guidance and knowledge sharing to client teams.
  • Conduct EPM trainings to client teams covering topics such as SmartView, Report building, and administrator training topics.
  • Support the transition of newly implemented applications into managed services by reviewing documentation, access, known issues, and operating requirements.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to maintain coverage, effective handovers, and consistent service quality.
  • Maintain and pursue relevant Oracle EPM certifications.
  • Contribute to internal service improvement initiatives and other duties relevant to the role.

Work Environment

  • Manages multiple client environments with competing priorities and time-sensitive requests.
  • Works at a steady pace, with periods of increased demand during financial close, planning cycles, and critical incidents.
  • Exercises a high degree of autonomy while maintaining regular communication with clients and Managed Services leadership.
  • Works collaboratively in a remote or distributed team environment.
  • Provides support during agreed service hours; any extended-hours or on-call responsibilities will be defined for the position.

Position Outcomes/Objectives and Standards of Performance

1. Maintains reliable Oracle EPM applications.
Assigned applications support clients’ financial processes consistently. Routine monitoring and maintenance are completed, and operational risks are identified and addressed promptly.

2. Resolves incidents and requests within agreed service levels.
Issues are prioritized appropriately, investigated thoroughly, and resolved within applicable SLA targets. Clients receive timely updates, and escalations occur before service commitments are at risk.

3. Supports successful financial cycles.
Applications are prepared for critical close, reconciliation, budgeting, and forecasting activities. Issues affecting these processes receive appropriate priority and coordination.

4. Delivers controlled, high-quality changes.
Enhancements and maintenance changes meet approved requirements, pass relevant testing, and follow change-control procedures. Documentation is updated to support ongoing operations.

5. Builds strong client relationships.
Client feedback reflects confidence in the consultant’s responsiveness, expertise, and communication. Expectations, service scope, and outstanding actions are clearly understood.

6. Improves service efficiency and team capability.
Recurring issues are reduced through root-cause resolution, automation, and process improvements. Knowledge is documented and shared to support consistent service delivery.

7. Demonstrates professional conduct and ongoing development.
Works collaboratively, takes accountability for commitments, and maintains current knowledge of Oracle EPM capabilities and relevant finance processes.

Qualifications, Skills, and Competencies

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered.
  • Typically five or more years of hands-on Oracle EPM experience, including production support and application administration.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting business-critical Oracle EPM applications through financial close or planning cycles.
  • Experience in managed services, application support, or a multi-client consulting environment preferred.
  • Relevant Oracle EPM certification preferred.
  • Implementation experience and experience transitioning applications into ongoing support are advantageous.

Skills

  • Expert knowledge of at least one core Oracle EPM application, with working knowledge of related modules.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across application configuration, calculations, integrations, security, and reporting.
  • Experience with Smart View, Data Integration / Data Management, and relevant Oracle EPM reporting tools.
  • Knowledge of business rules, Calculation Manager, Groovy, and Essbase concepts where applicable.
  • Experience with EPM Automate, REST APIs, or scripting for administration and support automation.
  • Functional understanding of consolidation, accounting, reconciliation, budgeting, or forecasting processes.
  • Familiarity with incident management, problem management, SLAs, and change control.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to data accuracy.

Competencies

  • Takes ownership of issues and follows through on commitments.
  • Communicates clearly with finance users, technical teams, and client leadership.
  • Prioritizes effectively across support and enhancement project work, adjusting priorities based on business impact, contractual commitments, deadlines, and client needs..
  • Maintains visibility into workload, upcoming commitments, and capacity; proactively communicate when priorities or deadlines require adjustment.
  • Remains calm and methodical when resolving urgent production issues.
  • Works independently while recognizing when to seek assistance or escalate.
  • Collaborates effectively and shares knowledge with colleagues.
  • Identifies practical opportunities to improve service and client outcomes.

Our commitment

Ascend Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, creed, color, age, religion, gender, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military status, national origin, or ancestry. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace where all employees and partners are valued, respected, and supported.

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. What you’ll do:

  • Manage Mozilla’s root store: Make root store management your primary responsibility, through public review processes, and policy and audit evaluations and using certificate analysis tools, the Common CA Database (CCADB), to process root inclusions, trust changes, and removals and maintain accurate trust and revocation data.
  • Evaluate CA compliance and investigate incidents: Review certificates, CA policies, audit reports, and incident responses. Identify gaps, ask precise follow-up questions, assess corrective actions, and support informed trust decisions.
  • Develop security policy and standards: Contribute to Mozilla’s Root Store Policy, program guidance, and CCADB and CA/Browser Forum requirements through technical analysis, clear drafting, and constructive public discussion.

  • Understanding of the Web PKI and internet security: Working knowledge of digital certificates, public key cryptography, TLS, certificate chains, and revocation, including how technical requirements and CA practices establish trust. Awareness of emerging threats and developments, including post-quantum cryptography, and an interest in evaluating their implications for browser trust and CA operations.
  • Practical software engineering and automation skills: Experience developing, maintaining, testing, and debugging tools or services using existing codebases, APIs, structured data, Git-based workflows, and cloud applications.
  • CA compliance and audit evaluation: Ability to critically evaluate Certificate Policies and Certification Practice Statements (CP/CPS), independent audit reports, and incident analyses against applicable requirements. Familiarity with industry requirements and WebTrust and ETSI audit frameworks and the ability to identify gaps, assess supporting evidence, and formulate precise follow-up questions.

Job Description:

Own your opportunity to make a personal impact as a Senior Data Analyst supporting the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will analyze, map, convert, validate, and reconcile data exchanged between CMS and external systems and the ClaimsCore claims-processing platform. You will support API integrations, data pipelines, file generation and ingestion, and high-volume claims-data processing in an Amazon Web Services (AWS) environment.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:

• Analyze source data from CMS, Medicare shared systems, external partners, and legacy claims-processing platforms to define conversion and integration requirements for ClaimsCore.
• Develop source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, transformation rules, field-level specifications, interface requirements, and reconciliation criteria.
• Profile Medicare and Medicaid claims data to identify completeness, validity, consistency, duplication, referential-integrity, and business-rule issues before conversion or ingestion.
• Partner with integration developers, ClaimsCore configuration teams, testers, business analysts, and claims subject matter experts to translate claims processing requirements into implementable data rules.
• Support RESTful API integrations, event-driven exchanges, ETL/ELT data pipelines, database interfaces, and batch or near real-time processing between CMS, external systems, and ClaimsCore.
• Define and validate file-generation and ingestion requirements for fixed-width, delimited, XML, JSON, EDI/X12, and partner-specific formats.
• Use SQL, Python, and analytical tools to transform, cleanse, enrich, compare, and reconcile high-volume claims, provider, beneficiary, payment, status, and reference data.
• Validate converted data and integration outputs against source systems, approved mappings, ClaimsCore configuration, business rules, control totals, and expected claims outcomes.
• Develop automated data-quality checks, exception reports, balancing controls, lineage, traceability, and reconciliation dashboards.
• Analyze rejected records, failed files, API errors, mapping discrepancies, and downstream processing issues; identify root causes and coordinate remediation.
• Support scalable ingestion and processing patterns using AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, RDS, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, and MSK/Kafka as applicable.
• Define operational metrics for throughput, latency, error rates, completeness, conversion accuracy, and reconciliation status.
• Create test data and support interface, conversion, regression, performance, and end-to-end claims-processing testing.
• Document data assumptions, transformation logic, interface dependencies, controls, known limitations, and operational procedures.
• Present findings, risks, conversion readiness, and reconciliation results clearly to CMS stakeholders, technical teams, and program leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED:
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years of data analysis, data conversion, integration analysis, or healthcare data experience.
• Advanced SQL skills and working proficiency with Python or a comparable data-processing language.
• Demonstrated experience with source-to-target mapping, data profiling, transformation, validation, cleansing, lineage, reconciliation, and defect analysis.
• Experience supporting APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, database integrations, messaging, or batch/file exchanges.
• Experience analyzing and processing large datasets and designing repeatable controls for high-volume data conversion and ingestion.
• Ability to interpret schemas, interface-control documents, data contracts, business rules, and technical specifications.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Ability to translate technical data issues and conversion results into clear business impacts for technical and non-technical audiences.
• Ability to obtain a CMS Public Trust clearance and meet the requirement of living in the United States for at least three of the last five years.
• Work visa sponsorship will not be provided.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
• Experience with HHS, CMS, Medicare Part A, Part B, DME, Medicaid, or healthcare claims-processing data.
• Experience integrating or converting data for ClaimsCore, another COTS claims platform, or legacy Medicare shared systems such as FISS, MCS, or VMS.
• Knowledge of claims intake, edits, coverage, pricing, adjudication, payment, status, provider, beneficiary, and appeals data.
• Experience with healthcare EDI/X12 transactions and fixed-width, delimited, XML, JSON, or partner-specific interface files.
• Experience with AWS S3, Glue, Lambda, RDS, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, MSK/Kafka, Athena, Redshift, or comparable cloud data services.
• Familiarity with API testing, data-pipeline monitoring, automated reconciliation, performance testing, and production support.
• Experience with PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, data visualization, or data-quality and metadata-management tools.
• Experience working in Scrum or SAFe Agile environments.

What are we looking for?

We are seeking a highly motivated Product Designer to join our team. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about user experience and design, eager to learn, and excited to work in a dynamic and fast-paced startup environment. You should be able to take direction well, but also be confident in bringing your own ideas to the table.

Requirements

    A portfolio showing your thinking, design decisions, interaction craft, and impact on real products—not just final screens.

    Experience taking digital product work from ambiguous problems to launched experiences.

    Strong skills in prototyping, UI systems, information architecture, and interaction design, working with and without AI.

    Solid user-centered design practice: knowing when to research, what to test, and how to turn findings into decisions.

    Strong written and verbal communication and comfort collaborating asynchronously with engineers and product stakeholders.

    A technical mindset and a willingness to learn. You should be curious about SQL, APIs, data models, infrastructure, and the constraints behind the UI or any of the surfaces of our product.

    Unafraid of and effective at using AI to write your own PRs and/or build fast prototypes.

    Ownership, initiative, attention to detail, and comfort working with ambiguity in a fast-moving team.

    Some other things that are important to us:

    You are fluent in English.

    You communicate well in writing. This is important mostly because we favor asynchronous work.

    You like technical software and are curious about real time data and its usage.

    Experience designing developer tools, data platforms, databases, observability, analytics, cloud infrastructure, or other technical B2B products.

    Familiarity with SQL editors, schema explorers, API tooling, query execution, performance feedback, or infrastructure consoles.

    Ability to build functional prototypes and comfortable with modern AI-assisted prototyping and coding tools.

    Experience designing complex workflows across CLI, API, documentation, and graphical interfaces.

    Experience measuring activation, task completion, usability, and adoption after launch.

    Experience with accessibility and responsive interfaces in data-dense products.

    Ideally based in Spain, Europe or the UK.

What you’ll do in this role

    As a Product Designer, you will work closely with our designers, engineers, and business stakeholders to create designs that are both functional and aesthetic. Your responsibilities will include:

    Own end-to-end design for key Tinybird RawTree experiences, from problem framing and user flows to polished interactions and production.

    Simplify the journeys that matter: getting started, connecting and exploring data, writing and testing queries, building APIs, understanding errors, and operating workloads.

    Design for different levels of technical expertise without taking control or power away from experienced developers.

    Work directly with product and engineering to explore trade-offs, prototype quickly, and make pragmatic decisions.

    Conduct lightweight user interviews, usability tests, and feedback sessions; combine qualitative evidence with product usage to prioritize improvements.

    Create information architecture, interaction patterns, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and interactive prototypes.

    Build and evolve reusable components and a coherent design system that can scale as Tinybird RawTree grows.

    Design clear system states, permissions, onboarding, empty states, loading, errors, observability, and actionable feedback—not just the happy path.

    Help customers understand the relationship between existing Tinybird workflows and RawTree, including transitions where relevant.

    Contribute to developer-facing touchpoints such as documentation, examples, and product education when they are part of the user experience.

    Define success with the team, ship, observe what happens, and iterate.

    We’re an early-stage startup, and pace and quality of execution are paramount to our success. We understand that startups aren’t for everyone, and that’s okay. As we say at Tinybird, “Speed Wins.” We don’t dither in endless meetings. We execute, analyze our performance, and adjust going forward.

Why Tinybird RawTree?

    Tinybird RawTree is a chance to shape a foundational product experience, not simply polish an established interface. You’ll help decide how sophisticated data capabilities become approachable, productive, and reliable for developers. Your work will influence both the product’s direction and the day-to-day experience of the people using it.

Some bits about the way we work

    We are a remote-friendly company, all of our previous companies were remote-friendly companies, and we intend to remain a remote-friendly company.

    Our head office is located in Madrid, we love to see each other and work face to face regularly, feel free to go whenever it suits you.

    We are just starting up so your work will impact everything we do. We also believe in full transparency, and you will always know what is going on.

jobs.description:
Mavvrik is looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer with 6–12 years of experience who combines strong software engineering capabilities with expertise in applied AI, machine learning, analytics, and optimization systems.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on building the intelligence layer that powers cloud, SaaS, and AI cost optimization capabilities, including forecasting, anomaly detection, recommendation systems, optimization models, and autonomous agents.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with deep experience in applied AI, machine learning, data analytics, and optimization systems. You actively leverage AI-assisted development platforms and agentic workflows to improve velocity while applying strong technical judgment.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and improve AI-powered capabilities that help customers understand, optimize, and control cloud, SaaS, and AI spend.
  • Develop anomaly detection systems that identify unusual spending patterns, waste, and operational risks.
  • Build forecasting models for consumption, budgets, cost trends, and capacity planning.
  • Design recommendation and optimization engines that identify savings opportunities and rank actions based on expected business impact.
  • Develop AI and ML models that improve recommendation relevance, prioritization, explainability, and customer trust.
  • Analyze large-scale cost, usage, operational, and telemetry datasets to uncover trends and optimization opportunities.
  • Design and implement feature engineering pipelines, experimentation frameworks, and analytical datasets.
  • Fine-tune AI systems and agent behaviors to improve quality, consistency, explainability, and reliability.
  • Build evaluation frameworks that measure model performance, recommendation quality, forecast accuracy, agent effectiveness, and business outcomes.
  • Analyze and eliminate failure modes such as hallucinations, reasoning failures, excessive tool invocation, and agent loops.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of autonomous and semi-autonomous FinOps agents.
  • Build integrations with MCP servers, APIs, enterprise systems, and optimization workflows.
  • Participate in multi-agent system design where specialized agents collaborate to solve customer problems.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Mavvrik’s semantic layer, business entities, metadata models, and optimization concepts.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design reviews, experimentation practices, and technical guidance.
  • Promote best practices around AI reliability, observability, governance, testing, and production readiness.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 6–12 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, machine learning, data science, or applied AI product development.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and software engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience building production-grade AI, ML, analytics, or optimization systems.
  • Strong experience with anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive analytics, recommendation systems, or optimization algorithms.
  • Experience designing and implementing data pipelines for analytical and AI workloads.
  • Experience with SQL and modern analytics platforms such as PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or similar technologies.
  • Experience deploying AI Systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of agent lifecycle management, memory, context management, tool orchestration, agent loops, and common agent failure modes.
  • Strong understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector search, hybrid search, and reranking.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of daily engineering workflows.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated code, analysis, recommendations, and designs to identify risks, inaccuracies, and hidden assumptions.
  • Ability to independently drive initiatives from concept to production.

Preferred

  • Experience building agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, or AI copilots.
  • Experience with MCP servers, tool orchestration, and at least one modern agentic AI framework such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, Mistral Agents, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience implementing AI observability, governance, evaluation, and reliability practices.
  • Experience contributing to semantic layers, business ontologies, metadata systems, knowledge graphs, or enterprise data models.
  • Experience in FinOps, cloud cost management, SaaS management, AI cost management, observability, or enterprise technology management.
  • Experience working in fast-paced startup environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Ships high-impact forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization, and recommendation capabilities that deliver measurable customer value.
  • Improves recommendation quality, accuracy, explainability, and customer adoption over time.
  • Builds robust evaluation frameworks and quality metrics that continuously improve AI system performance.
  • Contributes to autonomous optimization agents that customers trust and rely on.
  • Balances strong engineering rigor with rapid experimentation and delivery velocity.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, health insurance, and equity package
  • Remote-first work environment
  • Flexible working hours with overlap with US time zones
  • Significant opportunity to influence AI strategy and technical direction
  • Direct impact on company growth and customer outcomes
  • Opportunity to work on an AI-driven cloud, SaaS, and AI cost management platform

About Mavvrik

Mavvrik is a VC-backed, AI-driven startup revolutionizing hybrid cloud cost, SaaS cost, and AI cost management. Our platform empowers businesses to gain visibility, control, and optimization of their technology spend with real-time precision.

jobs.description:
Location: Argentina (remote)

Working Hours: 7:00 pm to 4:00 am

About the role

You help make our customers’ content work in every market by owning the delivery of their localization projects from start to finish. You work with linguists, vendors, technical experts, and colleagues across Customer Success, and you report to the Localization Program Manager. You plan your projects, make decisions within your scope, and coordinate the people involved with minimal oversight. You’ll measure success by whether our customers’ content works, not just whether it was delivered.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end execution of localization projects and workstreams, managing plans, timelines, dependencies, and milestones so deliverables meet agreed quality, schedule, budget, and client requirements.
  • Coordinate linguists, vendors, technical experts, publishers, DTP specialists, quality teams, and partners in Account Management, Program Management, Sales, Solutions, Engineering, and Vendor Management, allocating work, monitoring workload, and resolving capacity and scheduling issues.
  • Serve as the primary operational contact for your projects, giving timely updates, managing expectations, and responding quickly to client needs.
  • Identify delivery risks early, plan mitigation, decide how to handle routine escalations within your scope, document decisions, and escalate when the impact reaches beyond your project.
  • Apply localization workflows, client-specific processes, system requirements, and quality controls, monitor quality throughout delivery, and coordinate reviews and corrective actions that reduce errors.
  • Prepare estimates, quotes, purchase requests, and budget inputs, flag budget variances to the right stakeholder, and keep project data, reporting, and forecasts accurate to support decisions.
  • Use translation management systems, workflow tools, automation, and AI-enabled processes to improve delivery, support workflow and service changes, cut manual effort and recurring issues, and share best practices through documentation and onboarding support.

What you'll bring

  • typically 5+ years of progressive experience in localization project management or related project or service delivery roles, or equivalent experience
  • hands-on experience managing concurrent localization projects on quality, schedule, and budget, including quoting and budget control
  • hands-on experience with translation management systems, project management platforms, and reporting tools
  • an understanding of localization workflows, quality management, and project finance, including rates, margin, and cost to serve
  • clear written and spoken English for working with clients, vendors, and colleagues across cultures and time zones
  • the judgment to prioritize competing demands and manage risks and changing priorities without losing focus on delivery

Nice to have

  • experience supporting enterprise or multi-service client accounts, or regulated, technical, or software localization
  • hands-on experience with tools such as memoQ, Smartling, XTM, or Plunet, and with automation or machine translation post-editing
  • experience producing client-facing reports and delivery metrics, including dashboards or data analysis in Excel or Power BI
  • a project management qualification, such as PMP, CAPM, or Agile
  • a degree in business, communications, languages, or a related field

If you have some of these, great. If you don’t, we’d still like to hear from you.

Who we are

Acclaro is a content intelligence solutions company, helping global brands communicate with purpose and precision in every market. We bring together the strategy, expertise, and technology organizations need to shape multilingual content that earns trust, connects with buyers, and drives measurable international growth.

With offices around the globe and a team of top talent, we’re committed to being a true strategic partner to the world’s leading companies. In all we do, we remain grounded in our values, as we help make our customers’ content work everywhere.

How we work

Our values shape how we work with customers, colleagues, and partners. Here's what you can expect from us, and what we'll look for in you.

  • Be Accountable. We own our work, learn from our mistakes, and come with solutions.
  • Be Proud. We care about the work, hold a high standard, and celebrate each other's wins.
  • Be Resilient. When things get hard, we stay calm, adapt, and ask for help when we need it.
  • Be Curious. We ask why, keep learning, share what we know, and explore new ways of working, including AI.
  • Be Kind. We assume good intent, give honest feedback with care, and look out for each other.

Inclusion and equal opportunity

Acclaro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

We assess every candidate against the same criteria. If you need a reasonable accommodation to take part in any stage of our hiring process, let your recruiter know. We'll work with you to find a solution and keep what you share confidential.

jobs.title: Recruitment Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: We need a hands-on recruiting lead who can interview, headhunt and fill roles every day, and run the process and the team that makes it all faster.
jobs.description:
We need a hands-on recruiting lead who can interview, headhunt and fill roles every day, and run the process and the team that makes it all faster.

The opportunity

Limitless Talent places closers, setters, client success managers, media buyers and marketing managers for the agency owners in our programs, and hires for Limitless itself. Demand is already there: more than a dozen paid searches are open right now. We need someone who can carry real recruiting work and put a system around it.

About Limitless

Limitless Agency helps digital marketing agency owners build businesses that scale and sell. Our core program, Limitless Black Card, combines one-on-one strategy with the founders, implementation support, weekly group coaching and a dedicated account team. We launched Limitless Talent in September 2026 so our clients could hire A-players fast, and it's become one of our fastest-growing divisions.

Role at a glance

  • Role: Recruitment Operations Manager (Limitless Talent)
  • Team: Limitless Agency, Limitless Talent
  • Reports to: Director of Operations
  • Type: Full-time W-2 employee. Exclusive role. Remote, U.S. Eastern business hours.
  • Location: Remote, United States

The role

This is a player-coach seat. Most of your week is real recruiting: screening, interviewing, headhunting and closing candidates for client and internal roles. You also own how recruiting runs: the pipeline, the process, capacity, client updates and the weekly numbers, and you lead the recruiters who work alongside you.

No task is beneath this role. You'll post jobs, chase no-shows and update Workable yourself when that's what it takes.

What you will do

Hands-on recruiting (every day)

  • Run first-round screens and interviews for client and Limitless roles.
  • Headhunt every week on LinkedIn Recruiter and other channels. Don't wait for inbound.
  • Write and post job ads, review applicants and keep candidates moving.
  • Present shortlists and one-page candidate profiles, and close candidates through to offer and start date.
  • Fill Limitless's own sales, client success and recruiting roles with a weekly screening quota.

Delivery and speed

  • Get every new search live within 48 hours of the client's hiring alignment call.
  • Deliver a first qualified shortlist within 10 business days (sooner for sales roles).
  • Own the search queue: set capacity per recruiter, sequence new searches and give clients honest timelines.

Pipeline and process

  • Run Workable like a sales pipeline: every candidate in the right stage, every interview logged as held, no-show, pass or fail within 24 hours.
  • Standardize 20 to 25 minute first-round screens with pass/fail scorecards.
  • Write and maintain recruiting SOPs, interview guides and job description templates.
  • Use AI and automation to cut admin work.

Talent bench, team and reporting

  • Build and run our talent community, a vetted pool of strong candidates we stay in touch with so new roles fill from the bench.
  • Coach the recruiters, hold them to weekly targets and help hire new ones as we grow.
  • Run client hiring alignment calls and be the escalation point when a search is off track.
  • Send leadership a weekly scorecard: open searches, days to shortlist, interviews held, pass-through rates and starts.

How we'll measure you

  • Search live after alignment call: 48 hours
  • First qualified shortlist to client: 10 business days or less
  • Interview outcomes logged in Workable: 100%, within 24 hours
  • Headhunted candidates added: 25+ a week, visible in Workable
  • Internal Limitless roles: weekly screening quota hit, every week
  • Talent community: 300+ vetted members by day 90
  • Placements starting: 5 to 10 a month across the team, 1 to 2 of them internal Limitless hires

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on recruiting, including leading or mentoring other recruiters or running delivery at a recruiting or staffing agency.
  • You still love the work itself: screening, interviewing and headhunting are part of your week.
  • Experience running many searches at once and hitting time-to-fill and quality targets.
  • A track record hiring sales, client success and marketing roles for U.S. companies, including remote and international hires.
  • Process brain: you've built pipelines, SOPs, scorecards and reporting.
  • Power user of an ATS (Workable strongly preferred) and LinkedIn Recruiter. Comfortable using AI tools every day.
  • Confident with clients: you can run an alignment call, push back on unrealistic asks and protect our standards.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken. Available full-time during U.S. Eastern hours, with no other jobs or side clients.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a digital marketing agency or with agency-owner clients.
  • You've built or run a talent community or candidate network.
  • Experience with behavioral assessments (Predictive Index or similar).

Prove it

Finalists will be asked to show real numbers and real work, for example:

  • Searches you ran at the same time, with time-to-shortlist and time-to-fill.
  • A pipeline, scorecard or SOP you built, and what it changed.
  • A live headhunting exercise: find five strong candidates for one of our open roles.

Who thrives here

You're driven, organized and fast. You do the work yourself and fix the system around it. You hold people to a standard, side with the company's standards when a client pushes, and tell leadership the truth even when the numbers are bad. If you only want to manage and not recruit, this isn't the seat for you.

Benefits

  • Base pay: $60,000 USD a year ($5,000 a month)
  • On-target earnings: $84,000 USD a year on-target earnings
  • Incentives: $200 per client placement that starts (whole team) + $400 per Limitless internal hire who passes 60 days
  • Benefits: Health insurance and benefits package (details in the offer letter).

A fixed base plus incentives on every hire that starts. Placement incentives are paid at the end of the month the candidate starts; internal-hire incentives after the hire passes 60 days. Final terms are in the written offer letter.

How we got to the numbers (expected team volume: 5 to 10 hires a month, 1 to 2 of them internal)

  • Ramp: 4 client + 1 internal hires, incentives $800 + $400 = $1,200, $6,200/month ($74,400 annualized)
  • On target: 6 client + 2 internal hires, incentives $1,200 + $800 = $2,000, $7,000/month ($84,000 annualized)
  • Strong: 8 client + 2 internal hires, incentives $1,600 + $800 = $2,400, $7,400/month ($88,800 annualized)

Examples, not guarantees. Incentives are uncapped.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building relationships, developing business opportunities, and contributing directly to company growth.

Partner Development & Business Growth
