jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.excerpt: An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives.
jobs.description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives.Come join the excellence!

Overview

The Project Management area is responsible for leading a team, typically cross-functional teams, to achieve project goals and requirements. Work with project teams and stakeholders to plan, execute, monitor, and control the project. Manage resources, budget, cost, time, quality, risks and other constraints.

Responsibilities

Position Summary:

  • The Global Service Delivery Project Management team is to provide a professional project management service supporting the Global Service Delivery and Processing Operations organisations for the delivery of projects within the Payment, Financial and Telecoms divisions.
  • The Project Manager will manage projects requiring provision and implementation of services. These projects are derived from two sources, customers and internally. The Project Manager is expected to manage multiple concurrent projects and to have full control of those projects during their entire lifecycle. The Project Manager will work with guidance and supervision from the management team.
  • Projects range in size from a week to many months. In most cases the Project Manager will be heavily reliant on specialist teams to deliver their work, therefore people management is key. This does not rule out the possibility, on occasions, of Project Managers having technical input and ownership where their skills suit.
  • The Project Manager has the authority to run the project on a day-to-day basis on behalf of the Project Sponsors within the constraints laid down by them. Prime responsibility is to ensure that the project produces the required deliverables, to the required standard of quality and within the specified constraints of time and cost.
  • Whilst a managed and structured approach to Project Management is required, this should not be a limiting FRctor. The Project Manager, with the support of the Management team must be capable of selecting the appropriate project controls on a per project basis bearing in mind the FRst paced environment we operate within.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Manage the delivery of the required objectives within agreed time and budget parameters.
  • Direct and motivate the overall project team.
  • Produce all relevant documentation in line with the departmental procedures; this may include the participation in external audits.
  • Provide regular project status reports.
  • Identify and recommend operational improvement opportunities consistent with the delivery of the key project outputs (NB any such opportunity must be carefully scrutinised to assess that it is IN/OUT of project scope).
  • Prepare, track, and maintain the project plan throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Monitor resource availability and utilisation.
  • Establish all required communication paths and processes within the project and between the project and other interested parties in the business, and with customers and 3rd parties.
  • Identify, via a risk log, and manage business and project risks, including the development of contingency plans via the nominated risk owners.
  • Formally manage issues through to resolution and utilise the escalation path where necessary.
  • Correct implementation of the change control process.
  • Responsible for managing the internal and external dependencies that may influence the project.
  • Liaise, closely, with the project sponsors to assure the overall direction and integrity of the project
  • Agree technical and quality strategy with appropriate members of the project team.
  • Prepare any follow-on action recommendations required at the end of project
  • Identify and obtain support and advice required for project management, planning or control
  • Be responsible for project administration.
  • Liaise with any Suppliers and account managers.
  • Assist, as required, with the management of standard work requests.
  • Maintain professional standards by keeping abreast of the latest trends and techniques.
  • Maintain an understanding of the technologies and products within TNS.
  • Qualifications:
  • Working with others – as part of a team, as opposed to working separately or competitively.
  • Organising work/project management – the ability to establish a clearly defined course of action to accomplish goals and to organise work efforts.
  • Technical /professional expertise - the ability and motivation to expand one's own technical/professional knowledge and share this experience.
  • Customer orientation – a willingness to help and serve others and meet their needs whether they are internal or external.
  • Change management/adaptability – the ability to maintain effectiveness in a challenging environment.
  • Directing work through others - the ability to direct, when necessary, the activities of others in the best interests of the organisation and its customers.
  • Computer literate with sound working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Project, Visio, Sharepoint.
  • Competent in report and project documentation writing.
  • Worked as a Project Manager for at least two years within the technology (Telecommunications environment particularly) sectors.
  • Strong technical IT industry experience in one or more of the following; Network/communications, Processing, card payments, EFT or application development.
  • Well practised at conducting workshops and meetings.

Qualifications

Desired Qualifications:

  • 6 to 10 years as a project manager
  • Personal drive – the drive to work well and achieve results by competing against a standard of excellence
  • Initiative – a bias for action to meet immediate challenges or to think ahead and meet future opportunities and challenges
  • Building trust - the ability to stick with principles that both earn and foster trust and respect from others
  • Influence – the ability to persuade or influence other people to accept a point of view, to adopt a specific agenda or take a course of action
  • Analysis - the ability to gather relevant information, notice relationships between different pieces of information, reason from cause to effect and generate effective solutions to practical problems
  • Self confidence – a belief in one's own opinion, decision and capability to accomplish a task and select an effective approach to a task or problem

Education and Certifications:

  • Formal Project Methodology training e.g. PRINCE2, PMP
  • Degree/HNC in a technically related discipline (IT, Telecommunications)

If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about!

TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

As a global leader in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, Autodesk helps people imagine, design, and create a better world. Our broad portfolio gives customers the tools to solve design, business, and environmental challenges.


The Applied ML team is seeking a Senior Engineer, Applied AI to build AI capabilities that deliver meaningful insights to Autodesk users. You’ll apply machine learning, data science, and software engineering to solve complex problems, taking solutions from exploration and prototyping through integration and production on Autodesk’s data and AI platforms.

If you have a strong background in machine learning and software development, experience bringing AI solutions into production, and a passion for applying emerging technologies to real-world problems, you may be a great fit.


Do you thrive in a fast-paced, high-energy environment? Are you a creative problem solver who enjoys building solutions with cutting-edge technologies? Do you like collaborating with motivated people from diverse backgrounds and making ideas happen? If so, we’d like to hear from you.

Take a look at some of the work we’re doing:

Tutor - AI for Creative Industries
Location: Fully Remote - Anywhere in New Zealand
Full-time | Permanent | Remote

About the Role:

We are seeking a creative and learner-centric Tutor to deliver the AI for Creative Industries strand of the New Zealand Certificate in Study and Employment Pathways (Level 4) within our online campus.

This programme supports ākonga and workforce learners to develop study and employment readiness, while developing foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence applied within creative contexts. The Creative strand is designed for learners exploring how AI tools and systems can support, enhance and optimize creative practice in ethical, human-centered, and culturally responsive ways.

This role is ideal for a tutor who is confident facilitating learning in a primarily asynchronous online environment and who can translate emerging AI concepts into practical, accessible learning experiences for creative learners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate learning in an online and largely asynchronous environment using the LMS and digital communication tools
  • Support learners across Creative strand and shared core courses, including:
    • Introduction to AI concepts and ethical awareness
    • Study skills, digital literacy, and employment readiness
    • AI technologies in creative practice
    • AI-enabled creative workflows and tools
  • Support ākonga to explore and evaluate AI tools used in creative industries (e.g. design, media, content creation, ideation, workflow optimization)
  • Guide learners to analyse AI outputs and communicate reflective, well-reasoned insights as part of their creative practice
  • Provide clear, timely and constructive online feedback on assessments
  • Monitor learner engagement and proactively support learners who may be new to study, technology, or creative tools
  • Maintain accurate academic records and contribute to continuous improvement of online delivery

About You

We are seeking a creative professional who brings both industry insight and a passion for learner success. You have a background in the creative industries and are confident using emerging AI tools within creative workflows such as design, content creation, digital media, or creative production.

You are able to translate new and evolving AI capabilities into practical, engaging learning experiences for aspiring creatives. Rather than a purely technical AI background, you bring a practitioner’s perspective on how AI can enhance and support creative practice.

With a learner-centred and culturally responsive approach, you are committed to supporting diverse ākonga and fostering ethical, human-centred use of AI in creative industries.

Please note: This is a full-time teaching position. We are only able to consider candidates who can fully commit to the role and are not seeking this opportunity as a secondary or side position.

Required Skills / Experience:

  • Professional background in the creative industries (e.g. design, digital media, content creation, creative technologies, or related fields)

  • Practical experience using AI-enabled tools within creative workflows

  • Ability to explain AI concepts in a creative, accessible, and learner-friendly way

  • Strong written communication skills and confidence engaging learners in an online environment

  • Teaching, tutoring, mentoring, or learner support experience (preferred but not essential)

  • Confidence supporting learners in an online or blended learning environment (advantageous)

  • A culturally responsive and inclusive approach aligned with Te Tiriti o Waitangi, supporting Māori, Pacific, and diverse learner communities

  • Commitment to ethical, responsible, and human-centred use of AI in creative practice

Why work with us?

Yoobee Colleges prides itself on supporting a diverse and inclusive culture - open to inputs from creative people of all genders, ethnicity, identity, thought and experiences. We are fast movers, action orientated, keen innovators, and quick thinkers who enjoy a workplace that is inspiring and fun.

  • Fully remote working part of an online team
  • Be a part of NZ’s Largest specialist creative & technology college
  • Rewarding opportunity to support students in their journey pursuing creative and tech industries
  • Strong commitment to your professional growth & development
  • Amazing work culture that is highly collaborative and supportive

To Apply:

To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and interest in the role.

Questions about your identity help us appreciate the diversity of individuals looking to work with us, ensuring we’re attracting applications from people with identities and perspectives that are as diverse as our students.

We are an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to equity, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment. 

Who are we?

At Yoobee Colleges, we believe learning should be defined by the exceptional. New Zealand’s largest specialist creative and technology college; we’ve been fuelling the creative and tech industries for over 30 years with talented Animators, Filmmakers, Designers, Techies, and Game Developers. We offer online delivery, alongside our campuses based in Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch.

Making a difference to someone’s life by sharing your industry knowledge, experience and stories is incredibly exciting and rewarding. We work passionately to prepare our students’ to be ‘work ready, world ready’ for an industry we love . . . and you can be a part of this

anstellungsdetails

info

Wer wir sind

Wir sind das Tech-Powerhaus hinter den internationalen Kaufland-Online-Marktplätzen und ein Unternehmen der Schwarz Gruppe. Mit Start-up-Mentalität und auf Augenhöhe entwickeln wir in flachen Hierarchien die besten Marktplatz-Lösungen: für unsere Kunden, Händler und Partner. #AusEuropaFürEuropa

Wir im Kundenservice versuchen deswegen nicht nur, als Kommunikationsexperten den Belangen des Kunden gerecht zu werden, sondern arbeiten auch gemeinsam mit anderen Abteilungen an proaktiven Lösungen.
Bei uns im CS Development Team steht die strategische Weiterentwicklung unseres Kundenservices im Fokus. Wir identifizieren und implementieren Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten, die den Kundenservice optimieren und die Kundenzufriedenheit steigern. Dabei arbeiten wir eng mit der Abteilung Tech & Product zusammen, um innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln und unsere Dienstleistungen im Kundenservice kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben - Das erwartet dich im Detail

  • Du trägst mit neuen Projekten, Prozessen und der Einführung von Tools maßgeblich dazu bei, unseren Online-Marktplatz kundenfreundlicher und effizienter zu gestalten. Hierbei steht die Automatisierung, insbesondere mittels KI-Tools, im Vordergrund
  • Du bewertest firmenweite Entwicklungen und neue Tech-Features hinsichtlich ihrer Relevanz für den Kundenservice, stellst, wenn nötig, die Umsetzung von Kundenservice-Anforderungen in der Entwicklung sicher und steuerst die Operationalisierung innerhalb des Kundenservice-Teams
  • Du analysierst den Status Quo bestehender Prozesse, u. a. mithilfe von vorliegenden Kundenanfragen, und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale durch Daten- und Prozessanalysen
  • Du leitest basierend darauf entsprechende Maßnahmen ab, stellst diese vor und bist ganzheitlich für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich. Dabei behältst du die wirtschaftlichen Aspekte stets im Auge
  • Du arbeitest mit vielen anderen Abteilungen eng zusammen, wie z. B. Tech & Product, Marktplatz-Support, Logistik, Finance, Legal

profil

Dein Profil - Das erwarten wir von dir

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit wirtschaftlichem Schwerpunkt (z. B. BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik)
  • Du verfügst über Praxiserfahrung in den Bereichen Business Development oder im Projektmanagement im Bereich Prozess- & Softwareoptimierung, idealerweise im Kundenservice
  • Du bist technik- und datenaffin und hast bereits Erfahrung in der Nutzung von KI- und Automatisierungstools zur Transformation von Businessprozessen
  • Du steuerst mehrere Initiativen parallel – eigenständig, pragmatisch und priorisierungsstark in agilen Umfeldern

  • Du kommunizierst klar, vertrittst dabei die Standpunkte des Kundenservices und bedienst dabei diverse Stakeholder-Gruppen
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1) und fühlst dich wohl dabei, im Arbeitsalltag regelmäßig und viel Englisch zu sprechen
  • Herausforderungen motivieren dich! Du bist in der Lage, dich in komplexe Prozesse hineinzudenken sowie Lösungen eigenständig zu entwickeln

benefits

Das bieten wir dir

  • Create your own work-life: Entscheide flexibel, ob du remote (innerhalb Deutschlands) oder an einem unserer Standorte in Köln, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf oder in Berlin arbeiten möchtest!

  • This is who we are: Unsere dynamische Kultur kombiniert flache Hierarchien, Start-up-Mentalität, ein internationales Team aus über 65 Nationen und der Power der Schwarz Gruppe, um dir ein agiles und sicheres Arbeitsumfeld zu bieten

jobs.description:
Chcesz rozwijać środowisko Microsoft 365, w którym technologia realnie ułatwia codzienną współpracę? Interesują Cię Microsoft Teams, Teams Rooms, nowoczesne rozwiązania konferencyjne oraz automatyzacja usług IT? Dołącz do projektu, w którym będziesz mieć wpływ na rozwój narzędzi wykorzystywanych przez użytkowników w międzynarodowej organizacji.

Szukamy Senior Systems Engineera / Senior Systems Engineerki, który/a połączy doświadczenie techniczne z podejściem skoncentrowanym na użytkowniku. Jeśli lubisz rozwiązywać złożone problemy, usprawniać istniejące usługi i wdrażać technologie, które przynoszą konkretną wartość – ta rola jest dla Ciebie.

O roli i zespole

Dołączysz do obszaru Collaboration Services, odpowiedzialnego za rozwój i utrzymanie usług współpracy opartych na ekosystemie Microsoft 365 w międzynarodowym środowisku enterprise.

Twoim głównym obszarem odpowiedzialności będą Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Teams Rooms oraz technologie wykorzystywane w salach konferencyjnych. Będziesz rozwijać rozwiązania zapewniające spójne, niezawodne i intuicyjne doświadczenia podczas spotkań oraz współpracy między zespołami i lokalizacjami.

Na co dzień będziesz:

  • Zarządzać środowiskiem Microsoft Teams Rooms, urządzeniami konferencyjnymi, panelami sal oraz powiązanymi technologiami audio/video.

  • Diagnozować i rozwiązywać złożone problemy techniczne związane z Microsoft Teams, systemami konferencyjnymi i usługami współpracy.

  • Odpowiadać za lifecycle management, aktualizacje, standaryzację i rozwój infrastruktury sal konferencyjnych.

  • Monitorować usługi, identyfikować potencjalne problemy i wdrażać usprawnienia, zanim wpłyną na użytkowników.

  • Współpracować z lokalnymi zespołami IT, użytkownikami, dostawcami i partnerami technologicznymi.

  • Wspierać adopcję Microsoft Teams i innych narzędzi Microsoft 365, analizując potrzeby użytkowników i przekładając ich feedback na konkretne usprawnienia.

  • Automatyzować powtarzalne zadania z wykorzystaniem PowerShell, Power Automate i Microsoft Graph.

  • Testować nowe funkcjonalności Microsoft 365, w tym rozwiązania AI, Microsoft 365 Copilot i Agents.

  • Współtworzyć kierunek technologiczny i roadmapę rozwoju usług Collaboration Services.

W zależności od Twojego doświadczenia i zainteresowań będziesz mieć również możliwość pracy z szerszym ekosystemem Microsoft 365, obejmującym SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange, Planner, Viva, Loop, Stream, Forms, a także Digital Signage, usługi SMTP, rozwiązania Adobe oraz zarządzanie licencjami Microsoft 365.

Nie musisz znać wszystkich tych technologii. Kluczowe jest doświadczenie w obszarze Teams i Teams Rooms oraz gotowość do rozwijania kompetencji w kolejnych usługach.

Wymagania

  • Bardzo dobra, praktyczna znajomość Microsoft Teams i Microsoft 365, zdobyta podczas pracy w środowisku enterprise.

  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu i utrzymaniu Microsoft Teams Rooms, systemów konferencyjnych lub rozwiązań meeting-room.

  • Umiejętność diagnozowania i rozwiązywania złożonych problemów technicznych związanych z usługami współpracy oraz technologiami audio/video.

  • Dobra znajomość ekosystemu Microsoft 365 i zależności między jego usługami.

  • Doświadczenie w utrzymaniu, optymalizacji i rozwijaniu usług IT z uwzględnieniem potrzeb użytkowników końcowych.

  • Samodzielność, proaktywność i odpowiedzialność za prowadzone działania.

  • Umiejętność współpracy z zespołami technicznymi, użytkownikami biznesowymi oraz zewnętrznymi dostawcami.

  • Nastawienie na ciągłe doskonalenie usług, upraszczanie procesów i wdrażanie nowych rozwiązań.

  • Komunikatywność, otwartość na dzielenie się wiedzą i chęć poznawania nowych technologii.

  • Biegła znajomość języka angielskiego w mowie i piśmie.

Dodatkowym atutem będzie:

  • Znajomość PowerShell, Power Automate i Microsoft Graph oraz doświadczenie w automatyzacji procesów administracyjnych.

  • Doświadczenie z SharePoint Online, OneDrive i Exchange Online.

jobs.title: Senior Conversion Rate Optimization Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: stellenausschreibung Mit unserer Marke deinSchrank.
jobs.description:
stellenausschreibung

Mit unserer Marke deinSchrank.de stehen wir für maßgefertigte Möbel „Made in Germany“. In unserer eigenen Produktion fertigen wir in Losgröße 1 und begeistern Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa – überwiegend über unsere digitalen Kanäle.
Unser Marketing bauen wir gerade neu auf. Ein zentraler Hebel für unser Wachstum ist eine konsequent getestete Customer Experience – vom ersten Besuch über die Planung im Konfigurator bis zur Bestellung. Dafür suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – remote aus ganz Deutschland – eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior Conversion Rate Optimization Manager (m/w/d).

das erwartet dich

  • Du verantwortest die Conversion-Optimierung unserer Online-Shops und baust ein systematisches Testprogramm auf, in dem dauerhaft Tests laufen.
  • Du entwickelst Hypothesen aus Daten, Nutzerverhalten, Kundenfeedback und Wettbewerbsvergleichen und priorisierst sie in einem transparenten Backlog.
  • Du konzipierst A/B-Tests, setzt Varianten KI-gestützt um – etwa Mockups, Texte und Layouts – und wertest sie statistisch sauber aus.
  • Du optimierst unseren Online-Konfigurator, Produktseiten, Checkout und Landingpages und reduzierst gezielt Hürden und Abbrüche im Planungs- und Kaufprozess.
  • Wo der Traffic für A/B-Tests nicht reicht, arbeitest du mit qualitativen Methoden wie Session-Analysen, Heatmaps und Nutzerbefragungen.
  • Du dokumentierst Ergebnisse und Learnings in einem Testlog und stellst sie regelmäßig im Management und im Team vor.
  • Du baust agentische Workflows für Analyse, Variantenentwicklung und Reporting auf.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Performance Marketing, CRM, Content, Design und unserer Webentwicklung zusammen.

das solltest du mitbringen

  • Langjährige Erfahrung in der Conversion-Optimierung, idealerweise im E-Commerce, mit einer großen Zahl selbst verantworteter Tests
  • Ein gutes Gespür dafür, welche Änderungen wirklich verkaufen – und nicht nur, was gut aussieht
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Testmethodik und Statistik, z. B. Signifikanz, Laufzeiten und Stichprobengrößen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Analyse- und Testing-Tools wie GA4, Microsoft Clarity oder gängigen A/B-Testing-Plattformen
  • Ein ausgeprägtes UX-Verständnis; Webdesign-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus, Programmierkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich
  • Eine starke KI-Affinität und Erfahrung darin, Mockups, Varianten und Analysen mit KI-Tools zu erstellen
  • Durchsetzungsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse auch auf Management-Ebene überzeugend zu vertreten
  • Erfahrung mit konfigurierbaren oder erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten ist von Vorteil
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; Niederländisch ist ein Plus
  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise; ein Wohnort im Raum Köln/Bonn ist ein Plus

das bieten wir dir

  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau unseres Testprogramms – inklusive der Freiheit, es mit KI-Agenten zu skalieren – und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis mit einer fairen, leistungsgerechten Vergütung in einem wachstumsstarken, innovativen Unternehmen
  • Moderne Tools und eine eigene KI-Infrastruktur für das Marketing
  • 30 Urlaubstage und eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung
  • Eine offene Kommunikationskultur, flache Hierarchien und ein familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld
  • Eine gezielte Einarbeitung sowie Weiterbildung und Förderung deiner Entwicklung
  • Rabatte auf unsere Möbel, „Family and Friends“-Angebote und weitere Mitarbeitervorteile
  • Remote-Arbeit aus ganz Deutschland und regelmäßige Mitarbeiter-Events vor Ort

die nächsten schritte

Du willst unsere Shops messbar besser machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit zwei bis drei Beispielen aus deinen bisherigen Tests (Hypothese, Ergebnis, Learning), deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung – per E-Mail an

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

About Us:

Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care.

A career with Psychiatry UK allows you to expand your knowledge, enhance your skills, and gain valuable life experience—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote full-time role. As part of a leading online mental health service, you'll collaborate with innovative, forward-thinking professionals in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team committed to making a real difference.

The ADHD Specialist GP plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality, patient-centred care within Psychiatry UK’s ADHD service. Reporting to the Titration Team Lead and working in close collaboration with Consultant Psychiatrists, the postholder is responsible for the treatment and ongoing management of adults with ADHD, including the independent or supplementary prescribing of ADHD medication in accordance with national guidance and Psychiatry UK clinical policies. Clinical supervision is provided by the ADHD Clinical Leadership team.

The ADHD Specialist GP will exercise a high level of autonomous clinical judgement to initiate, titrate, and monitor treatment, evaluate therapeutic effectiveness, manage clinical risk, and ensure safe and effective prescribing, while consistently upholding professional, ethical, and governance standards. Through collaborative multidisciplinary working, the role contributes to service development, clinical governance, and quality improvement, supporting Psychiatry UK’s commitment to innovation and excellence in mental healthcare.

This is a home-based role (applicants must be UK-resident), with occasional travel required for face-to-face meetings at various locations across the UK.

As our ADHD Specialist GP, you will:

• Deliver safe, effective, and evidence-based prescribing for adults with ADHD, in line with NICE guidance, Psychiatry UK clinical policies, and the Royal Pharmaceutical Society (RPS) Prescribing Framework.

• Manage a defined caseload of patients throughout titration and ongoing treatment, ensuring timely review of treatment response, side effects, adherence, and physical health parameters, including patients with physical health complexity.

• Communicate with patients via Psychiatry UK’s secure digital portal, providing clear, supportive, and clinically appropriate responses to medication-related queries.

• Complete End of Titration Reviews (EOTRs) and undertake annual medication reviews in a timely, thorough, and patient-centred manner to ensure continuity and quality of care.

• Exercise independent or supplementary prescribing rights within scope of practice, recognising professional limitations and seeking senior clinical advice when required.
• Provide clinical support and guidance to fellow prescribers, particularly in relation to physical health co-morbidities.

• Work collaboratively with Consultant Psychiatrists and the wider ADHD multidisciplinary team to deliver coordinated, high-quality care.

• Undertake regular risk assessments and review safeguarding concerns, escalating appropriately in accordance with organisational policy.

• Maintain accurate, comprehensive, and confidential clinical records using Psychiatry UK’s digital systems, in line with professional, ethical, and legal standards.

• Participate in audit, quality improvement initiatives, and prescribing reviews to support clinical governance and service development.

• Engage in regular clinical supervision, peer support, and team learning to maintain high standards of clinical decision-making.

• Contribute to the ongoing development of Psychiatry UK’s prescribing pathways, titration protocols, and service delivery models.

• Support the delivery of internal and external education and training sessions, sharing specialist knowledge and best practice.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant legislation, prescribing guidance, and organisational policies, demonstrating a strong commitment to continuing professional development.

The ADHD Specialist GP will hold prescribing responsibility within the titration team. Supervisory and appraisal responsibility will sit with an ADHD Clinical Lead, in line with RCGP guidance. Applications are welcomed from candidates currently practising as a GPwER in ADHD.

To succeed as our ADHD Specialist GP, you will have:

Demonstrable clinical experience in the assessment and management of ADHD in adults. Training will be provided in the prescribing and titration of ADHD medication. You will evidence a strong patient-centred approach, with the ability to show empathy, professionalism, and to build and sustain effective therapeutic relationships with patients and colleagues. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are essential, including the ability to engage clearly and sensitively both remotely and in written formats, and to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary and multi-agency teams.

You will be proficient in the use of ADHD rating scales, validated screening and outcome-monitoring tools, and have a clear understanding of safeguarding responsibilities, particularly within remote and digital models of care.

You will also demonstrate a sound understanding of relevant legislation, professional standards, and current developments in ADHD services and prescribing practice. The ability to work autonomously, safely, and efficiently while managing an independent caseload is required, supported by strong IT and digital literacy skills and confidence in using digital health platforms.

Essential Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

GP Requirements

  • GMC-registered General Practitioner with a valid licence to practise in the UK with 1-2 years post CCT experience as a GP.

  • Sound understanding of ADHD management or willingness to undertake training.

  • Experience working with patients with chronic physical and mental health diagnosis and complex medical needs.

Desirable Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Experience with titration and long-term management of stimulant and non-stimulant ADHD medications.

  • Understanding of clinical governance, audit, and quality improvement processes related to prescribing.

  • Knowledge of safeguarding procedures and risk assessment in mental health and remote care settings.

Psychiatry UK: Supporting You

Понад 1000 клієнтів у більш ніж 80 країнах вже переконалися в здатності Precoro створювати реальну бізнес-цінність і забезпечувати суттєву економію коштів.

Ми шукаємо Python Developer до Integrations Team. Наш ідеальний кандидат шукає нові виклики, сильну команду та можливість зробити свій вклад в продукт, який несе цінність клієнтам по всьому світу.

Команда Integrations відповідає за розвиток нативних інтеграцій Precoro з бізнес-системами NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Xero, BILL, Slack, MS Teams.
Найближчим часом ти працюватимеш над перенесенням інтеграцій з QuickBooks та Xero з PHP-моноліту на Python мікросервіс, підтримкою і розвитком наявних інтеграцій та над розробкою нової інтеграції з Sage, Workday, SAP, Zoho.

Твої задачі включатимуть:

  • Перенесення логіки інтеграцій з PHP-моноліту на Python мікросервіс

  • Розробку нової інтеграції з Sage

  • Підтримку та розвиток наявних нативних інтеграцій

  • Написання якісного коду, який легко підтримувати та розвивати

  • Участь у технічних обговореннях та пошуку оптимальних рішень разом із командою

Ми шукаємо людину, яка:

  • Має 1-3 роки досвіду розробки на Python

  • Добре розуміє OOP, типізацію та принципи clean code

  • Має досвід роботи з background jobs та чергами повідомлень (Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ)

  • Має досвід роботи з Flask або подібними фреймворками

  • Володіє SQL на практичному рівні

  • Працювала з REST API, Docker та Git

  • Вміє працювати з існуючою кодовою базою, пропонує покращення та бере відповідальність за свої рішення.


Буде плюсом:

  • Досвід роботи зі сторонніми інтеграціями

  • Знання Swagger/OpenAPI

  • Базове розуміння PHP (Symfony або Laravel)

Якщо це про тебе — чекаємо на твій відгук!

Що ми пропонуємо:

  • Довіра — база: Без мікроменеджменту — ми цінуємо твої ідеї та ініціативи.

  • Культура команди: Ти ніколи не залишишся сам на сам — наша команда відкрита, чесна та завжди готова допомогти.

  • Компенсація професійного розвитку: Ми інвестуємо у твій ріст через курси, лекції та інші можливості навчання.

  • 26 днів відпочинку щороку (15 днів відпустки + 11 державних свят): Ми дбаємо про баланс між роботою та особистим життям.

  • Медичне страхування (після шести місяців) та необмежена кількість лікарнянихбез медичних довідок: Здоров’я — пріоритет.

  • Pet-friendly офіс у Києві: Любиш свого пухнастого друга? Бери його з собою на роботу!

  • Підтримка України: Ми активно допомагаємо Збройним Силам та долучаємося до проєктів, які наближають нашу перемогу.

Наш процес наймупрозорий та швидкий:

  • Скрінінг резюме (Ми уважно розглядаємо всі резюме, але зв’яжемося лише з релевантними кандидатами)

  • Зустріч з рекрутером (45 хв)

  • Технічна співбесіда з наймаючим менеджером (1 година)

Приєднуйся до команди, яка цінує довіру, прозорість і відкриту комунікацію. Більше про цінності Precoro можна прочитати за цим посиланням.

jobs.description:
Role: Penetration Tester

Location: Remote (must be located near London)

About Rhymetec:

Rhymetec is an industry leader in the MSSP cybersecurity space. Our goal is to simplify cybersecurity for our clients so they can become compliant faster and focus more on their business and less on the complexities of building effective and compliant infosec programs.

Description:

The Lead Penetration Tester is an experienced offensive security professional who reports directly to the Director of Offensive Security. In this client-facing role, you will lead and execute penetration testing engagements for MSSP customers, serve as an escalation point for other penetration testers, and help ensure high-quality, defensible deliverables across the team

Responsibilities:

  • Independently execute in-depth web application and API penetration tests, performing manual testing, exploitation, and vulnerability validation beyond automated scanning.
  • Identify, exploit, and document security vulnerabilities with reproducible steps, supporting evidence, defensible severity ratings, and clear, actionable remediation recommendations.
  • Participate in customer kickoff, scoping, status, and debrief calls as needed; explain technical risks and remediation priorities clearly to engineering and security stakeholders.
  • Validate and triage customer bug bounty submissions, confirming reproducibility, exploitability, impact, and the accuracy of reported vulnerabilities.
  • Support PTaaS engagements, including ongoing security assessments, vulnerability validation, retesting, and customer remediation tracking.
  • Contribute to vulnerability research, emerging threat and CVE analysis, custom tools, scripts, testing playbooks, methodologies, and the penetration testing report writing library.

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 2 years of verifiable, full-time professional penetration testing experience.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience conducting both web application and web API penetration tests.
  • Strong manual testing, vulnerability exploitation, attack-path validation, and technical problem-solving skills beyond the interpretation of automated scanner results.
  • Ability to produce clear, customer-ready penetration testing reports with reproducible evidence, accurate severity ratings, and actionable remediation recommendations.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings and remediation guidance effectively to customer engineering and security teams.
  • Must be based in the United Kingdom and legally authorized to work in the UK. Employment sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Candidates must hold at least one of the following certifications, or an equivalent certification demonstrating practical, hands-on penetration testing skills:
    • OffSec Web Assessor (OSWA)
    • OffSec Web Expert (OSWE)
    • OffSec Certified Professional (OSCP / OSCP+)
    • OffSec Experienced Penetration Tester (OSEP)
    • Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP)
    • HTB Certified Web Exploitation Specialist (CWES)
    • HTB Certified Web Exploitation Expert (CWEE)
    • HTB Certified Offensive AI Expert (COAE)
    • HTB Certified Bug Bounty Hunter (CBBH)

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred; proficiency across all of them is not required:

  • Red teaming or adversary emulation, including attack chaining, post-exploitation, and objective-driven assessments.
  • Mobile application penetration testing (iOS and Android).
  • Internal network penetration testing, including Active Directory environments and lateral-movement techniques.
  • Desktop or thick-client application penetration testing (Windows, macOS, or Linux).
  • Cloud security testing or configuration reviews (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Browser extension penetration testing.
  • GenAI and LLM application security testing, including prompt injection, insecure tool integrations, and application-specific AI vulnerabilities.
  • PTaaS delivery, bug bounty triage, vulnerability disclosure, phishing or vishing, and hands-on offensive tool development.

Must be currently based near London. No sponsorship available for this position.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive, company-funded private medical insurance for employees
  • Dental and Optical benefits
  • Generous annual leave package, plus sick pay and 28 days annual leave including bank holidays
  • Workplace pension
  • Wellbeing Support: An annual subscription to TalkSpace, our online counseling and therapy service

Rhymetec is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic background, disability, or age.

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an E-commerce Operations & Data Analyst to support the day-to-day logistics, inventory management, operational reporting, and data analysis of a growing e-commerce business.

This is an operations-first role, not a highly technical data engineering position. You’ll coordinate freight and inventory, maintain accurate operational data, manage Shopify information, build reports and dashboards, and use spreadsheets to help the business make better operational decisions.

You’ll also use modern AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to streamline repetitive work, improve reporting, and make internal processes more efficient.

The ideal candidate combines logistics and e-commerce experience with strong spreadsheet and analytical skills and enjoys continuously improving how operations are run.

What You’ll Own

Logistics & Freight Coordination

  • Manage freight and shipment coordination from start to finish.
  • Track shipments, deliveries, and fulfillment timelines.
  • Coordinate closely with warehouses and logistics partners.
  • Maintain visibility into shipment status and proactively address delays.
  • Keep accurate and organized logistics records.
  • Ensure day-to-day logistics workflows run smoothly.

Inventory & Purchase Order Management

  • Monitor inventory levels and stock availability.
  • Create and manage purchase orders based on inventory needs.
  • Use sales trends and forecasting data to support purchasing decisions.
  • Help prevent stockouts and unnecessary overstock.
  • Maintain accurate inventory trackers and records.
  • Support inventory planning across products and fulfillment channels.

E-commerce Operations

  • Manage and update product and operational data within Shopify.
  • Maintain accurate product information and internal records.
  • Support day-to-day e-commerce operational workflows.
  • Coordinate information across inventory, logistics, sales, and customer operations.
  • Identify operational issues and help resolve them before they impact customers.

Reporting & Data Analysis

    • Returns
    • Customer service
    • Product performance

  • Analyze operational data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities.
  • Build and maintain dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into performance.

AI & Workflow Improvement

  • Use AI to support:
    • Reporting
    • Data organization
    • Dashboard workflows
    • Analysis

  • Develop practical AI-assisted processes that improve speed and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with developers when more technical integrations or automations are required.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to make operations more efficient.

  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple operational workflows.
  • You understand how logistics, inventory, and e-commerce operations connect.
  • You enjoy working with spreadsheets and turning operational data into useful insights.
  • You proactively identify problems rather than waiting for them to escalate.
  • You look for better, faster ways to complete repetitive work.
  • You’re comfortable experimenting with AI tools without needing to be a developer.
  • You can independently manage responsibilities in a remote environment.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills using Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Strong operational reporting and data management abilities.
  • Experience building or maintaining dashboards, reporting systems, or operational trackers.
  • Experience with Shopify or a similar e-commerce platform.
  • Practical experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools in a business environment.
  • Experience improving workflows or automating repetitive operational tasks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment during U.S. business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with growing e-commerce or DTC brands.
  • Inventory forecasting or demand-planning experience.
  • Experience coordinating with third-party warehouses or fulfillment partners.
  • Experience creating automated reports or dashboards.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted data analysis and workflow automation.
  • Experience collaborating with developers on operational integrations.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review inventory levels and upcoming stock requirements.
  • Track active freight shipments and follow up with warehouse partners.
  • Create or update purchase orders.
  • Update Shopify and operational records.
  • Maintain inventory and logistics spreadsheets.

Core Skills

  • Update CRM records and maintain documentation.
  • Prepare reports, spreadsheets, and presentations.
  • Conduct online research for ongoing projects.
  • Follow up with vendors, clients, and internal teams.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

What Makes You a Great Fit

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work
Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)
References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready
For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

jobs.description:
Remote | Project-Based Independent Contractor
Compensation: $15 to $45 Location-Based Hourly Rates (USD), based on qualifications, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Legal & Regulatory Intelligence

What if your expertise in Mainland China corporate law, commercial transactions, and regulatory compliance could help artificial intelligence better understand legal requirements, governance frameworks, corporate documentation, and regulatory obligations?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced legal professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking Corporate Attorneys, Compliance Counsel, Regulatory Counsel, Legal Consultants, and Corporate Governance professionals with expertise in Mainland China's legal and regulatory environment who can apply their professional judgment, legal research skills, and regulatory knowledge to evaluate AI-generated legal content.

This isn't a traditional legal practice position. You won't be representing clients or providing legal advice. Instead, you'll assess complex legal and regulatory information, identify inaccuracies, evaluate legal reasoning, review legal documentation, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your legal expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It is important to understand the nature of freelance work. Tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Mainland China Corporate & Regulatory Legal Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and legal reasoning of AI-generated content related to corporate law, business transactions, governance, compliance, and regulatory requirements.

You'll analyze legal scenarios, corporate governance matters, commercial transactions, regulatory approval processes, and legal documentation while identifying errors, unsupported conclusions, and compliance concerns.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex legal and regulatory questions involving Mainland China's corporate legal framework.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the following areas:

1. Corporate Law & Corporate Governance

Professionals experienced in PRC Company Law, corporate governance structures, shareholder rights, board responsibilities, corporate formation, articles of association, and corporate decision-making frameworks.

2. Commercial Law & Business Transactions

Professionals with experience drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and analyzing commercial agreements, business transactions, joint ventures, investment arrangements, mergers and acquisitions, and commercial legal documentation.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Administrative Approvals

Experts in business registrations, licensing requirements, regulatory filings, foreign investment compliance, administrative approvals, corporate compliance obligations, and regulatory risk management.

4. Chinese Legal Drafting & Documentation

Professionals who regularly draft, review, or interpret legal documentation in Simplified Chinese and possess strong understanding of professional legal terminology and drafting standards.

5. Legal Research & Regulatory Interpretation

Legal professionals experienced in researching PRC statutes, administrative regulations, judicial interpretations, government publications, and authoritative legal sources.

6. Corporate Compliance & Risk Assessments

Professionals who conduct compliance reviews, legal due diligence, risk assessments, governance reviews, and internal compliance evaluations.

7. Foreign Investment & Cross-Border Transactions

Experts familiar with foreign investment regulations, market access rules, international business structures, and related regulatory requirements.

8. Corporate Legal Advisory Services

Professionals who support businesses on governance matters, commercial transactions, compliance initiatives, and corporate regulatory obligations.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated legal content: Assess corporate, commercial, governance, and regulatory content for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and legal validity.
  • Review legal and regulatory information: Examine content involving corporate governance, contracts, compliance obligations, administrative approvals, and business regulations.
  • Analyze legal reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by applicable laws, regulations, and established legal principles.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate legal interpretations, unsupported assertions, outdated regulations, and missing legal requirements.
  • Validate information: Reference PRC laws, regulations, judicial interpretations, government publications, and other authoritative legal materials.
  • Review legal documentation: Evaluate Chinese-language legal documents, governance materials, commercial agreements, and compliance documentation.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend legally accurate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Legal Expertise in a New Way

Use the knowledge you've developed throughout your legal career to contribute to advanced AI technologies.

Help Improve Legal Accuracy

Your evaluations will help strengthen the reliability and quality of AI-generated legal and regulatory information.

Work Remotely

Participate in project-based assignments from an eligible location with flexibility based on project needs and availability.

Explore Emerging Technology

Gain experience contributing to AI evaluation initiatives while applying your existing legal expertise.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for legal professionals who can recognize sound legal reasoning, identify issues, and communicate expert assessments with clarity.

Compensation

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on legal specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and project requirements.

Locations and Pay Rate (USD/Hour)

Singapore, UK, US: $35–$45

Taiwan, Europe: $25–$35

Malaysia, Hong Kong: $15–$25

Compensation may vary based on experience level, legal specialization, professional qualifications, and assignment complexity.

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
  • Geographic Requirement: Candidates must currently reside and perform all project-related work outside Mainland China
  • Required Background: Relevant legal education obtained in Mainland China and/or professional legal work experience in Mainland China
  • Domain: Legal (Mainland China)
  • Project Type: AI Content Evaluation
  • Languages: English and native-level written Chinese proficiency
  • Schedule: Variable and assignment-based
  • Project Duration: Based on project requirements and assignment availability
  • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete screening questions and evaluation exercises before project selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Legal Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced legal professional with expertise in Mainland China's corporate and regulatory environment who enjoys analyzing complex legal information, applying professional judgment, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming Mainland China Corporate & Regulatory Legal Specialist (SME) – AI Evaluator opportunities.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced legal professionals who bring more than familiarity with corporate and regulatory law. You should be comfortable reviewing complex legal information, exercising independent professional judgment, conducting legal research, and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

  • Recognized Mainland China legal professional qualification.
  • Current or previous admission to practice law in Mainland China, or equivalent corporate/compliance legal credentials.
  • Relevant legal education obtained in Mainland China and/or professional work experience in Mainland China.
  • Native-level written Chinese proficiency, including the ability to draft, review, and interpret complex legal documents using professional Simplified Chinese legal terminology.
  • Strong understanding of Mainland China's corporate laws, commercial regulations, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience in one or more of the specialty areas listed above.
  • Ability to critically evaluate legal, regulatory, and compliance-related information.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.
  • Confidence reviewing complex legal documentation and explaining legal conclusions.
  • Comfort using digital platforms, web-based applications, and legal research tools.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed instructions, and meet established quality standards.
  • Must currently reside outside Mainland China and perform all project work outside Mainland China.
  • Must understand and be comfortable with a task-based freelance engagement model.

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • Corporate Attorney
  • Corporate Counsel
  • Commercial Counsel
  • Regulatory Counsel
  • Compliance Counsel
  • Legal Counsel
  • Legal & Compliance Manager
  • Corporate Governance Specialist

Additional preferred qualifications include:

  • LL.M., Juris Master (JM), or advanced legal credentials.
  • Experience supporting multinational organizations or cross-border transactions.
  • Experience conducting legal due diligence, compliance assessments, and regulatory reviews.
  • Experience drafting and reviewing commercial contracts and corporate governance documents.
  • Familiarity with PRC legislative databases and regulatory authorities.
  • Experience preparing or reviewing bilingual Chinese-English legal documentation.
  • Experience conducting legal research using authoritative Chinese-language sources.
  • Experience with AI model evaluation, legal technology, research projects, or structured quality assessments.

Experience with AI evaluation or large language models (LLMs) is beneficial but not required.

jobs.description:
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Senior Technology Alliances Manager to own our alliances with AWS and Salesforce and turn them into sourced and influenced revenue.

Why join Sprout's Partnerships team?

At Sprout Social, our Partnerships team extends how the world's leading brands and agencies find, buy and succeed with Sprout. We work with technology alliances, agency partners and a new reseller channel to put the leading social intelligence platform in front of customers our direct teams cannot reach alone.

Strategic Alliances owns Sprout's relationships with the platforms where our enterprise customers already buy, build and spend. Today that means AWS, where customers can purchase Sprout through AWS Marketplace against their committed cloud spend, and Salesforce, where Sprout integrates with the customer's CRM and is also a Sprout customer. The portfolio will grow, and this role will shape which alliances we add next.

You will be the senior owner of these relationships, with direct access to the CRO, Product, Marketing and Finance leadership. The team is small and AI-forward, so you will have real scope and the autonomy to run it your way.

In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global brands and the partners they trust. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You'll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters.

What you'll do

  • Joint Business Plans: Build, negotiate and execute multi-year joint business plans with AWS and Salesforce, with executive sponsors on both sides and agreed targets for sourced ARR, pipeline and co-investment.
  • Executive Cadence & Governance: Run monthly operating reviews and quarterly executive business reviews with partner leadership, tracking scorecard health and risk.
  • Internal Alignment: Act as the single internal point of contact for AWS and Salesforce. Work with the CRO, Product, Marketing, Finance and Legal to prioritize platform investments, and apply AI and automation to keep reporting and cadences lean.
  • Field Interlock & Co-Selling: Operationalize account mapping (via Crossbeam or Reveal) between Sprout's Enterprise Sales teams and AWS and Salesforce field sellers. Drive co-sell through AWS ACE and the Salesforce Partner Community, and pair reps on active opportunities. Teach Sprout's sellers and Customer Success teams how to use AWS committed spend and Salesforce footprints to accelerate deals.
  • Marketplace & Commercial Structures: Own the AWS Marketplace strategy, including private offers, consulting partner private offers and EDP drawdown mechanics, and the commercial terms and listing strategy on Salesforce AppExchange. Negotiate multiparty agreements with Legal, Finance and Procurement.
  • Program Standing & Funding: Maximize Sprout's tier in the AWS ISV Accelerate Program and the Salesforce partner program. Oversee the technical and security reviews that keep that standing (such as AWS Well-Architected and AppExchange Security Review), and secure and deploy market development funds for joint initiatives.
  • Events & Joint Go-To-Market: Set Sprout's presence at anchor ecosystem events (AWS re:Invent and Summits, Dreamforce) with Marketing, and work with Product Marketing on co-branded messaging, case studies and "better together" content for partner sellers.
  • Integration Alignment: Coordinate Product and Engineering with partner technical teams to prioritize roadmap integrations and keep Sprout compliant with partner technical standards.

What you'll bring

Sprout Social is looking for a senior alliance leader who has driven real revenue through hyperscaler and platform partnerships, can negotiate complex commercial terms, and builds trust with executives on both sides of the table.

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 8-10+ years of experience in strategic alliances, business development or partner management within enterprise B2B SaaS.
  • Hands-on AWS experience: the AWS Partner Network, ISV Accelerate, the ACE portal, AWS Marketplace private offers, and a working understanding of customer spend mechanics such as EDP and PPA.
  • Experience managing a strategic platform alliance with a major enterprise software vendor, including co-selling alongside their field team (Salesforce preferred).
  • A track record of owning and achieving an indirect or co-sell revenue goal ($10M+ in sourced or influenced ARR) through technology alliances.
  • Experience negotiating complex multiparty agreements, including marketplace fee structures, tri-party papering and partner margins, with Legal, Finance and Procurement.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence without direct authority across internal sales organizations and partner go-to-market teams.

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Direct experience with Salesforce AppExchange as an ISV partner, including partner business agreements, revenue share, security review and the Partner Community.
  • Hands-on experience operating a CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot), account-mapping tools (Crossbeam or Reveal) and a PRM or channel platform.
  • Experience with AWS competency programs and technical validation such as the Well-Architected Review.
  • Experience running alliances in a lean team using AI or automation, and familiarity with emerging marketplaces and agent directories.
  • Prior experience working inside the AWS or Salesforce partner organizations.

How you'll grow

Within 1 month, you'll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout Social's new hire training and onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members, to build a broad understanding of our products and organization.
  • Build relationships with your leader and with your counterparts in Sales, Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal and Revenue Operations.
  • Meet your AWS and Salesforce counterparts and executive sponsors, introduced by your leader.
  • Review current joint business plans, scorecards, marketplace transaction history, funding status and open commitments to each partner.
  • Shadow co-sell calls and partner reviews.

Within 3 months, you'll start hitting your stride by:

  • Running the monthly operating reviews with both partners.
  • Owning the account-mapping and co-sell cadence with Enterprise Sales and partner field teams.
  • Delivering an assessment of each alliance: where sourced and influenced ARR comes from today, which investments earn their cost, and where to focus next.
  • Publishing the priorities for next year's joint business plans, agreed with the CRO and Finance.
  • Running your first enablement sessions for Sprout's sellers on marketplace and co-sell mechanics.

Within 6-12 months, you'll make the role your own by:

  • Negotiating and signing the next joint business plans with agreed targets and executive sponsors on both sides.
  • Growing marketplace transactions and co-sell volume, with measurable lift in pipeline and win rates on partnered deals.
  • Advancing Sprout's program tier and securing the funding to match, with a defined plan for ecosystem events.
  • Setting the criteria for which alliances Sprout adds next, and making the case for the first one.
  • Becoming the person leadership consults before any decision that touches AWS or Salesforce.

Of course, what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. Recognized globally as a Great Place to Work and the recipient of multiple partner excellence awards, BIG is built on collaboration, innovation, and delivering measurable business outcomes for enterprise clients. We are a team of experienced technology professionals who enjoy solving complex challenges, celebrating wins together, and helping customers modernize with confidence.

AN EXCITING OPPORTUNITY WITH BIG AND CONVENE AI

BIG is excited to be partnering with Convene AI, an AI-focused technology company developing innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to solve real-world business challenges.

As part of this partnership, we are looking for talented professionals to join BIG and work directly on Convene AI projects and initiatives. You will initially be hired as an employee of Bits In Glass, while working closely with the Convene AI team and contributing to the development and growth of their AI solutions.

The role is expected to remain on BIG’s payroll for approximately 12 months, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent position directly with Convene AI following this period, subject to business requirements and transition arrangements.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an emerging AI organization at an important stage of its growth, while benefiting from the support, culture, and established consulting expertise of Bits In Glass.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You are the tip of the spear. You own the client relationship, the scope, and the definition of done. You decide what gets built, what does not, and when to tell a client no. This is not an internal product management role and it is not a program management role. You will be embedded with an enterprise client, running discovery, converting messy business problems into AI requirements a pod can build against, and holding a weekly release cadence together while stakeholders change their minds. Because our contracts are fixed-fee and outcome-based, your scope discipline is directly connected to whether the engagement is profitable. That is real commercial responsibility and we will treat you

accordingly.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run discovery: map the current process, quantify where the pain and the money are, and identify where an agent creates measurable value rather than novelty.
    • Convert business problems into AI requirements with acceptance criteria that can actually be tested, working with the AI Quality Engineer to make them measurable before build starts.
    • Own the outcome definition on outcome-based contracts: what "working"means, how it is measured, who signs off, and what happens if the threshold is missed.
    • Manage the client-provided domain expert: secure their time in writing up front, and escalate immediately when their availability slips. Weak domain SME support is the single most common cause of slipped go-lives in this model, and catching it early is your job.
    • Manage scope ruthlessly. Weekly releases only work if the backlog is disciplined and someone is willing to be unpopular.
    • Run the weekly cadence: demo to the client, capture feedback, re-prioritise, and keep the pod pointed at the highest value work.
  • Own stakeholder alignment across business, IT, security, procurement, and legal, and get security and procurement engaged in week one rather than week nine.
    • Partner with the client's change and adoption team so the system gets used, not just delivered.
    • Track and report delivery health: burn, risk register, decision log, and benefits realisation against the agreed outcome.
    • Surface commercial risk early. Scope creep, weak executive sponsorship, and integration surprises are margin erosion, and you are the early warning system.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3–8 years in product ownership, delivery management, or client-facing consulting, including at least 2 years shipping software rather than only running programmes.
    • A track record delivering under fixed-price or outcome-based commercial terms, where scope discipline had financial consequences.
    • Fluency in agile delivery at a genuine weekly release cadence, not two-week ceremony.
    • Enough technical literacy to challenge an engineer's estimate and to understand why a retrieval pipeline is returning poor answers. You do not need to write code.
    • A working understanding of what LLM-based systems can and cannot reliably do, and the confidence to tell a client when their request is not feasible.
    • Executive presence. You will hold steering committees with client CIOs, COOs, and business unit heads.
    • Experience in at least one of insurance, financial services, healthcare, or a comparably regulated industry.
    • Excellent written communication. Ambiguity that survives your documentation becomes a defect later.
    • Legally entitled to work in Canada and willing to travel to client sites.

BONUS POINTS

  • Prior experience at a top-tier strategy consultancy, Big Four, or a specialist delivery boutique.
    • A background as a business analyst, engineer, or data professional before moving into product.
    • Familiarity with AI quality concepts: evaluation design, acceptance thresholds, and human-in-the-loop workflow design.
    • Experience running engagements alongside a separate change management partner.

• Bilingual English and French.

WHY JOIN CONVENEAI

  • You will own client outcomes, not status reports.
    • Four-person pods mean your decisions translate into shipped software within days.
    • Outcome-based commercial terms mean the work is judged on whether it created value, which is a more interesting standard to be held to.
    • You will work directly with senior operators who have led AI delivery at Fortune 500 scale.
    • Real influence over how ConveneAI's delivery model evolves as we scale from the first pods to many.

Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,500 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like British Heart Foundation, Fadata, VivaGym, Fresha, Graitec, Speexx and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

We are seeking a Senior Account Executive (Enterprise) to drive growth by owning the full sales cycle - from prospecting and pipeline creation to closing high-value, multi-stakeholder deals. This is a role for a proven hunter and closer who thrives in competitive environments, engages C-level executives with confidence, and consistently delivers results. You’ll be selling a category-defining solution, working with ambitious mid-market and growth-stage companies, and playing a key role in shaping our revenue engine.

Where you'll leave your mark?

  • Own and manage the end-to-end sales process for Enterprise accounts with an ACV of $70k to $250k
  • Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of new logos while expanding within existing customers.
  • Lead consultative, value-driven sales conversations with VP and C-level executives.
  • Build and execute territory plans to systematically open new opportunities.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with SDRs, Solutions Consultants, and Marketing to accelerate pipeline.
  • Accurately forecast and manage deals through disciplined pipeline management.
  • Consistently meet or exceed sales quotas and performance targets.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

  • 8+ Yrs is B2B Sales experience / Account Executive roles within SaaS, Software, or Technology Services, with a strong focus on new logo acquisition.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in outbound prospecting and pipeline generation.
  • Working knowledge of structured sales methodologies such as MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, or Consultative Selling.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual new business quotas , with consistent high performance.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, discovery, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage CXO-level stakeholders and close complex deals.

Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
