jobs.description:
ProgressionLIVE développe des logiciels web et mobiles de gestion des opérations de service sur le terrain, utilisés par des centaines d’organisations canadiennes dans les secteurs du CVC, de la plomberie, de l’électricité, de la construction, du transport et de la maintenance.

Votre rôle

Relevant du directeur général, vous dirigerez toute l’équipe produit et technologie et serez responsable de la feuille de route et de la livraison. Vous définirez avec le directeur général les orientations produit, les priorités majeures et les investissements structurants, tout en exerçant votre autonomie sur les décisions courantes et l’exécution.

Vous combinerez jugement produit, leadership et contribution technique directe : accompagner les développeurs, renforcer leurs compétences avec l’IA et programmer certaines fonctionnalités jusqu’à leur mise en production. Vous vous appuierez sur les expertises de l’équipe pour les décisions techniques spécialisées.

Vos responsabilités

  • Piloter la feuille de route à partir des échanges clients, des données d’utilisation et des objectifs commerciaux. Collaborer avec les ventes et le service client, puis mesurer l’adoption et l’impact.
  • Diriger l’exécution : définir la portée, organiser les priorités, lever les obstacles et accompagner l’équipe jusqu’à la mise en production et à la validation des résultats.
  • Programmer et livrer certaines fonctionnalités, en respectant les exigences de tests, de revue de code et de sécurité. Créer aussi des prototypes et des outils internes.
  • Recruter et développer l’équipe. Accompagner les développeurs par le travail en binôme, les revues de code, la formation et le partage des connaissances.
  • Définir et diriger un modèle opérationnel activé par l’IA pour le produit et l’ingénierie. Habiliter les développeurs, l’assurance qualité et les DevOps à utiliser l’IA efficacement tout au long du cycle de vie du développement, de la recherche et des spécifications à la mise en œuvre, aux tests, à l’examen du code, à la documentation, au débogage, au déploiement et à la réponse aux incidents.
  • Identifier et automatiser les activités répétitives ou à faible valeur ajoutée. Prototyper les flux de travail agentic à fort impact et les outils internes, les évaluer en fonction des améliorations mesurables dans la vitesse de livraison, la qualité, la fiabilité et la capacité de l’équipe, pas seulement les taux d’adoption.
  • Établir des normes pratiques pour l’utilisation responsable de l’IA (sécurité, confidentialité, propriété intellectuelle, qualité, responsabilité). Créer une culture d’expérimentation tout en veillant à ce que les gens restent responsables de l’exactitude et de la sécurité.
  • Identifier les opportunités d’IA orientées client qui créent une valeur significative et différenciée, distinguant les capacités authentiques des features motivées par la nouveauté. Partenaire avec les clients et l’équipe pour valider et hiérarchiser.
  • Équilibrer nouvelles fonctionnalités, dette technique, fiabilité et sécurité. Évaluer les compromis avec l’équipe et maintenir des exigences claires de qualité et de confidentialité.

Votre profil

  • 8+ années de leadership en développement logiciel, incluant la construction et la mise à l’échelle d’équipes d’ingénierie.
  • Expérience pratique en développement logiciel et capacité actuelle à comprendre une base de code, programmer, tester et livrer des fonctionnalités en production.
  • Expérience de direction d’une équipe de développement, avec responsabilité de la livraison et capacité à recruter, coacher et faire progresser les développeurs.
  • Solide jugement produit : comprendre les problèmes clients, piloter une feuille de route, prioriser les investissements et mesurer les résultats.
  • Maîtrise pratique des outils de développement assisté par l’IA et capacité à transmettre des méthodes efficaces, avec validation critique du code généré.
  • Bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais pour collaborer avec les équipes et utiliser la documentation technique.

Notre environnement technologique

Java, Spring, Hibernate, Vue 3, TypeScript, AWS, GitHub Actions et Terraform. Nos applications mobiles fonctionnent hors ligne et se synchronisent. La maîtrise de chaque technologie n’est pas requise.

Nos avantages (et ils valent le détour!)

Chez ProgressionLIVE, on croit que la performance passe par le bien-être.

Voici ce qu'on t'offre :

  • Semaine de 4 jours
  • Télétravail
  • Assurances collectives après 3 mois (50 % payé par l'entreprise, option famille)
  • Programme d'aide aux employés (PAE)
  • Programme de médecine corporative
  • REER collectif (RPDB)
  • 3 semaines de vacances dès la première année (accessibles après 3 mois)
  • Activités sociales et sportives régulières
  • Budget annuel pour de la formation
  • Budget personnel annuel (équipements sportifs ou de télétravail)
  • Cafés, collations et bonne humeur garantis au bureau

ProgressionLIVE develops web and mobile software for field service operations, used by hundreds of Canadian organizations across HVAC, plumbing, electrical, construction, transportation, and maintenance.

Your role

Reporting to the General Manager, you will lead the full product and technology team and own the roadmap and delivery. You will jointly agree with the General Manager on product direction, major priorities, and significant investments, while exercising autonomy over day to day product decisions and execution.

You will combine product judgment, team leadership, and direct technical contribution. Your software development experience will enable you to coach developers, build their AI skills, and personally code and ship selected product features. You will draw on the team’s expertise for specialized technical decisions.

Your responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap, drawing on customer conversations, usage data, and business objectives. Collaborate with sales and customer service, then measure adoption and impact.
  • Lead execution: define scope, sequence priorities, remove obstacles, and guide the team through release and validation of results.
  • Personally code and ship selected features, meeting testing, code review, and security standards. Build prototypes and internal tools as needed.
  • Recruit and develop the team. Coach developers through pair programming, code reviews, training, and knowledge sharing.
  • Define and lead an AI enabled operating model for product and engineering. Empower developers, QA, and DevOps to use AI effectively across the full development lifecycle, from research and specification through implementation, testing, code review, documentation, debugging, deployment, and incident response.
  • Identify and automate repetitive or low-value activities. Prototype high-leverage agentic workflows and internal tools, evaluating them based on measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, reliability, and team capacity, not just adoption rates.
  • Establish practical standards for responsible AI use (security, privacy, IP, quality, accountability). Build a culture of experimentation while ensuring people remain accountable for correctness and security.
  • Identify customer-facing AI opportunities that create meaningful, differentiated value, distinguishing genuine capabilities from novelty-driven features. Partner with customers and the team to validate and prioritize.
  • Balance new capabilities, technical debt, reliability, and security. Evaluate tradeoffs with the team and maintain clear quality and privacy standards.

Our technology environment

Java, Spring, Hibernate, Vue 3, TypeScript, AWS, GitHub Actions, and Terraform. Our mobile applications support offline use and synchronization. Experience with every technology is not required.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of software development leadership, including building and scaling engineering teams.
  • Practical software development experience and the current ability to understand a codebase, write code, test, and ship production features.
  • Experience leading a development team, with delivery accountability and the ability to recruit, coach, and develop engineers.
  • Strong product judgment: understanding customer problems, owning a roadmap, prioritizing investments, and measuring outcomes.
  • Practical command of AI coding tools and the ability to teach effective methods, including critical review of generated code.
  • Strong French and English communication skills to collaborate with teams and work with technical documentation..

Benefits

Benefits (And They're Worth It!)

At ProgressionLIVE, we believe that performance comes through well-being.

Here's what we offer:

  • 4-day work week
  • Remote work
  • Group insurance after 3 months (50% paid by company, family option)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Corporate wellness program
  • Group RRSP (RPDB)
  • 3 weeks vacation from day one (accessible after 3 months)
  • Regular social and sports activities
  • Annual training budget
  • Annual personal budget (sports or remote work equipment)
  • Coffee, snacks, and good vibes guaranteed at the office

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across paid and organic channels. You’ll manage campaign performance, coordinate content, improve SEO, and use data to identify opportunities for growth.

The ideal candidate combines creative thinking with analytical skills, takes ownership of campaigns from setup to reporting, and can work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Management & Optimization

  • Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across paid and organic channels.
  • Align campaign activities with broader marketing strategies and business goals.
  • Monitor campaign performance and make adjustments to improve results.
  • Run A/B tests on messaging, creative assets, and campaign approaches.

Content & Channel Coordination

  • Develop and schedule content across relevant digital platforms.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice while adapting messaging to each channel's audience.
  • Write compelling, audience-appropriate copy for different marketing formats.
  • Coordinate content reviews and approvals with relevant team members.

Performance Tracking & Reporting

  • Monitor campaign metrics and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Use Google Analytics and platform-native dashboards to evaluate results.
  • Translate performance data into actionable recommendations.
  • Identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

SEO & Website Optimization

  • Audit and improve on-page and off-page SEO.
  • Identify opportunities to improve search visibility and organic traffic.
  • Monitor search rankings and SEO performance.
  • Collaborate with the team to support ongoing website optimization.

Paid Media Management

  • Set up and manage paid advertising campaigns across relevant platforms.
  • Manage advertising budgets with a focus on cost efficiency and return on investment.
  • Monitor bids, budgets, creative performance, and campaign delivery.
  • Optimize campaigns toward target cost-per-acquisition (CPA) or return on ad spend (ROAS) goals.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with design, sales, and product teams to align marketing activities with the customer journey.
  • Communicate campaign updates, results, and recommendations proactively.
  • Flag performance issues early and propose practical solutions.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in digital marketing, with hands-on responsibility for campaigns from briefing through reporting.
  • Practical experience across paid search, paid social, email marketing, and SEO.
  • Proficiency with Google Analytics and digital advertising analytics dashboards.
  • Strong written English and the ability to create compelling marketing copy.
  • Experience managing advertising budgets and optimizing campaign performance.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and time management.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage campaigns with minimal supervision.

Perfect Fit / Culture

You’ll thrive in this role if you take ownership of your campaigns from start to finish and consistently use performance data to guide your decisions. You should be proactive in communication, comfortable testing new approaches, and able to balance creative ideas with analytical thinking.

We’re looking for someone who identifies problems early, recommends solutions, and takes responsibility for improving marketing results.

Typical Day

  • Review performance across active campaigns and identify opportunities to adjust budgets, bids, or creative assets.
  • Schedule content and review copy for upcoming campaigns.
  • Analyze channel metrics and prepare performance updates.
  • Monitor SEO progress, organic rankings, and competitor activity.
  • Run tests to improve campaign effectiveness.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and communicate recommendations.
  • Prioritize independent work and keep campaign activities on track.

Interview Process

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

jobs.excerpt: The Program Manager of Operations (Cross-Zone Execution) is a strategic operator on the Cross-Zone Execution team in Operations, which builds the metrics, review forums, playbooks, and engagements that help owners across Aledade deliver on company strategy.
jobs.description:
The Program Manager of Operations (Cross-Zone Execution) is a strategic operator on the Cross-Zone Execution team in Operations, which builds the metrics, review forums, playbooks, and engagements that help owners across Aledade deliver on company strategy. Aledade’s work sits in four zones (Performance, Transformation, Incubation, and Foundational), and every department has work in every zone. This role helps owners see how their work is performing, diagnose why a metric is off (“Heart of the Problem”), and decide what to do about it, while the accountable owner stays accountable. The role partners directly with senior leaders and helps build the operating infrastructure of a team that is still being designed. It starts in either metrics and forums or engagements and delivery, and works across both as the team matures.
We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the U.S. or from our office in Bethesda, MD.

Primary Duties:

  • Owns the metric record for each metric in scope, including its definition, owner, source system, target, and review forum, and reconciles definition and gross-versus-net differences before they reach a forum. Keeps the executive dashboard current and accurate, using AI tools to automate status collection and draft pre-reads. Leads the mechanics of review forums, including pre-reads, agendas, decisions, and actions, and tracks actions to closure. Spots variance early and routes it to the metric owner and the Director with a clear recommendation.
  • Leads short engagements for owners who ask for help: gathers data, frames the root of the problem (or “Heart of the Problem”), tests competing explanations, writes a one-page scope with an exit date, and drafts recommendations for handoff to the accountable business owner. Tracks funded investments against milestones and flags slippage before the forum. When approved, leads end-to-end projects through plan, dependencies, and readiness to a planned handoff.
  • Builds and refines the team’s templates, playbooks, and standards, including Aledade's decision making framework, the meeting standard, and “Heart of the Problem” worksheets. Delivers clinics and onboarding for requesters, coaches colleagues, collects feedback and improves the materials.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 8 years of related experience in operations, strategy, program management or consulting
  • Alternatively, a Master's degree with 6 years of related experience.
  • Ability to travel 10-25% of the time

Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities:

  • Master’s degree preferred
  • Proven ability to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including senior leaders
  • Structured problem-solving: able to separate competing explanations and say what evidence would tell them apart
  • Comfort with data: working in spreadsheets and BI tools, and spotting definition and data errors
  • Curiosity and practical experience using AI tools in day-to-day operating work
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to diverse audiences and influence stakeholders
  • Self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes

Physical Requirements:

  • Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

jobs.description:
Die meisten Performance Marketer können eines von dreien. Wir suchen jemanden, der alle drei verbindet.

Erstens: Performance. Du führst Meta-Ads-Accounts für hochpreisigen E-Commerce - Produkte ab mehreren hundert Euro AOV, lange Kaufentscheidungen, komplexe Customer Journeys. Du steuerst nach Geschäftszahlen (CAC, Deckungsbeitrag, MER), nicht nach Plattform-ROAS. Bei uns sinkt manchmal der ROAS im Werbeanzeigenmanager, während das Geschäft des Kunden wächst. Wenn du verstehst, warum das richtig sein kann, bist du hier richtig.

Zweitens: AI - richtig eingesetzt. Wir sind eine AI-native Agentur. Das heißt bei uns: eigene MCP-Anbindung an die Ad-Accounts, automatisierte Audits und Anomalie-Erkennung, selbstgebaute Skills für Angle-Entwicklung und Skript-Bau. Diese Werkzeuge sollst du nicht bedienen wie ein Formular, sondern führen wie ein Instrument: AI übernimmt das Wie (Analysen strukturieren, Varianten bauen, Daten durchkämmen), die Hypothese - das Was - bleibt deine. Wer jede Analyse von Hand baut, ist uns zu langsam. Wer jede Entscheidung an die AI abgibt, produziert denselben Output, den jeder Wettbewerber mit demselben Modell auch bekommt. Beides scheidet aus.

Drittens: Creative Strategy. Bei High-AOV entscheidet das Creative, nicht der Kampagnen-Setup-Trick. Du musst keine Creatives produzieren, aber du musst sie lesen können: Warum gewinnt dieser Winner? Welches Segment, welche Kaufhürde, welcher Beweis fehlt im Funnel? Du entwickelst mit dem Creative-Team Hypothesen (Segment → Mechanismus → Angle), verstehst, warum ein kalter Markt andere Hooks braucht als ein heißer, und liest Creative-Performance jenseits von Hook Rate und Thumbstop.

Wer wir sind: Divinely, eine Meta-Ads-Boutique für High-AOV E-Commerce mit bewusst kleinem Kundenportfolio und dem Anspruch, in unserer Nische die Beste in Deutschland zu sein. Unsere Kunden kaufen Urteilsvermögen, kein Button-Pushing: dass wir ihr Geschäft verstehen - Marge, Customer Journey, Liquidität - und nicht nur Anzeigen ins System tippen.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst Accounts end-to-end: Audit → Hypothese → Test-Plan → Skalierung → Reporting.
  • Du steuerst nach Total Business Numbers und inkrementellen KPIs; du verstehst warum Last-Click bei langen Journeys täuscht.
  • Du nutzt unseren AI-Stack als Standard-Werkzeug. Account-Audits, Breakdown-Analysen und Anomalie-Erkennung laufen AI-gestützt; du lieferst die Fragestellung, prüfst den Output und triffst die Entscheidung.
  • Du dekodierst Creative-Performance: Du erkennst, warum ein Winner gewinnt (Hook, Mechanismus, Einwandbehandlung, Proof), und übersetzt das in die nächste Test-Hypothese.
  • Du bringst eigene Angle- und Set-Piece-Hypothesen in die Creative-Planung ein: Welches Segment ist unterversorgt, welche Kaufhürde unbeantwortet, welches Stück Customer Journey fehlt.
  • Du sagst Kunden die harte Wahrheit, wenn der Bottleneck das Offer, die Landingpage oder das Produkt ist und nicht die Ads. Und du lieferst dazu immer einen Alternativweg.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Führen von Meta-Ads-Accounts mit relevantem Budget
  • Du arbeitest täglich und tief mit AI: eigene Prompts und Workflows, Erfahrung mit LLM-gestützter Analyse. Du kannst konkret zeigen, wo AI dich schneller gemacht hat und wo du ihr bewusst nicht vertraust.
  • Du kannst eine fremde Winning-Ad auseinandernehmen und erklären, warum sie funktioniert. Nicht "gutes Video", sondern Zielgruppe, Mechanismus, Beweisführung.
  • Du kennst die Grundlogik von Awareness- und Sophistication-Stufen (Schwartz) oder Vergleichbares aus der Praxis: verschiedene Bewusstseinsstufen brauchen verschiedene Botschaften.
  • Du denkst in Geschäftszahlen und verstehst ROAS ≠ Deckungsbeitrag
  • Du hast die Geduld für lange Journeys, die Disziplin, einem System zu folgen, und bist konfrontationsfähig gegenüber Kunden.

Benefits

  • Eine Rolle am Schnittpunkt von Performance, AI und Creative - mit Werkzeugen, die wir selbst bauen statt einkaufen.
  • Ein kleines, hochwertiges Kundenportfolio statt Fließband. Jede deiner Entscheidungen bewegt echtes Budget und echtes Geschäft.
  • Ein herausforderndes und anspruchsvolles Arbeitsumfeld, das stets im Wandel ist und deiner Arbeit Wertschätzung zollt.
  • Kompetitiver Gehalt basierend auf deinem Erfahrungslevel
  • Eine lockere Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und jeder Menge Spaß, ohne dass die Professionalität verloren geht.
  • Arbeite so, wie du am produktivsten bist. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work sind bei uns keine Fremdwörter.
  • Ausstattung mit den neusten Apple-Produkten.
  • Nette, professionelle und sorgfältig ausgesuchte Kunden - die dein Leben definitiv NICHT zur Hölle machen. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Kunden auf Augenhöhe.

So läuft die Bewerbung:

  1. Kurzbewerbung - Im Anschluss an die Profilsichtung: Ein paar Rückfragen per E-Mail oder Telefon.
  2. 2 x Gespräche - 1x mit Geschäftsführer & 1x mit einem Team-Member. Überprüfung der fachlichen und persönlichen Eignung.
  3. Eine kompakte Probearbeit an einem realen Szenario. AI-Einsatz ist dabei ausdrücklich erlaubt und erwünscht - uns interessiert, wo du sie einsetzt und wo bewusst nicht.

Du erkennst dich wieder? Dann bewirb dich.

Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The Senior Signal Integrity and Power Integrity Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring the performance, reliability, and compliance of high-speed electronic systems designed by Fidus. You will lead and support SI/PI analysis from early architecture through final validation, working closely with hardware designers, PCB layout, FPGA, and system teams to optimize signal quality and power distribution.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex high-speed challenges, enjoys working across multiple industries, and takes pride in delivering robust, production-ready designs backed by strong analytical and lab validation skills.

You'll contribute to projects ranging from evaluation boards and reference designs to high-speed backplanes and systems involving DDR memory interfaces and SERDES, engaging from early concept and stack-up definition through simulation, layout guidance, lab validation, and final product release.

Make an Impact with US:

At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects across Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead PCB layer stack-up design and optimization
  • Perform waveform integrity, crosstalk, timing, eye diagram, and jitter analysis
  • Conduct power integrity analysis including DC IR drop and decoupling strategy optimization
  • Model insertion and return loss and support EMC analysis
  • Use industry tools such as Cadence Sigrity, HSPICE, ADS, HFSS, and Hyperlynx for simulation and analysis
  • Support and execute lab validation using TDR, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and high-speed oscilloscopes
  • Estimate turnkey projects and execute work from concept through development, lab testing, and final product delivery
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, layout, FPGA, and system engineers to ensure SI/PI best practices are embedded early in the design cycle

Who You are:

  • MS or PhD in Electrical/Electronics Engineering
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience designing and analyzing high-speed circuits or RF structures
  • Strong background in signal integrity, power integrity, electromagnetics, RF, antennas, or EMC
  • Hands-on experience with high-speed interfaces such as DDR memory and SERDES
  • Proficiency with SI/PI simulation and analysis tools such as Cadence Sigrity, HSPICE, ADS, HFSS, and Hyperlynx
  • Solid lab validation experience using tools such as TDR, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and high-speed oscilloscopes
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with customers and cross-functional teams
  • Comfortable adapting to new technologies and working across diverse industries
  • Committed to disciplined engineering practices and delivering high-quality designs
  • Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit

Location and travel: Position is based in the United States. Travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.

This position may require access to export-controlled information. Candidates must be a U.S. person as defined under 22 CFR 120.62, or be eligible for an export license. Candidates will be required to complete background checks.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k) contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

About Fidus & Why Work Here

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can’t wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Curious what it's actually like to work here? Take a look at our page.

Fidus has a commitment to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process. Automated tools (including AI) support our initial screening of applicants against our job posting to identify candidates whose qualifications, experience, and skills align most closely with the position requirements. All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Thank you for your interest in Fidus. We welcome and encourage diverse candidates to apply. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Fidus is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Corporate Finance Manager (FP&A, Strategic Finance & Capital Planning) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Corporate Finance Manager to lead financial planning, forecasting, capital allocation, and executive financial analysis for a growing organization.

This is a strategic finance role—not a transactional accounting position. You’ll work closely with executive leadership to provide the financial insights that drive business decisions, optimize capital allocation, and support long-term growth.

Combining FP&A, strategic finance, treasury management, financial modeling, and executive reporting, you’ll build robust financial models, improve forecasting accuracy, evaluate investment opportunities, and deliver actionable recommendations that influence company strategy.

If you enjoy turning financial data into strategic business decisions, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

  • Lead the annual budgeting process across departments and business units.
  • Develop and maintain rolling monthly and quarterly forecasts.
  • Consolidate financial reporting across multiple entities, business units, or regions.
  • Improve forecast accuracy and financial planning visibility.
  • Support long-term financial planning initiatives and strategic budgeting.

Strategic Finance & Investment Analysis

  • Build advanced financial models including:
    • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF)
    • Return on Investment (ROI)
    • Internal Rate of Return (IRR)
    • Net Present Value (NPV)
    • Scenario and sensitivity analyses
  • Evaluate capital investments, pricing strategies, expansion initiatives, and M&A opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve margins, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Present data-driven recommendations to executive leadership.

Cash Flow & Treasury Management

  • Monitor liquidity, working capital, and cash flow performance.
  • Support debt compliance, capital structure planning, and financing strategies.
  • Partner with banking institutions, investors, and executive stakeholders.
  • Improve treasury reporting and cash flow forecasting processes.

Executive Reporting & Business Insights

  • Prepare:
    • Board presentations
    • Executive reporting packages
    • KPI dashboards
    • Financial summaries
  • Deliver variance analysis and executive commentary.
  • Translate complex financial information into clear, actionable business insights.
  • Ensure reporting accuracy and compliance with GAAP or IFRS standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Operations, Sales, Product, and Executive teams on strategic initiatives.
  • Align financial planning with operational goals and business priorities.
  • Support fundraising, investor relations, and strategic finance initiatives.
  • Mentor Financial Analysts and junior finance team members.

Process Improvement & Financial Controls

  • Improve forecasting workflows, reporting processes, and financial controls.
  • Support audits, due diligence activities, and compliance initiatives.
  • Enhance reporting scalability through automation and process improvements.
  • Drive continuous improvements across finance operations.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You combine strategic thinking with strong financial analysis.
  • You simplify complex financial information for executive decision-makers.
  • You’re highly analytical, organized, and detail-oriented.
  • You thrive in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.
  • You enjoy influencing business strategy through financial insights.
  • You’re confident presenting to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in Corporate Finance, FP&A, Strategic Finance, or Investment Banking.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Financial modeling
    • Scenario planning
    • Sensitivity analysis
    • Consolidations
    • Advanced formulas and automation
  • Experience with ERP platforms such as:
    • NetSuite
    • SAP
    • Oracle
    • or similar systems
  • Proven experience preparing:
    • Executive reporting
    • Financial models
    • Board presentations
  • Strong analytical, financial, and strategic problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • MBA, CFA, CPA, or equivalent professional qualification.
  • Experience supporting:
    • M&A transactions
    • Fundraising initiatives
    • Investor relations
    • Capital allocation projects
  • Experience with BI and reporting platforms such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
  • Background in SaaS, professional services, or multi-entity organizations.

What Success Looks Like

  • Forecasts consistently achieve target accuracy.
  • Budgets and financial plans are delivered on time.
  • Executive and board reporting is accurate, insightful, and actionable.
  • Capital allocation decisions improve business performance and ROI.
  • Financial processes become increasingly efficient through automation and optimization.
  • Leadership relies on finance for strategic planning and decision-making.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Financial Modeling Exercise

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

Our global insurance client base needs product-minded professionals who can bridge business and technology, shape data product strategies, and turn complex data requirements into trusted, governed, and reusable data solutions. At Sedona, we:

  • Create an open, collaborative culture

The Senior Technology Products Owner – Insurance Data Services is a key role within the Global Data Function, accountable for defining and executing the vision to deliver data product capabilities for Financial Planning & Analytics (FP&A), as part of the Group Finance transformation programme. Working closely to understand and meet the needs of senior stakeholders such as heads of FP&A, the role combines creative spark and vision, with mature process assurance to ensure the FP&A data products deliver iterative, quarterly business value whilst the team and processes show continuous improvement.

You will lead product delivery teams of 10-20 technical and business SMEs, as well as collaborating within wider product delivery frameworks from Group Data Products. Strong collaboration with FP&A business leads and associated source system SMEs is vital, including data from Policy Management, Human Capital Management & ERP systems. Your product delivery team will include senior, experienced data product professionals such as multiple BAs, delivery manager, multi-cloud data services architecture, engineering and development as well as the attachments of business SMEs. The role defines the product vision, scope and roadmap required to create a trusted, governed and reusable views and workflows around FP&A data. Data must be consolidated and reconciled to high levels of accuracy, establishing common definitions and quality standards, enabling consistent reporting, analysis, upstream integration and downstream use.

The role will continuously monitor and adjust ways of working from discovery and ongoing requirements management across the end-to-end data flow—from source systems and interfaces into the Unified Data Ecosystem through to transformation, conformance and consumption—and make clear, evidence-based decisions on priorities, dependencies and phased delivery. It will also matrix-manage the cross-functional delivery team and SMEs to secure adoption, clear ownership and measurable value. Experience in financial data analysis within UK financial services is required, especially applying techniques such as MIBI, financial planning & analytics leveraging ERP, HR/HCM and revenues data.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Define and direct execution of the vision, outcomes and roadmap for the FP&A data products, aligned to Finance transformation priorities and wider Group Data strategy. 
  • Business Discovery & Scope: Lead discovery with Finance business stakeholders to understand current reporting, analytics and planning needs, pain points and data flows; translate these into a clear, prioritised and phased product scope. 
  • End-to-End Product Ownership: Own the product and processes across source data, interfaces into the Unified Data Ecosystem, transformation and conformance requirements, and interfaces out to dashboards, analytics and other consuming products e.g. planning tooling. 
  • Common Data Model: Drive alignment of FP&A data across business areas, including common grain, definitions, dimensions and business rules, while making differences and exclusions explicit. 
  • Stakeholder & Business Ownership: Establish effective relationships with senior Finance leaders, business product owners, subject-matter experts, Data, Technology and external partners; secure decisions, sign-off and clear accountability for the product. 
  • Roadmap, Prioritisation & Dependencies: Maintain an integrated roadmap and backlog covering source readiness, interfaces, platform capability, transformation, reporting and adoption; expose trade-offs and manage cross-team dependencies. 
  • Team Definition & Mobilisation: Define the cross-functional team structure, capabilities, roles and capacity required to deliver the Premium data product once its scope and roadmap are established; identify resource gaps and work with delivery and functional leaders to mobilise the right team for each phase. 
  • Cross-Functional Delivery Leadership: Matrix-manage engineering, architecture, data quality, analysis, reporting and testing specialists through discovery, design, build, validation and release, while maintaining clear separation between product outcomes and delivery execution. 
  • Data Governance, Quality & Controls: Define ownership, lineage, metadata, access controls, reconciliation and quality expectations so that data is trusted, auditable and suitable for authorised use. 
  • Adoption & Value Realisation: Define success measures, monitor product health and usage, and work with consumers to embed the product into reporting and decision-making while reducing manual reconciliation and duplicated data preparation. 
  • Lifecycle & Operating Model: Agree the transition from change to run, including stewardship, support, small-change prioritisation and ongoing product improvement. 

Requirements 

  • Financial Services Acumen: Strong ability to understand how FP&A data supports financial management, performance, planning, reporting and executive decision-making. 
  • Data Product Leadership: Proven experience defining and managing data products from discovery and strategy through delivery, adoption and ongoing stewardship. 
  • Complex Data Landscape: Experience working across multiple source systems, business units and data models to establish common definitions, aligned grain and reusable data structures. 
  • Stakeholder Leadership: Credibility with senior business, Finance, Policies, Data and Technology stakeholders, with the ability to facilitate decisions, challenge constructively and build alignment where requirements differ. 
  • Analytical & Structured Thinking: Ability to break down ambiguous problems, trace business outcomes to source data and transformations, and make pragmatic scope and sequencing decisions. 
  • Governance & Data Quality: Practical knowledge of data ownership, controls, lineage, reconciliation, access management and quality standards in a regulated environment. 
  • Delivery Leadership: Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing roadmaps, backlogs, risks and dependencies using Agile and appropriate project disciplines. 
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to turn complex data and delivery issues into clear choices, recommendations and executive-level updates. 

Nice to Have 

  • Understanding of UK Insurance Finance reporting, including how measures and definitions can vary across business areas and reporting bases. 
  • Experience delivering enterprise data products on a cloud data platform and enabling Power BI or comparable MIBI consumption. 
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence or similar collaboration and delivery-management tools.

jobs.description:
About the role

A hands-on systems administrator who looks after our networks, systems and web security, and is slightly obsessed with keeping them safe. You are more of a sysadmin than a pure security engineer: you set things up, keep them running and make sure they are locked down properly, rather than writing reports about it.

You work for Raw Advisory first: our own infrastructure, accounts, devices and services. You will also help with the systems that connect to our clients' environments, so that every link between us and a client is set up securely and stays that way.

The company

Raw Advisory is a London-based AI consultancy. We build AI agents, data pipelines and machine learning systems for industrial clients, including trading and data platforms where numbers feed invoices, hedges and financial reporting, and we teach leadership teams how to adopt AI. Our clients trust us with sensitive commercial data, and protecting it is part of what we deliver.

What you will do

  • Set up and run our network and web security: firewalls, VPNs, DNS, TLS certificates, email security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and protection for our websites and web services
  • Administer Google Workspace or Microsoft 365: users, groups, permissions, multi-factor authentication and single sign-on
  • Manage laptops and phones with mobile device management, including onboarding and offboarding of staff and contractors
  • Look after our cloud infrastructure and servers: access control, secrets, patching, backups, logging and monitoring
  • Set up and maintain secure connections to client systems: VPNs, access accounts, data transfers and integrations, with the right permissions and nothing more
  • Keep an up-to-date inventory of systems, accounts and who has access to what, and review it regularly
  • Handle day-to-day issues and incidents during working hours: access problems, phishing, suspicious logins, outages
  • Automate routine work with scripts and AI tools, so that checks and reports run without you

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on systems administration, with a strong focus on security
  • Solid networking: firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, DNS, TLS and Wi-Fi for a small office or a distributed team
  • Admin-level experience with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365
  • Practical experience with Linux and Windows servers, and at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure)
  • Experience securing web services and email: certificates, reverse proxies, WAF or Cloudflare, SPF, DKIM and DMARC
  • Mobile device management (Jamf, Intune, Apple Business Manager or similar)
  • You script in Bash, PowerShell or Python, and are comfortable using AI tools in your daily work
  • Fluent Russian (required) and good working English
  • Based in the UK, with the right to work in the UK. We cannot sponsor a visa for this role
  • Complete discretion with client and company information

Nice to have

  • Experience connecting to client or partner systems securely: site-to-site VPNs, SSO, API access and data exchange
  • Monitoring and alerting tools (for example Grafana, Zabbix or a SIEM)
  • Experience with Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 27001 or client security questionnaires
  • Experience in a small company where you were the person who looked after everything

What we offer

  • Ownership of our systems and their security, and room to set things up the right way
  • Fully remote within the UK
  • Direct access to founders, engineers and leadership; short feedback loops
  • A long-term role on our five-level career framework, with an annual bonus linked to your review
  • No on-call rota: incidents are handled during working hours
  • Compensation discussed individually

How to apply

Share your CV and answers to the two questions below, a few sentences each. Applications without answers are not reviewed.

  1. Describe a network or system you set up and secured for a small company or team. What did you put in place, and what would you change now?
  2. A client asks us to connect to their internal system every day to pull data. How would you set up that connection so that it is secure on both sides?

Before an offer becomes final, we run background screening: employment history, references, criminal record and credit checks.

jobs.excerpt: About TigerTMS TigerTMS connects the systems behind the guest stay.
jobs.description:
About TigerTMS

TigerTMS connects the systems behind the guest stay. For more than 40 years we have built hospitality technology that today runs in 10,000+ hotels and on the ships of leading cruise lines, including properties of Marriott, IHG, Hilton, Hyatt, Accor, Four Seasons, Mandarin Oriental, Virgin Voyages and Princess Cruises.

We are headquartered in the UK, with offices in the USA, Germany and Dubai, and serve customers through a global network of partners and resellers.

About Aspire Software and Valsoft

Since 2023, TigerTMS has been part of Aspire Software, an operating group of Valsoft Corporation. Montreal-based Valsoft acquires and grows vertical market software businesses that provide mission-critical solutions in their niche, and offers them a permanent home. Its companies keep their own identity, leadership and teams, while drawing on shared best practices, operational support and a collaborative global network.

The role

As our Account Manager, you will be the first point of contact for TigerTMS partners, resellers and direct customers when they bring us new projects and orders. You will combine deep knowledge of the Tiger integration layer with a confident, customer-facing manner, so that every order is accurate, well scoped and handed smoothly into delivery.

Job title: Account Manager

Reports to: Director of Sales

Team: TigerTMS Sales

Works closely with: Sales, Projects/Implementation, Support, Product

Location: Remote

Working hours: Flexible, aligned to either US/UK/EU or EU/Middle East/APAC time zones

What you'll do

  • Own your accounts: build strong relationships with key direct customers and partners, keep track of their installed estate, and spot upgrade, expansion and renewal opportunities.
  • Lead technical pre-sales: run discovery with partners and customers on new projects, and confirm what is needed across PMS, PBX/UC, voicemail, call accounting and other integrations.
  • Scope solutions: turn requirements into a clear solution design and bill of materials, checking compatibility, interface availability and prerequisites before an order is placed.
  • Prepare quotes: complete accurate sales quotes for new projects.
  • Enable partners: be the go-to contact for resellers, run product and integration briefings, and help partners position and sell TigerTMS solutions, including our new AI products.
  • Hand over to delivery: pass well-documented orders to Projects/Implementation and stay involved where the customer needs continuity.
  • Route escalations: bring deeper technical questions to the Product and Support teams.
  • Be the voice of the customer: feed integration requests, gaps and market feedback back to Product.

What this role is, and isn't

This is an account management role, not an outbound new-business sales role. Your focus will be on supporting existing customers and partners with our existing products: keeping in regular contact with partners and resellers to support their own sales, sharing the product improvements TigerTMS is delivering, and finding new revenue within those relationships.

You will also respond to inbound leads, requests for information and quote requests from new and existing partners, resellers and direct customers.

Because we support accounts around the world, flexibility on working hours is important. We will align the role to one of two time-zone groups: US/UK/EU or EU/Middle East/APAC.

What you'll bring

Essential

  • Strong working knowledge of the Tiger integration layer and how it connects PMS, PBX/UC and third-party systems, ideally gained in Tiger support, projects or engineering.
  • The ability to explain technical detail clearly to non-technical buyers, partners and sales colleagues.
  • Confidence on customer calls and in meetings, including leading discovery sessions.
  • An organised, accurate approach to scoping, with strong written documentation.

Desirable

  • A background in hospitality technology (hotel PMS, telephony, guest services).
  • Experience working with channel partners or resellers.
  • Some exposure to sales processes, quoting or a CRM.
  • Familiarity with cloud and hosted deployments.

This role suits someone from the wider Tiger team (support, implementation or engineering) who knows the product deeply and wants to move into a customer-facing, commercial position. It is a great first step on a journey into sales, and full sales training will be provided.

How success is measured

  • Faster turnaround from enquiry to a technically validated quote.
  • Fewer orders needing rework or change requests at installation due to scoping gaps.
  • Revenue growth from existing partners and direct accounts through upgrades, add-ons and new sites.
  • Positive partner and customer feedback, including NPS.

Targets for each measure will be agreed with the Director of Sales.

Why join us

  • Work with technology trusted by many of the world's best-known hotel and cruise brands.
  • Be part of TigerTMS's move into AI-first hospitality technology with the AskTiger suite.
  • Build a commercial career with full sales training, from a base of technical expertise.
  • Enjoy the focus of a specialist team, backed by the stability and wider network of Aspire Software and Valsoft.
  • Work remotely, with flexible hours.

jobs.excerpt: Campaign build, management and account health • Build, launch and maintain campaigns across Meta, TikTok and X for web conversion, lead generation, app install and app-event objectives.
jobs.description:
Campaign build, management and account health

  • Build, launch and maintain campaigns across Meta, TikTok and X for web conversion, lead generation, app install and app-event objectives.

  • Manage assigned campaigns and markets day to day, including objectives, optimisation events, audiences, placements, bids, budgets, schedules, creative, copy and destination settings.

  • Execute accurate campaign duplication, bulk changes and asset uploads using available platform tools and approved workflows.

  • Monitor delivery and diagnose issues including limited learning, low delivery, audience saturation, frequency pressure, placement inefficiency and conversion-signal weakness.

  • Maintain account hygiene through naming conventions, labels, URL and UTM checks, disapproval checks, pre-launch QA, change logs and routine health reviews.

  • Identify and implement optimisation opportunities independently within agreed commercial and compliance guardrails.

Audience strategy and analysis

  • Build and maintain prospecting, retargeting and lifecycle audience structures aligned to campaign objectives and customer journey stages.

  • Use approved first-party, website, app-engagement and platform audiences, including custom audiences, lookalike or equivalent expansion and automated audience products where appropriate.

  • Maintain accurate exclusions and suppression logic to reduce overlap, protect prospecting activity and avoid inappropriate retargeting.

  • Analyse audience performance by market, funnel stage, creative and placement; identify saturation, weak quality, scale constraints and expansion opportunities.

  • Turn audience findings into clear actions across targeting, exclusions, budget allocation, creative briefs and campaign structure.

Budget pacing and forecasting

  • Monitor spend against approved plans by platform, market and campaign, maintaining an accurate pacing view.

  • Flag over- or underspend risk early, explain the cause and recommend corrective action.

  • Reallocate budget within agreed guardrails based on performance, delivery opportunity, downstream quality and business priority.

  • Provide short-term forecasts and month-end outlooks, clearly stating assumptions and delivery risks.

  • Escalate material budget, tracking, policy or inventory constraints before they affect delivery.

Creative performance and briefing

  • Analyse performance by creative concept, hook, message, proposition, format, duration, placement, call to action and variation where data is available.

  • Identify winning and underperforming patterns, creative fatigue and gaps in platform-native asset coverage.

  • Convert findings into clear test hypotheses and prioritised recommendations rather than descriptive commentary.

  • Brief the creative team on new concepts, iterations and platform-native variations, including objective, audience, insight, hook, message, format, required versions and success metric.

  • Track assets from briefing through launch and post-test analysis, documenting learning for future iterations and localisation.

Landing-page and post-click performance

  • Monitor post-click conversion performance using available analytics, segmented by platform, campaign, audience, creative, device, market and landing page where useful.

  • Identify likely friction, message mismatch, weak journey alignment, broken links, tracking gaps or page-performance issues that may suppress conversion.

  • Check destination URLs, deep links, app-store routes, UTMs and campaign-to-page alignment as part of launch and ongoing QA.

  • Brief CRO, web, product or app teams on evidence-based improvement and testing opportunities; this role supports analysis and briefing rather than owning the full CRO roadmap or development.

Competitor monitoring

  • Monitor observable competitor advertising, messaging, offers, creative formats and landing-page approaches across priority markets.

  • Use public platform ad-transparency and creative-discovery resources, alongside market observations, to identify material shifts and testable themes.

  • Turn observations into practical recommendations for messaging, creative formats, audience hypotheses, landing pages or structured tests.

Structured testing

  • Maintain a prioritised test backlog across creative, audiences, placements, bidding and optimisation, campaign structures and landing pages.

  • Define a clear hypothesis, control and variant, primary success metric, guardrails and expected decision before launch.

  • Configure platform experiments or other agreed test designs, validate setup and protect data quality during the test.

  • Interpret results carefully, distinguishing directional evidence from conclusive findings and documenting limitations.

  • Record outcomes, decisions and next actions so learning can be reused across platforms and markets.

  • Support conversion-lift, brand-lift and incrementality studies through setup, QA and data collection under the direction of the paid social lead or measurement team.

Tracking and measurement - web and app

  • Maintain working knowledge of platform pixels/tags, event configuration and server-side or conversion API concepts relevant to Meta, TikTok and X.

  • Validate conversion events and diagnose broken, missing, duplicated or misfiring signals; deep engineering implementation remains with Analytics or MarTech.

  • Work with Analytics and MarTech partners on event mapping, data quality, attribution settings and optimisation-signal readiness.

  • Use AppsFlyer or an equivalent mobile measurement partner for app campaign setup and analysis, including event mapping, attribution windows, deep links and app-event optimisation.

  • Understand privacy-related app measurement concepts, including SKAdNetwork, and flag material discrepancies between platform, MMP and backend reporting.

Reporting and analysis

  • Run weekly analysis for assigned markets and identify key performance drivers, blockers, risks and opportunities independently.

  • Produce concise reporting covering performance versus target, budget pacing, funnel and quality signals, material changes and planned optimisations.

  • Provide actionable creative, audience, placement, platform and landing-page insights with clear owners and next actions.

  • Use spreadsheets confidently for pivots, lookups, reconciliations and large platform exports.

  • Maintain clear documentation for tests, budget moves, structural changes and material optimisation decisions.

Multi-market delivery and agency QA

  • Execute and optimise multi-market and multi-language campaigns with appropriate consideration of local audience behaviour, creative conventions, copy and compliance nuance.

  • Coordinate translations and local validation where needed; do not rely on unreviewed machine translation for market-facing copy.

  • Turn around agreed ad hoc requests to deadline while protecting planned priorities.

  • QA agency output in assigned markets against agreed build, tracking, creative, compliance and reporting standards.

  • Escalate conflicts in market priority, resource or deadline risk promptly.

Compliance and governance

  • Monitor and resolve ad and asset disapprovals, escalating policy or legal questions through the correct internal route.

  • Follow approved claims, disclaimers, targeting restrictions, landing-page requirements and market rules, maintaining an auditable record of material changes.

  • Apply disciplined pre- and post-launch QA covering naming, objective, audience, exclusions, placements, budgets, schedule, optimisation event, URLs, tracking, creative and policy status.

Ways of working

  • Communicate proactively with the line manager on progress, blockers, decisions and deadline risk.

  • Organise concurrent market and platform priorities effectively and deliver to agreed timelines.

  • Collaborate with creative, CRO/web, app, analytics, MarTech, compliance and agency partners while retaining clear ownership of paid social execution.

  • Stay current with relevant changes across Meta, TikTok and X, applying new automation and AI-led capabilities only where they support agreed objectives and controls.

Essential skills and experience

  • 2+ years of hands-on paid social experience, ideally in a high-competition or complex vertical.

  • Proven day-to-day campaign delivery across Meta, with practical hands-on execution across TikTok and X.

  • Experience managing both web and app acquisition campaigns, including optimisation to conversion and app events.

  • Ability to build, QA, launch, optimise and troubleshoot campaigns independently across concurrent markets.

  • Strong audience-management capability across prospecting, retargeting, first-party/custom audiences, expansion, exclusions and saturation analysis.

  • Ability to analyse creative performance and brief new concepts, iterations and platform-native variations to a creative team.

  • Practical budget pacing and short-term forecasting skills, including early identification of over- or underspend risk.

  • Experience designing and interpreting structured tests across creative, audiences, placements, optimisation and campaign setup.

  • Ability to assess landing-page and post-click performance and brief evidence-based improvements without requiring full CRO ownership.

  • Working knowledge of paid social conversion tracking, event validation and troubleshooting across web and app.

  • Strong performance-analysis and written-reporting skills, with the ability to convert data into prioritised actions.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills, including pivots, lookups, reconciliations and handling large data exports.

  • Disciplined QA and governance approach covering naming, URLs, tracking, audiences, budgets, creative, policy status and change logging.

  • Clear written communication for reporting upwards and briefing internal teams, agencies and external partners.

  • Proactive workload management, ownership of deadlines and early escalation of blockers or risk.

Desirable skills and experience:

  • Experience advertising financial services or another regulated category across Meta, TikTok or X, including policy restrictions, verification and disapproval resolution.

  • Experience managing multi-market and multi-language paid social accounts.

  • AppsFlyer or equivalent MMP experience, including app-event mapping, deep links, attribution windows and SKAdNetwork concepts.

  • Practical exposure to platform pixels, server-side measurement or conversion APIs, working with Analytics or MarTech teams on implementation and troubleshooting.

  • GA4, Looker Studio, Power BI or comparable analytics and reporting experience.

  • Experience supporting conversion-lift, brand-lift or incrementality studies and interpreting results appropriately.

  • Experience using public ad libraries or creative-discovery tools for structured competitor and creative monitoring.

  • Understanding of downstream quality, value-based optimisation or predictive customer-value signals.

  • Experience QAing agency work or coordinating delivery across internal and external partners.

  • Working knowledge of current platform automation and AI-led campaign products, with sound judgement on when to use or constrain them.

Role boundaries:

  • This is a hands-on channel-execution role, not ownership of the overall paid social or cross-channel strategy.

  • The role owns creative analysis, test recommendations and performance-led briefing; the creative team owns full concept development and production.

  • The role identifies landing-page and journey issues and briefs tests; CRO, product, web and app teams own their roadmaps and implementation.

  • The role validates and troubleshoots tracking and coordinates fixes; Analytics, MarTech or engineering own deep technical implementation.

  • The role may reallocate spend within agreed guardrails; material budget or strategy changes require the appropriate approval.

  • Competitor monitoring is based on observable information and is not a claim of access to competitor performance data.

jobs.excerpt: About SPUN SPUN (Society for the Protection of Underground Networks) is a startup NGO with a mission to map and protect the mycorrhizal fungal networks that regulate Earth’s climate and ecosystems.
jobs.description:
About SPUN

SPUN (Society for the Protection of Underground Networks) is a startup NGO with a mission to map and protect the mycorrhizal fungal networks that regulate Earth’s climate and ecosystems. These fungi draw down approximately 13 billion tons of CO2 each year, yet they have been largely overlooked by science, policy, and practice.

Since our founding in 2021, we’ve built a global data platform to make these invisible networks measurable. Through our Underground Explorers program and network of over 700 Science Associates across more than 80 countries, with the majority in the Global South, we generate high-resolution biodiversity maps and machine learning tools that integrate mycorrhizal data into climate, conservation, restoration, and land management decisions.

Our work spans laboratory research, data science, and high-resolution biodiversity mapping through to locally led field applications, and we’ve begun working with policymakers and restoration practitioners to apply our findings on the ground. With strong backing from leading foundations and growing momentum in international policy circles, we’re now at an inflection point: scaling these efforts across more landscapes, institutions, and countries over the long term.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Program Coordinator to manage the day-to-day administration of the Underground Explorers grant program. The Underground Explorer Program (UEP) is SPUN’s flagship science granting program. The UEP supports researchers and local communities to map mycorrhizal fungal networks in their home ecosystems. Starting with just 10 grantees in 2022, the program has now grown to 200 grantees across 69 countries in 2026.

In this role, you will own the operational core of the grant cycle, from the funding call setup through grant completion and offboarding. You will also be the primary point of contact for grantees from all over the world on program logistics and administration, working closely with the Director, CFO, and communications team to keep the program running smoothly.

This role suits someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, enjoys working with scientists from diverse backgrounds, and is comfortable using independent judgement to flag issues, propose solutions, and keep a complex and multi-phase program on track. The successful candidate will have a strong commitment to SPUN’s goal of advancing mycorrhizal conservation efforts around the world through rigorous science.

Key Responsibilities

This role administers SPUN’s Underground Explorers grant programs, including the Ground Truth Collective, Underground Advocates (UAP), Underground Creators, and related travel grants. Collectively, these grant programs cover scientists from around the world learning new skills, from high-resolution mapping to science advocacy and communication.

Grant Administration

jobs.description:
Leidos is seeking a Senior Director of Data and AI to lead the strategy, technical direction, and growth of the Data and AI portfolio within the Information Advantage (IA) Practice of the Digital Modernization Sector.


POSITION SUMMARY:

As Senior Director of Data and AI, you will work with your peers to decide what the portfolio builds and why, shape how it is architected, and drive how it wins and grows across federal and commercial programs. You will work in equal measure as a product strategist, a hands-on technical leader, and a growth partner to capture and account teams. This role leads through influence across engineering, program delivery, growth, and partner organizations rather than through a large direct-report organization. Our team adapts quickly to changing government needs: we prize innovation, practicality, speed, and accountability. The IA practice builds and sells the products federal customers use to adopt AI safely and put it to work in their missions. Our HeadWay portfolio includes HeadWay Propel, governed access to foundation models through an enterprise model gateway; HeadWay Dispatch, runtime governance for AI agents, including mission-ready VISTA agents; and HeadWay MissionOS, the data foundation.

LOCATION:This position is remote; however, prefer candidates that are local to Leidos HQ in Reston, VA and must be able to travel to customer sites.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENT: No initial clearance is required to start; however, you must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance. (US Citizenship required).


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Product Strategy and Portfolio:

  • Lead HeadWay Propel end to end. Co-develop Data and AI product strategy with the Digital Sector AI Lead, and own its execution for the IA practice through a 1–3 year roadmap spanning the MissionOS data foundation, Propel enterprise model and agent gateway, and Dispatch governance and VISTA agents.
  • Guide allocation of product investment, including IR&D and capex funding, toward the capabilities with the greatest mission impact and growth potential.
  • Run the portfolio operating rhythm, including sprint and release planning, monthly operating reviews, and tracking IR&D funding to delivered features.
  • Define and report portfolio performance measures such as usage, mission impact, reuse, and growth contribution, and use them to decide what to scale, change, or sunset.
  • Turn customer needs into clear product direction and buildable requirements, and feed field lessons back into roadmaps, documentation, and reusable patterns.

Technical Leadership and Solution Architecture:

  • Set the technical direction for how data products, models, and agents work together across the portfolio, including model routing by cost, capability, and data sensitivity, policy guardrails, and integration of third-party agents.
  • Direct rapid prototyping and customer demonstrations that combine Mission Drivers, and step in personally on demonstrations and architecture reviews.
  • Ensure portfolio capabilities can be deployed and operated across commercial cloud, government cloud, on-premises, and intermittently connected or disconnected environments.
  • Own service operations for the enterprise model gateway, including platform migrations, chargeback, operational resiliency, and a tiered support model with defined service levels.
  • With your peers, establish responsible AI product standards, including human-in-the-loop oversight, tamper-evident auditability, and clearance-aware design, aligned with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and current OMB AI guidance.

Growth and Client Engagement:

  • Partner with Sector CTOs, growth leaders, business development, and capture teams to position Data and AI products in major pursuits, and own adoption and growth targets after award.
  • Contribute to captures with solution architecture, technical volumes, RFI responses, demonstrations, and orals.
  • Lead AI adoption engagements that onboard Leidos programs and customers to governed data and model access, including reference architectures and enablement sessions.
  • Build and maintain relationships with senior customer leaders and technology partners, and brief sector and enterprise executives on matters of significant importance.

Collaboration and Influence:

  • Lead cross-functional teams across engineering, program delivery, growth, and capture to align on product priorities and resolve tradeoffs, without direct reporting authority.
  • Work with sector AI leads, other practice areas, and industry partners to place IA products inside larger Leidos solutions and to drive reuse across portfolios such as cyber, edge, autonomy, and mission AI.
  • Negotiate across Leidos and with partners to gain acceptance of new product practices and approaches.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field with 15+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree with 13+ years; additional years of experience can be substituted in lieu of a degree.
  • 5+ years leading product, portfolio, or technical direction for software or platform offerings, including ownership of vision and roadmap across multiple teams or offerings.
  • Experience shipping data, AI/ML, or agentic AI products or platforms from strategy through production, including agents, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop or governance controls.
  • Hands-on fluency with large language models, model APIs from more than one provider, and modern data platforms, along with cloud and container environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP; Kubernetes).
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence and to turn mission needs into buildable requirements with engineering, architecture, and delivery leads.
  • Experience working in or selling to U.S. government, defense, or intelligence customers, or within a federal systems integrator or government contractor.
  • Experience briefing senior and executive leaders, and explaining technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers, customers, and executives in writing and in live demonstrations.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Active Secret or TS/SCI security clearance.
  • Experience with agent frameworks and protocols such as MCP, A2A, Google ADK, or LangGraph, and with gateway patterns for model or API traffic.
  • Delivery experience in federal environments, including FedRAMP, DoD impact levels, CUI handling, and ATO support.
  • Familiarity with policy as code (OPA/Rego), OpenTelemetry, and audit or evidence pipelines.
  • Experience serving local or open-weight models and designing systems that keep working through lost or degraded connectivity.
  • Capture and proposal experience, including solution architecture, technical volumes, and orals.
  • Experience managing a product budget or P&L.
