The Opportunity

As a Mainland China Labor & Payroll Compliance Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated HR, payroll, and employment compliance content.

You'll analyze labor law scenarios, payroll calculations, compensation structures, employee communications, statutory benefit requirements, and employment compliance matters while identifying errors, unsupported conclusions, regulatory inconsistencies, and procedural gaps.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex HR, payroll, labor compliance, and employment-related challenges within Mainland China's regulatory environment.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the following areas:

1. Mainland China Labor Law & Employment Compliance

Professionals experienced in interpreting and applying PRC labor laws, employment regulations, labor contracts, employee rights, terminations, severance requirements, leave entitlements, disciplinary procedures, and workplace compliance obligations.

2. Payroll Administration, Compensation & Wage Compliance

Professionals experienced in payroll processing, compensation administration, wage calculations, overtime requirements, tax withholding, severance calculations, payroll reconciliation, and statutory payroll compliance.

3. Social Insurance, Statutory Benefits & Housing Provident Fund

Experts in social insurance administration, Housing Provident Fund requirements, statutory contribution calculations, employer obligations, employee enrollments, and regional contribution requirements.

4. HR Communications, Policies & Employment Documentation

Professionals experienced in drafting, reviewing, and implementing employment contracts, HR policies, employee communications, handbooks, compensation notices, disciplinary communications, and employment-related documentation.

5. Labor & Payroll Regulatory Research

Professionals experienced in researching labor regulations, employment laws, payroll requirements, government announcements, regulatory guidance, and historical regulatory changes.

6. Payroll Auditing & Technical Validation

Professionals who review payroll calculations, compensation models, payroll workbooks, reconciliations, calculation methodologies, and supporting documentation for accuracy and compliance.

7. Compensation & Benefits Administration

HR professionals responsible for employee compensation planning, statutory benefits administration, payroll compliance, and employee rewards programs.

8. Employment Compliance & HR Operations

Professionals responsible for employment compliance reviews, labor policy implementation, workforce administration, and HR operational governance.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated HR and payroll content: Assess employment, payroll, labor law, and compliance-related content for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory alignment.
  • Review employment and payroll information: Examine content involving labor laws, payroll administration, compensation, statutory benefits, HR policies, and workplace compliance.
  • Analyze regulatory reasoning: Assess employment interpretations, payroll methodologies, and compliance conclusions for accuracy and alignment with applicable regulations.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate statements, payroll errors, unsupported interpretations, missing obligations, and compliance risks.
  • Validate information: Research and verify content using official PRC labor, employment, taxation, and social insurance resources.
  • Review HR communications: Evaluate employee notices, workplace policies, compensation communications, and employment documentation.
  • Review payroll calculations: Assess salary calculations, overtime, tax withholding, statutory contributions, leave pay, and severance calculations.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings and recommend accurate corrections supported by regulatory references and professional practice.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation rubrics, quality standards, and review criteria.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established timelines.

Apply Your Expertise in a New Way

Use your specialized knowledge of labor law, payroll administration, HR compliance, and employment practices to contribute to emerging AI initiatives.

This freelance opportunity allows qualified professionals to earn additional income while applying their professional expertise to flexible, task-based assignments.

Tier 2 (National Markets): $138,000 - $168,000

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

The Director of Financial Planning & Analysis will lead the development of our newly established Finance department, taking ownership of company-wide budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and performance analytics across Paleovalley and Wild Pastures.

This hands-on leadership role will serve as a strategic financial partner to Accounting, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Operations, developing financial and operational models, establishing department-specific KPIs, and providing actionable insights to support business growth and profitability.

The ideal candidate brings proven experience leading finance or accounting teams, building sophisticated financial models, and translating complex financial data into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership. This individual will play a critical role in strengthening financial planning processes, establishing cross-functional reporting, and building the Finance department for long-term success.

What You’ll Do

Planning and Forecasting

  • Develop and lead the annual operating plan and budget process across all departments
  • Design and own the rolling monthly forecast for revenue, margins, operating expenses, EBITDA, cash, and cohort analysis
  • Develop and maintain the company’s three-statement financial model and long-range plan
  • Assume ownership of company-wide financial forecasting from an existing external consultant while establishing and improving budgeting and forecasting processes across departments

Analysis and Decision Support

  • Partner with department leaders to evaluate financial and operational performance, identify key business drivers, and develop data-driven recommendations that support departmental goals and company-wide financial objectives
  • Product unit economics and analysis by channel and product: gross margins, contribution margins, variable and fixed cost analysis, performance factors, break-even analysis and other economic metrics
  • Evaluate marketing spend efficiency including channel ROI, CAC, LTV, cohort retention, payback, etc.
  • Develop and present business cases with financial metrics for new products, retail expansion, price changes and capital investments
  • Provide scenario and sensitivity analysis to support leadership decisions
  • Analyze department and warehouse productivity and present findings and recommendations to executive and operational leads

Reporting and Performance Management

  • Deliver monthly business reviews to stakeholders: Actual vs Budget & Forecast, Variance Drivers, Unit Analysis, Performance Factors, Operating Margins, Cash Flow Projections and Marketing Analysis
  • Collaborate with department leaders to establish, develop, and maintain financial and operational KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting tailored to each department's business objectives
  • Develop and present actionable performance analytics across Marketing, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Finance, including cohort analysis, SKU-level performance, overhead costs, direct labor, and return on investment (ROI)
  • Develop and prepare an accurate monthly financial package for the executive team that includes detailed reports, analytics and summarized highlights
  • Maintain manufacturing overhead cost per unit within BOMs and direct labor cost within each work center
  • Provide departmental, locational, channel, or SKU specific P&Ls
  • Provide ad hoc reporting and analysis as requested

Marketing, Operations and Supply Chain Finance

  • Partner with department leads on inventory planning, COGS, COS, landed cost, resource needs and working capital management to keep the forecast updated and maintained within Acumatica
  • Model the impact of ingredient, co-manufacturer, freight, and packaging cost changes on margin
  • Monitor production-level costs and their impact on inventory, identifying and reporting variances outside established tolerances
  • Support departmental cash-flow forecasting and asset purchase timing

Systems and Team

  • Develop FP&A tools, data flows and automations within current systems that include Acumatica (ERP/SCM), Velixo (BI), Mixpanel (Mktng) and Logiwa (WMS)
  • Works closely with Accounting to ensure timely close and accurate data for reporting and analysis
  • Establish and lead the Finance department as a distinct function from Accounting, developing financial planning processes, reporting frameworks, and cross-functional collaboration to support organizational growth
  • Build, mentor, and develop the FP&A team as the department expands, including the future hiring and management of financial analysts

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 10+ Years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis or Corporate Finance
  • 5+ Years of experience in Corporate Planning
  • Proven experience leading or managing a Finance or Accounting department, with demonstrated success developing financial processes, reporting structures, and teams
  • Professional experience in at least two of the following three industries: e-commerce, retail, and manufacturing
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex financial modeling, data analysis, and reporting

jobs.description:
Ripjar was founded by veterans of GCHQ to bring national security-grade intelligence tools to the fight against financial crime. Financial crime funds human trafficking, terrorism, corruption and sanctions evasion on a global scale, and the organisations on the front line need technology built to match the threat.

Today, Ripjar's AI-native software and data fusion products are used by governments, the world's largest banks and global enterprises to automate the detection, investigation and monitoring of serious financial crime. Every day, hundreds of customers and thousands of daily active users rely on our technology to screen hundreds of millions of names for risk in real time, prevent money laundering and stop terrorist financing.

If you want your work to matter, this is where it happens.

We are a remote-first team, with a head office in Cheltenham and a regional office in London. This position is open to candidates across the UK. If you are based near Cheltenham or London, you are more than welcome to work from either of our offices at any time.

Team mission:

Our mission is to elevate brand awareness and drive revenue growth through innovative marketing strategies that captivate audiences, foster customer loyalty and amplify the influence of our brand in the marketplace.

The role:

Reporting into our VP of Marketing, you'll play a central role in bringing Ripjar's content strategy to life, turning our expertise in financial crime, regulation, data and AI into content that builds our brand, earns the attention of compliance leaders and supports pipeline growth.

You'll manage the day-to-day editorial calendar and be the voice behind our newsletter, blogs, LinkedIn content and nurture campaigns. You'll help develop thought leadership with our CEO and SMEs and play an important role in making sure Ripjar appears accurately and prominently when buyers search for answers through Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other emerging AI-powered discovery platforms.

This is a hands-on role for an excellent writer and editor who is as comfortable interviewing an SME as they are finding an interesting angle in industry news, planning a campaign or editing a short video.

You'll work closely with marketing, sales, product, customer success teams and senior leadership, using AI and new technology intelligently to help us create better content, work faster and experiment with new formats and channels.

We don't want to create content for the sake of creating content. We want to create things that people find useful, remember, share and act on.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own Ripjar’s content strategy and editorial calendar, partnering with the VP of Marketing to align output with campaigns, target markets and commercial priorities, including fast-turnaround regulatory commentary and the monthly newsletter.
  • Build Ripjar’s thought leadership voice across LinkedIn and other channels, ghostwriting for the CEO and working with subject matter experts to turn their expertise into distinctive points of view, articles and social content.
  • Produce a mix of formats, including short-form video, customer stories and case studies, and repurpose research reports and strongest ideas into a broader content programme that keeps delivering value across channels over time.
  • Create content that supports the pipeline, including nurture emails, account based marketing content, sales enablement materials, website and landing page copy, and content for webinars, events and campaigns, adapting these for the US and other priority markets.
  • Drive discoverability and distribution by delivering Ripjar’s SEO, answer engine and AI discovery plans, and making sure published content is actively pushed out across social, email, search and other channels, guided by real questions from sales, customers and search behavior.
  • Maintain strong editorial standards and tone of voice, use AI tools responsibly throughout the content workflow, and track performance across traffic, engagement, conversions and pipeline impact to keep improving what gets produced.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • Experience in content marketing, editorial or a closely related discipline within a B2B environment, ideally in SaaS, fintech, RegTech, financial services, cybersecurity or another technically complex or regulated industry.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with strong editorial judgement and curiosity to spot a good angle and turn expertise, news or research into content people want to read, backed by a portfolio showing strong work across formats such as articles, newsletters, email, social media, video and longer form content, including confidence taking a simple short form video from idea to finished asset.
  • A strong understanding of organic content distribution and channel adaptation across LinkedIn, search, email and video, combined with solid SEO knowledge, an interest in emerging AI search and discovery practices such as AEO and GEO, and practical experience using AI tools in a content workflow with the judgement to know when and how they should be used.
  • Proven ability to manage a content calendar and deliver across multiple campaigns, staying highly organised and self-directed enough to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines, along with strong stakeholder management and interviewing skills to draw useful insight out of busy subject matter experts and senior leaders.
  • A commercial mindset, with a clear understanding of how content contributes to demand and pipeline rather than just traffic and engagement.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of AML, sanctions, KYC or financial crime compliance.
  • Experience ghostwriting for senior executives.
  • Experience creating content for ABM programmes.
  • Experience working in a startup, scale-up or fast-moving technology company.
  • Experience creating customer stories or case studies in an enterprise environment.

Content and marketing tools:

You should be comfortable working with modern marketing and content tools. Our current stack includes:

  • CRM, marketing automation and CMS: HubSpot
  • SEO: Google Search Console
  • Analytics: GA4
  • AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude and other emerging generative AI tools
  • Design and video: Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma

Experience with every tool isn't essential. We're more interested in your ability to learn quickly and use the right tools to produce excellent work.

What success looks like:

In your first 12 months, we'd expect you to have:

  • Established a strong and reliable content rhythm across our website, social channels, email and video.
  • Developed repeatable content formats that give us new ways to share our expertise.
  • Introduced smarter AI-enabled workflows that help us produce content more efficiently without sacrificing quality.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary DOE
  • Full remote or office based working.
  • 25 days annual leave + your birthday off and Christmas shutdown, rising to 30 days after 5 years of service
  • 35 hour working week
  • Life assurance
  • Private Family Healthcare
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Salary sacrifice pension scheme
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay

jobs.description:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

AI-First Growth Marketer

Location: Remote – Peru

Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Financial Services / Private Lending / Real Estate Financing

Compensation: $2,500–$3,000 USD/month

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:45 AM–5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

English Proficiency: C1+ (written and spoken)

Start Date: Before December 31, 2026

About the Role

We are hiring an AI-First Growth Marketer for a U.S.-based private direct lender that funds business-purpose real estate loans nationwide, including fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction and DSCR rental loans across a wide range of loan sizes. The company markets to two audiences: real estate investors who borrow and loan brokers who refer deals.

As the company's first dedicated marketing hire, you will own the function end to end. You write a short, data-backed plan, a company partner approves it, and you build and ship it yourself. Over time, you will run marketing entirely, reporting directly to a partner.

Above all, we are looking for an AI power user backed by real marketing experience. You use Claude and other AI tools every day to research, build, automate and produce work, and your experience tells you where to aim them. Where you lack depth, you learn fast with AI or direct and check a specialist; outside help is the exception.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Be the first marketing hire and build the function your way, with a clear path to running all of marketing

  • Spend your time building: CRM workflows, live dashboards, SEO content, community engagement and PR, not decks or long strategy documents

  • Freedom to test better tools and drop anything that isn't earning its cost

  • A direct line between your work and qualified leads, broker sign-ups and funded loans

What You'll Do

CRM, Email & SMS Automation (top priority)

  • Build GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, lead routing, nurture sequences and a recurring newsletter for borrowers and brokers

  • Create segments such as borrowers by loan type, experience and state, and brokers by deal volume

  • Clean data safely, with backups and test runs before any bulk change

Tracking, Attribution & Live Reporting

  • Capture first- and last-touch source from WordPress (Gravity Forms) into the CRM without either being overwritten

  • Own UTMs, Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Microsoft Clarity

  • Build live dashboards on lead quality, AI mentions, traffic, form submissions, broker sign-ups, referral sources and funded loans; no manual reports

SEO, AEO, Website & PR

  • Run keyword research; write and optimize product, blog and state pages; manage internal linking and schema in WordPress

  • Earn citations in ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and emerging AI agents, and keep business listings consistent

  • Build lead magnets and A/B test landing pages, starting with the application and broker pages

  • Build backlinks at scale and source, pitch and write PR, feature and guest post placements

Social Media & Community

  • Share helpful, non-spammy content on LinkedIn, BiggerPockets, Reddit, Quora, investor forums and Facebook groups from a monthly calendar

  • Lightly manage the existing reviews setup

AI Content & Sales Enablement

  • Produce emails, landing pages, graphics, direct mail, one-pagers, term sheets, case studies and broker kits with AI

  • Maintain the brand guidelines and prompts the AI follows, and turn each funded deal into multiple content formats

  • Check all output for accuracy, loan terms and brand voice before it goes out

Data, Direct Mail, Automation & Paid Ads

  • Build targeted lists and enrich the CRM with data enrichment providers, and run hyper-personalized, measured direct mail campaigns

  • Replace manual work with automation and AI through Make.com, Zapier and GoHighLevel's AI tools

  • Later, once baselines exist, own paid ads (likely through GoHighLevel), including cost per lead and lead quality by channel

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • AI power user first: heavy daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or similar, with AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built yourself

  • 3+ years as the only or second marketer at a small company or startup, covering several channels long term

  • Hands-on CRM automation (GoHighLevel ideal; HubSpot or ActiveCampaign also count)

  • Make.com, Zapier or n8n, with enough understanding of APIs and webhooks to troubleshoot

  • GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTMs and attribution, including live dashboards used by leadership

  • SEO work with measurable results, plus working knowledge of AEO and WordPress

  • Proven growth of a brand on social media and in online communities

  • Ability to produce creatives and sales materials with AI tools and Canva

  • Track record of finding, testing and rolling out new marketing tools with results that justified them

  • Strong data sense to catch errors in AI output and data; self-directed without a playbook

  • C1+ English (written and spoken) and full, exclusive commitment during U.S. Eastern hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Lending, real estate, fintech or B2B lead generation experience, including the ability to explain fix-and-flip, bridge and DSCR loans

  • Paid ads on Google or Meta, including through GoHighLevel

  • Direct mail campaign experience

  • Gravity Forms and WordPress-to-CRM integrations

  • Lightweight internal tools built with Claude Code or Cursor

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:

  • Concrete examples of AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built

  • Measurable results in SEO, lead generation and community growth

  • Technical fluency with CRM automation, attribution and integrations

  • Accuracy and judgment when reviewing AI output and data

  • Autonomy, speed of learning and clear communication in English

How Success Is Measured

  • By Day 14: Productive in the tools, with the first quick wins shipped.

  • By Day 30: CRM, website and tracking audited; a 6-month plan approved; at least 3 quick wins live.

  • By Day 90: First- and last-touch source captured on every new lead; a live baseline dashboard running; borrower and broker nurture plus a monthly newsletter in place.

  • By Day 180: Targets set for qualified leads and broker sign-ups; SEO/AEO program running; weekly community posting with leads tracked; at least one direct mail campaign tested.

  • After Month 6: Success is judged by growth in qualified borrower and broker leads and funded loans from marketing.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote, full-time role with a U.S.-based direct lender

  • Ownership of an entire marketing function, reporting directly to a company partner

  • Visible, measurable impact on company growth

Important Notes

  • This is a hands-on execution role: no decks, long strategy documents or waiting for direction

  • Advanced AI use is the core of this role, not a nice-to-have

  • Agency or freelance project work alone does not count toward the experience requirement

  • Lending experience is not required; learn the industry with AI and be productive by week two

  • No coding needed, but you must understand automations and APIs well enough to diagnose issues and direct AI

  • This is a full-time, exclusive position: no other clients, freelance work or side jobs

This is a remote/telecommute position.

By applying, you can choose to let Hire Emerald and its technology partners use your de-identified application materials to train AI matching models, as described in our Privacy Policy (). This is optional and does not affect whether we consider your application.

We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity. Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities. May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/CeMs) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters. Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables. Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations. Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality. Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs), Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. Develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development.
  • May be assigned to larger, more complex trials or may coordinate clinical activities for a team of CTMs across a portfolio of projects
  • May coach and mentor CTMs regarding functional clinical delivery, evaluation of project risks, and action implementation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.

    • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

Job Responsibilities

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND REQUIREMENTS

    • Perform advanced statistical analyses using SAS, R, Python, SQL, and/or other appropriate tools, ensuring data quality, reproducibility, traceability, and methodological rigor.
    • Develop operational definitions, code lists, and analytical specifications aligned with study objectives and industry standards.
    • Prepare high-quality tables, figures, and listings (TFLs) and contribute to study reports, manuscripts, and client deliverables with clear interpretation of findings and articulation of limitations.
    • Experience in providing client-facing support, including presenting planning and project updates, explaining methodologies, addressing technical questions, and contributing to strategic discussions.
    • Demonstrate a consulting-oriented approach by proactively identifying risks, proposing solutions, and adapting to evolving client needs.
    • Manage programming timelines and analytical workstreams across multiple concurrent projects; communicate progress, risks, and mitigation strategies effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
    • Occasional support of proposal development, desk research, and exploratory analyses as needed.

Title: Systems and Digital Solutions Intern

Type of contract: Paid internship

Contract duration: 6 months

Work time: Full-time (40 hours per week) or part-time

Reporting to: Systems and Digital Solutions Coordinator

Technical guidance: BI and Systems Officer

Location: Remote (home-based outside Switzerland)

Start date: January 2027

Application deadline: 10/12/2026

Background

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Its mission is to enhance access to reparations for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence around the globe, thus responding to a gap long identified by survivors. GSF acts to provide interim reparative measures in situations where states or other parties are unable or unwilling to meet their responsibilities. GSF advocates for duty-bearers and the international community to develop reparations programmes. It also guides states and civil society by providing expertise and technical support for designing reparations programmes. GSF’s survivor-centric approach is the cornerstone of its work.

Role Summary

The Systems & Digital Solutions Intern provides part-time operational support across GSF’s systems, business intelligence, data quality, information management and IT support services. The intern contributes to first-line user assistance, routine administration, testing, documentation, data cleansing and validation, and the organisation of information within GSF Online, SharePoint and other approved systems. Assignments are prioritised through a six-month work plan and include a structured handover to support continuity between successive internship placements.

Position Responsibilities

Systems and User Support

  • Provide first-line support for GSF Online and other assigned systems, record support requests and contribute to an initial response within one business day;

  • Support routine user-account and access administration under supervision, including approved access requests and periodic access reviews;

  • Assist with system configuration, testing, issue reproduction and validation of fixes or new releases;

  • Escalate unresolved, recurring, security-related or access-control issues promptly.

Data Quality and Information Management

  • Support data cleansing, migration, validation and follow-up of identified data-quality issues;

  • Assist with routine data preparation and testing of Power BI dashboards and reporting outputs under technical guidance;

  • Support consistent organisation of information in SharePoint, GSF Online and other approved systems, including naming, storage and permissions;

  • Maintain clear records of completed checks, identified issues and follow-up actions.

Documentation, Training and Continuity

  • Prepare and update user guides, FAQs, process documentation and training materials;

  • Support system demonstrations, training sessions and user-adoption activities;

  • Complete priority assignments agreed through the six-month work plan and provide regular progress updates;

  • Prepare a structured handover of open tasks, documentation and learning for the next internship placement.

Position Requirements

Education and Experience

  • The position is open to students currently enrolled in a master’s program in information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a related field. Please note a tripartite agreement is mandatory for this internship;

  • Interest or initial experience in business systems, data quality, reporting, user support or information management;

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365; experience with Power BI, SharePoint or similar platforms is an asset.

Other Requirements

  • Good written and spoken English; French or another GSF working language is an asset.

  • Analytical, organised and service-oriented approach, with attention to detail and confidentiality;

  • Ability to learn quickly, document work clearly and escalate issues appropriately;

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and predominantly remote environment;

  • Commitment to GSF’s survivor-centred values, safeguarding, inclusion, accountability and responsible use of data and technology.

How to apply

Please click apply to submit your application by 10th December 2026 (midnight CET).

Kindly note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) is dedicated to fostering diversity, gender balance, and inclusion, reflecting the varied landscapes where we operate and the communities we work with. We welcome applications from qualified professionals of all backgrounds, cultures, and beliefs. We particularly encourage candidates from regions where GSF is active to apply.

At GSF, we are committed to enforcing stringent Safeguarding policies, covering protection from exploitation, abuse, harassment, misuse of power, and discrimination, as well as child safeguarding and financial and fiscal integrity. We uphold a zero-tolerance approach to any form of unacceptable behaviour.

As part of our recruitment process, shortlisted candidates will be required to provide references from previous employers and complete a self-declaration.

GSF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, or hiring processes (i.e. application stage, interview stage, validation stage, appointment, or training). GSF will never request applicants’ bank account information.

Please note that candidates must be authorised to work in the country where the position is based at the time of application.

Your Data - If you choose to apply for this position, you will be providing us with your personal data, which will be processed solely for the purpose of selecting a candidate for this position. We will retain the personal data you share with us as part of the application process for six months from the application deadline, after which it will be deleted. Your personal data will be accessed only by our HR Staff managing the recruitment process and members of the selection panel. You have the right to a) request access to your personal data and information about how we process it, b) ask us to rectify any inaccurate personal data we hold about you c) request the deletion of your personal data or restrict its processing, and d) object to how we process your personal data. To exercise these rights, please contact . If you have any concerns or complaints about how GSF processes your personal data, please submit them to .

jobs.title: Contracts Manager
jobs.excerpt: We're hiring our first full-time Contracts Manager to own client, data protection and vendor contracting across EMEA and APAC.
jobs.description:
We're hiring our first full-time Contracts Manager to own client, data protection and vendor contracting across EMEA and APAC. You'll take over from our part-time contractors and build the contracts function as we scale.

Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company operating in 12 markets. We're adding around $20M a year in new business, and every deal comes with an MSA, a DPA, a security questionnaire and, often, a client's own master agreement to negotiate.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role in a lean, remote team. You'll report to our leadership team, work closely with Sales, Account Management, Finance, Procurement and Compliance, and have real room to design how contracting works here. It's a great fit if you're an experienced commercial lawyer who wants to build something rather than sit in one box of a large legal department.

Client contracting

  • Own contracts on Veremark paper: MSAs, order forms and statements of work.

  • Mark up enterprise clients' own agreements against our negotiation positions, sequencing concessions across the whole deal.

  • Negotiate with opposing counsel and procurement, explaining why certain terms would stop us delivering the service.

  • Get involved early in RFPs to flag what we won't contract to.

  • Know when to escalate to our external, jurisdiction-qualified counsel, and when not to.

Data protection and compliance

  • Draft and negotiate DPAs under GDPR, India's DPDP Act and other APAC privacy laws.

  • Handle compliance and security questionnaires during RFPs and onboarding.

  • Manage flow-down terms from our data suppliers, including US screening products and FCRA requirements.

Vendors and subprocessors

  • Support Procurement with vendor contracts and due diligence.

  • Make sure client obligations flow down our supply chain and the liability chain is clear.

Building the function

  • Set up a contract intake process that triages requests by deal size and risk.

  • Build our contracting playbook, templates, clause library and contract repository.

  • Train Sales and other teams so legal is seen as an enabler, not a roadblock, and run a regular compliance and contracting training programme.

Must have

  • Law degree (LLB or equivalent).

  • 5+ years' commercial contracting experience, ideally in-house at a B2B SaaS, HR tech or tech-enabled services business.

  • Hands-on experience negotiating MSAs, SOWs and customer paper with enterprise clients across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Strong working knowledge of GDPR and India's DPDP Act, and experience drafting and negotiating DPAs.

  • Experience with vendor contracts and supplier due diligence.

  • Able to explain legal risk in plain commercial and operational terms.

  • Self-managing and comfortable building process where little exists today.

Nice to have

  • Qualified as a Barrister, Solicitor or Transferring Qualified Lawyer (TQL) in a UK jurisdiction.

  • Experience in background screening, HR tech, RegTech or another regulated industry.

  • Knowledge of FCRA and US screening requirements.

  • Familiarity with APAC privacy laws (e.g. Singapore PDPA, Philippines Data Privacy Act).

  • Experience responding to security and compliance questionnaires in RFPs.

  • Experience setting up contract playbooks, intake processes or contract management tools, including AI-assisted review.

We are an all-remote organisation with ~200+ people spread across the world. We value Trust, Integrity, Data and Experience in everything we do - from the way we collaborate to the products we create.

We’re focused on transforming the industry while partnering with many of the leading technology platforms in the People & Talent ecosystem.

And we’re growing fast. Having recently been ranked in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 for the second year running, we’re looking for brilliant people, fast thinkers and passionate change-drivers to join our expanding team.

What We Offer:

  • A supportive, team-driven culture focused on collaboration and excellence.
  • Structured onboarding, tools, and resources to help you succeed.
  • Opportunities for career growth within the Candidate Support function.
  • Remote work
  • A chance to directly impact the candidate journey in a meaningful way

Veremark is a remote-first HR tech scale-up on a mission to help the world trust faster.

We started with background and reference checking, pioneering an entirely new approach through Verepass - a blockchain solution which facilitates instant verification by enabling candidates to own, manage, and share their securely-held and verified career credentials.

We have recently launched our second product - a Whistleblowing platform with end-to-end encryption enabling employees to report issues safely and anonymously.

But this is just the beginning. Join us and become part of the journey using technology to help the world trust faster.

jobs.title: Account Executive m/f/x
jobs.excerpt: Schließe dich einem ambitionierten Team bei simpleclub an!
jobs.description:
Schließe dich einem ambitionierten Team bei simpleclub an! Seit Herbst 2022 arbeiten wir engagiert am Ausbau unseres B2B-Geschäfts und erleben ein starkes Wachstum! Wir suchen nach leidenschaftlichen Account Executives, die unser Sales Team bereichern möchten und dabei in einem bewährten System aus SDR's, AE's und CSM arbeiten wollen. Deine Rolle wird maßgeblich dazu beitragen, simpleclub auf das nächste Level zu bringen und bietet gleichzeitig zahlreiche Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung. Wenn du bereit bist, dich einer spannenden Herausforderung zu stellen und Teil eines engagierten Teams zu werden, dann bewirb dich jetzt und sei Teil unseres Erfolgs!

Wie du etwas bewegen wirst:

  • Wir suchen motivierte und gut organisierte Teammitglieder wie dich: Du hast eine Winner Mentality, setzt dir ambitionierte Ziele und willst gemeinsam mit dem Team wachsen.

  • Durch Cold und Warm Outreach gehst du auf Leads zu und verkaufst unsere Lernplattform für Unternehmen in allen Marktsegmenten. Du arbeitest beim Marktführer eng verzahnt mit den Gründern und einem schnell arbeitenden Tech-Team, welches sich auf Kundenwünsche fokussiert, damit du im Sales die beste Unterstützung bekommst.

  • Zu Beginn konzentrierst du dich auf Deals im Bereich von 5.000€ bis 25.000€ ARR. Mit herausragender Leistung steigt die Größe deiner Kunden. Dein Deal-Mix fokussiert sich am Anfang vor allem auf Neukunden, mit der Zeit kümmerst du dich dann auch um die Expansion bestehender Logos.

  • Du baust dir eine umfassende Expertise in den Bereichen digitale Bildung und deutsche “Aus- & Weiterbildung”auf. Kein Einwand ist für dich zu groß, und du kannst potenzielle Kunden souverän von den Vorteilen unserer Lösung überzeugen.

  • Du behältst stets den Überblick über deine Pipeline und kennst die Objections deiner Kunden, um sie zielsicher zu lösen.

  • Die Gründer der Firma kommen regelmäßig in Termine, wenn du support möchtest oder supporten dich bei onsite meetings.

  • Du experimentierst gerne mit neuen Ansätzen und teilst deine Erkenntnisse mit dem Team. Bei uns lernen wir gemeinsam, indem wir kontinuierlich innovative Methoden ausprobieren. Den Drive besser zu werden, brauchen wir von jedem in unserem Sales Team.

  • Wenn ein Closing nicht wie geplant läuft, suchst du proaktiv nach Wegen, dich zu verbessern, und gehst gestärkt daraus hervor.

  • Mit unserer Lösung unterstützt du deine Kunden, ohne einfach an jeden zu verkaufen, der ein Budget hat. Kundenbindung steht bei uns an erster Stelle, und sie beginnt bereits beim Verkaufsprozess. Wir gewinnen Kunden nicht mit leeren Versprechungen, sondern durch erstklassige Beratung während des gesamten Prozesses.

Worauf wir Wert legen:

  • Drive. Im letzten Jahr hat die überwiegende Mehrheit unserer Teammitglieder ihre Ziele erreicht oder übertroffen. Wir suchen Seller, die mit der Ambition starten, ihre Ziele zu übertreffen. Das ist bei uns möglich und keine Seltenheit.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken. Wir geben dir einen Rahmen vor wie man simpleclub am besten verkauft. Aber in Zeiten von AI und vielen anderen Makroökonomischen Trends, erwarten wir von jedem konstant den eigenen Sales Cycle durch Experimente weiterzuentwickeln und im Team zu teilen was funktioniert und was nicht.

  • Vorherige Sales Erfahrung. Mind. 1+ Jahre Erfahrung in einem B2B-/SaaS-Unternehmen als Account Executive. Oder herausragende performance als SDR mit ersten Kenntnissen im Closing.

  • Nachweislicher Erfolg. Du hast nachweislich zum Erfolg deiner vorherigen Teams beigetragen.

  • AI savvy: Du hast KI bereits aktiv in deine Sales‑Prozesse integriert und damit demonstriert, wie moderner Vertrieb heute funktioniert. Mit diesem zukunftsorientierten Ansatz willst du simpleclub entscheidend mitgestalten.

  • Hervorragende mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch. Unsere Kunden sind deutsch, unser Team international.

  • Disziplin. Du lässt dich von Absagen am Telefon oder gescheiterten Deals nicht beeinflussen und schaffst es, dich jederzeit wieder selbst zu motivieren.

  • Kundenfokus. Du stellst die Bedürfnisse und Needs von potentiellen Kunden über deine Provision. Dir ist es wichtig, Lösungen zu schaffen und so ein perfektes Fundament für eine langfristige Kooperation mit Kunden zu schaffen.

  • Team Player. Toxische Sales Kultur gibt es bei uns nicht. Wir setzen auf eine gesunde Competition im Team, unterstützen uns aber gegenseitig bei Deals, beraten uns und lernen voneinander.

Nice to have, aber kein Muss:

  • CRM-Erfahrung. Grundkenntnisse in den gängigen CRM Tools sind vorhanden.

  • Vorherige Erfahrung im Edtech Sektor, speziell im Bereich Aus- und Weiterbildung.

Was ist für dich drin:

  • Attraktive Vergütung mit ungedeckelter Provision

  • Arbeiten in einem Gründer geführten Unternehmen, die nah am Geschäft sind

  • Unbegrenzter bezahlter Urlaub

  • Arbeiten von überall

  • Team-Events

  • Eine großartige Kultur

  • Teilnahme an einer sinnvollen Mission

  • Offene Kommunikation

💰Deine Vergütung: Wir 💙 Transparenz. Wir haben verschiedene Vergütungsstufen, anhand derer wir ein gerechtes Gehalt für jeden Bereich festlegen. Die Vergütung wird mindestens einmal im Jahr überprüft.

Die Gehaltsspanne von 68.000 bis 83.000 EUR brutto jährlich (bei einer 100%-Stelle) stellt das Zieljahresgehalt dar und beinhaltet bereits einen 60/40-Split zwischen Fixgehalt und variablem Anteil – zuzüglich einer ungedeckelten Provision, die herausragende Leistungen honoriert.

Wenn du außerhalb von Deutschland lebst, werden wir uns an deinen lokalen Markt anpassen.

Wir haben in allen Stellenbeschreibungen Gehaltsbänder eingeführt, um sicherzustellen, dass wir alle Mitarbeiter fair behandeln.Nachdem wir uns im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses besser kennengelernt haben und ein tieferes Verständnis für die Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen entwickelt haben, können wir beurteilen, an welcher Stelle in der Vergütungsspanne du am besten positioniert wärst.

🌍 simpleclub heißt jeden willkommen. Ja, jeden:

Bei simpleclub widmen wir uns dem Aufbau eines Arbeitsumfeldes, das Gleichheit, Integration und Vielfalt fördert. Wir sind auf dem Weg zur Expansion und damit glauben wir, dass die Einzigartigkeit eines jeden gefeiert und angenommen werden sollte. Dies ist entscheidend für unseren Erfolg und unsere Innovation. Wir wollen ein Produkt bauen, das von allen geliebt wird, und wir wollen, dass sich das auch in unseren Teams widerspiegelt.

Es ist uns wichtig, dass unsere Mitarbeiter sich selbst in die Arbeit einbringen, unabhängig von Alter, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, Staatsbürgerschaft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderungsstatus, Neurodiversität, Hautfarbe, Glauben, Geschlecht oder anderem.

In diesem Sinne arbeiten wir daran, dass simpleclub ein vielfältiges und integratives Umfeld für alle bleibt.

About simpleclub

simpleclub was originally founded by Nicolai Schork and Alexander Giesecke as a B2C learning platform for students and soon became the most popular brand in the industry with 2m+ monthly users and 4m+ social media followers.
In 2021, simpleclub was ranked the #1 employer in the industry by Statista and Business Punk magazine.
In 2023 simpleclub expanded into B2B SaaS, led by Alexander Powell as a co-founder, which soon became the main focus of the company.
Today, simpleclub is an AI-powered B2B learning platform for up- & reskilling with a team of around 100 employees trusted by companies like Audi, Bosch, Amazon and Vodafone alongside 500+ other companies.
The platform combines an interactive learning experience for users with learning management for trainers, powered by AI.

The Association of Test Prep, Admissions, and Private Tutoring (TPAPT) is a national nonprofit consortium of more than 15,000 local tutors, IECs, and test prep professionals and we are looking for SAT and ACT test prep specialists to support our growing parent community.

The Position

  • Deliver live online and remote workshops to parents with questions about test preparation or college admissions
  • Workshops are monthly and are generally 30-45 minutes.

Requirements

  • US based and authorized to work in the US
  • Earned Bachelor's Degree
  • 5 or more years of experience as a professional SAT or ACT tutor
  • A strong commitment to student score improvement as the ultimate measure of efficacy
  • Exceptionally clear communicator
  • Strong online presentation skills
  • Past experience delivering these workshops

Benefits

  • $75-$100 per workshop
  • Showcase your personal brand and business identity during live presentations to our families
  • TPAPT Senior Tutor certification

About TPAPT

We exist to strengthen the independent tutoring sector by helping tutor-operators, small firms, and education entrepreneurs compete effectively with commercial test prep companies.

Our focus is practical and centered around: better tutoring outcomes, stronger business practices, and higher standards of instructional quality.

Members, affiliates, and partners observe a Code of Professional Ethics grounded in clear expectations, transparent practices, and straightforward tutoring guarantees that prioritize accountability and measurable results.

TPAPT provides:

  • Parent support for SAT/ACT
  • Continuing education and standards based training for independent tutors, IECs, and test prep professionals
  • Communities for both professional tutors and curious parents

jobs.description:
Recruitment Coordinator

Working Hours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST
Location: South Africa | Fully Remote

Salary: R26 500 - R30 000

About The Role

We are looking for a highly organised, responsive, and detail-oriented Recruitment Advertising Coordinator to manage job postings and recruitment advertising across a network of approximately 34–35 nursing home facilities in the United States.

This role will focus heavily on Indeed, including managing employer job postings, coordinating sponsored advertisements, monitoring vacancy activity, and ensuring each facility has the appropriate recruitment advertising in place to attract qualified applicants.

The successful candidate will work closely with facility administrators, corporate HR, and senior management to maintain accurate vacancy records, monitor applicant flow, and identify opportunities to improve recruitment advertising performance.

This is not simply a job-posting role. We are looking for someone who understands how Indeed works, particularly its employer advertising and sponsorship features, and who can take ownership of multiple vacancies and advertising campaigns simultaneously.

The client is open to considering candidates at different experience levels. While hands-on Indeed sponsorship experience is strongly preferred, candidates with solid recruitment coordination experience, strong administrative skills, and the ability to learn quickly will also be considered.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Indeed Job Posting & Advertising Management

  • Manage and maintain job postings across Indeed for approximately 34–35 nursing home facilities.
  • Create, publish, update, and remove job advertisements as vacancies change.
  • Manage Indeed sponsored advertisements and authorised advertising budgets.
  • Monitor sponsored job activity and make adjustments to improve visibility and applicant flow.
  • Ensure job advertisements are accurate, current, and aligned with each facility's hiring requirements.
  • Identify vacancies that require additional advertising attention or adjustments.
  • Monitor posting performance and flag advertisements that are not generating sufficient interest.

2. Vacancy & Recruitment Tracking

  • Maintain a centralised vacancy tracker or spreadsheet covering all facilities.
  • Monitor active vacancies, job postings, sponsorship status, and advertising activity.
  • Keep records updated to reflect changes in hiring needs and recruitment progress.
  • Identify gaps, outdated postings, and vacancies requiring attention.
  • Ensure accurate reporting across all facilities.
  • Track advertising activity and provide regular updates on posting status and performance.

3. Facility & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Communicate with facility administrators to gather vacancy updates and confirm recruitment requirements.
  • Follow up on outstanding information and ensure job advertisements reflect current hiring needs.
  • Maintain regular communication with corporate HR and relevant stakeholders.
  • Escalate recruitment advertising issues, delays, or barriers to Todd and corporate HR.
  • Provide prompt responses and ensure requests are actioned within reasonable timeframes.
  • Build effective working relationships with administrators across multiple facilities.

4. Reporting & Recruitment Advertising Improvements

  • Monitor applicant flow and identify vacancies that are struggling to attract candidates.
  • Identify opportunities to improve job visibility and advertising effectiveness.
  • Recommend adjustments to job postings and sponsorship strategies where appropriate.
  • Report on active vacancies, advertising status, sponsorship activity, and recruitment barriers.
  • Proactively communicate challenges rather than waiting for issues to be raised.
  • Take ownership of the overall advertising workflow and ensure consistent follow-through.

Essential Requirements

  • Previous experience using Indeed, particularly the employer platform.
  • Familiarity with creating, managing, editing, and removing job advertisements.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.
  • Experience maintaining spreadsheets, trackers, or recruitment dashboards.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Confident communicating with administrators, hiring managers, and other stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple vacancies and competing priorities.
  • Responsive, proactive, and reliable with follow-ups.
  • Quick learner who can adapt to new processes and systems.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

Advantageous Experience

  • Hands-on experience managing Indeed sponsored advertisements and recruitment budgets.
  • Experience monitoring, adjusting, and optimising sponsored job campaigns.
  • Previous recruitment coordination or talent acquisition experience.
  • Experience managing recruitment advertising across multiple locations or facilities.
  • Exposure to healthcare, nursing homes, senior living, or long-term care recruitment.
  • Experience improving applicant flow through job advertising strategies.
  • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS) and recruitment reporting tools.

Software & Systems

  • Indeed Employer Platform: Job postings, sponsored advertisements, campaign management, and vacancy advertising.
  • Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel: Vacancy tracking, advertising records, and reporting.
  • Recruitment Dashboards: Monitoring vacancies, posting activity, and sponsorship status.
  • Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS): Advantageous.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is someone who is highly organised, responsive, and comfortable managing a large volume of recruitment advertising activity across multiple locations.

They should understand that this role requires more than simply uploading job descriptions. They need to be able to monitor vacancies, manage sponsored advertisements, keep information accurate, communicate with stakeholders, and proactively identify when advertising is not delivering the desired results.

We are looking for someone who:

Takes ownership of their workload and follows through without constant supervision.

Responds promptly to requests and communicates proactively.

Is comfortable managing multiple facilities and vacancies simultaneously.

Understands the importance of effective job advertising and applicant flow.

Can identify problems and take initiative to resolve them.

Is confident using Indeed and other recruitment platforms.

Can become fully autonomous after an initial onboarding and training period.

jobs.description:
Traild: Who are we? 

Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role

    As Traild accelerates its expansion across North America, we are looking for an Enterprise Customer Onboarding Manager to own the full implementation journey for our most complex, high-stakes enterprise clients. This is a newly dedicated enterprise-focused role, created because enterprise implementations demand a different level of rigor, stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination than mid-market work. You will sit within the Customer Success team and collaborate daily with Solutions Engineering, Tech and Product to get clients live and, more importantly, to ensure they adopt Traild in a way that delivers lasting value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive enterprise implementations ($100K+ ACV) from scoping through to go-live and beyond, maintaining momentum across long and complex project timelines with multiple concurrent accounts
  • Own the end-to-end client journey from onboarding through to successful adoption, ensuring customers achieve measurable value
  • Provide user training, technical support and troubleshooting throughout implementation and beyond
  • Partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Tech and Product daily to work through client-specific issues, surface product feedback and keep implementations moving without unnecessary delays
  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise stakeholders and decision-makers, managing expectations clearly and maintaining CSAT above 90% across your portfolio
  • Own your personal KPIs including go-live targets, adoption outcomes and client health metrics, and contribute actively to internal documentation and process improvement
  • Drive momentum in complex or ambiguous customer environments, keeping implementations on track without needing to escalate

Who You Are

    You are an experienced implementation professional who has worked directly with enterprise clients in a B2B SaaS environment and knows what it takes to get complex projects across the line without losing sight of the longer-term adoption outcome. You bring a confident, consultative approach and thrive in fast-moving environments where you need to problem-solve, prioritize and own your outcomes with limited hand-holding.

    Must have

  • Advanced English proficiency (CEFR C1 or equivalent) — both written and spoken
  • Strong project management skills — owning scoping, timelines, risk management and driving outcomes independently
  • Solid technical aptitude, comfortable working across integrations, workflows, and partnering directly with Engineering and Product teams
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, especially with senior and executive-level stakeholders
  • Comfortable operating in a startup or scale-up environment where processes are still being built and the pace of change is high
  • Strong collaborator with an attitude embracing growth, hands-on execution, adaptability, and the scale-up spirit

    • Nice to have

  • 5–7 years of direct enterprise-level implementation experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with a strong preference for AP, accounting or fintech software
  • Familiarity with ERP or payment related platforms, particularly IFS, Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP B1 or SYSPRO
    • We know great implementation people come from all sorts of backgrounds. If you have transferable skills from other project management, onboarding, consulting or delivery roles, we'd still like to hear from you, please apply and use the relevant/transferable skills question in the application to tell us how your experience maps to this role.

Location & Language Requirements

    This role is open exclusively to candidates based in Canada, Mexico or Colombia. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in the United States at this time.

    Given the global nature of our business and the customers you'll be supporting, candidates must demonstrate advanced English language proficiency (CEFR C1 level or above), with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Salary Range

    The base salary range for this position is:

  • Canada: $90,000–$110,000 CAD per year.
  • Mexico and Colombia: Competitive, market-aligned compensation based on local salary benchmarks.

    • Compensation is determined based on experience, education and geographic location. The final offer will reflect the candidate’s qualifications and prevailing market conditions in their location.

The Perks of Working at Traild  

  • Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options. 

  • Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world. 

  • We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it 

  • Our team genuinely loves working at Traild: our eNPS score is 62, where anything above 50 is considered world-class.

Please note that the final applicants for this job will be asked to consent in writing to a police check / criminal background check to the extent permitted by law in your jurisdiction of employment. Please note that Traild is an E-Verify employer.

What is Keystone Bookkeepers’ favorite color?

Applications missing either requirement will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Position: Senior Response Engineer

Salary: Php 90,000 to Php 110,000

Working Hours: Aligned with Australian Business Hours

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Founded in 2005, The company is a premier Australian Managed Service Provider (MSP) delivering tailored technology solutions to organizations across financial services, hospitality, healthcare, and the not-for-profit sector. As part of the Lyra Technology Group, we operate a unified, high-performing team across Australia and the Philippines.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

Our Response Team is the frontline voice clients hear when critical issues arise. We are seeking a Senior Response Engineer (Tier 2/3) to provide technical leadership for this team—serving as the go-to escalation point for high-stakes incidents, elevating the technical capabilities of fellow engineers, and engineering permanent solutions that keep recurring issues resolved.

Because many of our clients—particularly in the hospitality sector—operate 7 days a week, this role works standard Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) business hours Monday through Friday, alongside scheduled weekend coverage to resolve urgent outages and incidents.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead Tier 2/3 Incident Response: Serve as the technical escalation lead for complex incidents and system outages, resolving escalations from Response Engineers within strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Frontline Intake & Communication: Answer incoming client calls, log and manage detailed support tickets, and maintain clear, thorough communication with internal engineering teams across all active matters.
  • Elevate Team Performance: Run daily queue triage, audit escalation quality, and actively coach and mentor junior engineers to raise the team's overall technical bar.
  • Deliver Sector-Specific Support: Tailor incident response to industry demands—executing rapid security containment for financial services clients (aligned with APRA CPS 234 and Essential Eight), resolving high-urgency POS, payment gateway, and PMS outages for hospitality venues, and implementing practical, cost-effective fixes for not-for-profits.
  • Drive Root Cause Resolution: Investigate recurring incident patterns, deploy permanent infrastructure or configuration fixes, and build automations to eliminate repetitive ticket volume.
  • Standardize Playbooks & Documentation: Establish repeatable troubleshooting workflows, author actionable team runbooks, and maintain accurate client environment documentation.
  • Provide Weekend Outage Coverage: Respond rapidly to urgent weekend incidents and outages to restore client operations quickly, delivering clean, structured handovers to the Monday morning team.

Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in IT support, including at least 1–2 years operating at a Tier 2 or Tier 3 escalation level.
  • Core Technical Stack: Proven troubleshooting expertise across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Windows endpoints, and core networking.
  • Security & Incident Management: Hands-on experience responding to and containing security incidents under pressure.
  • Tooling: Proficiency with Professional Services Automation (PSA) ticketing platforms (such as HaloPSA, or ConnectWise) and Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tools.
  • Leadership & Composure: Demonstrated ability to mentor or coach peers while remaining calm, decisive, and empathetic across phone, chat, and email channels.
  • Communication & Setup: Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills, backed by a reliable, high-speed home internet connection and a professional-grade noise-cancelling headset.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Availability to work Monday–Friday during Australian business hours (AEST) and cover weekend shifts as required for urgent incidents and outages.

PREFERRED:

  • MSP Experience: Prior experience operating within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment.
  • PSA Proficiency: Direct operational experience with HaloPSA.
  • Working knowledge of the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight framework and APRA CPS 234 compliance standards.
  • Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell.


What You’ll Bring:

  • An Ownership Mindset: You don't just close tickets—you hunt down root causes, automate away repeat work, and build documentation so the entire team gets faster.
  • A Multiplier Effect: You naturally lift the engineers around you through constructive queue triage, clear escalation feedback, and approachable technical mentorship.
  • Commercial & Sector Awareness: You understand the difference between a Friday night hospitality POS outage and a financial services compliance alert, prioritizing business impact with calm precision.
