jobs.title: Onboarding Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our Opportunity: We’re seeking an organized, strategic, customer-focused Onboarding Manager to own the onboarding lifecycle for our multifamily real estate partners: Property Management Companies (PMCs), Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), regional operations leaders, and onsite community teams.
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity:

We’re seeking an organized, strategic, customer-focused Onboarding Manager to own the onboarding lifecycle for our multifamily real estate partners: Property Management Companies (PMCs), Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), regional operations leaders, and onsite community teams.

You’ll lead onboarding from start to finish. That covers the post-sales handoff, account configuration, software integrations, onsite staff training, and early adoption across newly launched property portfolios. During rollout you’ll be the operational anchor, making sure each implementation meets technical, operational, and service-level agreement (SLA) standards. You’ll also keep Sales, Client Success, Field Operations, and Product aligned throughout, so every new portfolio sees value fast.

The ideal candidate is an onboarding expert who has run complex, multi-stakeholder rollouts for enterprise clients and knows how to turn new customers into confident users. Strong technical implementation skills are a must, and experience in multifamily real estate is a plus.

This is an individual contributor role with room to grow as the Onboarding function expands. You’ll improve client retention, shorten time-to-value, and speed up the handoff to Client Success, all while refining the process as you go. Along the way, you’ll help build the operational standards and processes that let Onboarding scale.

What You'll Do:


    Onboarding & Implementation

  • Own onboarding for newly contracted properties, regional rollouts, and portfolio acquisitions, from the sales handoff through the first 90 days after launch.

  • Build implementation plans, milestone schedules, and kickoff meetings with regional VPs, Asset Managers, and onsite Community Managers.

  • Coordinate technical setup, data migration, and integrations with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, ResMan, and AppFolio.

  • Make sure community profiles and property access credentials are set up accurately before go-live.

  • Lead virtual and onsite training for Regional Managers, Property Managers, Leasing Consultants, and Maintenance teams.

    • Client Experience

  • Serve as the primary contact and escalation point during the 90-day onboarding window, and diagnose and resolve implementation issues quickly.

  • Build trust with VPs of Property Operations, Asset Managers, and Regional VPs by tying the platform to the metrics they care about: NOI, occupancy, and resident retention.

  • Run implementation reviews and post-launch health checks to drive adoption and catch churn risk early.

  • Track SLA compliance, setup turnaround, CSAT, and early adoption, and act on warning signs before they turn into escalations.

    • Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Run formal sales-to-onboarding handoffs to confirm scope, custom contract terms, and client expectations.

  • Get Field Operations, Logistics, and Support aligned on property readiness ahead of each go-live.

  • Bring client feedback, feature requests, and bug escalations to Product and Engineering.

  • Keep Salesforce and project tools accurate so leadership has clear portfolio reporting.

    • Process Improvement & Enablement

  • Find recurring friction points and turn the fixes into SOPs, playbooks, and launch checklists that help onboarding scale.

  • Create client-facing onboarding materials and training guides built around multifamily workflows.

  • Lead workflow automation projects in Salesforce, project management tools, and ticketing systems, partnering with Revenue Operations.

  • Act as the team’s subject matter expert on onboarding, sharing best practices with Client Success team members.

What Success Looks Like:

    In your first year, success means:

  • New properties go live on schedule, meet SLAs, and start with strong satisfaction and health scores.

  • The playbooks, SOPs, and automations you build are adopted across Client Services.

  • You resolve complex, multi-property launch issues on your own and keep internal teams on track through tight timelines.

  • Teammates count on you as a go-to resource for onboarding.

What You'll Need:


    Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years in client onboarding or implementation at a B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services company.

  • A track record of leading enterprise or multi-location rollouts from handoff to adoption, including building the playbooks and SOPs behind them.

  • Experience coordinating software integrations or data migrations with clients and technical teams.

  • Strong organization. You can manage dozens of rollouts at once without letting quality slip, and you use data to spot and fix problems.

  • Clear communication, from presenting to executives to explaining complex workflows to non-technical staff.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and changing tools, plus hands-on experience with CRM, project management, and support platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, Kustomer).

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Multifamily real estate experience, whether in onsite or regional property operations (e.g., Community Manager) or at a PropTech vendor, ideally with NMHC Top 50 owners/operators.

  • Experience with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, AppFolio, or ResMan.

  • Experience with Salesforce Flow or custom intake forms.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, Communications, or a related field.

    • Core Competency Profile

  • Project Management: Highly organized with superior attention to detail; capable of managing dozens of simultaneous property rollouts without sacrificing quality.

  • Customer-Centric Leadership: Empathetic listener and skilled communicator capable of simplifying complex workflows for non-technical property staff.

  • Problem-Solving & Agility: Able to navigate ambiguity, overcome technical blockers, and build constructive relationships across diverse internal and external stakeholders.

What We'll Deliver On:

  • Competitive base salary plus performance bonus potential

  • Flexible work schedule with eligibility to work remotely

  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Unlimited vacation


At Fetch, we are always looking for awesome people to join our growing team. If you think you’re the right fit for this position, apply today. We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
[Freelance, en télétravail]

Circles est une marque française DTC qui propose des solutions naturelles pour l'équilibre hormonal féminin, des premières règles à la ménopause : compléments alimentaires, cosmétiques naturels et contenus éducatifs.

Notre mission ? Éduquer et informer sur l'équilibre hormonal féminin, tout en proposant des produits naturels et clés en main pour accompagner chaque étape du cycle. En 5 ans, plus de 200 000 clientes nous ont fait confiance. Circles est aujourd'hui présente en ligne et en pharmacie en France, ainsi qu'en Italie.

La marque recherche une personne en freelance, en télétravail depuis la France ou ailleurs, pour développer, aux côtés de l'équipe fondatrice, notre pôle customer success : expérience et fidélisation des clientes, avis clients, projets communautaires (testeuses, UGC) et utilisation de l'IA pour améliorer nos process.

Un rôle transverse, au cœur de la marque, qui ne se limite pas au service client.

Vos missions

Expérience et fidélisation des clientes

  • Accompagner nos clientes par écrit (email, chat, réseaux sociaux), du conseil produit au service après-vente, et faire de chaque échange une occasion de les fidéliser
  • Gérer les avis clients (Trustpilot, Reviews.io) : y répondre, analyser les retours et en tirer des actions concrètes
  • Modérer les commentaires et les échanges avec notre communauté pour améliorer l'expérience client
  • Contribuer à la fidélisation : abonnements, réachat, satisfaction sur la durée

Projets clientes et communauté

  • Piloter la relation avec nos clientes sur des projets transverses : recrutement et suivi de testeuses, contenus UGC, retours sur les nouveaux produits
  • Travailler avec l'équipe CRM sur la communication aux clientes (emails, SMS, WhatsApp), à partir de ce que vous entendez au quotidien

IA et amélioration des process

  • Piloter notre agent IA de service client : relire ses réponses, enrichir ses connaissances, tester les améliorations
  • Utiliser l'IA (Claude, agent IA Gorgias) pour automatiser les tâches répétitives et améliorer les process de l'entreprise, bien au-delà du service client

Développement du pôle customer success

  • Travailler en direct avec l'équipe fondatrice pour structurer et faire grandir le pôle customer success
  • Suivre les indicateurs clés (satisfaction, avis, délais de réponse, fidélisation) et proposer des plans d'action
  • Repérer les tendances dans les retours des clientes et les partager avec les équipes produit, marketing, CRM et logistique pour améliorer l'expérience

Vos compétences

  • Solides compétences en communication écrite et maîtrise de l'orthographe et de la grammaire française (maîtrise parfaite de la langue française)
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais obligatoire : langue de travail de l'entreprise
  • Une première expérience en relation client, customer success ou marketing pour une marque e-commerce ou DTC
  • Esprit vif, curiosité et sens de l'initiative : vous aimez comprendre, proposer et faire avancer les choses
  • Esprit d'analyse : à l'aise avec les chiffres et les indicateurs
  • Aisance avec les outils IA et envie de les utiliser au quotidien. Une expérience avec un agent IA de service client (Gorgias, Zendesk…) est un vrai plus
  • Intérêt pour le marketing, la communication et l'univers des marques DTC
  • Intérêt pour le bien-être et la santé féminine, pour la marque Circles et pour nos produits
  • Des connaissances en nutrition, santé et phytothérapie sont un plus

• L'italien est un plus

  • Organisation, souci du détail, autonomie et goût du travail en équipe

Avantages

  • Un rôle transverse, avec de vraies responsabilités et un lien direct avec l'équipe fondatrice

• Horaires de travail flexibles

• 100 % télétravail

  • Environnement de travail agréable et stimulant
  • Contribution à l'amélioration du bien-être et de la santé des femmes

jobs.title: Clinical Research Associate II - FSP
jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Job Overview

The Clinical Research Associate II (CRA) has local responsibility for the delivery of the studies at allocated sites and is an active participant in the local study team(s). The SrCRA works in close collaboration with other CRAs and the Local Study Team/ Study Manager to ensure that study commitments are achieved in a timely and efficient manner. The SrCRA acts as the main contact with the study site and has the responsibility for monitoring the study conduct to ensure proper delivery of the study.

The SrCRA is responsible for the preparation, initiation, monitoring and closure of assigned sites in clinical studies, in compliance with Sponsor's Procedural Documents, international guidelines such as ICH-GCP, and relevant local regulations and that the sites deliver according to their respective commitment in the individual studies.


Job Responsibilities

  • Contributes to the selection of potential investigators.
  • In some countries, as required, Sr. CRAs are accountable for study start-up and regulatory maintenance. Tasks may include Site Qualification Visits, collection, preparation, review, and tracking of documents for the application process; submission of appropriate application packages to Ethics Committees/Institutional Review Boards (ECs/IRBs) and Regulatory Authorities for study start-up and throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Trains, supports, and advises investigators and site staff on study-related matters, including Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) principles.
  • Confirms that site staff have completed and documented all required training appropriately, including ICH-GCP training, prior to and throughout study conduct. Ensures sites remain inspection-ready at all times.
  • Actively participates in Local Study Team (LST) meetings.
  • Contributes to Investigator Meetings, as applicable.
  • Initiates, monitors, and closes study sites in compliance with applicable study procedures and SOPs.
  • Shares information regarding patient recruitment and site performance with the Local Study Team.
  • Drives performance at study sites and proactively identifies, resolves, or escalates study-related issues as appropriate.
  • Updates CTMS and other study systems with site data within required timelines.
  • Manages study supplies (ISF, etc.), investigational product supplies, and investigational product accountability at study sites. Prepares investigational product for destruction, when applicable.
  • Performs monitoring visits (remote and onsite) and remote data review activities according to the study-specific Monitoring Plan. If required, determines and discusses with the Study Manager the appropriate timing and type of monitoring visits.
  • Performs Source Data Review (SDR), Case Report Form (CRF) review, and Source Data Verification (SDV) in accordance with the Monitoring Plan.
  • Conducts regular Site Quality Risk Assessments and adjusts monitoring intensity accordingly throughout the study.
  • Ensures timely resolution of data queries.
  • Collaborates with Data Management to ensure the quality and integrity of study data.
  • Ensures accurate and timely reporting of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) and associated follow-up information.
  • Prepares and finalizes monitoring visit reports in CTMS and provides timely feedback to the Principal Investigator, including follow-up correspondence, within required timelines and in accordance with applicable SOPs.
  • Follows up on outstanding actions with study sites to ensure timely resolution.
  • Escalates systematic or significant quality issues, data privacy concerns, protocol deviations, or ICH-GCP compliance issues through appropriate quality management processes.
  • Assists sites in maintaining inspection-ready Investigator Site Files (ISF).
  • Prepares for and supports activities associated with audits and regulatory inspections in collaboration with the Study Manager and quality representatives, as applicable.
  • Ensures timely collection and upload of essential documents into the eTMF in accordance with ICH-GCP, applicable SOPs, and local regulatory requirements. Supports and participates in regular quality control reviews performed by the Study Manager or delegate.
  • Ensures all study documents under their responsibility, including site documentation and relevant correspondence, are complete and ready for final archiving and study closeout.
  • Provides feedback regarding sites, investigators, competing studies, and market intelligence that may support study execution.
  • Ensures compliance with company Code of Conduct and Ethics, as well as policies and procedures related to people, finance, technology, security, and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS).
  • Ensures compliance with applicable local, national, and regional regulations.
  • Collaborates with relevant cross-functional stakeholders as directed by the Study Manager or line manager.

Education, Qualifications, Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in a related discipline, preferably Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related healthcare field, or equivalent qualification (*).
  • 2 years of monitoring experience
  • Excellent knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and basic knowledge of GMP/GDP principles.
  • Good knowledge of applicable local regulations.
  • Good medical and scientific knowledge, with the ability to learn assigned therapeutic areas.
  • Basic understanding of the drug development process.
  • Strong understanding of Clinical Study Management, including site monitoring, investigational product management, and data management.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills.
  • Effective negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to travel nationally and internationally as required.
  • Valid driver's license (*) where applicable.

Desirable

  • Experience working within a remote or geographically dispersed team environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to change and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to identify and implement more efficient methods and processes for delivering high-quality clinical trials.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with risk-based monitoring methodologies, including remote monitoring approaches.
  • Strong cultural awareness and ability to work effectively across diverse regions and teams.
  • Proficiency with clinical systems and technologies used in an e-enabled clinical research environment.
  • Team-oriented, flexible, and responsive to changing business needs and

jobs.excerpt: Über uns: Wir sind Yorizon:Als Vorreiter für nachhaltige Green-IT-Cloud-Lösungen setzen wir auf digitale Souveränität.
jobs.description:
Über uns:

Wir sind Yorizon:Als Vorreiter für nachhaltige Green-IT-Cloud-Lösungen setzen wir auf digitale Souveränität. Wir sind eine Tochter von HOCHTIEF und bauen eine europäische Cloud-Plattform nach europäischen Sicherheitsstandards, die vollständig in unseren eigenen Rechenzentren läuft.

Open Source ist unsere DNA: Wir engagieren uns aktiv in Open-Source-Verbänden, Netzwerken und Kooperationen, um offene Standards mitzugestalten und die digitale Souveränität Europas mit innovativen IT-Lösungen zu fördern. Unsere Mission ist es, Unternehmen jeder Größe gemeinsam mit unserem Partnerökosystem dabei zu unterstützen, ihre digitale Transformation zu beschleunigen und ihre Geschäftsziele durch den Einsatz nachhaltiger Cloud-Technologien zu erreichen.

Start-up-Spirit trifft Konzern-Power:Yorizon ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von HOCHTIEF. HOCHTIEF ist ein technisch ausgerichteter, globaler Infrastrukturkonzern mit führenden Positionen in seinen Kernaktivitäten Bau, Dienstleistungen und Konzessionen/Public-Private-Partnerships (PPP) und mit Tätigkeitsschwerpunkten in Australien, Nordamerika und Europa. So verbinden wir agilen Pioniergeist und flache Hierarchien mit der Stabilität eines internationalen Konzerns.

Dein Wirkungsbereich:

Als Netzwerkarchitekt (m/w/d) im Team Data Center Operations entwirfst Du das Netzwerk unserer Cloud. Es reicht vom Spine-Leaf-Fabric über Multi-Tenant-Netze in OpenStack und Kubernetes bis zu GPU-Clustern für AI-Workloads, und das über mehrere Rechenzentrumsstandorte hinweg. Du legst fest, wie unser Netz heute und in drei Jahren aussieht, und arbeitest dabei eng mit unseren Plattform- und Operations-Teams zusammen.

Deine Rolle:

  • Architektur & Design:Du entwirfst skalierbare, hochverfügbare Netzwerkarchitekturen für unsere Multi-Datacenter-Umgebung auf Basis von OpenStack und Kubernetes.
  • Multi-Tenancy:Du gestaltest mandantenfähige Netzwerke mit Neutron/OVN sowie Container-Networking mit CNI-Plugins wie Cilium oder Calico.
  • High-Performance-Netzwerke für AI:Du planst Netzwerktopologien für GPU-Cluster mit RoCE, InfiniBand und lossless Ethernet und optimierst sie für verteiltes Training und latenzkritische Anwendungen.
  • Multi-DC-Strategie: Du verantwortest Inter-DC-Connectivity, Geo-Redundanz, Failover-Szenarien sowie Disaster-Recovery- und Business-Continuity-Konzepte.
  • Performance & Betrieb: Du sorgst für Verfügbarkeit, Performance und Sicherheit des Netzes, unter anderem durch Load-Balancing, Traffic-Engineering, QoS und Kapazitätsplanung.
  • Technologieauswahl: Du bewertest neue Netzwerktechnologien und Standards und triffst fundierte Entscheidungen, gerne auch für offene Lösungen wie SONiC.
  • Wissen teilen:Du erstellst Architekturdiagramme, Standards und Best-Practice-Leitfäden, berätst Entwicklungs- und Operations-Teams und gestaltest Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen mit.

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Architektur und Betrieb von Netzwerken in Rechenzentren. Du hast physische DC-Infrastruktur selbst geplant und betrieben, nicht nur Cloud-Netze bei Hyperscalern konfiguriert. Ob Du dafür ein Informatikstudium oder einen anderen Weg gegangen bist, ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was Du kannst.
  • Fundiertes Know-how in modernen DC-Architekturen (Spine-Leaf/CLOS) und Routing mit BGP und EVPN-VXLAN
  • Erfahrung mit Netzwerkvirtualisierung in OpenStack (Neutron, OVN/OVS) und/oder Kubernetes (CNI, Network Policies, Ingress)
  • Praxis mit Automatisierung und Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Python, Ansible, Terraform, GitOps
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Netzwerkthemen verständlich zu erklären und Entscheidungen sauber zu dokumentieren
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen zu unseren Rechenzentrumsstandorten

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung mit GPU-Netzwerken: RDMA/RoCE, InfiniBand, GPUDirect, NVLink/NVSwitch
    Verständnis für die Netzwerkanforderungen von verteiltem AI-Training (NCCL, MPI, All-Reduce)
  • Erfahrung mit SONiC, P4 oder anderen SDN-Ansätzen
  • Erfahrung mit 100G/400G Ethernet und optischen Netzen
  • Monitoring mit Prometheus, Grafana oder ELK
  • Zertifizierungen wie CCIE, CKA oder NVIDIA NCP, die für uns aber kein Muss sind

Unser Angebot:

jobs.title: Director, Advocacy & Communications
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT VILLAGEREACH VillageReach transforms health care delivery to reach everyone.
jobs.description:
ABOUT VILLAGEREACH

VillageReach transforms health care delivery to reach everyone. We are driven by a vision of a world where each person has the health care needed to thrive. VillageReach’s goal is to reduce inequities in access to quality primary health care for 350 million people by 2030. We work with governments, the private sector, partners and communities to build responsive primary health care systems that deliver health products, information and services to the most under-reached. As a locally driven and globally connected organization, VillageReach has offices in Côte d’Ivoire, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique and the United States.

Summary

The Director, Advocacy and Communications provides strategic leadership for two complementary organizational functions: advocacy and communications. The role ensures that evidence generated from VillageReach's programs translate into systemic policy change, while strengthening organizational visibility, reputation, positioning and influence in support of the 2030 Strategy.

As a trusted advisor to the CEO, Executive Management Team and senior leaders, the Director represents VillageReach with priority external stakeholders and leads the organization's advocacy and communications functions. The role ensures advocacy and communications work in close partnership, in advancing policy influence and systems change, and strengthening visibility, credibility, understanding and engagement.

The Director will ensure both the Communications and Advocacy functions deliver strategic value while leading the continued development of VillageReach's advocacy and communications capabilities.

Description

Essential Duties and Responsibilities are listed below and other related duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time.

Advocacy and Policy Influence

  • Lead the advocacy and policy function including an influence strategy aligned with VillageReach’s mission, 2030 Strategy, country priorities and systems-change goals.
  • Strengthen relationships with governments, donors, multilateral institutions, civil society, partners and other decision-makers.
  • Build alliances that expand VillageReach’s influence and advance shared priorities.
  • Translate evidence and technical insights into persuasive positions, briefs, messages and engagement plans.
  • Represent VillageReach in high-level forums and prepare leaders for effective participation.
  • Monitor policy, funding and stakeholder developments and advise leaders on risks, opportunities and timely responses.
  • Set goals and indicators to assess influence, adapt strategies and demonstrate policy and systems impact.
  • Anticipate and manage political, reputational and stakeholder risks with executive, legal, country and technical leaders.
  • Partner with regional leads, country directors and other staff to co-create country and regional-specific policy briefs and plans.

Communications Leadership

  • Lead VillageReach's communications strategy, positioning, messaging and organizational narrative to strengthen visibility, credibility and influence.
  • Advise the CEO, Executive Management Team, country leadership and program teams on communications priorities, opportunities and reputational risks.
  • Raise VillageReach's profile through executive communications, CEO visibility, thought leadership, strategic media engagement and high-impact speaking opportunities.
  • Serve as steward of the VillageReach brand, value proposition and reputation, ensuring effective brand governance and crisis communications.
  • Position VillageReach as a leading voice in global health and health systems through strategic stakeholder engagement, external communications and thought leadership.
  • Provide strategic oversight of content, digital channels and communications campaigns, ensuring evidence-based, audience-centered communications that advance organizational priorities.
  • Strengthen internal communications and organizational engagement, partnering with People & Culture and leadership on change management and staff communications.

Internal and Technical Leadership

  • Align advocacy and communications plans with other programs, countries, Development, People & Culture and other functions.
  • Establish governance and processes for decisions, approvals, escalation, quality assurance and crisis response.
  • Ensure public positions are evidence-based, locally relevant, ethical and grounded in program experience.
  • Equip staff and leaders with practical tools, guidance and training for effective advocacy and communications.

Team Leadership

  • Set goals, allocate resources and manage performance, budgets, consultants and agencies.
  • Build an inclusive, high-performing culture that supports growth, judgment, creativity and delivery.
  • Assess capacity needs and build the capabilities required for both functions to succeed.
  • Model VillageReach’s values and contribute to enterprise leadership and culture.

Competencies:

VillageReach has ten (10) Organizational Competencies that describe how we work together and get things done that are grouped into three strategic areas of Achieving Great Results, Setting Direction and, Bringing Others With you. For a full description, please download our Organizational Competency document.

Achieving Great Results:

1.Risk Taking and Innovation

  • Key Behaviors: Comfort with ambiguity, curiosity, adaptability, unconstrained and undeterred creativity, resourcefulness.

2.Business Judgement

  • Key Behaviors: Getting to root causes, understanding environment, navigating complexity and ambiguity, entrepreneurial energy.

3.Building Strong Teams

  • Key Behaviors: Trust in Subject Matter Experts (SME’s); radical candor to resolve conflict, hold each other accountable as colleagues, focused on results, commitment to mission.

Setting Direction:

4.Compelling Communication

  • Key Behaviors: Clear and evidence-based communication, audience adaptability, curious listener.

5.Resilient Self Leadership

  • Key Behaviors: Self-aware, plan how one shows up, emotionally intelligent, use one’s own agency and takes accountability.

6.Stewardship and Personal Alignment

  • Key Behaviors: Take ownership, display ethical conduct, effective at resource management, alignment of personal objectives with organizational goals and mission, focus on continuous improvement and sustainability.

Bringing Others with You:

7.Influencing Leadership

  • Key Behaviors: Cultivate trust, influences to make change, navigate the matrix structure.

8.Radical Partnership

  • Key Behaviors: Share information and credit, address conflict, increase impact through collaboration, political and contextual awareness.

9.Cultivates a Growth Mindset

  • Key Behaviors: Seek out diverse input, demonstrate flexibility in thinking and curiosity, embrace challenges, demonstrate persistence, seek learning opportunities.

10.Cultural Intelligence and Inclusion

  • Key Behaviors: Continuous learning and ally-ship across cultural lines, challenge prejudice and bias, modeled in one’s own behavior.

Requirements

REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position directly supervises employees in both Advocacy and Communications teams. It carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning and directing work; monitoring performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems.

Education & Experience:

  • Master’s degree in public policy, international relations, communications, public health or development studies.
  • Minimum 10 years of progressively experience in advocacy, strategic communications, public affairs, external affairs or related fields, including substantial senior leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing advocacy or influence strategies and advancing policy or systems-change objectives.
  • Strong experience engaging governments and decision-makers and building coalitions, partnerships and external relationships.
  • Demonstrated success leading an organization-wide communications strategy, including positioning, messaging, executive communications, thought leadership, media relations, reputation management, brand stewardship and internal communications.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, managing senior staff and building or strengthening organizational functions.
  • Proven ability to translate technical evidence and complex issues into clear, credible and compelling content for diverse audiences.
  • Experience serving as a strategic advisor to executive leadership and operating effectively in complex, multi-country and multicultural environments.
  • Experience in global health, international development or a closely related sector strongly preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in French or another language relevant to VillageReach’s operating contexts is an advantage.
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally as required.

Other Qualifications:

  • Established cultural competency in partnering with racial, cultural and linguistically diverse groups.
  • Demonstrated understanding of challenges with working in rural, underserved and low-income context; experience living in and/or working in a low-income country a plus.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, diplomacy and influencing skills.
  • Political, cultural and organizational acumen.
  • Decisive prioritization and disciplined execution across competing demands.
  • Commitment to developing people and sustaining high-performing teams.

Environment and Physical Demands:

VillageReach employees typically work in a shared, open environment with task and conference rooms accessible to employees for privacy and meetings. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Due to the time zone differences across our USA, Kenya and Country Offices and location of other global staff, we have established core collaboration hours between 6am Pacific Time and 18:00 South Africa Time (GMT+1) Monday through Thursday. All staff, regardless of location are expected to be available between these hours. During Daylight Savings Time, this allows for 12 hours per week (3 hours/day) of collaboration time and during Standard Time, 8 hours (2 hours/day). We do not hold cross-office meetings on Friday.

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION:

VillageReach is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. We believe that diverse, equitably weighted perspectives foster an organizational capacity to create novel solutions that improve health in the most under-reached and hard-to-reach areas. To align our values, innovations and impact, VillageReach is committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse global workforce.

APPLICATION INFORMATION:

This is an immediate hire and therefore resumes will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter to our online portal: In your cover letter, please address (1)Why you are interested in this position, (2)What is one reason you think you’d be a good fit for this position and, (3)what is one strength you would bring to this position?

Hiring Process:

The hiring process will include the following steps:

1.Review submitted applications

2.Conduct 20-30 minute screening interviews for shortlisted candidates

3.Conduct skills and value-based interviews for 3-5 candidates.

4.Request that top candidates submit a practical assessment (designed to take no more than two hours to complete). Sometimes the assignment will occur before the interview.

5.Conduct final interview if necessary

6.Request references

7.Make offer

8.Conduct background check

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted, but candidates who proceed to step 2 will be notified if they are not chosen for step 3.

Safeguarding:

VillageReach is committed to promoting the welfare of children, young people, adults, and beneficiaries with whom it engages. We expect everyone working with us to share this commitment through our code of conduct. All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which may include criminal records. VillageReach participates in the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme and, in line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse, and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By applying, the job applicant confirms his/her understanding of these recruitment procedures.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits:

VillageReach has an established compensation structure that is based on the relevant market and internally transparent. We hire people into the established range based on one’s experience and education and considering internal equity. We do not inquire about salary history. Please refer to our compensation overview on our website for more information and for more information on employee benefits.

jobs.description:
Meet True Vet
At True Vet Solutions, we believe no veteran should have to fight alone for what they already earned.
Every day in America, veterans walk away from disability benefits they qualify for, not because they don't deserve them, but because the system meant to serve them is slow, confusing, and built to wear people down. We exist to change that. We stand between the veteran and the system, and we do not stop until they receive every benefit they earned.
We are a team of high-empathy, high-standards people doing work that actually matters. We answer the call when someone who served is at the end of their rope, and we turn it into an outcome that changes their life. The proof is in what our clients live:
  • Tens of thousands of veterans represented
  • $350M+ in lifetime benefits secured for the people who served
  • 4.9-star client rating across 634 reviews

Where we're going.
We are not building a small shop that helps a few hundred veterans a year. There are millions of veterans in this country leaving earned benefits on the table, and we intend to reach them. We are building the most trusted veteran advocacy organization in America, and we are building it fast. If you are looking for a ceiling, this is the wrong place. If you are looking for a mission big enough to spend a career on, and a company moving fast enough for you to grow into the leader you're capable of becoming, keep reading.

The mission of this role
True Veteran Solutions is seeking a versatile, detail-oriented Marketing Specialist to support all areas of marketing. This role will help plan, coordinate, and execute initiatives that build brand awareness, engage target audiences, generate leads, and support business growth.
The ideal candidate is a strong writer, organized project coordinator, and creative thinker who enjoys working across multiple marketing channels. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn ideas into finished work, manage competing priorities, and collaborate with internal teams and external partners.

What success looks like
Success in this role means marketing projects are completed accurately and on time, messaging stays consistent, campaigns run smoothly, and performance insights help the team improve results. The Marketing Specialist will be a dependable contributor who brings initiative, creativity, and strong follow-through to a wide range of marketing needs.

What you'll own
Content and Brand Support
  • Write, edit, and proofread content for websites, emails, social media, advertising, presentations, and marketing materials.
  • Help maintain consistent messaging, tone, and visual branding across all channels.
  • Coordinate the creation of graphics, videos, testimonials, and other marketing assets.
  • Review materials for accuracy, clarity, and alignment with company standards.
Digital Marketing and Website Support
  • Assist with website updates, landing pages, blog publishing, and routine content maintenance.
  • Support search engine optimization through keyword research, content updates, and on-page improvements.
  • Assist with paid advertising campaigns across search, social media, and other digital platforms.
  • Help maintain business listings, online profiles, and other digital properties.
Social Media and Email Marketing
  • Maintain content calendars and help create, schedule, and publish social media posts.
  • Monitor comments and messages, responding or routing inquiries according to company guidelines.
  • Assist with email campaigns, newsletters, audience segmentation, and contact list maintenance.
  • Track engagement and identify opportunities to improve content and campaign performance.
Campaigns, Events, and Marketing Operations
  • Support marketing campaigns from planning and production through launch and reporting.
  • Coordinate project timelines, approvals, deliverables, and communication with vendors or agency partners.
  • Assist with events, sponsorships, promotional materials, and other marketing activities.
  • Organize marketing files, assets, and project documentation.
  • Work with sales and other internal teams to develop materials that support outreach and follow-up.
Reporting and Research
  • Compile and maintain reports on website traffic, social media engagement, email performance, advertising results, and lead generation.
  • Conduct audience, competitor, and industry research to inform marketing decisions.
  • Share practical recommendations based on campaign results and emerging opportunities.

Requirements
  • Approximately 2–5 years of experience in marketing, communications, or a related role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and communication skills.
  • Working knowledge of digital marketing, social media, email marketing, SEO, and basic marketing analytics.
  • Experience with common marketing tools, such as content management systems, email platforms, CRM software, social media scheduling tools, and Canva or Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Attention to detail, sound judgment, and a willingness to learn new tools and processes.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
What we offer you
  • Daily coaching and real skill development, you will be sharper in six months than you have ever been
  • A clear path to grow: we promote from within and invest in the people who invest in the mission
  • A team that has your back, and a standard worth being held to
  • Work that lets you end the day knowing you changed the life of someone who served
Benefits
  • Remote-first work, from anywhere in the USA
  • Employer-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Paid time off and company-wide holidays
  • Hospitality experiences and team gatherings that make remote feel connected
Our Core Values
Our values are the heart of this company. The right person for any role here recognizes themselves in each of them.
Empathy, Without Exception. Every veteran is a person who served, not a case number. We lead with understanding and we hold that standard on the hardest days, in the longest calls, with the most frustrated client. Empathy is the one thing we will never trade away.
Remarkable Character. We do right by veterans when no one is watching. We tell each other hard truths with care, accept them with humility, and keep our words and our actions pointed at the same goal.
Relentless Advocacy. We fight for every benefit a veteran earned, and we do not quit when the system pushes back. It is us against the issue, never us against the veteran, and never each other.
Competitive Greatness. We hold ourselves to an elite standard because the people who served deserve elite representation. We compound small improvements into outsized results, and we build each other into leaders along the way.
How to apply
If this is the mission you've been looking for, apply now. Tell us why this work matters to you, we read every one.
True Vet Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for character and capability, and we welcome applicants of every background. Veterans and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Core Analytics
jobs.excerpt: Ripjar builds software and data products that help our customers combat serious financial crime.
jobs.description:
Ripjar builds software and data products that help our customers combat serious financial crime. Our technology identifies criminal activity such as money laundering and terrorist financing, and helps customers enforce sanctions at scale.

Data is at the heart of everything we do. Much of it is multilingual text: an archive of over 10 billion news articles in 150+ languages, going back more than 30 years, alongside government sanctions, watchlist data and ownership data on 250 million organisations from corporate registries worldwide.

Working at this scale means our problems are as much computational as statistical. Comparing hundreds of millions of entities, or running models over billions of documents, is intractable without the right algorithms, so careful thinking about complexity and efficient implementation is part of the job.

Data Science Team

Our data science team builds and maintains the models behind Ripjar’s screening product. Much of the work is NLP, including named entity recognition, risk classification, entity resolution, duplicate detection, summarisation and geolocation, and we're increasingly using LLMs to push this further.

The team sits within Engineering and works in short cycles, shipping improvements regularly and measuring their impact. Because our customers operate in heavily regulated environments, our models face a high level of scrutiny, so every change needs to be well tested, explainable and backed by evidence.

This is a great time to join a growing team of talented technologists and data scientists building products that change how financial crime is detected and prevented. We're keen to hear from experienced data scientists at a range of levels, and the scope of the role will reflect what you bring.

What you'll be doing:

We're looking for an experienced Data Scientist who is motivated to solve customer problems and enjoys owning them end to end, from:

  • Framing the problem and exploring the data
  • Building and evaluating models
  • Deploying, scaling and maintaining the solution in production

You will work with language models, machine learning tools and large-scale distributed clusters.

This role suits a data scientist with a strength in NLP and a genuine interest in computing: someone who thinks about algorithmic complexity, memory and throughput as naturally as model accuracy. You'll enjoy shipping a model that adds real value quickly and iterating on it based on real-world feedback.

Ripjar equips staff with the very best AI tooling to help them work effectively via judicious review.

Some recent work Ripjar’s data scientists have been involved in:

  • Entity resolution across tens of millions of news articles, at a scale where naive pairwise comparison is intractable.
  • Using LLMs to summarise news articles linking an entity to financial crime (or other similar risks), with LLM judges to monitor performance.
  • Using LLMs to run automated quality assurance on our data outputs at scale.

Key Tasks:

  • Analyse large datasets using Ripjar’s distributed data processing infrastructure to identify patterns and inform new analytics and models.
  • Develop and evaluate machine learning models, including LLM-based approaches, to enhance Ripjar’s products.
  • Design algorithms and pipelines that stay tractable at scale, making sensible trade-offs between accuracy, latency and compute cost.
  • Work with Data Engineers and the wider engineering team to integrate models into our products and pipelines, then own their performance, efficiency and maintenance in production.
  • Design statistical tests, evaluate results, and document models and methodologies to the standard our regulated customers expect.
  • Work with Product and, from time to time, directly with customers to understand their needs, explain analytics, models and test results, and help resolve questions about how our models behave in practice.

Requirements

  • Experience delivering data science solutions end to end, from prototype to production, including testing, deployment and long-term maintenance.
  • Strong computer science fundamentals: algorithms, data structures and computational complexity, and how to apply them to make large-scale problems tractable.
  • Proficiency in Python and writing production-quality, performant code, particularly with machine learning and data science libraries such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, numpy and scipy.
  • Proficiency using Natural Language Processing techniques to solve problems, ideally including Large Language Models.
  • Working knowledge of statistics.
  • Experience working with large-scale data processing systems such as Spark and Hadoop.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Keen to use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to speed up development and experimentation.
  • A habit of keeping up to date with developments in AI, including ML, NLP and LLMs, and judging which new techniques and tools are worth applying to real problems.
  • Cloud-based experience is desirable.
  • Experience using or implementing MLOps approaches is desirable.

Benefits

Why we think you’ll enjoy it here:

  • Competitive base salary DOE
  • 25 days annual leave + birthdays off, rising to 30 days after 5 years of service
  • Christmas shutdown
  • Fully remote or office based working
  • 35 hour working week
  • Private Family Healthcare
  • Life Assurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Salary sacrifice pension scheme
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay

Depending on the team you join, your work may include:

  • Developing and testing product features, security fixes and engineering tools.
  • Investigating unfamiliar code and understanding how different parts of a system interact.
  • Building and improving tools for verifying, testing and delivering software.
  • Automating engineering workflows.
  • Contributing to code reviews and technical discussions.

Requirements

What we’re looking for:

  • Practical programming skills in at least one language, such as C, C++, Python or Go, whether from coursework, personal projects or early hands-on experience.
  • Strong analytical thinking, solid fundamentals in algorithms and data structures, and a structured approach to solving problems.
  • The ability to use AI tools to work through unfamiliar programming problems, critically assess and improve their output, and explain and test the resulting solution.
  • Curiosity, the ability to learn independently, and persistence when a solution isn’t immediately clear.
  • Care for code quality and the ability to carry a task through to a working, tested solution.
  • Clear communication and the ability to explain technical decisions.
  • English at B2 level or higher.

We’re looking for people at the very start of their engineering careers. We’re open to:

  • Final-year students.
  • Recent graduates.

This is a full-time position, including for candidates who are still completing their studies.

What may help you stand out

Any of the following can strengthen your application, although none is mandatory:

  • A degree (or final-year standing) in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent skills you can demonstrate through your projects and code.
  • Personal or academic software projects, especially ones whose design decisions you can explain.
  • Contributions to open-source projects, even small ones.
  • Participation in CTF competitions, hackathons, or a homelab you administer.
  • Evidence that you’ve taught yourself a language, stack or system in depth because a problem demanded it.
  • A strong interest in Linux, operating systems, networking or security — including relevant coursework, a thesis, research or personal projects.

If your CV doesn’t fully capture your potential, apply anyway. Show us what you’ve built, the hard problems you’ve solved, and what makes you different from other engineers at a similar stage of their career.

How selection works

What you build counts for more than your CV.

  • Apply with a short form. Autofill your details from your CV or LinkedIn, then answer a few questions about how you think and work.
  • We take a quick first look at each application. Candidates who look like a fit get a personal link to our engineering challenge, which carries the most weight in our assessment. You can start whenever you’re ready within the access window.
  • You’ll have up to 3 hours for the challenge. It is modelled on a real problem from our security products — one our engineers have already solved in production. Your work won’t be used in our products; it is used only to assess your approach and skills.
  • The task unfolds in phases, with changing requirements. It is deliberately larger than anyone can finish — we look at what you prioritise and why, not at whether you complete every part.
  • AI tools are expected, not just allowed. We’re interested in your judgment: what you accept, reject and verify, and how you defend your trade-offs.
  • Candidates whose challenge results demonstrate a strong match are invited to interview with our senior engineers and HR.

The challenge is designed to give you an opportunity to demonstrate your practical skills, judgment and potential.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • A focus on professional development
  • Interesting and challenging projects
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours, which allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide
  • Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves
  • Compensation for private medical insurance
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement
  • Budget for education
  • The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy (), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.

jobs.description:
Manufacturers rely on Vendavo Channel Data Management (CDM) to turn the sales, inventory and claims data their distributors and partners send every week into numbers they can trust for rebates, incentives and channel decisions. When a file fails, a partner sends bad data, or a report looks wrong, our CDM Support team finds out why and works directly with distributors and partners to get it corrected.

As a Technical Support Engineer II, you will be the first line of support for CDM. You will triage incoming requests, from file failures and data questions to user access and submission schedule updates, and resolve what you can. For data issues, you will trace the problem from the raw file through parsing, matching and loading into the database, identify where the data went wrong, and explain to customers and partners, in plain language, what happened and how to correct it. When an issue needs deeper investigation, you will escalate it to the right team with a clear summary of your findings.

This is a remote role at moment: you will join our Hyderabad-based CDM team, work closely with colleagues in the US, and cover the US business day.

THE OPPORTUNITY

  • Triage incoming cases. Monitor our Salesforce support queue, classifying and prioritizing new CDM cases, from file failures to general support requests. See the cases through to a confirmed resolution or a clean handoff to the right team.

  • Identify data processing failures. Investigate file failures, file scanner errors and parser issues. Compare the raw file, parser output and database, using SQL and lower-environment testing to find the cause. Tell partners exactly what to correct.

  • Communicate with customers and partners. Explain what happened and how to correct their data in plain, professional English, follow up regularly until the issue is resolved, and respond to common data requests.

  • Escalate with a clear handoff. When an issue needs deeper investigation, route it to the right team with your findings, the evidence gathered and the steps already taken.

  • Work across teams. Collaborate with Tier 2, Partner Onboarding and Active Partner Management (APM) so issues reach the right people with the right context.

  • Maintain submission schedules. Keep partner and distributor contacts in the submission schedules accurate and up to date.

  • Manage user access. Create and maintain user credentials for our online tool as needed.

  • Improve the process. Follow and update knowledge articles, and flag recurring issues that could be prevented or automated.

    • This role works a US shift, covering the US business day from India (exact hours confirmed at offer, typically starting between 21:30 and 23:30 IST), with night-shift allowance in line with Vendavo India policy, and cover for some holidays on a rotation.

THE SKILLS

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. A non-engineering background is welcome if your data skills are strong.

  • 1 to 3 years in technical or application support, data operations or data processing, ideally for enterprise or SaaS software.

  • Working knowledge of SQL. You can write basic queries, including joins, and understand database schemas. Oracle or SQL Server experience is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel, including formulas, lookups (VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP), pivot tables and checking large data sets.

  • Comfortable with file-based data such as CSV, fixed-width, XML and EDI, and with basic Unix or Windows command-line work.

  • Experience working cases in a ticketing system, ideally Salesforce Service Cloud, and following an escalation process to other teams.

  • A methodical, process-driven way of working: you track your work, document what you find and follow it through.

  • Fluent written and spoken English, with good email etiquette and the confidence to explain a technical problem to a non-technical customer.

  • You enjoy learning new tools and products, and you work well with colleagues across time zones.

    • Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with channel data, point-of-sale (POS) or inventory reporting, rebates, incentives or claims, or with Model N or Vendavo CDM.

  • Familiarity with EDI 867, 844 and 852 transaction sets, or similar formats such as EDIFACT.

  • Scripting in Python or PowerShell, or using AI tools to speed up data checks.

    • Don't tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care most about how you investigate a problem, how you communicate and how you work with others.

THE BENEFITS

  • Professional growth and Development opportunities.
  • Working within a team of friendly, skilled people where help is always within reach
  • Flexible working hours
  • 4 recharge days, where the entire company goes on a brief pause in all geographies for 1 day each quarter. This day can be spent in whatever way helps you recharge, to regain energy, and dive back into the next workday
  • High-end laptop (Windows or Mac)
  • Competitive pay and bonus
  • 18 vacation days in a year in addition to 15 days Sick Leave/ Casual leave per calendar year.
  • 16 hours of paid volunteer time off per year
  • 26 weeks of paid maternity leave and 10 days of paid paternity leave.
  • Health Insurance of up to 7 lacs for self, spouse, 4 dependent children, and parents. 100% of the premium is paid by Vendavo and it covers the employee, spouse, children, and their parents.
  • Group Term Insurance coverage up to three times of their Annual CTC . Dependents are not covered.
  • Group Personal Accident coverage up to three times of Annual CTC. Dependents are not covered.
  • Provident fund contributions

THE VENDAVO STORY

Vendavo partners with the world’s leading companies to accelerate growth and profitability, advance innovation, and build more prosperous communities. Our powerful, cloud-based, AI-powered pricing, selling, and prescribing solutions empower global manufacturers and distributors to manage, optimize, and digitize their end-to-end commercial processes. But we offer so much more than software. Our proven, repeatable process, and passionate, experienced people accelerate value and drive profitable, unrivaled business outcomes for our customers. We are passionate about helping our customers deliver the right products, at the right prices, at the right time, for the right people.

OUR SAAS PRODUCTS

Our B2B pricing and selling solutions include Vendavo’s Pricing & Strategy Management (Pricepoint, Enterprise Pricing Platform, Deal Price Optimizer, and Vendavo AI), Sales & Quoting Solutions (Intelligent CPQ and Sales Optimizer), Profit and Margin Analytics (Profit Analyzer and Margin Bridge Analyzer), and Incentive & Channel Operations (Rebate and Channel Manager). You can learn more about our products here.

OUR FUNDING

We are backed by two of the top high-tech private equity firms in the world, have excellent financial health, and boast the top SaaS retention in our space.

OUR CULTURE & YOU

We collaborate with our customers unlike any others in our industry. Anchored in our values (Integrity, Customer Centricity, Innovation, Clarity, Collaboration), we are growing, constantly innovating, and consistently driving sustainable outcomes for our clients and partners.
Unlocking opportunities for our customers would not be possible without our employees. When you are part of Vendavo, you’re part of a company that’s committed to your growth and invested in your career. Diversity, inclusion, and celebration of community are at our core, and we come together to learn from each other and honor our commitments.
EMEA and California residents applying for positions at Vendavo can see our privacy policy here.

jobs.description:
Remote | Project-Based Independent Contractor
Compensation: $15 to $45 Location-Based Hourly Rates (USD), based on qualifications, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Human Resources & Payroll Compliance

What if your expertise in Mainland China labor law, payroll administration, statutory benefits, and employment compliance could help artificial intelligence better understand employment regulations, payroll requirements, HR communications, and workforce compliance obligations?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced HR, payroll, labor compliance, and employment law professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking Human Resources professionals, Payroll Specialists, Labor Compliance Experts, Employment Law specialists, Compensation & Benefits professionals, and HR Operations practitioners who can apply their professional expertise, regulatory knowledge, and analytical judgment to evaluate AI-generated employment and payroll content.

This isn't a traditional HR, payroll administration, or labor relations position. You won't be managing employees, processing payroll, or administering benefits programs. Instead, you'll assess employment-related content, validate payroll calculations, review HR communications, identify regulatory inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your HR and payroll expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It is important to understand the nature of freelance work. Tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent. Candidates must currently reside and perform all project-related work outside Mainland China.

The Opportunity

As a Mainland China Labor & Payroll Compliance Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated HR, payroll, and employment compliance content.

You'll analyze labor law scenarios, payroll calculations, compensation structures, employee communications, statutory benefit requirements, and employment compliance matters while identifying errors, unsupported conclusions, regulatory inconsistencies, and procedural gaps.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex HR, payroll, labor compliance, and employment-related challenges within Mainland China's regulatory environment.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the following areas:

1. Mainland China Labor Law & Employment Compliance

Professionals experienced in interpreting and applying PRC labor laws, employment regulations, labor contracts, employee rights, terminations, severance requirements, leave entitlements, disciplinary procedures, and workplace compliance obligations.

2. Payroll Administration, Compensation & Wage Compliance

Professionals experienced in payroll processing, compensation administration, wage calculations, overtime requirements, tax withholding, severance calculations, payroll reconciliation, and statutory payroll compliance.

3. Social Insurance, Statutory Benefits & Housing Provident Fund

Experts in social insurance administration, Housing Provident Fund requirements, statutory contribution calculations, employer obligations, employee enrollments, and regional contribution requirements.

4. HR Communications, Policies & Employment Documentation

Professionals experienced in drafting, reviewing, and implementing employment contracts, HR policies, employee communications, handbooks, compensation notices, disciplinary communications, and employment-related documentation.

5. Labor & Payroll Regulatory Research

Professionals experienced in researching labor regulations, employment laws, payroll requirements, government announcements, regulatory guidance, and historical regulatory changes.

6. Payroll Auditing & Technical Validation

Professionals who review payroll calculations, compensation models, payroll workbooks, reconciliations, calculation methodologies, and supporting documentation for accuracy and compliance.

7. Compensation & Benefits Administration

HR professionals responsible for employee compensation planning, statutory benefits administration, payroll compliance, and employee rewards programs.

8. Employment Compliance & HR Operations

Professionals responsible for employment compliance reviews, labor policy implementation, workforce administration, and HR operational governance.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated HR and payroll content: Assess employment, payroll, labor law, and compliance-related content for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory alignment.
  • Review employment and payroll information: Examine content involving labor laws, payroll administration, compensation, statutory benefits, HR policies, and workplace compliance.
  • Analyze regulatory reasoning: Assess employment interpretations, payroll methodologies, and compliance conclusions for accuracy and alignment with applicable regulations.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate statements, payroll errors, unsupported interpretations, missing obligations, and compliance risks.
  • Validate information: Research and verify content using official PRC labor, employment, taxation, and social insurance resources.
  • Review HR communications: Evaluate employee notices, workplace policies, compensation communications, and employment documentation.
  • Review payroll calculations: Assess salary calculations, overtime, tax withholding, statutory contributions, leave pay, and severance calculations.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings and recommend accurate corrections supported by regulatory references and professional practice.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation rubrics, quality standards, and review criteria.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Expertise in a New Way

Use your specialized knowledge of labor law, payroll administration, HR compliance, and employment practices to contribute to emerging AI initiatives.

Earn Supplemental Income

This freelance opportunity allows qualified professionals to earn additional income while applying their professional expertise to flexible, task-based assignments.

Leverage Your Mainland China Expertise Internationally

Apply the education, knowledge, and experience you've developed in Mainland China while working remotely from your current country of residence.

Help Improve HR & Payroll Accuracy

Your evaluations will improve the quality and reliability of AI-generated employment, payroll, benefits, and compliance information.

Explore Emerging Technology

Gain exposure to AI evaluation initiatives while utilizing your existing professional expertise.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for professionals who can recognize accurate regulatory reasoning, identify compliance concerns, and communicate expert assessments clearly.

Compensation

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on specialty, experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and project requirements.

Locations and Pay Rate (USD/Hour)

Singapore, UK, US $35–$45

Taiwan, Europe $25–$35

Malaysia, Hong Kong $15–$25

Compensation may vary based on experience level, area of expertise, professional qualifications, and assignment complexity.

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
  • Geographic Requirement: Must reside and perform all project work outside Mainland China
  • Regional Expertise Requirement: Relevant education obtained in Mainland China and/or professional work experience in Mainland China
  • Domain: Human Resources, Labor Law & Payroll Compliance (Mainland China)
  • Specialty: Mainland China Labor & Payroll Compliance Specialist
  • Languages: English plus the ability to independently interpret original Chinese-language materials
  • Schedule: Variable and assignment-based
  • Project Type: AI Content Evaluation Pilot
  • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be asked to complete screening questions and evaluation exercises before project selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced HR, payroll, labor compliance, and employment law professionals who bring more than familiarity with employment regulations. You should be comfortable reviewing regulatory information, assessing payroll calculations, exercising independent judgment, and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

  • Relevant education obtained in Mainland China and/or professional work experience in Mainland China within HR, labor compliance, payroll administration, compensation & benefits, employment law, or related disciplines.
  • Must currently reside and perform all project work outside Mainland China.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in HR, payroll administration, employment compliance, labor relations, or compensation and benefits.
  • Strong knowledge of Mainland China's labor laws, payroll regulations, statutory contribution requirements, and employment compliance obligations.
  • Ability to review and validate payroll calculations, tax withholding, statutory contributions, overtime, severance, and compensation-related payments.
  • Ability to assess HR communications, employee notices, workplace policies, and employment documentation.
  • Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong written Chinese reading comprehension skills and written English communication skills.
  • Comfort using spreadsheets, HR systems, payroll tools, research platforms, and digital documentation systems.
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed project guidelines.

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • HR Manager
  • Payroll Manager
  • Labor Compliance Manager
  • Employment Compliance Specialist
  • Compensation & Benefits Manager
  • HR Operations Manager
  • Labor Relations Specialist

Additional preferred qualifications include:

  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR, GPHR, Mainland China HR certifications, or related professional credentials.
  • Experience supporting Mainland China employees or business entities.
  • Experience conducting payroll audits, employment compliance reviews, or HR assessments.
  • Experience researching labor regulations and regional employment requirements.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and payroll reconciliation experience.
  • Experience with HRIS, HCM, payroll administration, or ERP systems.
  • Previous exposure to AI-assisted HR research, payroll technology, regulatory technology, or AI content evaluation.

Experience with AI model evaluation, data annotation, research projects, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

Bring Your HR & Payroll Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced HR, payroll, labor compliance, or employment law professional who enjoys analyzing complex regulatory requirements, validating payroll calculations, applying professional judgment, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of HR and payroll AI.

Process Improvement and Automation:

Requirements

Soft Skill Requirements:

  • Ability to capture the end-to-end process and determine areas of opportunity for improvement, automation, and refinement to allow for the ability to grow and scale.

Other Valued Attributes

Recruitment Specialist – International Talent Acquisition

Location: Remote — LATAM or Philippines

Reports To: Recruitment Manager
Start Date: ASAP, ideally within one week

About Limitless Agency

Limitless Agency helps businesses build high-performing teams by connecting them with qualified talent across international markets. Our recruitment department is expanding to support a growing portfolio of overseas searches for U.S.-based clients.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a mid-level recruiter to take ownership of assigned searches while working directly with our Recruitment Manager. You’ll primarily recruit remote talent for U.S.-based clients across digital marketing, sales, and client success roles.

You’ll receive hands-on training in our recruitment methodology, with ongoing feedback and a clear focus on independent execution and measurable hiring outcomes.

This is a hands-on, performance-driven role for someone who combines fast execution with sound candidate judgment, proactive communication, and a commitment to long-term professional growth.

What You’ll Do

Recruitment & Candidate Assessment

  • Screen inbound applications, resumes, pre-check responses, video introductions, and assessments against role-specific requirements.
  • Conduct structured interviews in English, probing individual responsibilities, achievements, metrics, and relevant competencies.
  • Manage assigned overseas searches, including proactive sourcing and headhunting when needed.
  • Prepare evidence-based candidate evaluations, scorecards, and qualified shortlists for the Recruitment Manager’s review.
  • Maintain professional candidate communication, coordinate interviews and follow-ups, and support offer and onboarding coordination.

Pipeline Ownership & Recruitment Operations

  • Manage at least four concurrent searches, adapting priorities to hiring needs and deadlines.
  • Keep ATS records accurate and up to date, including candidate stages, evaluations, and next actions.
  • Identify opportunities to reprofile qualified candidates for other searches.
  • Track delivery timelines, hiring outcomes, and candidate quality, and communicate blockers and delays proactively.
  • Contribute to job postings, recruitment workflows, interview guides, and process improvements as your responsibilities expand.

Collaboration with the Recruitment Manager

  • Report directly to the Recruitment Manager and apply feedback and established evaluation standards.
  • Maintain a strong interview cadence, typically 4–5 interviews per day, or more when search volume requires it, with quality always the priority.

What Success Looks Like

  • Ramp-up: 2 successful hires during your first month.
  • Target performance: 3–4 successful hires per month following onboarding.
  • Excellent performance: 5–6 successful hires per month.

Earning Potential

Your compensation combines a fixed monthly base with a performance bonus for each successful hire.

  • Base pay: $1,500–$1,800 USD/month
  • Performance bonus: $100 USD per successful hire
  • At target (3–4 hires/month): $1,800–$2,200 USD/month (base plus 3–4 bonuses)
  • At excellent performance (5–6 hires/month): $2,000–$2,400 USD/month (base plus 5–6 bonuses)

Bonuses are earned when the placed candidate actually starts working and are payable at the end of that month. Actual monthly earnings depend on successful starts. Final bonus terms will be detailed in the written agreement.

Work Environment

  • Remote, full-time independent contractor role with an exclusive professional commitment to Limitless Agency.
  • Standard schedule of 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, with occasional additional flexibility needed to meet hiring deadlines and business needs.
  • A fast-paced, high-accountability environment where prompt responses during working hours, proactive updates, quality shortlists, and consistent ATS documentation are expected.

How to Apply

Submit an updated English-language resume highlighting your overseas recruitment experience, relevant marketing and sales searches, and measurable hiring results. Please highlight your ATS proficiency (particularly Workable) and confirm your availability to start.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of relevant recruitment experience with direct ownership of screening, interviewing, sourcing, and shortlisting.
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting overseas talent for U.S.-based companies, including remote international hiring.
  • Hands-on experience recruiting digital marketing and sales talent, such as Marketing Managers, Media Buyers, Meta Ads or Google Ads Specialists, SEO Specialists, and sales professionals. Client Success recruitment experience is also valuable.

  • Strong ATS discipline, attention to detail, initiative, responsiveness, work ethic, and accountability.
  • Professional stability in your career history.
  • Based in LATAM or the Philippines.
  • Availability for exclusive, full-time work from 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Workable ATS (strongly preferred; proficiency with another ATS is acceptable).

Benefits

About the Role

We are looking for a Purchasing Planner to help keep the right inventory flowing at the right cost. This role plans and purchases finished goods and raw materials, maintains forecasts and order plans, manages vendor relationships, and keeps purchasing data accurate in NetSuite.

Reporting to our Purchasing Manager as part of the Financial Planning & Analysis team, you will work closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, and Brand & Ecommerce, as well as our supply chain partners, to keep products in stock while managing inventory investment, inventory turns, and excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory.

The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, and comfortable working with data, with hands-on purchasing experience and the judgment to balance product availability, cost, and inventory health.

Forecasting and Order Planning
