Purchasing and Raw Materials

  • Plan and place purchase orders for finished goods and raw materials such as paper, cartons, and foil, and maintain POs for accurate cost, quantity, and delivery dates.

Vendor Management

  • Serve as a primary contact for assigned vendors, handling price updates, quotes, product questions, and shipment and order issues.

Inventory Health

  • Monitor stock levels, inventory turns, and aging to prevent stockouts and excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory, and recommend actions for slow-moving items.

Item Records and Data Analysis

  • Maintain item records in NetSuite, including vendor SKUs, costs, descriptions, and components, using standard templates and audit cycles.

AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Strong analytical and root-cause problem-solving skills.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, pricing, and quotes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Microsoft Fabric.

This is an opportunity to join a purchasing team that is growing within our Financial Planning & Analysis function, with a strong focus on better planning, cleaner data, and close partnership with the rest of the business.

jobs.description:
Who We're Looking For

At ScalePad, we hire thoughtful builders who want their work to matter. Our roles are designed for people who thrive on driving impact, see ambiguity as an opportunity, and believe that raising the bar is a team sport.

We don't bring people in to run playbooks. We hire people who want to rewrite them. In this role, you'll do that by redefining what great technical support looks like for the MSPs who rely on Backup Radar, while shaping the future of managed services for our global partners. (That's what we call our customers.)

What is ScalePad

At ScalePad, we're building more than software; we're building confidence and clarity for the people who manage the technology businesses rely on every day.

Our mission: help MSPs evolve into MVPs (their clients' most valuable partner). Our tools turn them from reactive service providers into strategic advisors through a consistent, scalable Customer Success motion. Our product suite unifies risk insights, client planning, and service delivery so MSPs can have smarter conversations, show clients their value, and grow their revenue.

But our purpose goes beyond our software. We're creating a workplace where curious, growth-minded people can do their best work, where ideas are valued, progress is shared, and everyone belongs. Together, we're creating a future where MSPs don't just keep businesses running, they help them thrive. We believe that when our partners succeed, we all do.

With offices in Vancouver, Toronto, and Phoenix and a global-first mindset, ScalePad has grown into a category leader trusted by 12,000+ partners across 60+ countries. We've been recognized for our products and corporate culture by MSP Today, G2, and Great Place to Work™, to name a few.

About The Role

As a key contributor to our Product Support team, you'll take an already successful offering to the next level. If you're a strong problem solver, a fast researcher, constantly curious, and can't stand users having anything less than a stellar experience, we want to hear from you.

This is not your typical help desk job. It's a diverse, rewarding, and career-defining opportunity to go much further. Here's what makes it unique:

  • Our users are highly skilled IT companies. No need to explain the right mouse button.
  • Our products are built to be intuitive. Bugs are squashed as soon as (or before!) they appear.
  • We take a modern approach to support, keeping it friendly and personal.
  • We offer email-first support using a great tool, and our partners love it.

You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and our Partner Development team, and the insights you gather from partners will directly shape how our products grow.

AI Fluency: We expect you to use AI as a daily part of how you work. That includes quickly researching unfamiliar tools, integrations, and error messages; drafting and refining partner replies and knowledge base articles; spotting patterns in support volume to surface systemic issues for Product and Engineering; and finding faster ways to troubleshoot. You'll also use judgment about when a partner needs a person's expertise and empathy rather than an automated answer.

What You'll Own

Get ready to go beyond order-taking. Your strategic responsibilities include:

  • Spend time interacting with users by email and occasionally by phone.
  • Optimize documentation and processes that instigate changes to help scale.
  • Gain unique insights into how tens of thousands of IT professionals operate.
  • Work closely with our internal Partner Development Executives to provide technical/product expertise.
  • Work closely with Product Management and Engineering teams to report and champion the resolution of bugs.
  • Drive onboarding/adoption of the platform through your interactions with users.
  • Champion our products by writing technical tutorials, publishing articles, and building inspiring demos.
  • Document features and best practices, organizing them for discoverability and maintaining quality.
  • Dream up and implement new ways to deliver, author, and interact with technical content.

What We're Looking For

We care about what you can do more than where you've done it. However, experience in the following areas will help you hit the ground running in this role:

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer success/support role, preferably in a SaaS environment.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication ability (you need to be fluent and highly proficient in English).
  • Can empathize with users and quickly grasp the issues they're facing.
  • A good understanding of various IT concepts.
  • Enjoy talking about technical concepts, have great analytical skills, and are comfortable explaining technically complicated topics simply and elegantly, even in challenging situations.
  • Enjoy the puzzle of solving open-ended problems.
  • Are adaptive and have no problem constantly learning about a changing technical product, even when it's a little out of your depth.
  • Are happy to take on new projects, which can sometimes involve quickly researching to become a subject matter expert while seeing things through to completion.
  • Are creative, collaborative, optimistic, communicative, intellectually curious, and clever.
  • Able to quickly iterate and improve as a perpetual learner and teacher.
  • Proficient in basic HTML and Markdown.
  • An understanding of API fundamentals / interpretation of JSON.
  • A strong understanding of email deliverability.
  • A strong general knowledge of software development.
  • A strong sense of time management.
  • Incredible attention to detail.
  • A proven ability to multitask, stay organized, and work rapidly in time-critical situations.

Bonus points if:

  • You have experience within the MSP industry or adjacent IT industry.
  • You have working knowledge of Regular Expression Fundamentals.

Perks

ScalePad offers our employees a blend of purpose, growth, and genuinely great perks.

  • Everyone's an owner. Share in our success through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and RRSP matching.
  • Support for growing families. Parental leave programs are in place to support you and your family when it matters most.

Before You Apply

This is a full-time role for those who are eligible to work in Canada or the United States. We thank all applicants for taking the time to apply, but only candidates who make it to the next stage will be contacted.

Note on AI Use: ScalePad uses AI technology to support certain administrative aspects of our hiring process, such as transcription, note-taking, and interview documentation. These tools are strictly used to assist our team and have no influence on candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

Marek Health is built around a simple vision: help people reach a level of health and performance they did not think was possible. Our expert clinical team creates a clear path to higher energy, stronger bodies, sharper minds, and a longer, fuller life. We do this through personalized, clinician-guided care grounded in advanced diagnostics and evidence-based treatments, including hormone optimization, peptides, nutrition, and lifestyle support. Our goal is to become the partner that guides people to the healthiest, most capable version of themselves.

We are hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own email and SMS end-to-end across all three Marek brands: Marek Health, Marek Diagnostics, and Marek Supplements. This covers every email and text we send: lifecycle and automated flows, lead nurture, campaigns and promotions, client and care communications, and newsletters. Email and SMS are the channels we control outright, and they are one of our biggest levers for intakes, revenue, and retention. This role sets the strategy and does the build, and is directly accountable for what the program drives. It reports to the Growth and Operations Manager and works closely with the tech, sales, product, and clinical teams.

Key Responsibilities

Lifecycle Strategy and the Client Journey

  • Own, manage, and scale the email and SMS program across all three brands: strategy, calendar, and cadence.
  • Map the entire client lifecycle and hold the source of truth for every automated touchpoint: what triggers it, who receives it, what it says, and how it looks.
  • Own stage-to-stage conversion after intake: intake to labs, labs to provider exam, exam to treatment plan, and first refill. Set baselines for each stage and show the lift email and SMS drive.
  • Work in parallel with the tech and sales teams to rebuild and maintain the journey, define what lifecycle needs, and see it through.
  • Focus heavily on client retention and reactivation.
  • Drive adoption of the new Account Management portal. Use email and SMS to notify clients of status changes and incentivize the actions we want them to take, and partner with product to see which features clients use and scale adoption.

All Email and SMS, Across All Brands

  • Run every type of send: lifecycle and automated flows, campaigns and promotions, client and care communications, and newsletters.
  • Build lead nurture and mid-funnel journeys that move prospects from first touch through the questionnaire, discovery call, and intake.
  • Build and run onboarding, evergreen sends to inactives, abandonment, win-backs, and retention journeys.
  • Ship campaign and promotional sends on time, and modify flows for sales and promotions as they come up, without being asked.

Data, Build, and Deliverability

  • Define and maintain the event and attribute spec that lifecycle depends on, covering the clinical system, payments, scheduling, and both Shopify stores. QA new events with tech before they go live.

Wir sind NETSHAKE – die AI-First E-Commerce-Agentur

Als Shopify Premier Partner und eine der führenden AI-First-Agenturen Europas vereinen wir fundiertes E-Commerce-Know-how mit künstlicher Intelligenz. Unser Ziel: bessere Ergebnisse, kürzere Umsetzungszeiten und maximaler Output.

Deine Rolle: Shopify & AI Traffic

Als (Junior) E-Commerce Kaufmann bringst du dein Wissen aus dem Handel in Kundenprojekte ein. Du pflegst und optimierst Shopify-Shops, setzt Kampagnen auf und sorgst dafür, dass die Shops unserer Kunden bei Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini gefunden werden. Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Teamlead zusammen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt eigene Kunden.

Unsere DNA: AI First

AI ist bei NETSHAKE keine Ergänzung, sondern die Grundlage unserer Arbeitsweise. Wir hinterfragen bestehende Abläufe, automatisieren gezielt und fördern den Ausbau deiner AI-Kompetenz. Unsere Überzeugung: Wer AI souverän einsetzt, macht sich nicht überflüssig, sondern unverzichtbar.

Du möchtest Verantwortung tragen, dich schnell weiterentwickeln und den E-Commerce von morgen mitgestalten? Dann werde Teil von NETSHAKE!

Aufgaben

✍️ Content & Lifecycle

  • Du entwickelst Inhalte, die sowohl für klassische Suchmaschinen als auch für generative KI-Systeme optimiert sind.

  • Du betreust den gesamten Content-Lifecycle deiner Kundenprojekte: von der Erstellung über die Weiterentwicklung bis zum Monitoring.

  • Du erstellst monatliche Performance-Reportings und leitest daraus klare nächste Schritte ab.

  • Du unterstützt bei bezahlter Reichweite und setzt Ads-Kampagnen für Kundenshops mit auf.

🛍️ Shopify-Umsetzung

  • Du realisierst Shopify-Shops von der ersten Konzeption bis zum Go-live. Theme-Architektur, Liquid, App-Integrationen und Shopify Functions setzt du selbstständig um.

  • Du unterstützt Händler bei Fragen zu Shop-Struktur, Funktionen und technischen Entscheidungen – verständlich, transparent und mit Blick auf die passende Lösung.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für den Erfolg des gesamten Projekts, nicht nur für einzelne Aufgaben.

🔎 GEO & KI-Sichtbarkeit

  • Du bringst GEO-Strategien in die Umsetzung: Mit strukturierten Daten, Schema Markup, Feeds und optimierten Inhalten schaffst du die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass Kundenshops in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Co. als relevante Quellen erkannt und empfohlen werden.

  • Du analysierst Shops mit Blick auf ihre KI-Sichtbarkeit und entwickelst daraus konkrete Maßnahmen.

  • Du überprüfst Ergebnisse, testest neue Ansätze und optimierst kontinuierlich – auf Basis von Daten statt Bauchgefühl.

⚙️ AI-Tools & Automation

  • Du integrierst AI konsequent in deinen Arbeitsalltag – von Recherche und Shop-Umsetzung über Content und Datenanalyse bis zu Qualitätssicherung und Reporting.

  • Du entwickelst AI-gestützte Workflows und Automatisierungen, die wiederkehrende Aufgaben reduzieren und den Output steigern.

  • Du probierst eigenständig neue AI-Technologien aus und bringst konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten ins Team ein.

🤝 Händler & Workshops

  • Du planst und leitest Händler-Workshops mit einem klaren Fokus auf messbare Projektergebnisse.

  • Du hältst Kunden und Team proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, sodass der aktuelle Projektstand jederzeit klar ist.

  • Nach jedem Projektabschluss holst du zwei Bewertungen ein – eine auf Shopify und eine auf Google. Dein Qualitätsanspruch: fünf Sterne.

Qualifikation

🎯 Ownership

Du übernimmst Verantwortung – für deine Aufgaben, das gesamte Projektergebnis und den gemeinsamen Teamerfolg. Wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft, konzentrierst du dich auf Lösungen statt auf Schuldzuweisungen.

⚡ Eigenverantwortung

Du erhältst ein Ziel und organisierst selbstständig den Weg dorthin. Du planst deine Sprints, behältst Fristen im Blick und kommunizierst Risiken rechtzeitig. Du wartest nicht darauf, angeschoben zu werden, sondern treibst deine Projekte selbst voran.

💡 Weitblick

Du denkst über einzelne Aufgaben hinaus, erkennst mögliche Probleme früh und entdeckst Verbesserungspotenzial in Abläufen. Statt nur Fragen aufzuwerfen, bringst du durchdachte Optionen und eine begründete Empfehlung mit. Bestehende Prozesse hinterfragst du konstruktiv – und entwickelst bessere Alternativen.

🤖 AI-Kompetenz

AI ist für dich mehr als ein hilfreiches Werkzeug: Sie prägt deine Herangehensweise. Du kennst ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity und Cursor und kannst einschätzen, welches Tool für welche Aufgabe den größten Nutzen bietet. Neue Tools und Claude Skills entdeckst und testest du eigenständig und zeigst dem Team, wie sie sich direkt sinnvoll einsetzen lassen. Du verknüpfst Tools, APIs und KI zu neuen Lösungen.

Außerdem bringst du einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch mit: Du gibst dich nicht damit zufrieden, dass etwas lediglich funktioniert, sondern möchtest wirklich gute Ergebnisse erzielen. Du nimmst Feedback offen an, lernst schnell und probierst Neues aus. Auf deine Zusagen ist Verlass – und wenn etwas dazwischenkommt, kommunizierst du das frühzeitig.

Must-haves

jobs.description:
Director of Security

Reports to: CTO · Location: Greece (remote) · Leads: Corporate Security Engineer, Product Security Engineer; directs Corporate IT on security controls

The role

You lead TRG's security program and do its hardest technical work. Expect at least 60% of your week hands-on: investigating alerts, writing detections, reviewing architecture and testing our defences. You lead two engineers by example and review their changes. Compliance runs on automated evidence, so it takes no more than one day a week.

Outcomes you will own

  • Lead every security investigation and incident hands-on, from first alert to post-mortem.
  • Hunt for threats every week and write cross-domain detections in the SIEM; each engineer owns the detections in their domain.
  • Review the architecture of every new platform, region and dedicated deployment before launch.
  • Run internal penetration tests and red-team exercises between annual external tests.
  • Review every security change your engineers make; they review yours.
  • Lead TRG's compliance roadmap: achieve SOC 2 Type I, then Type II, and align our controls with NIST CSF and NIST SP 800-53. Build one control set that maps to all three, ready for future FedRAMP authorisation. Automate evidence collection to keep compliance under one day a week.
  • Own the ISG Policy; approve the standards each engineer maintains under it.
  • Lead customer security reviews and questionnaires as the technical authority.
  • Run vendor risk reviews, including AI model providers.
  • Run on-call, the incident response plan and the MDR provider for after-hours cover.
  • Publish a monthly security posture report to the CTO and CEO.
  • Agree employee monitoring scope with Legal and the DPO under GDPR before telemetry rollouts.
  • Own the SIEM: centralise endpoint, identity, cloud and application logs, with retention that meets SOC 2 and NIST requirements.

First 90 days

  1. Take over SOC 2 from the outgoing owner; publish a ranked risk register.
  2. Assess identity, detection coverage and incident readiness yourself; fix the top five findings.
  3. Ship the incident response playbooks and the first monthly posture report.

What you bring

  • 8+ years in security, including 5+ years hands-on in incident response, detection engineering or offensive security.
  • Led a team of 2 to 5 security engineers while staying hands-on.
  • Investigates incidents across endpoint telemetry, cloud logs and network traffic.
  • Writes detection rules and automation in Python or similar.
  • Hands-on with cloud, container, endpoint and identity security.
  • Delivered a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification as the accountable owner; working knowledge of NIST CSF and NIST SP 800-53.
  • Writes clearly for executives, auditors and customers.

Nice to have

  • OSCP, GCIH, GCFA or equivalent.
  • Experience selling to government, defence or law enforcement customers.
  • Familiarity with security for LLM-based products.
  • Prepared a cloud product for FedRAMP authorisation.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Cold Caller to open doors for a New York-based branded entertainment studio that makes recurring shows for brands on social platforms. You will call small businesses, mainly unique stays and local experience providers, and start conversations that turn into meetings. The leads, the power dialer, and the software are already set up, so your job is to pick up the phone and bring energy to every call.

This is a high-volume role at 200 to 400 dials a day. It is also a personality role. The product is new, and prospects are buying a little bit of the person they are talking to. The difference between a good caller and a great one shows up in the deals. The best person for this seat has top-tier spoken English, sounds warm and clear on the phone, builds rapport in seconds, and can keep that up through a full day of dialing without burning out. If you are reliable, ambitious, and the kind of person people enjoy talking to, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Leads, a power dialer, and software are already set up, so you can start calling right away
  • Get in early at a young studio and help build its sales motion

What You'll Work On

High-Volume Dialing

  • Make 200 to 400 outbound calls a day using a power dialer
  • Keep your energy, tone, and quality steady across the full working day
  • Reach owners and decision makers at small hospitality and local experience businesses

Conversations and Meetings

  • Open cold calls warmly and quickly explain why the call is worth their time
  • Build rapport, ask good questions, and handle objections with confidence and good humor
  • Book qualified meetings for the founder

CRM and Reporting

  • Log every call, outcome, and follow-up accurately
  • Track dials, conversations, and meetings booked each day
  • Share what you hear from prospects so the team can sharpen the pitch

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Top-tier spoken English that is clear, natural, and easy to understand; this is the most important requirement
  • A warm, personable, and genuinely charming way on the phone that makes people want to keep talking
  • Prior cold calling or outbound sales experience, with the stamina for 200 to 400 dials a day
  • Resilience, steady energy, and the ability to handle volume without burning out
  • Reliability and ambition, with the discipline to hit daily targets without being chased
  • Clean CRM habits and accurate call logging
  • Reliable internet and a quiet place to take calls
  • Available to work full-time during US business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to small businesses, hospitality, travel, or experience providers
  • Experience with a power dialer
  • Experience selling creative, media, or marketing services
  • Interest in content, entertainment, or social media

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself in your natural speaking voice, describing your cold calling experience, and giving a 30-second opener as if you were calling the owner of a small boutique stay

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are charming on the phone, reliable through a full day of dialing, and want to help build the sales motion of a young studio, this role gives you the volume and the direct impact to do your best work.

Benefits

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.title: First-Principles Prize Designer
jobs.excerpt: XPRIZE Overview XPRIZE is an established global leader in designing and executing large-scale competitions to solve humanity’s greatest challenges.
jobs.description:
XPRIZE Overview

XPRIZE is an established global leader in designing and executing large-scale competitions to solve humanity’s greatest challenges. As a 501(c)3, our unique model democratizes innovation by incentivizing crowd-sourced, scientifically viable solutions to create a more equitable and abundant future for all. Since our founding in 1994, we’ve launched $519 million in prize competitions that are driving more than $31 billion in social and economic impact — a 60x return on philanthropic investment. These competitions not only de-risk early-stage breakthrough ideas but also mobilize capital, talent, and momentum to accelerate solutions from concept to real-world scale.

We operate across 5 areas of impact,including:

  • Deep Tech + Exploration
  • Energy + Climate + Nature
  • Food + Water + Waste
  • Health
  • Learning + Society

Join XPRIZE to help create meaningful impact as we strive to empower humanity to achieve breakthroughs and architect a more equitable and abundant future for all.

Position Description

XPRIZE is seeking a First-Principles Prize Designer to lead the development of bold, high-impact global incentive competitions that accelerate innovation for the benefit of humanity. The role functions as a product manager for Prize Design projects, combining research, quantitative reasoning, design thinking, and communication to produce competition designs that target the breakthroughs behind an equitable and abundant future.

What sets this role apart is how the work starts. Faced with a new problem, you start by building your own understanding from the ground up before turning to the literature. You develop a working sense of the problem's scale and structure early, apply order-of-magnitude estimates and “whiteboard” the first-order math — enough to judge which incentives and metrics will meaningfully move the needle — then test those ideas against the world's leading experts.

Every prize shares some common themes, and you’re energized by the thought of being flexible and adaptable enough to apply that mental model across five diverse areas of impact at XPRIZE. You work closely with XPRIZE domain leaders and technology staff to explain your framing of the problem, refine the implications of your findings, and in doing so, create the next great XPRIZE.

From a technical perspective, the ideal candidate thinks like a scientist and communicates like a generalist. You are able to build a credible working model of an unfamiliar problem quickly, and know when to go deeper. This allows you to move (for example) from designing a prize around the next breakthrough in fusion energy, to the effects of AI on society, to biotech for spaceflight, all in the same year.

The First-Principles Prize Designer leads end-to-end design, from initial ideation through the XPRIZE Global Visioneering process, to delivery of the final design report. You steward every phase: defining the problem, choosing the most effective prize direction, setting competition criteria, establishing phases and milestones, and building budgets across the full lifecycle of a prize. You ensure that each concept is well-researched, feasible, fundable, and positioned to win funding from a future sponsor. You report to the Prize Design Director and work within structured, accelerated timelines alongside a Project Manager, Domain Leads, Advancement, and cross-functional partners in finance, marketing, and operations. The role also involves regular engagement with sponsors and subject matter experts to keep technical rigor and strategic impact aligned.

Prize Designers also steward XPRIZE's design methodology, refining internal processes, capturing lessons learned, and representing the approach through thought leadership, workshops, and publications. Beyond individual projects, they contribute to organization-wide efforts such as Global Visioneering and other ideation that surfaces future XPRIZE opportunities.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end design and development of XPRIZE competitions, from framing the problem and defining success metrics to conducting research, engaging stakeholders, shaping the prize model, and producing final design documentation. Work within a structured design process guided by the Prize Design Director and seek Director input at key decision points to stay aligned with organizational priorities and quality standards.
  • Operate with a high degree of self-direction between check-ins with the Prize Design Director. Proactively surface blockers, risks, and decisions that need Director input rather than waiting for scheduled touchpoints.
  • Adapt quickly when the Prize Design Director reprioritizes projects or shifts design direction mid-cycle, maintaining momentum and timelines.
  • Develop project plans, budgets, and timelines, coordinating with the Project Manager so deliverables meet deadlines and quality standards.
  • Work closely with internal teams and collaborators, keeping alignment with Domain Leads, leadership, and Advancement on strategy, content, and positioning. Fold operational, financial, and communications inputs from Finance, Marketing, and Operations into the prize model and documentation.
  • Identify and engage external experts and stakeholders, including designing and facilitating workshops, technical interviews, and other participatory research to inform design choices.
  • Facilitate productive sponsor relationships as requested, with clear communication, updates, and deliverables that align with sponsor goals and XPRIZE standards.
  • Contribute to organization-wide ideation and concept development such as Global Visioneering and prize ideation/ “Moonshot” workshops.
  • Maintain and improve XPRIZE’s prize design methodology by staying fluent in current processes and documentation, capturing lessons learned from past and active designs, and updating tools and practices. Serve as an internal resource on the prize design process and keep core documentation current.
  • Elevate XPRIZE’s prize design process externally through presentations, publications, website content, and thought leadership.

Qualifications

  • First-principles reasoning: builds a working understanding of an unfamiliar problem from first principles — developing a credible sense of scale, feasibility, and impact potential early enough to make good design decisions before investing significant time.
  • Cross-disciplinary range: moves comfortably across unrelated fields (e.g. Energy/Nature/Climate to Learning/Society) and knows how to reach design-credible competence in a new domain fast.
  • Education: Masters’ degree in a STEM field required. Recent PhD/post-doc encouraged. Candidates with equivalent analytical experience in rigorous, research-driven fields will be considered. Exceptional analytical and research experience in related disciplines may substitute for the education requirement.
  • Demonstrates basic ability to use dimensional analysis or order-of-magnitude estimates to constrain a new problem. The prepared candidate will benefit from a working level familiarity with the themes of “Order of Magnitude Physics: Understanding the World with Dimensional Analysis, Educated Guesswork and White Lies (Goldreich et al., available online for free).
  • Applies research, analytical, and creative problem-solving in fields such as engineering, physical or life sciences, data science, economics, or other rigor-driven domains.
  • Strong design and design-thinking skills: problem definition, decomposition into sub-problems, identifying the right problem to solve, and combining creative and analytical methods to find design elements.
  • Command of core product management: budgeting, contractual compliance, client relations, and project design, execution, evaluation, and delivery.
  • Produces high-quality research, analysis, and design deliverables under compressed timelines without losing rigor or accuracy.
  • Runs several active projects at once and reprioritizes quickly when organizational needs shift, keeping a direct supervisor informed when timelines are at risk or scope is evolving.
  • Comfortable taking direction from a senior design leader and executing independently within it. Knows what to decide alone and what to escalate.
  • Communicates clearly and credibly with experts and external stakeholders, orally and in writing, and matches style and standards to the audience.
  • Exceptionally strong technical presentation skills: able to adapt depth and framing for expert and non-expert audiences equally.
  • Familiar with research and data platforms (e.g. Google Scholar, PubMed, Scopus) and AI assisted research functions (e.g. Gemini Deep Research). Proficient with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, and quick to pick up new productivity, research, and collaboration tools.

Competencies required for this role:

  • First-Principles Reasoning
  • Order-of-Magnitude Estimation
  • Analytical Problem-Solving
  • Feasibility Judgment
  • Cross-Disciplinary Range
  • Manages Ambiguity and Complexity
  • Nimble Learning, even in a new field
  • Situational Adaptability
  • Global Perspective
  • Communicates Effectively and Professionally
  • Collaborates Internally and Externally
  • Drives Vision and Purpose

Why Work at XPRIZE:

In addition to working for a mission-driven company that catalyzes industries, pushes innovation forward, and is creating an abundant and equitable future, we offer the following benefits:

  • Remote-first environment (must live and work in the United States)
  • Quarterly company-paid All-Hands meetings in Los Angeles for frequent in-person collaboration
  • Employee and dependent medical, dental, and vision options
  • A 401(K) program with employer match
  • Ample paid time off, including vacation, floating holidays, sick days, and company-paid holidays
  • An Employee Assistance Program for confidential, professional support with personal, family, or other challenges
  • Employee stipends/reimbursements for cell phone, internet, health & wellbeing, and learning & development
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave for all employees welcoming a new child to their family
  • One meeting-free block per week and four focus weeks per year to ensure uninterrupted time for strategic projects

The anticipated base salary for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 and may also qualify for an annualincentive. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors including the qualifications of the individual applicant, years of relevant experience for therole, level of education attained, and certifications and/or other licenses held. XPRIZE is a remote-first environment. All employees must be authorized to work in the United States and work from within the United States full-time.

The XPRIZE FOUNDATION is an equal opportunity employer and does not unlawfully discriminate in employment. Equal access to employment, services, and programs is available to all persons. Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a representative of the organization.

Why should you choose us?


Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry’s pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security. Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit:


Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan’s newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global. To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business – from sales to engineering, support functions to product development.


Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together!


About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to approximately 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit


About the Job:

Rakuten Mobile is at the forefront of data-driven innovation. Having successfully implemented robust data platforms and AI orchestration layer, we are now entering an aggressive phase of data monetization. We are seeking a Data Product Specialist to serve as the techno-functional resource bridging our business strategy and platform/ engineering teams.

In this role, you will own the data products [monetizable assets], translate complex technical capabilities into high-value business outcomes and support technical architecture designs and roadmaps. You will be the delivery partner of Rakuten Mobile’s monetizable assets, driving growth through deep client/ vendor partnerships and ensuring technical efficiencies.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Data Product Ownership & Monetization: Own the lifecycle of data-led monetizable offerings, including identifying high-value data assets, shaping productized use cases, and driving adoption, scalability, and revenue growth.
  • Client Solutioning & Business Engagement: Serve as the techno-functional bridge between enterprise/ business and internal teams, gathering requirements, leading discovery discussions, and aligning data/ tech capabilities to business needs.
  • Technical Architecture & Delivery Enablement: Support the design of solution architecture, data flows, and integration approaches, by working closely with engineering and platform teams to ensure scalable and feasible delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance: Partner with Data, Engineering, AI, Legal, Privacy, and Governance teams to ensure data offerings are compliant, operationally robust, and ready for commercialization.
  • Market Intelligence & Growth Strategy: Track market trends, customer needs, and competitive developments in data monetization to inform product roadmap, packaging, and strategic growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications:

Education: B.Tech, MBA or MS preferred.

Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in product techno-functional roles

Domain Expertise: Proven track record in data monetization, data-led product development

Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to navigate complex organizational structures, manage business planning, and influence cross-functional teams.

Preferred Experience (previous):

Roles: Product Manager, Technology Consultant

Functions: Data Monetization, Data Product

RAKUTEN SHUGI PRINCIPLES: Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen.

  • Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.
  • Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.

jobs.description:
As part of eight&four Group's continued growth, we're acquiring a specialist influencer marketing agency that's changing the way financial brands connect with their audiences, championing financial literacy through creative and meaningful influencer partnerships.

With ambitious plans for the year ahead, we're looking for a talented Influencer Account Manager - French speaker to join this growing team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about influencer marketing, relationship building and creating content that makes a genuine impact. You’ll work exclusively with clients in the financial services sector, so a genuine interest in and passion for this industry is essential.

They bridge the gap between influencers and their audiences, promoting financial literacy through meaningful collaborations. You'll work closely with an established roster of influencers and financial brands, helping to deliver campaigns that educate, engage and inspire audiences.

You will report to experienced professionals who will provide mentorship and guidance while empowering you to bring your unique talents to the role. Our approach is collaborative, encouraging you to thrive and develop expertise in influencer marketing and account management.

The role is fully remote, though your attendance may occasionally be required at in-person client meetings and events. Depending on your location, there are also opportunities to work in person with other members of the team on a regular basis.

Requirements

To succeed in this role, you’ll need strong interpersonal skills, a proactive attitude and a genuine interest in influencer marketing.

Your key skills, objectives and responsibilities will include:

Languages

  • Fluency in English and French, ideally with native-level proficiency.

Influencer & platform expertise

  • A strong understanding of how the influencer world works, and experience executing influencer campaigns.
  • Fluency across social platforms: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, X, Twitch, Facebook, Pinterest and more.
  • Confidence with social analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Instagram Insights, TikTok Insights and YouTube Insights.
  • Excellent knowledge of influencers: identifying the right creators, building relationships and exploring emerging trends and verticals.
  • Excellent negotiation skills.

Campaign strategy & delivery

  • Leading creative and strategic ideas sessions.
  • Managing the conception and execution of creative, engaging influencer marketing campaigns.
  • Preparing and maintaining internal and client-facing media plans and proposals in Google Slides, plus client- and supplier-facing documents.
  • Challenging the status quo of how Finfluencer runs influencer campaigns.

Client relationships

  • Being a strong, friendly communicator who handles day-to-day client contact: email updates, update calls, presenting ideas and delivering reports.
  • Feeling confident walking into a room on your own and presenting results and strategy.
  • Building rapport and speaking comfortably about the subject in informal settings, such as client meet-ups.
  • Spotting opportunities to upsell other marketing streams that benefit your client’s business.

Performance & reporting

  • Continuously evaluating and optimising campaigns, proactively keeping clients up to date with results.
  • Compiling, maintaining and analysing accurate, transparent and insightful campaign reports.
  • Understanding what ROI looks like for each of a client’s objectives.
  • Meeting demanding internal and client targets in a proactive, positive, can-do manner, formulating solutions along the way.

Ways of working

Managing your own work independently, with a Director overseeing and lightly supporting where needed.

Supporting team members to learn and grow, so they feel empowered with a sense of supported ownership.

They prioritise a human approach in everything they do and therefore they are looking for team members who can demonstrate the following:

  • Proactive - You take initiative and approach challenges with a can-do attitude.
  • Relationship-building - You excel at creating and maintaining professional relationships.
  • Adaptable - You’re comfortable working in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Supportive - You’re a team player who contributes to a positive, collaborative atmosphere.
  • Detail-oriented - You’re thorough in your work and ensure quality output.

Benefits

  • Join group that is named Campaign Magazine's Best Places to Work 8 years running
  • A fully remote working arrangement that supports work-life balance.
  • Training and support in influencer marketing and investing concepts.
  • Opportunity to be part of an innovative agency with exciting growth plans.
  • A home office set-up contribution after passing probation.
  • Private Healthcare & Life Insurance
  • On-target earnings (OTE).
  • 25 Days+ Holiday
  • Team Mini breaks in the UK and abroad
  • Culture: Open, Engaged & Inspirational

jobs.description:
The Remote-based Virtual Sales Representative (VSR) - Dermatology will play a vital role in the EVERSANA client partnership by meeting or exceeding assigned territory sales goals. The VSR will establish and maintain productive virtual relationships with dermatologists as the primary call point, along with advanced practice providers and dermatology office staff. This individual will communicate approved information about the client’s dermatology product and educate customers on relevant disease-state and patient education materials and programs.

EVERSANA Deployment Solutions offers our VSRs competitive compensation, lucrative bonus potential, paid time off, company paid holidays, excellent training, employee development programs, 401K plan with an employer match, and an incredible list of comprehensive employer benefits that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance along with a whole host of other valuable programs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Complete assigned product training at an advanced level, developing a comprehensive understanding of dermatologic disease states, the assigned product’s features and benefits, the dermatology treatment landscape, and core selling messages.
  • Develop expertise in delivering core selling messages for the assigned promoted dermatology product.
  • Meet or exceed virtual call expectations and sales attainment goals established by the Client, with dermatologists serving as the primary customer audience.
  • Ensure that sample and literature requests are generated accurately and perform appropriate follow-up and investigation on product shipments as needed.
  • Maintain accurate and timely CRM entries for targeted dermatology customer calls, including call attempts, product discussions, customer insights, and literature requests.
  • Provide feedback and recommendations on team leadership in areas and opportunities for improvement.
  • Adhere to all company, Prescription Drug Marketing Act (PDMA), compliance, and regulatory policies and guidelines.
  • Work independently from "remote" home office.
  • Cultivate the assigned virtual dermatology territory and remain accountable for measurable activity, engagement, and sales results.
  • Collaborate closely with field-based partners and other cross-functional colleagues to support coordinated dermatologist engagement and appropriate patient access to therapy.
  • Compensated based on a mix of overall volume/metrics and outcomes.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Territory and Customer Engagement Responsibilities

  • Execute the virtual territory strategy and call plan for prioritized dermatology practices, adapting activities and objectives as business needs evolve.
  • Deliver high-quality, approved educational presentations and materials to dermatologists and their office staff, while providing customer and market insights to support the broader commercial strategy.
  • Apply virtual engagement best practices to build meaningful relationships with dermatology customers, identify appropriate patient types and practice workflows, coordinate follow-up, and connect customers with field-based colleagues when appropriate.
  • Execute sustained call-plan objectives, strengthen coordinated territory penetration, and expand reach to additional high-priority dermatologists and dermatology practices.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements below represent the experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for this role.

Education:

  • Four-year Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college OR equivalent experience required

Experience:

  • 2+ years of HCP-facing pharmaceutical sales experience, including virtual engagement; experience calling on dermatologists or specialty practices is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office software especially Word, Excel and Outlook required with the ability to learn new software as needed (i.e. Veeva CRM experience a plus).
  • Excellent communication & rapport building skills.
  • Ability to articulate complex clinical data.
  • Solid and persuasive communication skills.
  • Aptitude and confidence to engage dermatologists, advanced practice providers, and all levels of dermatology office staff.
  • Stable internet connection adequate to support voice over VoIP calls and virtual call platforms.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in dermatology, immunology, biologics, or other specialty pharmaceutical markets.
  • Experience supporting an established specialty brand or a product launch is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with CRM applications is preferred.
  • Experience in cross functional, collaborative roles.
  • Demonstrated success utilizing digital engagement strategies to drive customer adoption and business performance.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS

Patient Minded - I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight - I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action - I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

Grow Talent - I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together - I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters - I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity - I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). This role is eligible for hire in select U.S. locations based on business and operational considerations. For a full list of locations, visit eversana.com/careers. More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at .

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to the market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

jobs.title: Especialista de Integración Tecnológica (Java & APIs) - México Only - Intermedia
jobs.excerpt: Descripción ¡Trabaja en DaCodes!  Somos una firma de expertos en software y transformación digital de alto impacto.
jobs.description:
Descripción

¡Trabaja en DaCodes!

Somos una firma de expertos en software y transformación digital de alto impacto.
Durante 10 años hemos creado soluciones enfocadas en la tecnología e innovación gracias a nuestro equipo de casi 300 talentosos #DaCoders, incluyendo desarrolladores, arquitectos, diseñadores UX/UI, PMs, QA testers y más. Nuestro equipo colabora en proyectos con clientes en LATAM y Estados Unidos, logrando resultados sobresalientes.
En DaCodes, tendrás la oportunidad de impulsar tu desarrollo profesional, trabajar en diversos proyectos dentro de distintas industrias, y contribuir al diseño, implementación y optimización de infraestructuras en la nube.
Nuestros DaCoders tienen un gran impacto en el éxito de nuestro negocio y el de nuestros clientes. Serás el experto que participará en nuestros proyectos y tendrás acceso a startups disruptivas y marcas globales.
¿Te interesa?

Estamos buscando un Especialista de Integración Tecnológica con experiencia profesional en programación Java, sólidos fundamentos técnicos y capacidad para investigar, diagnosticar y resolver problemas relacionados con la comunicación e integración entre sistemas.

Formarás parte de un proyecto de modernización tecnológica dentro del sector financiero, participando en la evolución de servicios web existentes hacia APIs y nuevos mecanismos de integración para plataformas de pagos electrónicos.

Tendrás contacto directo con equipos de ingeniería de empresas nacionales e internacionales, desde grandes organizaciones con infraestructuras tecnológicas complejas hasta empresas con equipos técnicos más pequeños que requieren mayor acompañamiento durante sus procesos de integración.

Tu responsabilidad será comprender las necesidades técnicas de estos clientes, asesorarlos en la configuración y consumo de servicios, identificar el origen de incidentes y facilitar su resolución en colaboración con equipos especializados.

Esta posición no está enfocada en el desarrollo de software full-time ni requiere un nivel Senior de programación Java. Sin embargo, es indispensable contar con experiencia laboral real programando, así como con la madurez profesional, iniciativa y criterio técnico necesarios para investigar problemas, formular hipótesis, proponer soluciones y dar seguimiento a los incidentes.

Buscamos a una persona que vaya más allá de ejecutar instrucciones o escalar tickets, que disfrute entender cómo funcionan los sistemas y tenga interés en ampliar sus conocimientos en integraciones empresariales, seguridad, infraestructura y tecnología financiera.

Ubicación: México.

Modalidad: 100% remota.

Seniority: Intermedio, con experiencia profesional en Java.

Idioma: Inglés intermedio conversacional requerido para comunicación y soporte a clientes.

Requerimientos
Principales responsabilidades

  • Brindar soporte y asesoría técnica a equipos de ingeniería de clientes nacionales e internacionales durante la configuración, implementación y operación de integraciones tecnológicas.
  • Participar en la modernización de servicios web hacia APIs, acompañando a los clientes durante la transición y adopción de los nuevos mecanismos de integración.
  • Investigar incidentes técnicos mediante el análisis de logs, trazas, código Java, peticiones y mensajes de error.
  • Identificar si el origen de una falla corresponde a la aplicación, configuración del cliente, conectividad, cifrado o infraestructura.
  • Orientar a los equipos técnicos de los clientes en el consumo de servicios, configuración de conexiones y resolución de problemas de integración.
  • Aplicar conocimientos de programación Java para comprender el comportamiento de los servicios, identificar defectos y facilitar su resolución.
  • Realizar pruebas técnicas que permitan validar hipótesis, reproducir errores y comprobar el funcionamiento de las integraciones.
  • Coordinar la atención de problemas con equipos internos de desarrollo, arquitectura, infraestructura, seguridad y cumplimiento regulatorio.
  • Organizar sesiones técnicas con las áreas involucradas cuando la resolución de un incidente requiera conocimientos especializados.
  • Dar seguimiento a los problemas asignados hasta su resolución, manteniendo una comunicación clara y oportuna con los clientes.
  • Documentar hallazgos, causas de incidentes, soluciones y procedimientos técnicos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de mejora y automatización de procesos.


¿Qué tipo de retos técnicos encontrarás?
Durante tu participación en el proyecto, podrás enfrentarte a situaciones como:

  • Problemas de comunicación entre aplicaciones: investigar por qué un cliente no logra establecer comunicación con un servicio, diferenciando problemas de conectividad, configuración y errores de aplicación.
  • Errores en peticiones HTTP/HTTPS: identificar las diferencias entre un timeout, un error 404 u otros códigos de respuesta, determinando las posibles causas y acciones necesarias.
  • Problemas de cifrado y descifrado: analizar situaciones en las que los sistemas no logran procesar correctamente información cifrada, aplicando fundamentos de criptografía simétrica y asimétrica.
  • Análisis de logs y código Java: investigar el comportamiento de los servicios para determinar dónde se origina una falla y orientar su resolución.
  • Configuraciones de integración: asesorar a clientes cuyos equipos técnicos presentan dificultades para consumir APIs, configurar servicios web o establecer conexiones.
  • Incidentes de infraestructura y conectividad: identificar cuándo un problema está relacionado con VPN, redes, arquitectura o servicios en la nube y coordinar su atención con las áreas correspondientes.
  • Integraciones financieras: acompañar a clientes que requieren orientación técnica relacionada con sistemas de pagos y canalizar consultas regulatorias hacia los equipos especializados.


No tendrás que resolver todos los problemas por tu cuenta, pero sí deberás contar con el criterio técnico necesario para investigarlos, identificar su posible origen y movilizar a las áreas correspondientes hasta encontrar una solución.

Requirements

Experiencia y conocimientos indispensables

  • Experiencia laboral real en programación Java, preferentemente de 2 a 3 años o experiencia equivalente que demuestre los conocimientos requeridos.
  • Haber participado directamente en el desarrollo, mantenimiento o corrección de componentes de software utilizando Java.
  • Capacidad para leer, interpretar y analizar código Java.
  • Experiencia investigando errores, resolviendo defectos de software o diagnosticando problemas técnicos.
  • Fundamentos del funcionamiento y consumo de APIs y WebServices.
  • Comprensión del funcionamiento de peticiones HTTP y HTTPS.
  • Conocimiento de códigos de respuesta HTTP y capacidad para diferenciar errores de aplicación, problemas de conexión y timeouts.
  • Fundamentos de cifrado simétrico y asimétrico, incluyendo la comprensión de los procesos de cifrado y descifrado.
  • Capacidad para interpretar logs, trazas y mensajes de error.
  • Habilidad para realizar troubleshooting de manera estructurada, formular hipótesis y validar posibles causas de un problema.
  • Inglés intermedio conversacional, con capacidad para participar en llamadas y comunicarse con equipos técnicos de clientes internacionales.


Conocimientos y experiencia deseables

  • Experiencia en soporte de aplicaciones, soporte técnico especializado o soporte de segundo nivel (L2).
  • Experiencia en integraciones Host-to-Host (H2H).
  • Conocimientos de APIs REST y WebServices SOAP.
  • Manejo de herramientas para pruebas y diagnóstico de APIs, como Postman o similares.
  • Conocimientos de SFTP y mecanismos de intercambio de información entre sistemas.
  • Fundamentos de bases de datos y SQL.
  • Conocimientos básicos de redes, VPN y conectividad.
  • Nociones de arquitectura de software e infraestructura en la nube.
  • Experiencia con herramientas de gestión de tickets e incidentes.
  • Experiencia brindando asesoría técnica a clientes empresariales.
  • Conocimiento del sector financiero, plataformas de pagos electrónicos o SPEI.
  • Conocimientos de automatización de procesos.
  • Interés o experiencia en desarrollo de agentes de inteligencia artificial.


No es indispensable contar con experiencia previa en integraciones H2H, sistemas de pagos o desarrollo de agentes de IA. Valoramos especialmente tu experiencia práctica en Java, tus fundamentos técnicos y tu capacidad para aprender y resolver problemas.

Habilidades y competencias

  • Pensamiento analítico y razonamiento técnico.
  • Autonomía para investigar problemas sin depender exclusivamente de procedimientos preestablecidos.
  • Capacidad para formular hipótesis, realizar pruebas e interpretar resultados.
  • Proactividad e iniciativa para buscar soluciones.
  • Madurez profesional y sentido de responsabilidad sobre los incidentes asignados.
  • Comunicación efectiva con clientes y equipos de ingeniería.
  • Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos de manera clara y estructurada.
  • Liderazgo transversal y capacidad para coordinar actividades con diferentes áreas, sin necesidad de tener personal a cargo.
  • Criterio para reconocer cuándo un problema requiere la intervención de un especialista.
  • Orientación al servicio y empatía con el cliente.
  • Curiosidad tecnológica y disposición para adquirir nuevos conocimientos.


¿Qué podrás aprender y desarrollar en esta posición?

  • Integraciones tecnológicas empresariales y mecanismos de comunicación Host-to-Host (H2H).
  • Modernización de servicios web hacia arquitecturas de integración basadas en APIs.
  • Diagnóstico de incidentes en plataformas financieras y sistemas de pagos electrónicos.

Who We Are


We are the first publicly-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. Our public benefit purpose is to provide a brighter future for patients through the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs.

United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF).

The cure for end-stage life-threatening diseases like PAH, PH-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option.

Who You Are


You are a passionate problem solver with an aptitude for internal and external auditing. jobs.excerpt: Job Description Summary The Supplier Fulfilment Leader manages delivery, demand translation, and production planning for an assigned part family, balancing efficient inventory management for work-in-process (WIP) against supplier capacity constraints.
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Supplier Fulfilment Leader manages delivery, demand translation, and production planning for an assigned part family, balancing efficient inventory management for work-in-process (WIP) against supplier capacity constraints. Working in close collaboration with the internal make shops and Site Materials teams, the role facilitates supplier problem solving for the assigned parts and owns execution of complex, multi-year, multi-site source changes that support improved connected flow within the part family.
Delivery-first role for a seasoned professional with a manufacturing production planning background who understands how master schedules, MRP, and shop-floor sequencing translate into supplier demand, and what a late or short shipment costs the line. The role leads through influence, partnering with Sourcing, Production Planning, Quality, Engineering, and Finance.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and improve sourcing strategy. Manage sourcing strategies at the part family and supplier level, including execution of connected flow in line with a decentralized organization structure.
  • Translate demand into level supplier schedules. Absorb the total demand profile from all end items requiring the supplier's processes and convert it into a level production schedule within suppliers.
  • Own supplier delivery performance. Drive on-time, delivery (OTD) for assigned suppliers and parts; set targets, track results, and hold suppliers accountable to commitments.
  • Manage external WIP and commitments. Manage supplier WIP, commits, and recommits; integrate loop design, input plan, delivery, return store levels, supplier WIP, and supplier performance.
  • Lead shortage recovery. Run shortage reviews, expedite and escalate critical items, and execute structured recovery plans that protect line-down and customer-delivery risk.
  • Analyze capability and capacity. Assess supplier capability and total capacity for the defined production areas; identify at-risk suppliers and parts early and develop contingencies such as alternate sources, buffer stock, and re-sequencing.
  • Align with S&OP and Site Materials. In partnership with Site Materials Leaders, collaborate with external S&OP, forecasting, and product line teams to surface and resolve constraints; help define and apply elements of the production system and set the pace for upstream supply chain.
  • Lead supplier communication. Lead communication and response to all assigned suppliers; use on-site presence at the Houston-area supplier to drive problem solving alongside supplier production, planning, and quality teams.
  • Report and improve. Manage team metrics and reporting to support team and part family bowler metrics; apply Lean and continuous-improvement tools to eliminate recurring root causes of late delivery.
  • Influence and develop others. Serve as a best-practice resource and mentor to less experienced colleagues; lead projects with large-scale business impact and build consensus on sensitive or complex topics.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university. Minimum of 5 years of sourcing and sourcing management experience, with demonstrated production planning, master scheduling, or materials planning background in a manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability, long-lead-time manufacturing; experience with forgings, castings, or rotating parts supply bases.
  • APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
  • Lean training or certification.
  • Experience with supplier development, ramp-up, and multi-site source transitions.
  • Proven track record of improving supplier delivery performance and resolving material shortages in a complex, high-mix or regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems and planning concepts: lead time, safety stock, BOM structure, planning parameters, and constraint-based scheduling.
  • Strong data analysis skills (Excel, BI tools) to support recommendations and decisions.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and escalation skills; able to influence suppliers and senior stakeholders and to explain difficult or sensitive information.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to make decisions under pressure with moderate autonomy within broad guidelines and policies.

Desired Characteristics

  • Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn.
  • Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively.
  • Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed.
  • Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative.
  • Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker.

Core Competencies

  • Delivery mindset: Relentless focus on commitments, with a bias for action and clear ownership.
  • Manufacturing acumen: Understands how supply shortfalls affect shop-floor flow, cost, and customer commitments.
  • Influence and collaboration: Builds trust and aligns suppliers and internal partners around shared outcomes.
  • Problem solving: Gets to root cause quickly and implements durable corrective actions.
  • Integrity and compliance: Upholds company values, ethics, and regulatory requirements.

Success Measures

  • Supplier OTD and schedule adherence for assigned scope.
  • Reduction in past-due value, critical shortages, and line-down events.
  • Accuracy and stability of supplier promise dates versus plan.
  • Speed and quality of recovery plans and escalation closure.
  • Improvement in supplier scorecard ratings and recurring root causes eliminated.

jobs.description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Healthcare Staffing

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a bilingual Sales Development Representative (SDR) to drive new business for a healthcare staffing services provider. In this role, you’ll connect with dental and medical clinic owners, office managers, and hiring decision-makers across the United States to introduce staffing solutions and build long-term employer relationships.

You’ll manage outbound prospecting, present trained graduates for administrative and patient-facing roles, negotiate placement fees, and coordinate job orders with the internal team. This position is ideal for a confident, organized sales professional who understands healthcare office operations and can turn cold outreach into lasting business opportunities.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Make high-volume cold calls to dental and medical clinics across the United States.
  • Introduce staffing services, identify hiring needs, and qualify prospective employer accounts.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects to generate new business opportunities.

Candidate Pitching & Solution Selling

  • Present trained graduates for front desk, patient coordinator, treatment coordinator, and administrative positions.
  • Match candidate profiles to employer requirements and communicate their value clearly in English and Spanish.
  • Address objections and guide prospective clients toward a hiring agreement.

Job Order Management

  • Gather detailed job orders and clarify role requirements, timelines, and compensation expectations.
  • Coordinate with the internal team to ensure suitable candidates are presented promptly.
  • Manage multiple open job orders while maintaining consistent prospecting activity.

Negotiation & Account Development

  • Negotiate placement fees and service agreements with employers.
  • Build and maintain relationships with clinic owners, office managers, and hiring decision-makers.
  • Follow up after placements, monitor client satisfaction, and identify repeat business and referral opportunities.

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Record outreach activity, client conversations, open job orders, and deal progress in the CRM.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline and ensure timely follow-ups.
  • Track sales activity and communicate pipeline progress, challenges, and opportunities proactively.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in outbound sales, business development, or B2B sales, ideally in staffing, recruiting, healthcare staffing, or professional services.
  • Professional fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken.
  • Comfort with high-volume cold calling, objection handling, and phone-based selling.
  • Strongly preferred: hands-on experience in a dental or medical office as a Front Desk Representative, Patient Coordinator, or Treatment Coordinator.
  • Understanding of healthcare office workflows, including patient scheduling, insurance verification, patient intake, and treatment coordination.
  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Experience managing job orders, client requirements, or multiple sales opportunities simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms for lead tracking, outreach documentation, and pipeline management.
  • Excellent organization, time management, follow-through, and independent working skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling staffing or recruiting services to healthcare practices.
  • Familiarity with dental and medical practice staffing challenges.
  • Experience negotiating placement fees, service agreements, or B2B contracts.
  • Established knowledge of front desk and patient-facing administrative roles in healthcare settings.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand dental or medical office operations and can speak confidently with practice owners about their staffing needs.
  • You’re comfortable making cold calls, handling rejection, and consistently building your pipeline.
  • You take ownership of your sales targets, follow-ups, and client commitments.
  • You can switch naturally between relationship-building and direct sales conversations.
  • You communicate proactively and keep clients and internal teams informed.
  • You’re motivated by closing new business and developing long-term commercial relationships.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent outbound prospecting and a growing pipeline of qualified clinic prospects.
  • New employer accounts secured through effective outreach and negotiation.
  • Complete, accurate job orders that support timely candidate submissions.
  • Strong client relationships, repeat business, and referral opportunities.
  • Organized CRM records and reliable follow-up across all active opportunities.

Typical Day

Your day begins by reviewing your call list and prioritizing new prospects and follow-ups during U.S. Central business hours. You’ll spend much of your time calling dental and medical clinics, introducing staffing services, pitching trained graduates, handling objections, and moving interested employers toward agreements.

When a clinic is ready to hire, you’ll gather the job requirements and coordinate with the internal team to support candidate submissions. You’ll also follow up with existing accounts, explore additional hiring needs, and keep your CRM updated.

The role is primarily focused on outbound calling, business development, relationship management, and closing new

employer accounts.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. AI Rating & Recruiter Screening
  3. Technical/Client Interview
  4. Final Selection & Onboarding
