jobs.description:
Job Role: Head of Delivery ( Employability Health Related)

Contract: Permanent

Location : Remote - Home Worker

Salary: £60,000 - £65,000 (depending on experience)

About the role:

The Head of Delivery provides strategic and operational leadership across a portfolio of health and employment services, currently including the Access to Work Mental Health Support Service and Employment Advice in NHS Talking Therapies.

The postholder has end-to-end accountability for ensuring that services achieve their contractual, operational, quality and financial objectives while delivering safe, effective and person-centred support. They will translate contractual and commissioner requirements into clear delivery plans, maintain effective governance and assurance arrangements, and lead improvement or recovery activity where required.

Working through a senior operational leadership team, the Head of Delivery will create a high-performing and inclusive culture, ensuring colleagues and delivery partners have the capacity, competence and support required to deliver consistently high-quality services.

The role will maintain established, trusted relationships with DWP, NHS commissioners, Integrated Care Boards, NHS Talking Therapies providers, supply-chain partners and other strategic stakeholders. It will also contribute to service development, innovation, business growth and the mobilisation or transition of services across the Employability and Health division.

What you will be doing:

Contract Delivery, Performance and Operations

  • Provide end-to-end leadership and accountability for the successful delivery of the portfolio of health and employment services, currently including Access to Work Mental Health Support Service and Employment Support in NHS Talking Therapies.
  • Ensure services achieve contractual performance requirements, service levels, customer outcomes and commissioner expectations.
  • Translate contractual requirements and organisational priorities into clear operational plans, objectives and accountabilities for operational leaders and delivery teams.
  • Maintain oversight of demand, referrals, caseloads, customer journeys, workforce capacity, productivity and outcomes, ensuring operational resources remain aligned to service requirements.
  • Use performance data, management information and accurate forecasting to identify emerging trends, risks and opportunities, providing clear assurance to the Operations Director, commissioners and internal governance forums.
  • Lead recovery and improvement activity where contractual, operational or service performance is below expectation.
  • Ensure appropriate operational controls, reporting arrangements and governance are in place across the portfolio.
  • Lead significant operational change where required, including mobilisation, transition, service redesign and contract closure.

Financial and Commercial Management:

  • Hold accountability for the financial and commercial performance of the portfolio, including budgets, forecasts and workforce plans within the agreed levels of delegated authority.
  • Work closely with Finance and operational leaders to monitor income, expenditure, productivity and financial performance, ensuring risks, opportunities and variances are identified and addressed promptly.
  • Ensure resources are deployed effectively to balance contractual performance, service quality, customer outcomes and financial sustainability.
  • Lead annual budgeting, reforecasting and financial planning, ensuring decisions are informed by robust operational and financial evidence.
  • Ensure services deliver value for money and remain commercially sustainable, taking appropriate corrective action where financial performance is outside agreed expectations.
  • Contribute operational and commercial expertise to contract negotiations, variations and extensions, and to relevant bids and growth opportunities.

Strategic Leadership, People and Culture:

  • Provide clear strategic and operational leadership across the portfolio, setting expectations and creating a high-performing, inclusive and collaborative culture aligned with Ingeus values.
  • Lead through Operations Managers, Service Managers and other senior or specialist leads, establishing clear accountability, effective delegation and appropriate oversight.
  • Maintain a high-performing, inclusive and collaborative culture in which colleagues are empowered to deliver excellent services while being held appropriately accountable for results.
  • Coach and develop operational leaders, strengthening leadership capability and building a strong pipeline of talent and succession.
  • Maintain strategic oversight of workforce planning, recruitment, retention and capability, ensuring services have the skills and capacity required to meet current and future needs.
  • Ensure effective induction, learning, competence assurance and continuing professional development arrangements are embedded across services.
  • Promote strong employee engagement and communication across geographically dispersed and hybrid teams.
  • Contribute to wider divisional and organisational leadership, strategy and planning.

Quality, Risk, Assurance and Compliance:

  • Hold senior operational accountability for ensuring services are delivered safely and consistently in accordance with contractual, organisational, professional and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain effective quality and assurance arrangements across direct and partner delivery, ensuring appropriate audit, quality review and improvement activity is undertaken.
  • Maintain readiness for commissioner and external assurance activity, providing clear and evidence-based assurance on service quality, compliance and improvement.
  • Maintain effective risk, safeguarding and information governance arrangements, ensuring significant issues have appropriate ownership, mitigation, escalation and oversight.
  • Ensure services operate within their defined scope and professional boundaries, working with relevant clinical, quality, compliance and safeguarding leads to maintain appropriate standards and controls.
  • Ensure complaints, incidents, non-compliance, audit findings and customer feedback are appropriately addressed and that learning is embedded into continuous service improvement.

Commissioner and Stakeholder Leadership:

  • Act as the senior operational relationship lead for commissioners and key strategic stakeholders, building trusted and effective relationships across the portfolio.
  • Represent Ingeus at contract reviews, performance and assurance boards, and relevant strategic partnership forums.
  • Provide clear, evidence-based assurance to commissioners on service performance, quality, finance, risk and improvement activity.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of commissioner priorities and emerging requirements, ensuring these inform service delivery and development.
  • Lead complex or sensitive contractual and stakeholder matters, influencing effectively across organisational boundaries to achieve appropriate resolution.
  • Develop strategic partnerships that strengthen service integration, referral pathways and customer outcomes.

Supply Chain and Partner Management:

  • Maintain senior accountability for the performance, quality, compliance, capacity and value for money of end-to-end supply-chain and delivery partners across the portfolio.
  • Ensure partners are managed in accordance with contractual requirements, Ingeus’ Supply Chain Management Framework and relevant standards, supported by effective governance and assurance arrangements.
  • Monitor partner performance and risk using robust operational, financial and quality information, ensuring underperformance or capacity concerns are identified and addressed promptly.
  • Build constructive senior relationships with partner organisations, maintaining clear accountability while supporting capability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Provide strategic oversight of supply-chain arrangements, informing decisions on partner capacity, future delivery models and supply-chain development.

.Service Development, Innovation and Growth:

  • Lead continuous improvement and innovation across the portfolio, using insight and feedback to improve service delivery and customer outcomes.
  • Identify emerging commissioner, customer and market needs and translate these into opportunities for service development and growth.
  • Contribute operational expertise to bids, contract extensions and new-business opportunities, ensuring proposed delivery models are credible and deliverable.
  • Lead the operational development and implementation of new services and significant service changes.

Essential experience required:

  • Significant senior operational leadership experience within employment, health, skills, welfare-to-work, public services or a comparable contracted-services environment.
  • Experience of leading multiple contracts, services, locations or delivery models through other managers.
  • Accountability for contractual performance, quality, financial management and service improvement.
  • Experience of managing complex commissioner and stakeholder relationships.
  • Strong financial capability, including budgeting, forecasting, resource planning and management of variances.
  • Experience of leading geographically dispersed or hybrid teams.
  • Experience of successful organisational or service change, mobilisation, transition or recovery.
  • Strong analytical capability and the ability to convert performance data into clear decisions and actions.
  • Experience of governance, audit, risk management and contractual compliance.
  • Experience of leading and developing senior operational managers.
  • Evidence of building inclusive, accountable and high-performing teams.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation and influencing skills.
  • Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • To be able to work constructively and collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Proficient in IT, particularly MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI and Outlook.

Desirable:

  • Experience of DWP-commissioned services, NHS-commissioned services or both.
  • Knowledge of Access to Work, workplace mental-health support or NHS Talking Therapies.
  • Experience of managing subcontractors, supply-chain partners or other third-party delivery arrangements.
  • Understanding of employment support delivered within clinical or healthcare environments.
  • Experience of external assurance, commissioner audits or Provider Assurance activity.
  • Experience contributing to bids, contract extensions, variations or service growth.
  • Relevant management, contract-management, programme-management or professional qualification.
  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent senior professional experience.

What we are looking for:

  • Significant senior operational leadership experience within employment, health, skills, welfare-to-work, public services or a comparable contracted-services environment.
  • Experience of leading multiple contracts, services, locations or delivery models through other managers.
  • Accountability for contractual performance, quality, financial management and service improvement.
  • Experience of managing complex commissioner and stakeholder relationships.
  • Strong financial capability, including budgeting, forecasting, resource planning and management of variances.
  • Experience of leading geographically dispersed or hybrid teams.
  • Experience of successful organisational or service change, mobilisation, transition or recovery.
  • Strong analytical capability and the ability to convert performance data into clear decisions and actions.
  • Experience of governance, audit, risk management and contractual compliance.
  • Experience of leading and developing senior operational managers.
  • Evidence of building inclusive, accountable and high-performing teams.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation and influencing skills.
  • Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • To be able to work constructively and collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Proficient in IT, particularly MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI and Outlook.
  • The role requires flexibility to travel across the UK to support service delivery and attend commissioner, partner and internal meetings, with occasional overnight stays where required.
  • The postholder may be required to support the mobilisation, transition or implementation of new services as the portfolio develops.

At Ingeus, we’ve spent time listening to our employees to build our benefits package;

  • 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to trade for additional leave.
  • EAP Support programme available 24/7, including 6 free counselling sessions.
  • Private medical insurance and life assurance.
  • Up to 2 days of Community Giving (volunteering) each year to support a cause that matters to you.
  • Eyecare vouchers to help with glasses or eye care.
  • Online Shopping discounts
  • Cycle to Work scheme and travel season ticket loan.
  • Long service awards to celebrate your commitment.
  • Salary Finance offering financial education and advice.
  • The opportunity to purchase extra benefits like critical illness cover and dental insurance.

Please note that this role may be closed early if we receive a high volume of applications.

Ingeus is a leading human services provider, helping people, businesses and communities thrive through employment, health and wellbeing, skills and other public services.

We are a trusted partner to government, the NHS and other organisations, delivering services that create positive social impact and help people overcome barriers, improve their wellbeing and progress towards meaningful and sustainable employment.

jobs.description:
Role: Sales Development Representative

Reports to: India BU Lead

Location: Remote/Hybrid working (India-based).

We are currently a remote-first organisation, but hybrid working may be an option in the future.

Salary: up to INR 18,00,000 depending on experience, plus equity and benefits

Hours: Full-Time 9am-6pm IST

A note about recruitment at Vestd

We recognise how challenging the job market can be for candidates, and at Vestd we strive to provide a positive candidate experience. If you are interested in this opportunity, we kindly request that your application and all communication go through official application channels. Apply via our website careers page, other job site or LinkedIn, as opposed to sending the team individual emails or LinkedIn direct messages. We want each candidate to be considered fairly, and for everyone who applies to receives a consistent experience.

Contacting Vestd employees via email, personal social media, or other informal routes is not appropriate. We also have a zero-tolerance approach to any form of harassment or abuse directed at our team. Candidates who do not respect these boundaries may be disqualified from the recruitment process and, in serious cases, barred from applying in future.

About Vestd

Vestd is a leading sharetech platform for equity management - shares schemes, fund raising, company secretarial and much more.

Our regulated platform makes light work of all of the most popular and tax-efficient share scheme types, empowering businesses to attract and retain their talent. Our powerful software also helps investors, and founders seeking investment.

Vestd was founded by Ifty Nasir, who lives and breathes our mission. Vestd’s big moonshot aim is to see one billion people worldwide invested in the companies they work hard to grow by 2030. We are all about inclusion and fairness for our customers and our team.

Vestd is also a B Corp-certified company, which means we’re committed to balancing profit with purpose. We care about our people, our customers, and the wider world – and we hold ourselves to the highest social and environmental standards.

If you’d like to learn more about Vestd, check out this short video from our founder, Ifty.

Requirements

The role

We are looking for individuals who are not only passionate about our mission but also comfortable and confident using cutting-edge technologies and AI tools, to streamline processes, drive innovation, and contribute to the growth of Vestd.

Responsible for driving outbound lead generation through proactive prospecting and cold calling potential customers. The role involves identifying and reaching out to prospective businesses, initiating conversations, qualifying leads, generating interest in Vestd's solutions, and converting these interactions into qualified meetings and product demos for the sales team. The individual will own the top of the sales funnel, with clear targets around outbound activity, qualified meetings booked, and leads generated.

What success looks like in year one

Success in this role will be measured by consistent outbound activity, the ability to generate a healthy pipeline of qualified leads, and converting cold outreach into meaningful business conversations. The individual should consistently meet monthly targets for calls, prospect engagement, qualified meetings and demos booked, ultimately contributing to new customer acquisition and revenue growth for the business.

What you’ll own

  • Outbound Prospecting: Proactively identify and reach out to potential customers through cold calling, email and other outbound channels to generate interest.
  • Lead Generation & Qualification: Build a strong pipeline of qualified leads by understanding prospect requirements, assessing fit and creating opportunities for the sales team.
  • Meeting & Demo Conversion: Own the responsibility of converting outbound conversations into qualified meetings, consistently achieving weekly and monthly targets.

What we’re looking for

Essential elements of this role

We cannot provide an exhaustive list of duties; additional duties may arise, but these will be core elements of this role.

  • 5-6 years of SDR or Sales experience (of which 3+ years in B2B business).
  • Experience using Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot or similar prospecting tools.
  • Impeccable attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • You must be comfortable with working in a remote-first environment.

Nice to have

These will help you stand out from the pack:

  • Experience selling B2B SaaS, HRTech, FinTech or compliance-related products.
  • Understanding of startup ecosystems, ESOPs, equity management or fundraising.
  • Experience working with a defined ICP and running structured outbound campaigns.
  • Experience working in a remote team.

Culture fit

What makes Vestd folk collaborative, adaptable, and eager to grow?

  • Thrives in a startup environment, ready to tackle diverse challenges with enthusiasm
  • Adaptable - open to taking on responsibilities beyond the defined role as needed
  • Passionate about contributing to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Embraces technology to improve processes and drive efficiency

While the above describes the core responsibilities, this role may from time to time involve tasks beyond this list — as needed to respond to evolving business needs.

Benefits

What you can expect

Our culture is our backbone (BreatheHR named us one of the ‘Top 3 Companies in the UK for Company Culture’), and we take team happiness seriously.

Vestd strives to be as principled as possible. We’re all about Goal 8 of the United Nations ‘Sustainable Development Goals. This goal is about ‘Decent work and economic growth,’ and we consider it both with our external activities and internal workings.

We’ll do everything we can to help you grow in your role. In return, you’ll want to learn all about our industry and do all you can to help us continue leading it.

Vestd is remote-first, so in return for your commitment, diligence, and productivity, you’ll have a lot of autonomy during your working day. Some roles demand office hours (to fit our customers’ schedules), but we are committed to offering flexibility where possible.

Happy employees make for happy customers, as demonstrated in our five-star reviews. Vestd’s excellence has also been recognised by The Europas, The Fintech Awards London, The Hustle Awards, TechRound, and BusinessCloud’s Fintech50. See more about our awards here.

This could be the perfect opportunity if you’re an autonomous, self-driven individual passionate about contributing to a meaningful mission and value being part of a supportive, close-knit team.

Why work at Vestd?

Vestd is a great place to work. There are a range of benefits that you can look forward to as one of our folk (benefits vary depending on location):

  • This job is remote-first, although attendance is required twice yearly at our in-person get-togethers
  • A flexible environment to help you achieve the best work/life balance
  • An Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), of course! (After the qualifying period)
  • Monthly recognition scheme, where we celebrate our folk
  • Support with home working equipment*
  • A personal training and development budget to keep your career and professional growth on track
  • Private medical insurance (after the qualifying period)
  • Team retreats are held twice a year. They can include an overnight stay and focus on fun and team cohesion
  • Great team ethos, connect through regular team and company socials
  • 25 days annual leave plus one extra day per year of service (up to five days)

We’re looking for somebody with initiative who can focus on the business and their personal growth path. This is a great time to join our team, and it would be a superb role for the right person.

*At Vestd we provide our folk with the hardware and software required to support them in their role. As a remote-first business, we expect anyone applying for a job to have a suitable, quiet working space. You must have an appropriate desk/table and chair, with a reliable internet connection.

Equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI) at Vestd

At Vestd, we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and diverse team. Trust is one of our core values; with that comes a commitment to fairness and transparency. We want to be open about our EDI efforts.

We wish to recruit people who are passionate about working in a diverse environment and who will support us to ensure that all colleagues are supported and included while working with us.

Research shows that while men are likely to apply when they meet 60% of a job’s requirements, women and individuals from underrepresented groups often apply only when they meet every criterion.

We understand the value of transferable skills and the unique perspectives that diversity brings. That’s why we encourage applications from candidates with unique strengths and experiences.


Our application process

We are accepting rolling applications for this role with no fixed end date - if you are interested in joining the Vestd folk, please apply when you can. We will respond to every applicant, but we may only screen some candidates depending on the number of applications received.

Our recruitment pipeline has a few stages, giving you plenty of opportunities to learn about Vestd as we take the time to find someone who is the best fit for the role. We aim to complete the selection process as efficiently as possible, and we are committed to making our candidate experience as inclusive as we can, so please get in touch with us if you require any information or support during the application process or need to ask for any adjustments.

A typical selection process might be:

  • Apply online
  • 20-minute screening call
  • 45-minute interview with the hiring manager and team member
  • Task-based assignment
  • 45-minute team cultural interview
  • 30-minute interview with the CEO

How we review applications

Some roles include questions about essential requirements, and applications that don’t meet them may be closed automatically. All other applications are reviewed by a member of our People Team, who may use AI to help review CVs against the role requirements. AI never makes a recruitment decision. If you’d like a person to review a closed application, or need a reasonable adjustment, contact us at . You can read more in our Recruitment Principles and Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Please note that we record our interviews. These recordings are only viewed by the hiring team and no later than once a role is filled, all recordings are deleted. We do not share any candidate information with anyone outside of Vestd at any time.

If you need any adjustments or support with your application, please let us know.

We are excited to receive your application.

When a role is filled, we will contact all other applicants to let them know.

This job is remote-first within India. You must be primarily India-based and eligible to work in the country.

Position Summary


We are seeking a highly accomplished Senior Director, Cyber Defense & Network Operations to build, lead, and scale a next-generation cybersecurity practice focused on protecting public sector organizations across the Federal, State, and Local government landscape.


This executive leadership role is responsible for establishing and growing a comprehensive cyber defense portfolio that includes Security Operations Center (SOC) services, network operations and security, threat detection and response, incident response, cyber resilience, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, managed security services, and Zero Trust operations.


The successful candidate will possess a unique combination of cybersecurity operations leadership, large-scale program management, practice-building expertise, and professional services sales acumen. The ideal leader has a demonstrated track record of building and leading high-performing cybersecurity organizations of 100+ professionals while driving business growth, developing strategic client relationships, and delivering innovative solutions for government customers.


This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to client executives, a mentor to cybersecurity leaders, and a key driver of revenue, profitability, and market differentiation.

Practice Leadership & Strategy

    • Cloud Security Operations
    • Security Automation and Orchestration
  • Drive modernization initiatives leveraging AI, advanced analytics, automation, and orchestration platforms.
  • Develop and maintain service offerings aligned to evolving cyber threats and government cybersecurity priorities.

Network Operations & Resilience

  • Build integrated cyber defense and network operations capabilities supporting hybrid, cloud, and on-premises environments.
  • Lead organizations responsible for:
    • Network Operations Centers (NOC)
    • Network Security Engineering
    • Enterprise Monitoring
    • Network Detection and Response (NDR)
    • SASE and Secure Networking
    • SD-WAN Security
    • Critical Infrastructure and Operational Technology Security
  • Ensure operational resilience, service reliability, and continuous improvement across all delivery environments.

Business Development & Revenue Growth

  • Own growth objectives for the Cyber Defense & Network Operations practice, including pipeline development, bookings, revenue expansion, and strategic account growth.
  • Partner with sales, capture, and account leadership teams to identify, develop, and close new business opportunities.
  • Lead solution development and support proposal responses, pricing strategies, oral presentations, and customer briefings.
  • Establish and maintain executive relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, procurement leaders, and agency executives across Federal, State, and Local government organizations.
  • Collaborate with alliance partners including Microsoft, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Splunk, ServiceNow, and other strategic technology providers.
  • Represent the organization at industry conferences, cybersecurity forums, and executive-level events.
  • Meet or exceed annual revenue, bookings, and pipeline growth targets.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and oversee large, geographically dispersed cybersecurity organizations delivering mission-critical services.
  • Manage cybersecurity programs and operational organizations consisting of 100+ cybersecurity professionals across engineering, architecture, operations, threat intelligence, incident response, consulting, and client delivery functions.
  • Develop workforce strategies, succession plans, leadership pipelines, and employee development programs.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, operational excellence, and customer success.
  • Ensure effective talent acquisition, retention, mentoring, and career progression across the cybersecurity organization.

Executive Advisory

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders on cyber risk, operational resilience, and cybersecurity strategy.
  • Advise clients on:
    • Zero Trust implementation
    • Security Operations modernization
    • Cyber resilience strategies
    • Threat-informed defense
    • Risk management
    • Regulatory compliance
    • Security governance

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience leading cyber defense, security operations, network operations, incident response, or managed security organizations.
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading cybersecurity practices, business units, or service portfolios.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cybersecurity programs, operations, or organizations consisting of 100 or more employees.
  • Proven success leading large, multi-disciplinary cybersecurity teams with responsibility for service delivery, personnel management, customer satisfaction, and operational performance.
  • Significant experience supporting Federal, State, and Local government customers.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • NIST Cybersecurity Framework
    • NIST 800-53
    • NIST 800-171
    • FISMA
    • FedRAMP
    • CISA guidance
    • Zero Trust Architecture
    • Cybersecurity maturity frameworks
  • Demonstrated success in professional services sales, managed services growth, or cybersecurity consulting services.
  • Proven experience contributing to or leading business development, capture activities, proposal development, and contract pursuits.
  • Track record of driving revenue growth and expanding strategic client relationships.
  • Experience managing multimillion-dollar programs, portfolios, and operating budgets.
  • Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 15+ years of progressive cybersecurity leadership experience.
  • 10+ years leading cyber defense, security operations, network operations, incident response, or managed security organizations.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance, or ability to obtain one.
  • Experience managing a cybersecurity portfolio exceeding $25M+ annually.
  • Prior P&L ownership for a cybersecurity business unit, practice, or operating portfolio.
  • Industry certifications such as:
    • CISSP
    • CISM
    • CCSP
    • GIAC Certifications
    • PMP
    • ITIL
  • Experience with Microsoft Security, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, Azure Security, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto, Cisco, Splunk, and cloud-native security platforms.

Depending on your background and specialization, this role may focus on cloud engineering, network infrastructure, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll help configure and monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot complex technical issues, manage access and authentication, support security operations, and contribute to infrastructure deployments and upgrades.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with a practical understanding of networking, cloud environments, systems, and security best practices.

What You’ll Own

Cloud & Infrastructure Management

  • Configure, monitor, and maintain cloud and infrastructure environments
  • Support platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, or related technologies
  • Monitor infrastructure health, availability, and performance
  • Assist with infrastructure deployments, upgrades, and configuration changes
  • Help maintain reliable and scalable technical environments

Network Engineering & Troubleshooting

  • Troubleshoot network, connectivity, DNS, routing, and infrastructure issues
  • Diagnose complex technical problems across systems and environments
  • Monitor network health and performance
  • Help maintain reliable connectivity across business systems

Cybersecurity & Security Operations

  • Implement and maintain security best practices
  • Monitor systems for potential security issues
  • Support security-related troubleshooting and incident response
  • Help identify infrastructure vulnerabilities and operational risks
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to improve the organization’s security posture

Identity & Access Management

  • Manage user access, permissions, and authentication
  • Support appropriate access controls across systems and platforms
  • Troubleshoot authentication and authorization issues
  • Help maintain secure access practices
  • Assist with onboarding, offboarding, and access changes when required

Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Monitor systems for performance, availability, and security issues
  • Investigate alerts and technical incidents
  • Support incident response and troubleshooting
  • Identify root causes and help implement corrective actions
  • Escalate critical infrastructure or security issues appropriately

Infrastructure Automation

  • Identify repetitive infrastructure tasks that can be automated
  • Build or support automation for routine technical processes
  • Improve consistency and efficiency across infrastructure workflows
  • Reduce unnecessary manual administration where possible

Documentation & Technical Operations

  • Maintain clear technical documentation
  • Document infrastructure configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures
  • Keep operational and security documentation current
  • Support repeatable processes for deployments, incidents, and system changes

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with engineering, IT, security, and business teams
  • Support technical projects and infrastructure initiatives
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to relevant stakeholders
  • Help coordinate deployments, upgrades, and operational changes

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in network engineering, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a related infrastructure role
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, and/or enterprise networking technologies
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts and security best practices
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical and connectivity issues
  • Understanding of user access, permissions, and authentication
  • Experience monitoring infrastructure, networks, or systems
  • Strong technical documentation skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Professional working English
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Relevant technical certifications
  • Cloud certifications related to AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Networking or cybersecurity certifications
  • Experience with infrastructure or task automation
  • Experience supporting incident response
  • Experience with identity and access management
  • Familiarity with DevOps and deployment workflows
  • Experience supporting distributed or cloud-based environments

Tools & Technologies

AWS | Microsoft Azure | Google Cloud Platform (GCP) | Enterprise Networking | Identity & Access Management | Infrastructure Monitoring | Security Tools | DevOps & Automation Technologies

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Can troubleshoot complex technical problems methodically
  • Understand how networks, systems, cloud infrastructure, and security interact
  • Think about security as part of everyday infrastructure operations
  • Stay calm and organized when responding to technical incidents
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work
  • Maintain clear documentation rather than relying on tribal knowledge
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Take ownership of problems through resolution

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include reviewing infrastructure and security alerts, troubleshooting a connectivity issue, managing user permissions, supporting a cloud deployment, or investigating a technical incident.

You may also update infrastructure configurations, automate repetitive tasks, document technical processes, and collaborate with engineering or IT teams on deployments and upgrades.

In short: you help keep the organization’s infrastructure secure, reliable, accessible, and running smoothly.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Infrastructure availability and reliability
  • Network and system performance
  • Speed and effectiveness of technical issue resolution
  • Security and access-control compliance
  • Successful infrastructure deployments and upgrades
  • Effective incident response
  • Reduction in repetitive manual infrastructure work

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

Plays a critical role in development and implementation of an efficient network for our members. Reporting to the Manager of Contracting you will be a critical part of the Provider Relations team.

The ideal candidate for this role is passionate, community oriented and has direct health plan managed care contract implementation experience. You have strength in reading and interpreting complex contacts, evaluating competing priorities while staying aligned with organizational goals and strategies. You are technically savvy with a solid understanding of different reimbursement methodologies and charge master increase calculations to aid in the contract implementation process. You are detail oriented, flexible and thrive in a fast-paced, environment.

The Contract Implementation Specialist performs duties to support contracting and has responsibilities in loading and auditing contracts to ensure the Peak Health Network meets or exceeds access, quality, and financial goals across all product lines in the market.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Health Care Management or other related Business field OR five (5) years' experience in healthcare or insurance.

EXPERIENCE:

1. Five (5) years’ experience in healthcare or insurance environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EXPERIENCE:

1. Solid understanding of fee schedule development and implementation; demonstrated understanding of health care reimbursement methods and strategies.

2. Progressive experience in health care management, physician groups, hospitals, payer contract negotiations, legal reviews of contract, or contact management.

3. Experience with provider data management and contract management software.

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Maintenance and coordination of contracting documents and any contracting databases.

2. Supports contracting initiatives in accordance with Peak Health business and budget requirements.

3. Ensure new contract terms (including payment terms) for agreements are successfully communicated within the organization.

5. Prepares, sends, and receives provider documents, including contracts, amendments, addendums, and correspondence to grow and maintain all Peak Health product lines across multiple markets.

6. Summarizes offers for review with appropriate Peak Health committees and individuals.

7. Communicates the implementation of new and renewal contracts to upper management and monitors the reimbursement to ensure accurate payment of claims by Peak Health.

8. Audits large volumes of data and conducts in-depth quantitative analysis of results and evaluates trends.

9. Communicates and educates other regarding financial improvement analysis, findings and recommendations.

10. Maintains contract files for Peak Health.

11. Maintains physician fee and hospital rate information for Peak Health contracted providers.

12. Maintains contract information on major providers with selected competitor and benchmark providers.

13. Organize meeting materials and attends various organization meetings as needed as well as assists in development of annual strategic planning.

14. Negotiate standard Single Case Agreements (SCA) with non-participating providers.

15. Must remain current with how information is collected, maintained and reported in all key systems.

16. Communicates with providers to obtain documents needed to complete the contracting process.

17. Responds to phone and e-mail inquiries from providers regarding contract status.

18. Calculate annual rate revisions based on contractual requirements including charge master increase maximums.

19. Assures compliance with Peak Health policies and procedures.

20. Performs retrospective audits on pricing following initial load and at scheduled intervals.

21. Provides education to claims processing staff on changes to pricing and/or issues discovered during audits.

22. Works as a liaison between contracting and IS Department for contract language, and fee schedules/rates.

23. Special Projects as Assigned

1. Ability to review and think critically.

2. Strong problem solving and quantitative abilities.

3. Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

4. Attention to detail.

5. Knowledge of provider contracting, provider customer service, and standard credentialing procedures.

6. Strong knowledge of contracting language and the ability to understand different types of reimbursement models.

7. Demonstrates high level of integrity, discretion and sound judgement when handling confidential information.

8.Ability to interpret and compose spreadsheets, reports and presentations using the Microsoft Office Suite.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Bot Detection (Client-Side & Signals) - US Remote
jobs.excerpt: At Hugging Face, we're on a journey to democratize good AI.
jobs.description:
At Hugging Face, we're on a journey to democratize good AI. We are building the fastest growing platform for AI builders with over 20 million users who collectively shared over 4 million models, 1 million datasets & 1.5 million apps. Our open-source libraries have more than 700,000 stars on Github.

About the Role

Hugging Face hosts millions of models, datasets and Spaces, and serves a very large community of developers. That scale also brings automated abuse: fake accounts, scraping, spam, credential stuffing, and bots gaming downloads, likes and trending signals. We're building a small, dedicated bot-detection effort inside our Trust & Safety team, and we're looking for an engineer to own the signal-collection side of it.

You'll design and ship the mechanisms that tell humans from automation across every surface where people and machines touch the Hub: web, API, git/LFS, CLI and client libraries. "Front" here is broad. It covers browser instrumentation, but also what we can learn from network, TLS and protocol behavior, and from how clients talk to our infrastructure.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and deploy detection signals in production: browser and device fingerprinting, client-side challenges, TLS/HTTP fingerprinting, behavioral telemetry
  • Analyze how real-world bots and automation frameworks work (headless browsers, anti-detect browsers, residential proxies, CAPTCHA farms) and build countermeasures that hold up when attackers adapt
  • Work with our data-focused bot-detection engineer to turn raw signals into reliable features and decisions
  • Respect user privacy and keep legitimate developers, researchers and API users free of friction
  • Partner with infra, security and Hub engineers to roll out mitigations (rate limiting, step-up challenges, enforcement) safely at scale
  • Contribute openly where it makes sense: tooling, write-ups and research shared with the community

Requirements

  • You have solid hands-on experience in bot detection, anti-fraud, browser fingerprinting, web security or a closely related field, and you've shipped things that ran in production
  • You understand browser internals and the web platform deeply (JavaScript, DOM and rendering APIs, WebGL/Canvas/Audio, extensions), as well as networking protocols (HTTP/2/3, TLS)
  • You know the attacker's toolbox from the inside (Puppeteer/Playwright/Selenium, stealth plugins, automation frameworks) and you like taking it apart
  • You're comfortable across the stack: TypeScript/JavaScript, and at least one backend language (Python, Go, Rust…)
  • You're pragmatic: you prefer a signal that works today and improves tomorrow over a perfect system that never ships
  • You care about privacy and about not punishing legitimate users

Nice to have

  • Published work or talks on fingerprinting, bot detection or web measurement (academic or industry). A research background is welcome as long as you like seeing your work in prod
  • Experience at a bot-management, anti-fraud or CDN/WAF company
  • Open-source contributions

One more thing

At Hugging Face we believe great AI shouldn't require a massive cluster, we build for everyone, especially the GPU-poor. And because we read every application, here's a small sign that you read this one too: start your answer to the first application question with the words “GPU-poor and proud 🤗”. No trick, no catch, it just tells us a real person is on the other side.

Benefits

More about Hugging Face

We are actively working to build a culture that values diversity, equity, and inclusivity. We are intentionally building a workplace where people feel respected and supported—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We believe this is foundational to building a great company and community. Hugging Face is an equal opportunity employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We value development. You will work with some of the smartest people in our industry. We are an organization that has a bias for impact and is always challenging ourselves to continuously grow. We provide all employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education.

We care about your well-being. We offer flexible working hours and remote options. We offer health, dental, and vision benefits for employees and their dependents. We also offer parental leave and flexible paid time off.

We support our employees wherever they are. While we have office spaces in NYC and Paris, we're very distributed and all remote employees have the opportunity to visit our offices. If needed, we'll also outfit your workstation to ensure you succeed.

We want our teammates to be shareholders. All employees have company equity as part of their compensation package. If we succeed in becoming a category-defining platform in machine learning and artificial intelligence, everyone enjoys the upside.

We support the community. We believe major scientific advancements are the result of collaboration across the field. Join a community supporting the ML/AI community.

jobs.description:
We are a leading PE-backed tech and digital transformation business specialising in application engineering and support, cloud, data and AI and security. We differentiate in our ability to solve legacy systems challenges, helping organisations transition to more agile and efficient solutions. Our mission is to empower businesses through innovative technology that drives growth and enhances operational efficiency.

Within TXP, our product lab is building AI tools that help developers build software faster and work more effectively. Our ambition is to create products that developers choose to use every day.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to join as the lab’s first design hire and help shape our first product. Working directly with a Product Manager and engineers, you’ll turn early ideas and technical capabilities into experiences that solve real problems and fit naturally into developers’ workflows.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Partner with Product Management, engineering and lab leadership to identify valuable problems, challenge assumptions and shape focused product releases.
  • Lead discovery and user research to understand developers’ workflows, needs and frustrations.
  • Own end-to-end product design, from early exploration and user flows through to interaction design, visual design, prototyping and implementation.
  • Design intuitive AI experiences that make it easy for developers to guide the system, understand its behaviour, review results and recover from errors.
  • Work closely with engineering to balance usability, technical feasibility and speed of delivery.
  • Ship products and features in small, useful increments, learning from users and continuously improving the experience.
  • Establish practical design foundations, including reusable components and interaction patterns.
  • Use feedback, usage data and hands-on product experience to identify areas of friction and prioritise improvements.
Requirements:
  • Proven experience taking a product or significant feature from an unclear problem through to launch and iteration.
  • Strong product judgement, with the ability to simplify scope while maintaining a coherent and useful user experience.
  • Confidence working independently within a small, fast-moving team and making progress with incomplete information.
  • Experience turning complex workflows into clear and intuitive interfaces.
  • Strong understanding of interaction and visual design, accessibility, user feedback and error recovery.
  • Experience working closely with engineers and navigating technical constraints and implementation trade-offs.
  • A practical approach to user research, prototyping and usability testing.
  • Experience using modern design and prototyping tools.
  • Curiosity around AI and how it can be used to accelerate design exploration and execution.
Benefits:
  • 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)
  • Holiday buy and sell scheme (up to an additional 5 days per annum)
  • An additional day of paid leave for your birthday (or Christmas Eve)
  • 4% matched employer-contributed pension (salary sacrifice)
  • Life assurance (3x)
  • Private medical insurance through our partner Vitality
  • Access to an Employee Assistance Programme and other health benefits through our partner Medicash
  • Octopus EV Scheme (salary sacrifice)
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Corporate eye-care vouchers
  • 2 social value days per year to give back to local communities

Grow with us:
Work on exciting new projects
If you want to avoid getting stuck with the mundane, you’re in the right place. We work in many sectors with fantastic clients, so you’ll always be working on something exciting and challenging.

Career growth – we’ve got you!
We recognise that you might have a career path planned out and you might need some support to help you move forward. We’re here to support you and make the most out of your time with us, through challenging work, opportunities to grow and learning and development opportunities.

Be part of the TXP growth journey
We are a high growth, fast paced environment. We currently have 200+ employees and work with clients across the UK. Joining TXP means you’ll be part of that.

jobs.description:
Verantwortung für KI-Produkte von Strategize bis Grow | Beratung im Kundenmandat | Eigenes Entwicklerteam im Verbund | deutschlandweit

Du hast schon KI-Piloten gebaut, die in der Demo funktioniert haben – und danach im Nirgendwo verschwunden sind.

Bei uns endet die Verantwortung nicht am Konzept. Unser Bereich Digital & AI Services begleitet Kunden über den gesamten Zyklus: Strategize – Design – Build – Grow. Als Product Owner verantwortest du KI-Produkte und -Services über genau diese vier Phasen – von der Use-Case-Identifikation bis zum produktiven Betrieb und der Skalierung.

Das ist eine Beratungsrolle. Du arbeitest im Kundenmandat, in fremden Systemlandschaften, mit Stakeholdern, die du dir nicht ausgesucht hast – und musst dein Produkt trotzdem durch deren Organisation bringen. Wer nur Produkt kann, scheitert am Kunden. Wer nur Beratung kann, scheitert am Go-Live.

Das erwartet dich

Du verantwortest KI-Produkte unserer Kunden – im Zusammenspiel mit unseren Beratungsservices. Konkret:

  • Strategize:Du identifizierst KI-Potenziale entlang der Wertschöpfungskette deiner Kunden und priorisierst sie nach belastbarem Business-Mehrwert – und sagst auch ab, wenn ein Use Case nur gut aussieht. Formate wie unser KI Boostcamp (2 Wochen) sind dein Werkzeug, nicht dein Endprodukt.
  • Design: Du übersetzt den Use Case in eine Produktvision inklusive Geschäftsmodell und triffst mit unseren AI Engineers und Architects die Entscheidungen zu Modell, Zielarchitektur und Datengrundlage – nachvollziehbar entlang Kosten, Latenz, Datenschutz und Wartbarkeit.
  • Build:Du führst die Realisierung: Anforderungen formulieren, Backlog steuern, MVP und Go-Live verantworten – gemeinsam mit den Softwareentwicklern der UNITY Innovation Alliance. Wir geben keine Konzepte ab.
  • Grow:Du verantwortest Betrieb und Skalierung: Evals, Guardrails, KI-Governance und die Frage, wo KI entscheidet und wo Menschen. Und du machst aus Erfolgreichem einen wiederverwendbaren Portfolio-Baustein.
  • Beraten: Du moderierst Workshops, machst Zielbilder entscheidungsreif und vertrittst sie im Lenkungskreis – auch gegen Widerstand. Du erkennst Anschlussthemen und bringst sie mit Daniel in ein Angebot.

Womit du arbeitest: Copilot Studio, Langdock, Azure, AWS, Power Automate, n8n, Agentic Coding mit Claude Code, Jira

Wofür wir stehen:KI-Strategie in der technischen Entwicklung bei Volkswagen, Marktreife des digitalen Service SmartVue bei Kannegiesser, die Smart-City-Datenplattform der Stadt Paderborn, Entwicklung einer KI-Plattform bei HEGGEMANN.

Künstliche Intelligenz @UNITY:Bei UNITY arbeitest du mit KI, die du selbst mitgestalten kannst: die eigenentwickelte UNITY X-Plattform gibt dir Zugriff auf verschiedene Claude-, ChatGPT & Gemini Modelle. Copilot und Claude-Modelle sind direkt in Teams und den Microsoft-Anwendungen verfügbar. In Copilot Studio kannst du außerdem eigene Agenten bauen, wenn du willst. UNITY Coding Communities, Hackathons, AI Labs und das AI Trainings Camp geben dir Raum, eigene Lösungen für intern und für Kunden zu bauen.

Das bringst du mit

Must-have:

  • Du hast mehrere relevante KI- oder Softwareprodukteals Product Owner* bis in den produktiven Betrieb geführt – nicht nur bis zum Piloten. Über mindestens eines davon kannst du eine Stunde lang ins Detail gehen.
  • Mindestens5 Jahre in einer Beratung oder vergleichbaren Rolle mit Mandatsverantwortung – du kennst wechselnde Kundenorganisationen, Angebotslogik und den Unterschied zwischen dem, was der Kunde bestellt, und dem, was er braucht.
  • Erfahrung mit generativer KI über Prompting hinaus:RAG, Agenten-Orchestrierung, Evals und Guardrails – du weißt, warum ein Agent in Produktion anders scheitert als im Test.
  • Du triffst Architektur- und Modellentscheidungen anhand nachvollziehbarer Kriterien und dokumentierst die Trade-offs.
  • Erfahrung mit cloudbasierten Architekturen(Azure, AWS oder vergleichbar) und mit der Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften (ERP, CRM, MES o. ä.).
  • Du bewegst dich sicher auf Entscheider-Ebene: Du moderierst Workshops, hältst einem Lenkungskreis stand und lieferst schlechte Nachrichten früh statt schön.
  • Du führst fachlich, ohne disziplinarisch zu führen:Backlog, Priorisierung und Stakeholder-Erwartungen sind dein Handwerk.
  • Prägnanz in Kommunikation und Präsentation auf Deutsch (ab C1) und Englisch (ab B2).
  • Sehr gut abgeschlossenes Studium in einem für die Position relevanten Bereich.
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine.

Nice-to-have:

  • Eigene Erfahrung im Agentic Coding oder in der Softwareentwicklung (Python, JavaScript, REST) – du musst nicht committen, aber den Code deines Teams lesen können.
  • MLOps- bzw. LLMOps-Erfahrung: Deployment, Monitoring, Model-Registry, Kostenkontrolle im Betrieb.
  • Erfahrung mit dem EU AI Act und der Übersetzung von Compliance-Anforderungen in Produktentscheidungen.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau eines produktisierten Beratungsangebots (vom Einzelmandat zum wiederverwendbaren Baustein).
  • Branchenkenntnis in u. a. Automotive, Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Öffentlicher Sektor.

Für wen diese Stelle nichts ist, wenn du...:

  • KI-Strategien konzipierst, aber die Umsetzung anderen überlässt– hier gehören Strategize und Build zur Rolle.
  • Deine KI-Erfahrung im Wesentlichen aus Prompting und Tool-Evaluation besteht: Diese Rolle setzt produktive Systeme voraus, die du selbst verantwortet hast.
  • Dein Produkt bisher in einer festen Inhouse-Organisation verantwortet hast und dort bleiben willst: Hier wechseln Kunde, Systemlandschaft und Stakeholder – Beratungsalltag inklusive Reisetätigkeit.
  • Akquise und Angebotsarbeit für dich „nicht die eigentliche Arbeit" sind – bei uns gehören sie zur Rolle.

Warum UNITY – und warum diese Rolle jetzt

Wir behaupten nicht, dass wir „auf KI setzen". Das sagt jede Beratung. Was bei uns nachprüfbar anders ist:

  • Du hast Entwickler im eigenen Unternehmen.Digital & AI Services arbeitet interdisziplinär mit den Softwareentwicklern der UNITY Innovation Alliance – Cloud, Embedded, Individualsoftware, Data Analytics und KI aus einer Hand.
  • Das Portfolio steht schon. Du baust nicht bei null an: corporateGPT, KI Boostcamp, Cloud Assessment und die Service Factory sind etablierte Bausteine, auf denen du aufsetzt – und die du weiterentwickelst.
  • Lernen läuft im Betrieb mit:AI Community, Copilot Power User Community, Agentic Coding Community, AI Playground, Standort-Formate wie „Prompting & Prosecco".
  • Weitere Benefits: Flexible Arbeitsmodelle inkl. Homeoffice · Sabbaticals · persönliches Coaching, Mentoring & UNITYacademy · individuelles Mobilitätskonzept · JobRad, UrbanSports u. v. m. · Verwirkliche mit uns deine Big Five for Life**

Über uns:

UNITY ist die Managementberatung für Innovation und digitale Transformation. Mit 380 Mitarbeitenden sind wir an 15 Standorten vertreten und führen weltweit Kundenprojekte durch.

Unsere Standorte: Berlin, Braunschweig, Frankfurt a. M., Hamburg, Köln, München, Nürnberg, Paderborn/Büren oder Stuttgart.

Bewirb dich jetzt mit wenigen Klicks. Du findest mehrere Stellen interessant? Einmal bewerben reicht: Dein Können wird für alle Stellen geprüft.

The Director of State Affairs leads our state-based campaigns to secure proposal and ratification of the For Our Freedom Amendment to the U.S. Constitution. The Director of State Affairs will serve as a state lead for multiple state campaigns and will ensure timely reporting and evaluation of all programs and key performance indicators. Company: Petra Brands

Location: Remote

About Petra Brands:

Petra Brands is a dynamic and innovative company that encompasses a diverse range of brands, including House of Party, Fomin, EveryMood and Roofus Pet. We specialize in creating unique and compelling consumer packaged goods (CPG) in the beauty, personal care, and lifestyle sectors. Our mission is to deliver exceptional products that evoke emotion, memories, and a sense of place through captivating brand identities and packaging.

About The Role:

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Illustrator & DIY Craft Designer to join House of Party (HOP)—a core brand under Petra Brands specializing in innovative, DIY, and trend-driven party and craft products.

The Product & Crafts Designer will play a key role in designing and developing new craft concepts, DIY activity kits, product packaging, and seasonal collections that reflect the brand’s fun, celebratory, and modern aesthetic. Working closely with the Head of Creatives, this role supports the full product development cycle from ideation to production, ensuring that each craft and party product is retail-ready, visually compelling, and aligned with market trends.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Craft & Product Concept Design

  • Conceptualize, design, and review sampling of creative DIY craft products, activity sets, and party items.
  • Effective use of AI tools in the concept and mockup phase
  • Support in the creation and delivery of biannual retail product catalogs.
  • Track progress of product and craft subcategories (e.g., Pixel Pop, Muddies, Threadies, DIY activity kits, etc.), ensuring deadlines for SKU definition, pricing, packaging, and samples are met.
  • Coordinate with design, sourcing, and marketing teams to ensure all craft materials, assembly instructions, and visuals are ready for internal and retail presentations.

2. Collaboration & Execution

  • Work closely with the Head of Creatives, Sourcing, and Private Label teams to align on craft design direction, material selection (yarn, clay, paper goods, textiles), and production feasibilit and to ensure craft designs and assembly components meet quality, safety, material, and cost standards.
  • Review physical samples, test assembly/craft mechanics, and provide design feedback during pre-production.

3. Brand & Aesthetic Consistency

  • Ensure craft product lines, packaging designs, and instructional inserts align with brand guidelines and seasonal themes.
  • Support the development of cohesive craft and party collections that align with broader campaign or retail strategies.

4. Research & Trend Analysis

  • Stay updated with retail and design trends within the crafts, DIY hobby, party goods, gifting, and lifestyle categories.
  • Benchmark competitor craft kits and propose improvements or innovation opportunities.

5. Documentation & Handoffs

  • Prepare detailed design specs, product renders, assembly guides/craft instructions, and print-ready files for supplier handoff.
  • Maintain organized design records, templates, and version control for ongoing projects.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Illustration, Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Surface Pattern Design, or a related visual arts field
  • 2-4 years of professional experience focusing on commercial illustration, surface pattern design, children's book/toy graphics, or DIY craft product development.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional skills in digital illustration, character/motif creation, pattern design, and playful color theory.
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign; comfort with digital illustration tools (Procreate, etc.).
  • Strong proficiency in using AI art generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, etc.) for creative concepting and moodboarding.
  • Hands-on passion and expertise in physical crafting techniques (e.g., paper crafts, textiles, clay, scrapbooking, DIY kits).
  • Good understanding of print production processes (CMYK vs. RGB, spot colors, print finishes, vector files) and component-based product assembly.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple visual projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to balance creative thinking with practical design execution.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, ability to collaborate with creatives, sourcing, and marketing teams effectively.
  • Interest in seasonal trends (Christmas, Halloween, Birthdays, etc.) relevant to the party and craft industries.

Benefits: 

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work with a dynamic and innovative team.
  • Creative and collaborative work environment.
  • Professional development opportunities and career growth.

Petra Brands is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Who The Client Is:

Our client is an established Australian company specialising in practical solutions for the built environment sector, supporting both residential and commercial projects.

They are highly engaged in leveraging AI across their workflows and are looking for someone who is tech-savvy, adaptable, and shares the same forward-thinking mindset.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a Finance Manager to take ownership of key finance operations while embracing AI and technology to make the function more efficient.

This is more than a traditional bookkeeping role. You’ll be responsible for core finance activities including accounts payable, bank reconciliation and month-end close, while also supporting broader accounts receivable and billing functions.

The client uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, including for multi-currency supplier payments, so experience working with a robust ERP system beyond Xero or QuickBooks is essential.

You will not be responsible for leading the company's broader AI automation program. Instead, we are looking for someone who is genuinely interested in AI and willing to use tools such as Claude and other LLMs to reduce manual work, improve accuracy and work more efficiently.

The ideal candidate combines strong finance fundamentals with a continuous improvement and AI-enabled mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own day-to-day finance operations, ensuring transactions and financial records are accurate and up to date.
  • Manage accounts payable, including supplier invoices, payment processing and multi-currency supplier payments.
  • Perform bank reconciliations and investigate and resolve discrepancies.
  • Own and support the month-end close process, including reconciliations, adjustments and supporting schedules.
  • Manage accounts receivable, invoicing, collections and related billing processes.
  • Review financial records and identify discrepancies, gaps or unusual transactions.
  • Work within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and maintain accurate ERP records.
  • Support broader finance administration and reporting requirements.
  • Use AI and LLM tools to improve the speed, accuracy and efficiency of finance tasks.
  • Identify repetitive or manual finance processes where AI or automation could reduce unnecessary work.
  • Experiment with and adopt appropriate AI tools as part of everyday finance workflows.
  • Document processes and contribute ideas for improving finance operations.
  • Work collaboratively with the internal team on finance and process improvement initiatives.
  • Over time, support additional finance functions, including purchasing and procurement-related processes.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in a Finance Manager, Senior Accountant or similar finance operations role.
  • Strong hands-on experience across accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation and month-end close.
  • Experience working with an ERP system such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, SAP, NetSuite, Oracle or a similar platform.
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central experience is highly preferred, particularly experience handling supplier payments and multi-currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and finance processes.
  • Experience managing supplier invoices, payments, reconciliations and financial records.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
  • Ability to investigate discrepancies, identify gaps and take ownership of resolving issues.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.
  • Genuine interest in AI, LLMs and emerging finance technology.
  • Comfortable learning and using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar AI platforms.
  • A process-improvement mindset — you naturally look for ways to make finance work more efficient.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate combines strong finance fundamentals with a willingness to embrace AI.

You should be confident managing core finance responsibilities and comfortable getting hands-on with the detail, while also being curious about how AI can help you work faster, reduce repetitive tasks and improve accuracy.

You do not need to be an AI or automation specialist. The broader automation strategy is managed internally. What matters is that you are open to AI, willing to learn, and enthusiastic about using it as part of your day-to-day finance work.

You might already be using tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in your finance workflows, or you may simply have a strong interest in learning how these tools can be applied to finance.

As part of the selection process, shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical exercise using Claude to demonstrate how they approach finance tasks with AI.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means taking ownership of core finance operations while continuously finding practical ways to make the function faster, more accurate and more efficient.

You’ll be measured not only by the accuracy and reliability of your finance work, but also by your ability to identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary manual work through better processes and appropriate use of AI.
