jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.excerpt: Who we are At WELLSTAR, we are committed to reshaping Canadian healthcare by leveraging technology to address the administrative burdens that pull physicians away from their true calling—patient care.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At WELLSTAR, we are committed to reshaping Canadian healthcare by leveraging technology to address the administrative burdens that pull physicians away from their true calling—patient care. Our mission is to support providers and patients, shifting the emphasis back to quality, timeliness, and positive outcomes. With a comprehensive suite of technology solutions, we have successfully helped thousands of providers adopt and benefit from modern, interoperable technologies that improve patient outcomes and system efficiency.

Whether you are in research and development, administration, communications, operations leadership, or technology, joining us now is an opportunity to play a critical role in transforming how healthcare is managed and experienced in Canada.

The opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Engineering, we are hiring a Junior Software Developer to join the Billing Solutions Group (BSG) at WELLSTAR, with an initial focus on PatientSERV. In this role, you will work closely with experienced developers to maintain and enhance a healthcare technology platform that helps medical practices manage payments for uninsured services. You will take ownership of bug fixes, develop and release new features, and contribute to improvements across PatientSERV’s administrative, staff, and patient portals. Working with AI-assisted development tools, you will help deliver reliable, secure solutions while contributing to the ongoing evolution of our products.

This is a junior-level opportunity, and we welcome applications from recent graduates who bring a strong technical foundation and hands-on development experience gained through co-op placements or internships.

This is a newly created, fully remote role open to candidates anywhere in Canada, with flexible working hours and expected overlap with Eastern Time business hours to support team collaboration.

What’s in it for you

Build your skills with hands-on mentorship. You will work directly with experienced developers, a Technology Manager who knows the PatientSERV platform inside and out, and a Head of Engineering who remains actively involved in coding. You will have the guidance, code reviews, and support to strengthen your technical skills, build confidence, and gradually take ownership of more complex development work.

Expand your technical experience. You will start by building a deep understanding of PatientSERV, taking ownership of bug fixes, feature development, and ongoing improvements. As you grow, you will have opportunities to work across other products within the Billing Solutions Group, gaining exposure to different technologies, codebases, and development challenges. You will also work with AI-assisted coding tools as part of the team's everyday development practices, learning how to use emerging technologies to improve the way you build and deliver software.

Make a meaningful impact. You will contribute to healthcare technology that helps medical practices manage payments for uninsured services, supporting more efficient administrative processes for healthcare providers and their patients. You will join a small, growing engineering team where your contributions are visible, your ideas are valued, and you can see the results of your work as features and improvements move into production.

As our new Junior Software Developer, you will:

  • Develop and enhance features. You will build, maintain, and improve features across PatientSERV's administrative, staff, and patient portals. Our current technology stack primarily includes C#/.NET and SQL Server. You'll have the support to develop your skills in these technologies, starting with smaller enhancements and gradually taking ownership of more complex development work.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues. You will investigate bugs, identify root causes, and implement reliable fixes that improve platform functionality and the user experience. You will work with existing code, understand how different components interact, and collaborate with experienced developers to resolve technical challenges.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools. You will use tools such as Claude Code to support coding, testing, debugging, and understanding unfamiliar code. You will apply your technical knowledge and judgment to review AI-generated solutions, validate their accuracy, and ensure the quality and security of the code you deliver. Protecting patient privacy is fundamental to how we work. Patient data is never entered into or shared with AI tools.
  • Ensure quality and security. You will write and maintain tests, participate in code reviews, and contribute to secure, reliable software releases. You will help address security findings, support ongoing platform improvements, and contribute to the planned migration to AWS.
  • Collaborate and share knowledge. You will work closely with the Technology Manager, developers, and engineering leadership to understand priorities, deliver product updates, and solve problems. You will document processes, technical decisions, and lessons learned to support knowledge sharing and make the platform easier to maintain.
  • Expand your technical contributions. As you develop your understanding of PatientSERV, you will have opportunities to contribute to other products within the Billing Solutions Group, working with different technologies and supporting improvements across the broader product portfolio.

You bring:

  • The development experience. You have hands-on experience building, maintaining, or contributing to web applications through professional work, co-op placements, or personal projects. You have solid hands-on experience with at least one of the following technologies: Python, TypeScript, Angular, C#, or .NET. We value the depth of your understanding more than the specific technology you have worked with. You do not need experience across our entire technology stack. You can demonstrate your ability to write, understand, troubleshoot, and improve code. You are comfortable working with existing codebases and eager to learn new technologies.
  • The technical skills. You have a solid understanding of SQL and relational databases, including how to query, manage, and work with structured data. You are familiar with software development practices such as testing, debugging, version control, and code reviews. Exposure to SQL Server, AWS or Azure, ASP.NET WebForms, or Entity Framework is an asset.
  • The AI mindset. You have practical experience using AI-assisted coding tools, such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies, to support development and problem-solving. You understand how to evaluate AI-generated code, identify potential issues, and validate solutions through testing rather than relying on AI outputs without review. You understand the importance of using AI responsibly, particularly when working in an environment where patient privacy and data security are essential.
  • The problem-solving skills. You approach technical challenges with curiosity, patience, and a willingness to investigate. You can break down problems, identify potential solutions, and explain your thinking. You know when to work independently, when to ask questions, and when to seek guidance from more experienced team members.
  • The collaborative approach. You communicate clearly, share knowledge, and welcome feedback. You are comfortable working with a distributed team, contributing to technical discussions, and documenting your work. You are eager to learn from others, take responsibility for your contributions, and continue developing your skills as a software developer.

If you have a work sample, a co-op project, a personal development project, or a GitHub repository that you are permitted to share, we would welcome the opportunity to review it and learn more about your technical capabilities and approach to development. This is considered an asset, not a requirement.

Why join us?

WELLSTAR is a leading healthcare technology company dedicated to reshaping healthcare through digital enablement. We provide a comprehensive, holistic solution for healthcare providers across Canada, with over 40% of practitioners currently using our products and services. Our solutions serve primary care physicians, specialist physicians, health systems, and public sector organizations through a comprehensive suite that includes billing and practice management systems, electronic medical records (EMRs), digital health applications, and digital health network solutions.

As a majority-owned subsidiary of WELL Health, WELLSTAR continues to drive innovation and transformation in the Canadian healthcare landscape, reducing administrative burden and empowering providers to deliver better patient outcomes through advanced technology solutions.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A 60-minute technical interview with the Head of Engineering to discuss your technical knowledge, development experience and problem-solving approach. The interview will include a scenario-based exercise, giving you an opportunity to demonstrate how you approach technical challenges, work through potential solutions, and explain your thinking.
  • A final 60-minute virtual interview with two Developers and the Technology Manager. This conversation will focus on how you work, communicate, and collaborate. You will also have the opportunity to get to know the team and ask questions.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $70,000-$80,000. We will determine the salary based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills, as well as the organization's needs. At WELLSTAR, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a total compensation package that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

Apply now.

Interested in applying but worried you don't have it all? At WELLSTAR, we know not everyone gains their experience following a traditional path. If you share our values, want to make a difference in healthcare technology solutions, and meet 70% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Express your interest here.

WELLSTAR is committed to supporting a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome and celebrate the diversity of applicants and team members across ability, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, and perspective. We strive to create an inclusive workplace where differences are celebrated and fuel our success. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.title: Game Server Programmer
jobs.excerpt: This position requires you to reside in Japan during your employment with Wizcorp.
jobs.description:
This position requires you to reside in Japan during your employment with Wizcorp.

Wizcorp is looking for Game Server Programmers to work on exciting multiplayer games targeting a variety of consoles and environments. Depending on your background, skills, and experience we’ll find the most suitable role within our teams.

Is this job for me? 👨‍🦰👩‍🦳🧑‍🦲

You have a few years of work experience implementing real-time networking in games and have seen the release of a few games. You know all the quirks of low-level networking. You live and breathe C++, but don't mind using the right language for the job either. You’re not afraid to deep-dive into any network protocol implementation to make some improvements. You've implemented your fair share of lobby and matchmaking systems.

Sounds like you? Then this job is for you!

Typical day 🎮📆🕹️

You start your day by reviewing code from other engineers and ensuring they meet quality expectations. You will mainly work on network-related systems, but will often need to remain up-to-date with the features being implemented by your peers. Some days, you will be working on the game itself, ensuring a smooth multiplayer experience. On others, you will focus on peripheral systems used to support the gaming experience, like lobbies, matchmaking, and ranking systems. You may have to work on network optimization, help and support server-build deployments, and work on low-level parts of game engines affecting the quality of the multiplayer experience.

The ideal candidate will be able to

  • Implement multiplayer and networked features, and make server builds of the game.
  • Create standalone peripheral systems (lobby, matchmaking, etc.)
  • Design, test, and debug own code without assistance from other engineers
  • Capable of analyzing network traffic as part of problem-solving and debugging
  • Break down large features into engineering tasks and work with other engineers to complete them
  • Decipher and understand complex systems
  • Mentor engineers in engine development best practices
  • Develop system with a strong focus on optimization and performance
  • Confidently communicate with all members of the company

Roles and Responsibilities 🛠️🧪✨

  • Estimate own tasks and deliver them in a timely manner
  • Write clear, maintainable code that passes review by other senior engineers
  • Raise all blockers when they arise to the project lead
  • Test and document provided solutions to allow other developers to review and learn
  • Implement and uphold software engineering best practices for the full software development life cycle
  • Take ownership of large areas of the code base and large complex features
  • Take ownership of mission-critical areas of the codebase
  • Coordinate with members outside of the engineering team to deliver features in a timely manner
  • Determine large feature feasibility and propose solutions
  • Provide solid programming expertise to deliver large features and architecture suggestions
  • Provide code review analysis that uses all relevant experience to foresee problems with design and implementation

Application process 🈸⚙️😊

① Online selection

We review resumes from all applicants within 2 weeks. If your profile matches our requirements, we will send you tests and challenges. Based on the results, we will contact you again to schedule the first interview.

② Interviews

We conduct three interviews to assess your character, passions, skills, and interest in what we do. We also take the time to share our vision and values, as we believe you are interviewing us as much as we are interviewing you.

③ Reference Checks

We conduct reference checks with your previous employers or professional contacts to better understand your experience and working style.

④ Offer

We make our final decision within 2 weeks after the final interview, and send a detailed offer upon success.

Onboarding process 🈴🗼🌅

We strive to make the onboarding process as smooth and worry-free as possible.

Upon acceptance of our offer, you will receive our working agreement and our rules of employment.

Ideally, we want you to join us within a month, but we can adjust to your current work situation.

On your first day, your manager will introduce you to your team and will set a schedule for reviews over the 6-month probation period. We will give you all the support you need to complete it successfully.

At Wizcorp, we grow together.

Senior staff will support you and provide mentorship. You will also have access to digital learning material, and your manager will help you define a training curriculum based on your career aspirations.

You can learn more about our career philosophy here:

🤹 Skillset 🤹

  • Ability to write clean, readable, performant code and design the architecture around it
  • Excellent debugging and optimization skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Knowledge of existing optimization techniques
  • Focus on performance and performance analysis
  • Strong math skills
  • Willingness to work as part of a team and contribute to technical discussions
  • Eager to both provide and receive constructive feedback for continual growth
  • Strong software development skills, design theory, and development processes
  • Strong personal time management
  • Experience in one or multiple of the following
    • Multiplayer integration with Unreal Engine and/or proprietary game engines
    • Creation and deployment of server builds for Unreal Engine and/or proprietary game engines
    • Networking and network protocols
    • Knowledge of and ability to create network protocols used for multiplayer games
    • Development and integration of custom peripheral server-side systems (lobby, matchmaking, ranking, etc.)

⭐ Experience ⭐

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline; or relevant professional experience
  • For Japan-based candidates: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, and 2+ years of professional experience developing game servers
  • For overseas-based candidates: 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, and 6+ years of professional experience developing game servers
  • Solid software engineering abilities (good code hygiene, familiarity with various coding patterns, etc.)
  • Strong experience with C++ and C#
  • Good experience in a variety of programming languages used to create peripheral server-side systems
  • Comfortable with source code management systems (Git, SVN, Perforce, etc.)
  • At least conversational Japanese proficiency - JLPT N3 or above
  • English proficiency (ability to read, write, and discuss technical matters)

👍 Preferred 👍

  • Experience with some of the following languages: Go, Java, shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell, etc.)
  • Experience with other game engines such as Unreal, Unity, open source engines, or others
  • At least 3 years of experience in the video game industry
  • Worked on at least 1 released game

📍 Business hours and Location 📍

⏲ Flexibility in time

We all have different creative clocks, and you know yours better than we do.

We will expect you to work 8 hours per day from Monday to Friday with core hours between 11:00 and 16:00 (excluding a 1-hour break). The rest will be up to you.

🌎 Flexibility in location

Wizcorp fully embraces telework, and most of us work from home. Office space is also available for your convenience, and you will have access to meeting rooms and hot desks.

We may require you to work onsite on specific occasions when using highly specialized equipment.

Offices are located at 1 Chome-22-19 Izumi 8~9F, Suginami City, Tokyo 168-0063 (🗺map)

You must reside in Japan during your employment at Wizcorp. We offer legal support for visa applications. Depending on your situation, we may allow you to work outside of Japan during your probation period.

👷 Employment Type 👷‍♀️

Permanent

💴 Salary 💴

The following tiers are currently in application for this position:

  • GS1: 400~450K/month
  • GS2: 450~550K/month
  • GS3: 550~600K/month

All new staff members’ initial salary will be based on experience and interview evaluation.

Includes a 6 months probation period. Salary is not affected nor changed during that period.

💹 Raises and bonuses 💹

  • You will be reviewed once a year and your salary will be adjusted to match with gained experience and project contributions.
  • Pay raises are awarded around March each year, in line with our budget and financial forecasting for the subsequent year.
  • We do not offer bonuses.

🈷️ Additional benefits 🈷️

  • Monthly allowance for home office equipment and supplies (15,000 JPY/month)
  • Private language tutoring (Japanese and/or English)
  • Commute fees (however, train passes are not reimbursed)

♨️ Holidays and vacations ♨️

  • Weekends and national holidays
  • Summer/winter vacation: 5 days per year (paid, applicable after the probation period)
  • Annual Paid Leave: 10 days per year (first year, following the probation period)
  • Bereavement/funeral leave
  • Sick leave: 5 days per year (paid, applicable after the probation period)

🤝 Welfare 🤝

  • Social insurance
  • Parental leave (learn more here)

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

Keywords Studios is strongly committed to protecting your personal information. By sending your CV/Resume, you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and consent to your data being managed and retained in accordance with our data privacy and retention policy

About Wizcorp 🦄🇯🇵🎮

Wizcorp is a highly specialized game development studio based in Tokyo and operating 100% remotely. We are a cross-cultural team of passionate individuals working together toward one goal: bringing back magic to game development.

How?

  • We get better every day. Our technical abilities should never limit our ideas.
  • We question the status quo. We don't accept yesterday's answers to tomorrow's challenges.
  • We follow our moral compass. Our values guide our decisions.
  • We surround ourselves with people who believe in our mission. Our staff, clients, and partners are all part of the equation.

jobs.description:
Wizcorpでは、次世代コンソール向けのエキサイティングなプロジェクトに携わるUnreal Engine(4および5)プログラマーを募集しています。あなたのこれまでのご経歴、スキル、経験に応じて、当社のチーム内で最適なポジションをご紹介させていただきます。

このポジションに向いている方 👨‍🦰👩‍🦳🧑‍🦲

Unreal Engineでの実務経験が数年あり、コンソール向けゲームのリリース経験をお持ちの方。C++が共通言語であり、エンジン自体に深く踏み込んで改善を行うことに抵抗がない方。

当てはまる方、ぜひご応募ください!

業務内容 🎮📆🕹️

1日の始まりは、他のエンジニアが書いたコードをレビューし、品質基準を満たしているか確認することから始まります。ある日は、コンソール向けの操作システムをクリーンかつ拡張可能な方法で実装したり、ターゲットプラットフォームでのパフォーマンスを調査し、それを改善するためにゲームやエンジンを修正したりします。

午後は、更新されたコードをターゲットプラットフォームでテストし、正確性とパフォーマンスを確認する時間に充てられることが多いです。

理想的な候補者像

  • 他のエンジニアの支援なしに、自分のコードを設計、テスト、デバッグできる

  • 大規模な機能をエンジニアリングタスクに分解し、他のエンジニアと協力して完成させることができる

  • ソフトウェア開発のベストプラクティスについて、エンジニアへのメンタリングができる

  • ゲーム本体とそのツールの両方に取り組むことに興味がある

  • 社内のすべてのメンバーと自信を持ってコミュニケーションできる

役割と責任 🛠️🧪✨

  • 自身のタスクを見積もり、期限内に完遂する

  • 他のシニアエンジニアによるレビューに合格する、明確でメンテナンス性の高いコードを書く

  • 障害が発生した際は、プロジェクトリードに報告する

  • 他の開発者がレビューし、学習できるよう、提供するソリューションをテストし文書化する

  • ソフトウェア開発ライフサイクル全体において、ソフトウェアエンジニアリングのベストプラクティスを実装し、維持する

  • コードベースの広範囲や大規模で複雑な機能に対して責任を持つ

  • コードベースのミッションクリティカルな領域の責任を担う

  • エンジニアリングチーム外のメンバーと調整し、機能を期限内に提供する

  • 大規模な機能の実現可能性を判断し、解決策を提案する

  • 大規模な機能とアーキテクチャの提案を実現するための確かなプログラミングの専門知識を提供する

  • 関連する全ての経験を活用し、設計と実装における問題を予見するコードレビュー分析を行う

🤹 スキルセット 🤹

  • クリーンで読みやすく、パフォーマンスの高いコードを書き、それに基づくアーキテクチャを設計する能力

  • 優れたデバッグ能力と最適化スキル

  • 優れた文章力および口頭でのコミュニケーション能力

  • チームの一員として働き、技術的な議論に貢献する意欲

  • 継続的な成長のため、建設的なフィードバックを提供・受け取ることに積極的

  • 優れたソフトウェア開発スキル、設計理論、開発プロセス

  • 優れた個人的な時間管理能力

  • エンドツーエンドのソフトウェア開発知識

  • 以下のいずれか、または複数の経験

    • Unreal Online Subsystemを使用した開発

    • Unreal Engineの内部システムに精通し、カスタマイズ方法に関する知識

    • PlayStationプラットフォーム向けの開発

jobs.title: Unreal Engine Programmer
jobs.excerpt: This position requires you to reside in Japan during your employment with Wizcorp.
jobs.description:
This position requires you to reside in Japan during your employment with Wizcorp.

Wizcorp is looking for Unreal Engine (4 and 5) Programmers to work on exciting projects for next-generation consoles. Depending on your background, skills, and experience we’ll find the most suitable role within our teams.

Is this job for me? 👨‍🦰👩‍🦳🧑‍🦲

You have a few years of work experience working with Unreal Engine and who have released games on consoles. C++ needs to be your lingua franca, and you’re not afraid to deep-dive into the engine itself to make some improvements. Sounds like you?

Then this job is for you!

Typical day 🎮📆🕹️

You start your day by reviewing code from other engineers and ensuring they meet quality expectations. Some days will be spent implementing control systems for consoles in a clean and extensible manner, or investigating performance on the target platform and modifying the game or engine to improve this.

Afternoons will often be spent testing updated code on target platforms to ensure correctness and performance.

The ideal candidate will be able to

  • Design, test, and debug own code without assistance from other engineers

  • Break down large features into engineering tasks and work with other engineers to complete them

  • Mentor engineers in software development best practices

  • Have an interest in working on both games and their tools

  • Confidently communicate with all members of the company

Roles and Responsibilities 🛠️🧪✨

  • Estimate own tasks and deliver them in a timely manner

  • Write clear, maintainable code that passes review by other senior engineers

  • Raise all blockers when they arise to the project lead

  • Test and document provided solutions to allow other developers to review and learn

  • Implement and uphold software engineering best practices for the full software development life cycle

  • Take ownership of large areas of the code base and large complex features

  • Take ownership of mission-critical areas of the codebase

  • Coordinate with members outside of the engineering team to deliver features in a timely manner

  • Determine large feature feasibility and propose solutions

  • Provide solid programming expertise to deliver large features and architecture suggestions

  • Provide code review analysis that uses all relevant experience to foresee problems with design and implementation

Application process 🈸⚙️😊

① Online selection

We review resumes from all applicants within 2 weeks. If your profile matches our requirements, we will send you tests and challenges. Based on the results, we will contact you again to schedule the first interview.

② Interviews

We conduct three interviews to assess your character, passions, skills, and interest in what we do. We also take the time to share our vision and values, as we believe you are interviewing us as much as we are interviewing you.

③ Reference Checks

We conduct reference checks with your previous employers or professional contacts to better understand your experience and working style.

④ Offer

We make our final decision within 2 weeks after the final interview, and send a detailed offer upon success.

Onboarding process 🈴🗼🌅

We strive to make the onboarding process as smooth and worry-free as possible.

Upon acceptance of our offer, you will receive our working agreement and our rules of employment.

Ideally, we want you to join us within a month, but we can adjust to your current work situation.

On your first day, your manager will introduce you to your team and will set a schedule for reviews over the 6 month probation period. We will give you all the support you need to complete it successfully.

At Wizcorp, we grow together.

Senior staff will support you and provide mentorship. You will also have access to digital learning material, and your manager will help you define a training curriculum based on your career aspirations.
You can learn more about our career philosophy here:

🤹 Skillset 🤹

  • Ability to write clean, readable, performant code and design the architecture around it

  • Excellent debugging and optimization skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Willingness to work as part of a team and contribute to technical discussions

  • Eager to both provide and receive constructive feedback for continual growth

  • Strong software development skills, design theory, and development processes

  • Strong personal time management

  • End-to-end software development knowledge

  • Experience in one or multiple of the following

    • Development using the Unreal Online Subsystem

    • Familiarity with Unreal Engine’s internal systems, and knowledge on how to customize them

    • Development targeting PlayStation platforms

    • Development targeting Microsoft platforms

    • Familiarity with other target platforms (Nintendo, PC, mobile)

⭐ Experience ⭐

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline; or relevant professional experience

  • For Japan-based candidates: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, 2+ years of professional experience using Unreal Engine 4 and 2+ years of professional experience developing console games (including using test kits and dev kits)

  • For overseas-based candidates: 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, 6+ years of professional experience using Unreal Engine 4 and 6+ years of professional experience developing console games (including using test kits and dev kits)

  • Solid software engineering abilities (good code hygiene, familiarity with various coding patterns, etc.)

  • Strong experience with C++ and debugging in Unreal Engine

  • Comfortable with source code management systems (Git, SVN, Perforce, etc.)

  • At least conversational Japanese proficiency - JLPT N3 or above

  • English proficiency (ability to read, write, and discuss technical matters)

👍 Preferred 👍

  • Experience with some of the following languages: C#, Ruby, Python, shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell, etc.)

  • Familiarity with Unreal Engine’s build pipeline

  • Experience with other game engines such (Unity, proprietary engines, or others)

  • Worked on at least 1 released game

📍 Business hours and Location 📍

⏲ Flexibility in time

We all have different creative clocks, and you know yours better than we do.

We will expect you to work 8 hours per day from Monday to Friday with core hours between 11:00 and 16:00 (excluding a 1-hour break). The rest will be up to you.

🌎 Flexibility in location

Wizcorp fully embraces telework, and most of us work from home. Office space is also available for your convenience, and you will have access to meeting rooms and hot desks.

We may require you to work onsite on specific occasions when using highly specialized equipment.

Offices are located at 1 Chome-22-19 Izumi 8~9F, Suginami City, Tokyo 168-0063 (🗺map)

You must reside in Japan during your employment at Wizcorp. We offer legal support for visa applications. Depending on your situation, we may allow you to work outside of Japan during your probation period.

👷 Employment Type 👷‍♀️

Permanent

💴 Salary 💴

The following tiers are currently in application for this position:

  • UE1: 400~450K/month

  • UE2: 450~550K/month

  • UE3: 550~600K/month

All new staff members’ initial salary will be based on experience and interview evaluation.

Includes a 6-month probation period. Salary is not affected nor changed during that period.

💹 Raises and bonuses 💹

  • You will be reviewed once a year and your salary will be adjusted to match with gained experience and project contributions.
  • Pay raises are awarded around March each year, in line with our budget and financial forecasting for the subsequent year.
  • We do not offer bonuses.

🈷️ Additional benefits 🈷️

  • Monthly allowance for home office equipment and supplies (15,000 JPY/month)
  • Private language tutoring (Japanese and/or English)
  • Commute fees (however, train passes are not reimbursed)

♨️ Holidays and vacations ♨️

  • Weekends and national holidays
  • Summer/winter vacation: 5 days per year (paid, applicable after the probation period)
  • Annual Paid Leave: 10 days per year (first year, following the probation period)
  • Bereavement/funeral leave
  • Sick leave: 5 days per year (paid, applicable after the probation period)

🤝 Welfare 🤝

  • Social insurance
  • Parental leave (learn more here)

jobs.description:
Wizcorpでは、多様な分野で活躍するソフトウェアエンジニアを募集しています。あなたのこれまでのご経歴、スキル、経験に応じて、当社のチーム内で最適なポジションをご紹介させていただきます。私たちは、経験や熟練度と同じくらい、人間性とキャラクターを重視しています。

このポジションに向いている方 👨‍🦰👩‍🦳🧑‍🦲

ソフトウェア開発の実務経験が数年ある方。C++とC#があなたのツールボックスにおけるコアプログラミング言語であり、日常業務では他の1〜2つの言語を使用している可能性がある方。エンジンやコードベースに深く踏み込んで改善を行うことに抵抗がない方。

当てはまる方、ぜひご応募ください!

業務内容 🎮📆🕹️

1日の始まりは、シニアエンジニアと1時間ほどコードをレビューすることから始まるかもしれません。その後、AI ロジックの最適化に取り組む機会があり、必要に応じてその分野のスペシャリストと議論します。午後には、ゲームデザイナーやアーティストと協力して機能統合を完成させる時間を過ごすこともあります。

理想的な候補者像

  • 他のエンジニアの支援なしに、自分のコードを設計、テスト、デバッグできる

  • 機能をエンジニアリングタスクに分解し、他のエンジニアと協力して完成させることができる

  • ゲーム本体とその周辺ツールの両方に取り組むことに興味がある

  • 社内のすべてのメンバーと自信を持ってコミュニケーションできる

役割と責任 🛠️🧪✨

  • 割り当てられたエンジニアリングタスクを期限内に完遂する

  • 他の開発者がレビューし、学習できるよう、提供するソリューションをテストし文書化する

  • シニアエンジニアによるレビューに合格する、明確でメンテナンス性の高いコードを書く

  • 自身のタスクを見積もり、期限内に完遂する

  • 障害が発生した際は、機能リードまたはプロジェクトリードに報告する

  • コーディング規約、コードレビュー、ソースコード管理、テストなど、ソフトウェア開発ライフサイクル全体において、ソフトウェアエンジニアリングのベストプラクティスに従う

  • 中規模の機能を管理可能なタスクに分解し、自分自身や他のメンバーで達成できるようにすることで、その機能に対して責任を持つ

  • エンジニアリングチーム外のメンバーと調整し、機能を期限内に提供する

🤹 スキルセット 🤹

  • 優れたソフトウェア開発の基礎知識、設計理論、開発プロセス

  • 優れたデバッグスキル

  • 優れた文章力および口頭でのコミュニケーション能力

  • チームの一員として働き、技術的な議論に貢献する意欲

  • レビューや建設的なフィードバックから学ぶことに積極的

  • 優れた個人的な時間管理能力

⭐ 経験 ⭐

  • 工学、コンピューターサイエンス、または関連分野の大学卒業、または同等の実務経験

  • 日本在住の候補者の場合: ソフトウェアエンジニアリングの実務経験3年以上、およびゲーム業界での1年以上の経験

  • 海外在住の候補者の場合: ソフトウェアエンジニアリングの実務経験7年以上、およびゲーム業界での4年以上の経験

  • C++とC#の経験が必須、Goの経験があることが望ましい

  • 実証可能なソフトウェアエンジニアリング能力

  • Gitまたは他のバージョン管理システムでの経験

  • 複数のプログラミング言語での経験

  • 日常会話レベル以上の日本語能力 - JLPT N3以上

  • 英語能力(技術的な事項について読み、書き、議論できるレベル)

👍 歓迎するスキル 👍

  • Unity、Unreal、または独自エンジンコードなどのゲームエンジンでの経験

  • 2Dおよび3D数学の理解

応募プロセス 🈸⚙️😊

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: This position requires you to reside in Japan during your employment with Wizcorp.
jobs.description:
This position requires you to reside in Japan during your employment with Wizcorp.

Wizcorp is looking for Software Engineers for a selection of diverse fields. Depending on your background, skills, and experience we’ll find the most suitable role within our teams for you. We value human skills and character as much as we do experience and proficiency.

Is this job for me? 👨‍🦰👩‍🦳🧑‍🦲

You have a few years of work experience developing software professionally. C++ and C# are core programming languages in your tool box, even though you might be using one or two other languages for your daily tasks. You’re not afraid to deep-dive into the engine and code bases to make some improvements.

Sounds like you? Then this job is for you!

Typical day 🎮📆🕹️

You might start with an hour of looking over some code with a senior engineer. You then might have the opportunity to look at optimizing a piece of AI logic, discussing as necessary with a specialist in the area. In the afternoon you may spend some time working with game designers and artists to complete feature integration.

The ideal candidate will be able to

  • Design, test, and debug own code without assistance from other engineers
  • Break down features into engineering tasks and work with other engineers to complete them
  • Have an interest in working on both games and their surrounding tooling
  • Confidently communicate with all members of the company

Roles and Responsibilities 🛠️🧪✨

  • Complete assigned engineering tasks in a timely manner
  • Test and document provided solutions to allow other developers to review and learn
  • Write clear, maintainable code that passes review by senior engineers
  • Estimate own tasks and deliver them in a timely manner
  • Raise all blockers when they arise to the feature lead or project lead
  • Follow software engineering best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, and testing
  • Take ownership of medium-sized features by breaking them into manageable tasks that can be accomplished by themselves and/or others
  • Coordinate with members outside of the engineering team to deliver features in a timely manner

Application process 🈸⚙️😊

① Online selection

We review resumes from all applicants within 2 weeks. If your profile matches our requirements, we will send you tests and challenges. Based on the results, we will contact you again to schedule the first interview.

② Interviews

We conduct three interviews to assess your character, passions, skills, and interest in what we do. We also take the time to share our vision and values, as we believe you are interviewing us as much as we are interviewing you.

③ Reference Checks

We conduct reference checks with your previous employers or professional contacts to better understand your experience and working style.

④ Offer

We make our final decision within 2 weeks after the final interview, and send a detailed offer upon success.

Onboarding process 🈴🗼🌅

We strive to make the onboarding process as smooth and worry-free as possible.

Upon acceptance of our offer, you will receive our working agreement and our rules of employment.

Ideally, we want you to join us within a month, but we can adjust to your current work situation.

On your first day, your manager will introduce you to your team and will set a schedule for reviews over the 6 month probation period. We will give you all the support you need to complete it successfully.

At Wizcorp, we grow together.

Senior staff will support you and provide mentorship. You will also have access to digital learning material, and your manager will help you define a training curriculum based on your career aspirations.

You can learn more about our career philosophy here:

🤹 Skillset 🤹

  • Strong software development fundamentals, design theory, and development processes
  • Excellent debugging skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Willingness to work as part of a team and contribute to technical discussions
  • Eager to learn from reviews and constructive feedback
  • Strong personal time management

⭐ Experience ⭐

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline; or relevant professional experience
  • For Japan-based candidates: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience and at least 1 year of experience in the video game industry
  • For overseas-based candidates: 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, and at least 4+ year of experience in the video game industry
  • Must have experience with C++ and C#, backed with Go
  • Demonstrable Software Engineering ability
  • Experience with Git or other version control systems
  • Experience with multiple programming languages
  • At least conversational Japanese proficiency - JLPT N3 or above
  • English proficiency (ability to read, write, and discuss technical matters)

👍 Preferred 👍

  • Experience with game engines such as Unity, Unreal, or proprietary engine code
  • Understanding of 2D and 3D math

📍 Business hours and Location 📍

⏲ Flexibility in time

We all have different creative clocks, and you know yours better than we do.

We will expect you to work 8 hours per day from Monday to Friday with core hours between 11:00 and 16:00 (excluding a 1-hour break). The rest will be up to you.

🌎 Flexibility in location

Wizcorp fully embraces telework, and most of us work from home. Office space is also available for your convenience, and you will have access to meeting rooms and hot desks.

We may require you to work onsite on specific occasions when using highly specialized equipment.

Offices are located at 1 Chome-22-19 Izumi 8~9F, Suginami City, Tokyo 168-0063 (🗺map)

You must reside in Japan during your employment at Wizcorp. We offer legal support for visa applications. Depending on your situation, we may allow you to work outside of Japan during your probation period.

👷 Employment Type 👷‍♀️

Permanent

💴 Salary 💴

The following tiers are currently in application for this position:

  • SE1: 350~400K/month (equivalent to 2-3 years of experience)
  • SE2: 400~500K/month (equivalent to 4-5 years of experience)
  • SE3: 500~550K/month (equivalent to 6-7 years of experience)

All new staff members’ initial salary will be based on experience and interview evaluation.

Includes a 6 months probation period. Salary is not affected nor changed during that period.

💹 Raises and bonuses 💹

  • You will be reviewed once a year and your salary will be adjusted to match with gained experience and project contributions.
  • Pay raises are awarded around March each year, in line with our budget and financial forecasting for the subsequent year.
  • We do not offer bonuses.

🈷️ Additional benefits 🈷️

  • Monthly allowance for home office equipment and supplies (15,000 JPY/month)
  • Private language tutoring (Japanese and/or English)
  • Commute fees (however, train passes are not reimbursed)

♨️ Holidays and vacations ♨️

  • Weekends and national holidays
  • Summer/winter vacation: 5 days per year (paid, applicable after the probation period)
  • Annual Paid Leave: 10 days per year (first year, following the probation period)
  • Bereavement/funeral leave
  • Sick leave: 5 days per year (paid, applicable after the probation period)

🤝 Welfare 🤝

  • Social insurance
  • Parental leave (learn more here)

Wizcorp is a highly specialized game development studio based in Tokyo and operating 100% remotely. We are a cross-cultural team of passionate individuals working together toward one goal: bringing back magic to game development.

How?

  • We get better every day. Our technical abilities should never limit our ideas.

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) SAP BusinessObjects
jobs.excerpt: Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung.
jobs.description:
Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen.

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an anspruchsvollen Projekten arbeiten und dich in der gesamten Data & AI-Landschaft in die Richtung weiterentwickeln, die zu dir passt.

Warum solltest du jetzt bei Windhoff starten?

Windhoff wird in der aktuellen Lünendonk®-Studie 2025/2026 explizit als einer der 20 führenden Anbieter von Data & AI Services in Deutschland genannt. Getragen wird unser Wachstum von unserem Gesellschafter Aurelius, einem globalen Private-Equity-Investor, der seit 2023 an der Windhoff Group beteiligt ist. Unser SAP-Kerngeschäft bauen wir dabei gezielt zu einer Multi-Vendor-Strategie aus – mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio sowie den Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS (u. a. Amazon Athena). Du profitierst von einem Marktumfeld, das deutlich stärker wächst als der klassische IT-Dienstleistungsmarkt – und von einem Unternehmen, das dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestaltet, statt nur zu verwalten.

Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile
uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum
Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine
Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit.

Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden!

Aufgaben

  • Du startest mit einer strukturierten Einarbeitung – bei uns und beim Kunden. Erfahrene Kolleg:innen begleiten dich, bis du dich in der Systemlandschaft und den Fachbereichen sicher bewegst.

  • Du arbeitest nicht allein beim Kunden, sondern im Windhoff-Projektteam: Ihr unterstützt euch gegenseitig, teilt euer Wissen und löst knifflige Fragestellungen gemeinsam.

  • Du entwickelst gewachsene Data-Warehouse- und BI-Landschaften unserer Kunden weiter und sorgst für ihren stabilen Betrieb – im Frontend mit SAP BusinessObjects, im Backend mit SAP Data Services und Microsoft SQL Server.

  • Gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen wie Sales, Controlling oder Marketing nimmst du Anforderungen auf und setzt sie in Kennzahlen, Datenmodelle und Berichte um.

  • Du konzipierst und implementierst Datenmodelle (z. B. mit SAP PowerDesigner) und ETL-Strecken in SAP Data Services, pflegst Universen im Information Design Tool und erstellst Web-Intelligence-Berichte.

  • Im Application Management Support analysierst du Datenabweichungen über ETL, Universum und Bericht hinweg bis auf die Datenbank, findest die Ursache und behebst sie nachhaltig – vom 1st- bis zum 3rd-Level.

  • Du begleitest Vorhaben von der Anforderung über Test und Produktivsetzung bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb.

  • Als Senior Consultant übernimmst du die Verantwortung für Teilprojekte und das Windhoff-Projektteam, schätzt Aufwände, stimmst Prioritäten mit Fachbereichen, Kunden-IT und weiteren Dienstleistern ab und unterstützt bei Presales- und Angebotsprozessen.

  • Du gestaltest die Modernisierung bestehender Landschaften mit, etwa die Überführung von Berichten nach Microsoft Power BI oder erste Machine-Learning-Anwendungen, und denkst im Sinne unserer Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit SAP als Kern mit.

  • Durch Wissenstransfer und interne Formate gibst du dein Wissen an Kolleg:innen weiter.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Data Warehousing und BI mit, idealerweise mit SAP BusinessObjects (Web Intelligence, Information Design Tool / Universe Design Tool) und SAP Data Services.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit SQL, insbesondere T-SQL auf Microsoft SQL Server; Kenntnisse in IBM DB2 oder Oracle sind ein Plus.

  • Du kennst relationale Datenmodellierung (Star Schema, gern auch Data Vault) und mehrschichtige DWH-Architekturen.

  • Du analysierst Daten mit Ausdauer und Struktur und behältst auch bei vielen Quellsystemen den Überblick.

  • Du sprichst gern mit Fachbereichen und übersetzt fachliche Fragestellungen in technische Lösungen.

  • Von Vorteil sind Erfahrung mit Microsoft Power BI und im IT-Betrieb nach ITIL. Branchenerfahrung setzen wir nicht voraus – Kenntnisse aus Handel, Automotive oder Dienstleistung sind gern gesehen.

  • Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung darin, agentische KI in deinen Arbeitsalltag und die Durchführung von Data-Engineering-Projekten zu integrieren. Dafür stellen wir dir ein modernes Toolset mit verschiedenen Integrationsmöglichkeiten rund um unseren SAP-Kern bereit.

  • Durch deine hohe Eigeninitiative und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit bringst du deine Ideen sowohl intern als auch im Umfeld unserer Kunden erfolgreich ein. Hierfür sind verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (C1-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse erforderlich.

Benefits

  • Wir stellen standortunabhängig ein. Du kannst größtenteils von zuhause aus oder an einem unserer Standorte arbeiten, wenn dieser für dich gut erreichbar ist. Zu gelegentlichen Kundenterminen und Teamevents startest du von deinem Lebensmittelpunkt aus, egal wo in Deutschland du wohnst.

  • Über 100 Data & Analytics Consultants zum Austausch sowie eine interne Weiterbildungsacademy

  • Langfristige Projekte mit wechselnden technologischen Herausforderungen

  • Ein festes Budget für Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsperspektiven

  • Eine gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Überstundenausgleich sowie bis zu 40 Tagen Urlaub

  • Sowohl erstklassige Hard- und Softwareausstattung als auch Leasingangebote für Firmenwagen, IT-Hardware und Fahrräder

  • Kurze Wege im Unternehmen, ein fairer Umgang miteinander sowie unterhaltsame Teamevents

Du verfügst über die gewünschten Erfahrungen und suchst eine neue Herausforderung? Du bist flexibel, lösungsorientiert und kommunikationsfähig?

Nutze deine Chance: Wir bieten das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.

Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer – Infrastructure & Security | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer to support and maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing technology infrastructure.

Depending on your background and specialization, this role may focus on cloud engineering, network infrastructure, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll help configure and monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot complex technical issues, manage access and authentication, support security operations, and contribute to infrastructure deployments and upgrades.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with a practical understanding of networking, cloud environments, systems, and security best practices.

What You’ll Own

Cloud & Infrastructure Management

  • Configure, monitor, and maintain cloud and infrastructure environments
  • Support platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, or related technologies
  • Monitor infrastructure health, availability, and performance
  • Assist with infrastructure deployments, upgrades, and configuration changes
  • Help maintain reliable and scalable technical environments

Network Engineering & Troubleshooting

  • Configure and support network environments
  • Troubleshoot network, connectivity, DNS, routing, and infrastructure issues
  • Diagnose complex technical problems across systems and environments
  • Monitor network health and performance
  • Help maintain reliable connectivity across business systems

Cybersecurity & Security Operations

  • Implement and maintain security best practices
  • Monitor systems for potential security issues
  • Support security-related troubleshooting and incident response
  • Help identify infrastructure vulnerabilities and operational risks
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to improve the organization’s security posture

Identity & Access Management

  • Manage user access, permissions, and authentication
  • Support appropriate access controls across systems and platforms
  • Troubleshoot authentication and authorization issues
  • Help maintain secure access practices
  • Assist with onboarding, offboarding, and access changes when required

Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Monitor systems for performance, availability, and security issues
  • Investigate alerts and technical incidents
  • Support incident response and troubleshooting
  • Identify root causes and help implement corrective actions
  • Escalate critical infrastructure or security issues appropriately

Infrastructure Automation

  • Identify repetitive infrastructure tasks that can be automated
  • Build or support automation for routine technical processes
  • Improve consistency and efficiency across infrastructure workflows
  • Reduce unnecessary manual administration where possible

Documentation & Technical Operations

  • Maintain clear technical documentation
  • Document infrastructure configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures
  • Keep operational and security documentation current
  • Support repeatable processes for deployments, incidents, and system changes

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with engineering, IT, security, and business teams
  • Support technical projects and infrastructure initiatives
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to relevant stakeholders
  • Help coordinate deployments, upgrades, and operational changes

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in network engineering, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a related infrastructure role
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, and/or enterprise networking technologies
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts and security best practices
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical and connectivity issues
  • Understanding of user access, permissions, and authentication
  • Experience monitoring infrastructure, networks, or systems
  • Strong technical documentation skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Professional working English
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Relevant technical certifications
  • Cloud certifications related to AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Networking or cybersecurity certifications
  • Experience with infrastructure or task automation
  • Experience supporting incident response
  • Experience with identity and access management
  • Familiarity with DevOps and deployment workflows
  • Experience supporting distributed or cloud-based environments

Tools & Technologies

AWS | Microsoft Azure | Google Cloud Platform (GCP) | Enterprise Networking | Identity & Access Management | Infrastructure Monitoring | Security Tools | DevOps & Automation Technologies

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Can troubleshoot complex technical problems methodically
  • Understand how networks, systems, cloud infrastructure, and security interact
  • Think about security as part of everyday infrastructure operations
  • Stay calm and organized when responding to technical incidents
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work
  • Maintain clear documentation rather than relying on tribal knowledge
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Take ownership of problems through resolution

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include reviewing infrastructure and security alerts, troubleshooting a connectivity issue, managing user permissions, supporting a cloud deployment, or investigating a technical incident.

You may also update infrastructure configurations, automate repetitive tasks, document technical processes, and collaborate with engineering or IT teams on deployments and upgrades.

In short: you help keep the organization’s infrastructure secure, reliable, accessible, and running smoothly.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Infrastructure availability and reliability

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in cloud infrastructure, network engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, or systems administration and enjoy solving complex infrastructure and security challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing technology environments.

jobs.title: Implementation QA Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!
jobs.description:
Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!

What do we do?💥

We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences.

Check out our ‘About Us’page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional.

How will you help us make an impact? 👩‍💻👨‍💻

Clariti is seeking an experienced Implementation QA Specialist to help ensure the quality, reliability, and successful delivery of our community development software solutions. As a key member of our Professional Services organization, you will serve as a quality gatekeeper throughout the implementation lifecycle, ensuring that configured solutions, integrations, data migrations, and business processes meet documented requirements and are ready for customer acceptance.

You will own test planning, execution, defect management, and quality validation across complex SaaS implementations. You will also lead System Integration Testing (SIT), support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and help establish consistent quality standards across our delivery practice.

This role goes beyond traditional software testing. You will leverage AI-powered tools, intelligent automation, and reusable testing frameworks to accelerate testing, identify defects earlier, reduce rework, and improve implementation outcomes.

You will collaborate closely with Implementation Consultants, Delivery Architects, Engagement Managers, Product Engineering, customers, and implementation partners to deliver high-quality solutions that support real-world government operations.

What You'll Do

1. Test Strategy, Planning & Quality Assurance

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional, system, integration, data conversion, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing.
  • Establish testing entry and exit criteria, defect management procedures, quality gates, and formal sign-off requirements.
  • Design and execute test cases aligned with approved requirements, user stories, functional designs, and acceptance criteria.
  • Validate application configurations, business rules, workflow automation, user permissions, and custom functionality.
  • Establish and maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, test results, and defects through the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).
  • Participate in requirements reviews, solution design discussions, and story refinement to identify gaps before configuration or development begins.
  • Build and maintain reusable regression test suites across implementations and releases.
  • Execute functional, smoke, regression, and system testing as solutions progress through development, testing, and production environments.
  • Identify and communicate quality risks early to minimize downstream implementation delays.

2. Community Development & End-to-End Workflow Testing

  • Validate complete community development processes, including permitting, licensing, plan reviews, inspections, code enforcement, approvals, and regulatory workflows.
  • Develop testing scenarios that reflect real-world municipal and county operations.
  • Verify complex business rules, approval routing, fee calculations, notifications, document generation, and application status transitions.
  • Test role-based access controls, permissions, and security configurations across citizen, contractor, reviewer, inspector, and administrative user roles.
  • Validate workflows involving multiple departments, external agencies, and third-party systems.
  • Ensure testing covers complete business processes from initial application submission through final approval, inspection, and closure.
  • Identify functional gaps, workflow inconsistencies, and user experience issues before customer demonstrations or UAT.
  • Work with Implementation Consultants and Delivery Architects to confirm that configured solutions meet approved business requirements.

3. System Integration Testing (SIT)

  • Lead and execute System Integration Testing across fully configured solutions and connected third-party applications.
  • Validate end-to-end workflows, system interactions, data exchanges, and cross-functional business processes in production-like environments.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive SIT test scenarios using validated requirements and customer business processes.
  • Verify integration behavior, interface compatibility, exception handling, and data consistency.
  • Coordinate testing activities with internal delivery teams, customers, and external implementation partners.
  • Produce SIT test reports documenting execution results, outstanding defects, resolution status, and readiness for customer UAT.
  • Ensure critical defects are resolved or appropriately dispositioned before recommending progression to UAT.

4. User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Leadership

  • Support customer UAT preparation, execution, defect management, and formal closeout.
  • Develop UAT testing templates, sample scenarios, and guidance to help customer teams execute meaningful business process testing.
  • Review customer-developed test cases for completeness, accuracy, and alignment with approved requirements.
  • Validate UAT environment readiness, including configuration deployments, test data, migrated records, permissions, and in-scope integrations.
  • Facilitate UAT readiness checkpoints and provide guidance on testing expectations, execution procedures, and defect reporting.
  • Coordinate defect triage with customers and delivery teams, including severity classification, prioritization, and resolution tracking.
  • Monitor UAT progress, testing coverage, defect trends, and risks to project milestones.
  • Prepare UAT summary reports documenting test execution, defect status, and completion of defined exit criteria.
  • Support formal UAT closeout and customer acceptance activities in coordination with Engagement Managers.

5. AI-Driven Testing & Automation

  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate test case generation, test script development, defect analysis, and regression testing.
  • Use AI to analyze requirements, user stories, and functional designs to identify missing scenarios, inconsistencies, and potential defects.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance automated testing frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, ACCELQ, or comparable solutions.
  • Build reusable automated test libraries for common community development workflows and application configurations.
  • Explore AI agents and intelligent automation to improve testing coverage, execution speed, and defect identification.
  • Apply AI-assisted techniques to generate realistic test data, validate expected outcomes, and identify testing gaps.
  • Evaluate AI-generated testing artifacts for accuracy, completeness, security, and alignment with approved requirements.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to incorporate automated testing into development and deployment processes.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual testing while maintaining strong quality standards.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Clariti's AI-enabled delivery and QA practices.

6. Integration & API Testing

  • Test integrations between Clariti solutions and external government systems, including GIS, payment processing, electronic plan review, document management, identity management, and other third-party applications.
  • Validate real-time and batch integrations against approved interface specifications.
  • Perform API testing using tools such as Postman, Newman, or comparable solutions.
  • Verify request and response structures, data transformations, error handling, negative scenarios, and exception processing.
  • Validate data synchronization, interface reliability, and cross-system consistency.
  • Coordinate testing and defect resolution with Delivery Architects, customer technical teams, and third-party vendors.
  • Identify integration dependencies and risks that could impact testing readiness or production deployment.

7. Data Migration & Conversion Testing

  • Develop and execute data migration validation plans aligned with approved mapping and conversion requirements.
  • Validate migrated data for completeness, accuracy, uniqueness, consistency, and referential integrity.
  • Perform source-to-target reconciliation, record count verification, and data sampling.
  • Verify field mappings, transformation rules, and converted data relationships.
  • Identify and document conversion defects, data inconsistencies, and mapping discrepancies.
  • Support multiple conversion cycles and validate corrective actions.
  • Assist with final production migration validation and post-deployment data reconciliation.
  • Collaborate with technical and functional teams to ensure converted data supports expected business processes.

8. Deployment, Release & Production Readiness

  • Support release quality assurance across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
  • Validate application deployments, configuration changes, and release packages.
  • Execute smoke and regression testing following deployments and environment updates.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD and release management processes.
  • Participate in go-live readiness assessments and identify outstanding quality risks.
  • Support mock cutover testing, rollback validation, and production deployment preparation.
  • Develop and execute production smoke testing plans following go-live.
  • Provide QA readiness recommendations based on test results, defect status, and established acceptance criteria.
  • Support post-go-live stabilization and validation of critical defect fixes.

9. Defect Management, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and maintain structured defect management processes using Jira, Azure DevOps, or comparable tools.
  • Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected versus actual results, environment details, and severity assessments.
  • Coordinate defect triage, prioritization, retesting, and closure across functional and technical teams.
  • Track and report quality metrics, including defect escape rates, test execution progress, automation coverage, and regression results.
  • Communicate testing progress, quality concerns, and delivery risks to Engagement Managers and Professional Services leadership.
  • Identify recurring defects and recommend improvements to requirements gathering, configuration design, and implementation practices.
  • Contribute to standardized QA templates, testing methodologies, reusable test libraries, and delivery best practices.
  • Promote a culture of proactive quality ownership and continuous improvement across Professional Services.

What Do You Bring to the Team?

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, enterprise application testing, or SaaS implementation testing.
  • Strong understanding of software development and implementation lifecycles, including Agile methodologies.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing comprehensive test plans across functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
  • Experience leading or supporting SIT and customer-facing UAT activities.
  • Experience testing complex, configurable enterprise applications and business workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, ACCELQ, or comparable tools.
  • Experience validating system integrations, APIs, and data exchanges.
  • Experience testing data migrations, including reconciliation, source-to-target validation, and data integrity checks.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, release management, and testing across multiple environments.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Ability to interpret business requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including preparation of formal test plans, defect reports, and testing deliverables.
  • Strong customer-facing communication and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Interest in applying AI and automation to improve testing effectiveness and efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing or testing GovTech, community development, permitting, licensing, or regulatory software.
  • Experience working with municipal, county, or state government customers.
  • Familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms and configuration-driven SaaS applications.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or other LLM-based solutions for software testing.
  • Experience developing AI-assisted test automation or agent-based testing workflows.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, database validation, and data transformation processes.
  • Experience testing GIS, electronic plan review, payment processing, document management, and identity management integrations.
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or comparable solutions.
  • Familiarity with security testing, role-based access controls, and enterprise application permissions.
  • Experience working with third-party implementation partners and system integrators.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing implementation deliverables and formal acceptance processes.

What Does Success Look Like?

A Implementation QA Specialist will help Clariti deliver more predictable, efficient, and higher-quality implementations by identifying defects earlier, validating complete business processes, and improving the consistency of testing across projects.

Key measures of success include:

  • Quality Improvement: Reduce defects discovered during customer UAT and following production deployment.
  • Testing Coverage: Ensure approved requirements, critical business processes, integrations, and acceptance criteria are adequately tested.
  • AI & Automation Adoption: Increase automated test coverage and reduce repetitive manual testing through AI-enabled tools.
  • Implementation Efficiency: Reduce rework, improve first-pass configuration quality, and accelerate testing cycles.
  • Release Readiness: Ensure testing milestones and quality gates are completed before customer-facing releases.
  • Customer Confidence: Improve customer UAT experiences through stronger preparation, clearer reporting, and more reliable software.
  • Continuous Improvement: Establish reusable testing assets and scalable QA standards across Professional Services.

What Makes This Role Different?

At Clariti, quality assurance is more than validating individual software features. It is about ensuring that government employees, citizens, contractors, and other stakeholders can successfully complete the business processes they depend on every day. You will combine traditional QA discipline with modern AI-assisted testing practices to help deliver complex community development solutions more efficiently and reliablyYour work will directly contribute to reducing implementation risk, improving customer satisfaction, accelerating delivery timelines, and strengthening the quality of Clariti's software implementations.

What's in It for You?

We invest in and empower our team members with competitive compensation packages, well deserved time off and benefits to keep you and your family healthy! *

💰 The base salary range for this role is expected to be between $88,000–$110,000 CAD CAD based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications while considering internal pay equity and our broader pay philosophy. 💰

If you have questions about compensation as we move through the process, we’re happy to discuss further.

*Benefits depend on employment type (full-time, part-time, contract, etc).

Things to Note 📝

Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation.

Travel- Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description.

We're committed to building an inclusive culture where our team members take ownership over projects, tasks, and outcomes; bring a growth mindset to drive continuous learning and self-development; have the ability to communicate courageously in a direct but respectful way; and are customer-focused by keeping the customer at the heart of decision-making. It’s the diversity of our team that helps us make better decisions, by leveraging the diversity in thought & experience across to create impactful solutions as we explore new paths & challenges as we grow. We’re working to create a workplace and team that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Questions? We are here to help

If you require accommodations in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in our hiring process for any reason, please direct your questions to and we’ll be happy to support you.

Description

L’équipe des services professionnels de Fresche Solutions est à la recherche d’un gestionnaire de produit très motivé et polyvalent pour définir la vision à long terme et la stratégie produit des expériences client infonuagiques (Cloud). Vous transformerez des capacités de services gérés d’infrastructure sur mesure ou récurrentes en offres standardisées, évolutives et reproductibles, assorties d’une portée claire, d’une tarification définie et de directives de livraison précises. En tant que gestionnaire de produit principal pour le Cloud, vous serez responsable de ce que vend notre pratique Cloud. Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’ambiguïté, toujours prêt à poser les questions difficiles, à remettre en question lorsque nécessaire et à mobiliser les équipes. En collaboration avec les équipes de livraison, de ventes, de marketing, d’opérations et d’ingénierie, vous équilibrerez la valeur client, les marges et l’efficacité opérationnelle à travers tout le portefeuille. Vous rejoindrez une équipe de bâtisseurs, de leaders produit et d’opérateurs de bout en bout qui fixent des standards élevés, ont à cœur la réussite des clients et investissent dans le développement mutuel.

Principales responsabilités

Structurer les offres et la tarification :

  • Identifier le travail livré de façon répétée, documenter les modèles reproductibles et les transformer en actifs réutilisables.
