jobs.excerpt: KI-Systeme bauen und betreiben, nicht präsentieren | Agentenplattformen, LLMs, MCP | Full Stack bis Cloud | deutschlandweit, hybrid oder remote Die meisten KI-Prototypen sterben zwischen Demo und Deployment.
jobs.description:
KI-Systeme bauen und betreiben, nicht präsentieren | Agentenplattformen, LLMs, MCP | Full Stack bis Cloud | deutschlandweit, hybrid oder remote

Die meisten KI-Prototypen sterben zwischen Demo und Deployment. Nicht am Modell – an Evals, Kosten, Latenz, Rechten und der Frage, wer den Betrieb übernimmt.

Das UNITY AI Booster Team
Das UNITY AI Booster Team ist UNITYs Entwicklereinheit für die Entwicklung und Implementierung von KI-Lösungen in den Geschäftsprozessen unserer Kunden. Wir entwickeln Lösungen mit hoher Technologiebandbreite, von Machine Learning Use Cases, LLM Use Cases oder eigenen Agentenplattformen. Anders als unsere Consultants sind wir näher am Code: Wir arbeiten im Projekt mit den Consultants und unserem Procurement X Team zusammen, bauen und betreiben aber die technische Plattform dahinter. Werde jetzt Teil des Teams!

Als AI Engineer * baust du diese Systeme mit. Vom ersten Prototyp bis zu dem Punkt, an dem sie beim Kunden laufen und du weißt, warum sie laufen.

Wir besetzen diese Stelle auf Junior- wie auf Senior-Level. Was sich unterscheidet, ist nicht die Rolle – sondern wie viel du davon allein verantwortest.

Das erwartet dich

  • Baue Agentic-AI-Systeme auf Basis von LLMs, Multi-Agent-Frameworks und Tool-Integration – mit LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen oder CrewAI, je nachdem, was das Problem verlangt.
  • Entwickle KI-Applikationen Full Stack: Backend-Logik, API-Design und die Oberfläche, mit der am Ende jemand arbeitet.
  • Bringe Use Cases von der Idee über den Prototyp bis in den produktiven Einsatz beim Kunden – inklusive Evaluation, Monitoring und der Entscheidung, wann ein Ansatz nicht trägt.
  • Betreibe, was du gebaut hast: RAG-Architekturen, Vektordatenbanken, MCP-Anbindungen, Deployment in AWS, Azure oder GCP.
  • Berate Fach- und IT-Abteilungen bei der Identifikation und Priorisierung von KI-Potenzialen und der Auswahl geeigneter Technologien– als Engineer, der weiß, was die Umsetzung kostet.
  • Baue Wissen auf, das bleibt:Entwicklungsmuster, Best Practices und Bausteine, die das nächste Projekt schneller machen.

Womit du arbeitest:Python, Node.js, React oder Vue, LangChain / LangGraph / AutoGen / CrewAI, MCP, Vektordatenbanken (Elasticsearch, pgvector), AWS / Azure / GCP, Container und Serverless-Deployments

Das bringst du mit

Must-have – auf Junior-Level:

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung KI-basierter Anwendungen mit Large Language Models– über das Bedienen von Chat-Oberflächen hinaus: Prompt Engineering, Tool Use, Agentic-Coding-Patterns wie ReAct oder Chain-of-Thought.
  • Du hast mindestens ein KI-System selbst gebaut – auch aus Studium, Werkstudium oder Nebenprojekt. Du kannst erklären, warum du welchen Ansatz gewählt hast und woran es fast gescheitert wäre.
  • Solide Full-Stack-Kompetenz: Backend (Python, Node.js o. ä.) und Frontend (React, Vue o. ä.) – du kannst eine vollständige KI-Applikation eigenständig aufbauen.
  • Grundverständnis von Cloud-Plattformen(AWS, Azure oder GCP) und vom Deployment über Container oder APIs.
  • Prägnanz in Kommunikation und Präsentation auf Deutsch (ab C1) und Englisch (ab B2).
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, KI oder mit vergleichbarem technischem Fokus.

Zusätzlich auf Senior-Level:

  • Mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung im Design und Betrieb produktiver AI-Systeme– inklusive RAG-Architekturen, Fine-Tuning und Evaluation von LLM-Pipelines. Über mindestens ein System kannst du eine Stunde lang ins Detail gehen.
  • Du triffst Architektur- und Modellentscheidungen anhand nachvollziehbarer Kriterien (Kosten, Latenz, Datenschutz, Wartbarkeit) und dokumentierst die Trade-offs.
    MLOps-Erfahrung: strukturierter Betrieb von KI-Modellen in Produktionsumgebungen, Monitoring, Kostenkontrolle.
  • Erfahrung mit MCP (Model Context Protocol), Vektordatenbanken (Elasticsearch, pgvector o. ä.) oder AI-Observability-Tools.
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Kunden-IT und Fachbereichen zusammen und übersetzt zwischen technischer Machbarkeit und fachlicher Erwartung.

Nice-to-have:

  • Erfahrung mit Data Governance oder mit dem EU AI Act und dessen Übersetzung in Architekturentscheidungen.
  • Beiträge zu Open-Source-Projekten im KI- oder Agenten-Umfeld.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Plattform-Bausteine statt reiner Projektlösungen.

Für wen diese Stelle nichts ist

  • Wenn du KI-Konzepte schreiben willst, ohne sie zu bauen: Bei uns ist das die Rolle der Consultants, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten – nicht unsere.
  • Wenn deine KI-Erfahrung im Wesentlichen aus Prompting und Tool-Evaluation besteht: Wir suchen Leute, die verstehen, was unter der Oberfläche passiert.
  • Wenn Forschung dein Ziel ist:Wir publizieren nicht, wir liefern. State of the Art nutzen wir, wir erweitern ihn nicht.
  • Wenn du bauen willst, ohne zu betreiben:Was du hier entwickelst, läuft danach – und du bist derjenige, der weiß, warum.

Warum das AI Booster Team & Über uns

  • Du bist näher am Code als in jeder Beratungsrolle.Wir sitzen im Projekt, aber unser Ergebnis ist laufende Software, keine Präsentation.
  • Du siehst deine Systeme im Einsatz.Wir bauen nicht auf Zuruf für einen anonymen Backlog, sondern für Kunden, deren Prozesse wir kennen – und begleiten die Lösung in den Betrieb.
  • Technologiebandbreite statt Monokultur: Machine Learning, LLM-Anwendungen und eigene Agentenplattformen – je nach Problem, nicht je nach Hausstandard.
  • Remote ist bei uns möglich, nicht nur geduldet: deutschlandweit, hybrid oder vollständig remote.
  • Weitere Benefits:Flexible Arbeitsmodelle · Sabbaticals · persönliches Coaching, Mentoring & UNITYacademy · JobRad, UrbanSports u. v. m. · Verwirklichung eigener Ideen und unternehmerischer Freiraum · Verwirkliche mit uns deine Big Five for Life**

Über uns

UNITY ist die Managementberatung für Innovation und digitale Transformation. Dabei setzen wir insbesondere auf Künstliche Intelligenz als Schlüsseltechnologie für Effizienz und Wachstum. Mit 380 Mitarbeitern sind wir weltweit an 15 Standorten vertreten und führen rund um den Globus Kundenprojekte durch.

Unsere Standorte,an denen du deutschlandweit arbeiten kannst: Berlin, Braunschweig, Frankfurt a. M., Hamburg, Köln, München, Nürnberg, Paderborn/Büren oder Stuttgart.

Bewirb dich jetzt mit wenigen Klicks. Du findest mehrere Stellen interessant? Einmal bewerben reicht: Dein Können wird für alle Stellen geprüft.

* UNITY lebt Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit. Bei uns ist jeder unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Handicap, Religion und Alter willkommen.
** Die Big5forLife sind ein Coaching-Impuls aus dem Bereich der individuellen Visions-Bildung von John Strelecky...

jobs.description:
Cloud Security Specialist/Consultant

12 month contract

Remote

Maximum budget R120 000 per month

Executive Summary

Netsurit is seeking a contractor to fulfil a Cloud Security Specialist/Consultant role for one of our clients. The ideal candidate will have hands‑on expertise across major cloud platforms—particularly AWS and Microsoft Azure—to secure, govern, architect, and optimize enterprise cloud environments.

The role requires strong cloud security and cloud enablement capabilities, including solution architecture, governance, cybersecurity, risk management, and secure‑by‑design implementation. Experience in AI security and DevSecOps practices will be considered an advantage. The resource should be able to provide both strategic advisory services and hands‑on delivery within large‑scale enterprise environments.

Core Technical & Delivery Requirements

1. Cloud Expertise

  • Deep hands-on expertise across Cloud platforms, including but not limited to Amazon web services, Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong understanding of how Cloud technologies integrate across identity, collaboration, security, infrastructure, and data platforms.
  • Ability to architect, optimize, and implement solutions leveraging the Cloud capabilities to support business, operational, compliance, and security objectives.
  • Proven experience in cloud configuration, governance, administration, security hardening, and adoption enablement.

2. Security-Driven Delivery, Governance & Cybersecurity

  • Strong understanding of enterprise security principles, cybersecurity frameworks, governance models, and secure-by-design methodologies.
  • Ability to embed security controls, compliance requirements, identity governance, risk mitigation, and operational security into all solution designs.
  • Experience in driving security maturity improvements across cloud, identity, collaboration, infrastructure, endpoint security, and data protection.
  • Ability to identify vulnerabilities, security gaps, compliance concerns, and remediation opportunities.

3. AI Security

  • Securing AI/ML systems and pipelines
  • Familiarity with security frameworks such OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, Mitre ATLAS
  • Managing risks such as:
  • Model poisoning
  • Data leakage
  • Prompt injection
  • Implementing governance and controls for AI usage
  • Experience with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry

4. DevSecOps

  • Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines
  • Use tooling such as:
  • SAST / DAST / SCA
  • Container security solutions
  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) scanning
  • Promote shift-left security practices

5. Solution Design, Architecture & Implementation

  • Demonstrated ability to assess business requirements, design scalable enterprise solutions, and lead end-to-end implementation.
  • Capability to translate functional and technical requirements into secure, sustainable, and fit-for-purpose architectures.
  • Experience across the full solution lifecycle including discovery, planning, architecture, build, testing, deployment, transition, support, optimization, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to provide both strategic solutioning and hands-on implementation support.

6. Cyber Risk Management

  • Demonstrated experience in cyber risk identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting across enterprise environments.
  • Ability to evaluate security threats, vulnerabilities, operational risks, and business impacts across cloud, infrastructure, endpoints, identity, and data environments.
  • Experience implementing risk-based security controls, remediation strategies, and continuous monitoring processes.
  • Strong understanding of cyber risk frameworks, governance models, compliance obligations, and audit readiness.
  • Ability to align cyber risk management practices with broader enterprise risk, business continuity, disaster recovery, and security strategies.
  • Experience in reducing organizational exposure through proactive risk assessments, threat prioritization, and security improvement initiatives.

Professional Competencies & Ways of Working

7. Methodical & Structured Approach

  • Demonstrated ability to work in a disciplined, structured, and methodical manner.
  • Strong planning, prioritization, documentation, governance, and execution capabilities.
  • Ability to consistently follow delivery frameworks, security standards, and quality assurance processes.

8. Attention to Detail

  • High degree of precision, diligence, and accuracy across analysis, architecture, implementation, validation, and documentation.
  • Ability to proactively identify risks, dependencies, security concerns, configuration issues, compliance gaps, and operational impacts.
  • Strong quality focus ensuring alignment with technical, regulatory, security, and business requirements.

9. Problem Solving & Strategic Thinking

  • Ability to assess complex technical, operational, and cyber-related challenges and provide practical, scalable, and secure recommendations.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, cloud, identity, security, and risk domains.
  • Ability to align technical and security decisions with long-term business resilience and operational strategy.

10. Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills across business, architecture, operations, security, compliance, and risk teams.
  • Ability to facilitate workshops, gather requirements, provide advisory guidance, and drive alignment across multiple workstreams.
  • Experience working within enterprise, cross-functional, and governance-heavy environments.

11. Documentation, Governance & Knowledge Transfer

  • Ability to produce high-quality architecture documents, implementation plans, risk registers, security documentation, operational runbooks, support documentation, and governance artefacts.
  • Strong documentation discipline and attention to detail.
  • Commitment to knowledge transfer, handover, operational sustainability, and support readiness.

12. Proven Experience & Certifications

  • Resources must demonstrate proven experience delivering enterprise-scale cloud, AI, endpoint security, cyber risk management, and infrastructure transformation initiatives.
  • Relevant certifications in Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Security, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, AI, or Enterprise Architecture will be considered advantageous.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer — Python, Temporal & AI Workflows (US)
Technoidentity — Durable Product Engineering®
What’s in it for You?
You'll build internal apps, AI workflows, AI agents, and backend integrations powering Finance and Supply Chain operations for a Tier-1 client. The work spans Python services, React front-ends, API and enterprise integrations, and Temporal-based durable workflows — plus production support for what you ship. Senior Full Stack AI Engineer

Location: Remote (Canada)

Team: Product & Engineering (Lending or Wealth)

Type: Full-time

Compensation: $115,000 - $175,000 Base Salary + Bonus + Meaningful Equity

About Orion Digital

Orion Digital Corp (NASDAQ/TSX: ORIO) is a publicly listed Canadian fintech operating a multi-engine financial platform spanning lending (Mogo), payments (Carta), and wealth (Intelligent Investing).

We have moved past the traditional fintech model. Capital allocation, decisioning, and risk management sit at the core of how the business creates value, and AI runs as an enabling layer across the platform rather than as a standalone product narrative. That layer is real and in use, and the work now is making it faster, safer, and harder to break.

Lending or Wealth

This role is open to both of our product engineering teams. Depending on your background and where the business needs you, you will join one of them. Let us know which interests you more when you apply.

  • Lending (Mogo): consumer credit products, including onboarding, credit decisioning, repayments and customer support, using AI to improve decisions and personalization over time.
  • Wealth (Intelligent Investing): a self-directed and managed investing platform built on value-investing principles, with AI-native flows that help investors act on discipline rather than impulse.

Both teams work to the same engineering standard and the same expectations for ownership of what ships.

The Role: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer

We're looking for a product-minded engineer who can:

  • Move fast like a startup dev
  • Architect and ship production-grade systems
  • Build LLM-native, intelligent workflows
  • Set technical direction as Orion evolves into an AI-first platform

You’ll drive development across backend systems and LLM agent orchestration, contributing to features that are AI-assisted, adaptive, and continuously improving, with human oversight where it matters. You will own systems rather than single features, work through ambiguous problems that span services and teams, set technical direction, and raise the quality bar for the engineers around you.

What You’ll Build

  • Production-Grade AI Systems
    Deploy and maintain LLM-powered systems in production environments with clear SLAs, observability, and fallback strategies. Focus on scalability, latency, throughput, and reliability to ensure AI services deliver real business value.
  • AI-Native Workflows
    Design and ship agent-based flows across onboarding, support, credit decisioning, payments, and investing. You'll help build a self-serve credit experience that gets smarter with every user interaction, improving decisioning, repayments, and personalization through intelligence. Work cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Compliance to ensure these flows drive real outcomes and align with regulatory standards.
  • LLM Integrations
    Work with OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, and other tools to build intelligent experiences. These include LLM-powered education tools and conversational interfaces that guide users through investing and credit decisions. Participate in architectural design discussions that center on securely and efficiently integrating LLM systems into production environments. Stay current with the latest AI advancements and evaluate emerging tools and frameworks that can advance our product.
  • End-to-End Features
    Develop full stack features with real impact, from backend APIs and microservices in Node.js/TypeScript to intelligent frontends in React or React Native, supporting personalized, AI-powered finance journeys. Champion best practices in testing, deployment, and code quality through modern development workflows (TDD, CI/CD, AI-driven testing).
  • Backend Services
    Own and evolve TypeScript and Node.js services built as event-driven microservices on RabbitMQ and AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambda), with MySQL, Postgres and Redis, deployed to Kubernetes through ArgoCD and monitored in Datadog. Make the architecture calls, from service boundaries to data models, and keep the system simple enough to run.
  • Automation With Guardrails
    Replace manual ops with AI-assisted automation built with guardrails, observability, and rollback, especially for anything that moves money. Your work will enable a high-performance fintech operation that’s lean, scalable, and safe to run.
  • Scalable Intelligence
    Architect systems for continuous learning, observability, and performance. Define and monitor AI performance metrics to assess model behavior, user impact, and long-term value. Your solutions will support both a smarter lending platform and a next-generation investing experience grounded in value-investing principles and real-time data.
  • The Craft That Earns Trust
    Keeping money moving correctly, from order and repayment lifecycles to reconciliation against partner and custodian files and statements. At senior level you own correctness end to end and set the standard for how the team proves it.
  • Ownership of Security, Data, and Incidents
    Own security and PII handling in the systems you build, and take real ownership of on-call and incident response, from first alert to a clear post-incident review.
  • Architecture and Technical Direction
    Own architecture decisions and the reliability targets behind them, including build-versus-buy calls, and lead design reviews that leave the team with clearer, simpler systems. Take broadly defined, ambiguous problems and turn them into plans others can execute.
  • AI-Optimized Engineering Practices
    Contribute to a culture of technical excellence by participating in code reviews, owning the quality bar and developing Intermediate and Junior engineers, including mentoring them in AI-native engineering approaches, and continuously raising the bar for scalable, intelligent development.

What You’ll Need

  • 6+ years of experience as a full stack or backend engineer
  • A record of owning production systems end to end with little direction, and of showing that your changes moved the outcome they were meant to move
  • Strong skills in Node.js, TypeScript, and MySQL or Postgres
  • Experience building and deploying LLM-based applications using OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, etc.
  • Comfort with AI workflows like prompt chaining, embeddings, RAG, or vector search
  • Fluent with AI coding tools: you write clear specs, critically review AI-generated code, and set the standard for how your team uses them
  • Experience with React/React Native to build intelligent frontends
  • Experience optimizing LLM latency, cost, and reliability in production is a strong plus
  • Experience with cloud-native tooling and infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes via ArgoCD, AWS Lambda, SQS/SNS, Datadog)
  • Reliable batch and event-driven processing, system design, and test-driven development
  • Bonus: Exposure to Python for AI scripting or LangChain workflows
  • Bonus: Experience with Ruby/Rails (a strong plus for Lending) or serverless AWS (Lambda, SQS/SNS)

Who Thrives Here

  • You have a deep curiosity about AI’s evolving landscape and enjoy staying on the frontier of tools and techniques
  • You mentor others and elevate your team through thoughtful feedback, shared learning, and technical clarity
  • You treat AI as part of how the work gets done, and hold it to a high standard
  • You move quickly in small, safe steps and measure the outcome of every change
  • You’re excited by 10x impact, not 10% improvements
  • You want to own outcomes, not just write code
  • You have a growth mindset and a builder’s DNA

How We Hire

  1. Intro screen: a conversation about your background and what you want to work on.
  2. Technical interview: a practical exercise in the stack above.
  3. Team conversation: meet the engineers you would work with.

Let’s Build the Future Together

AI is real and in use at Orion, and the work now is making it faster, safer, and harder to break.

If you want to be part of a fast-moving, high-performing team that's using AI to redefine what a fintech can be, apply now.

You'll think about how a smart contract design decision ripples outward, to the web app, to the teams operating the system day to day, and ultimately to our end users. You'll collaborate with product, legal, compliance, web, and ops to make sure contracts are technically sound, regulatorily aligned, and genuinely operable by the teams who rely on them day to day.   • Tooling & Automation: Build tooling and automated systems that let non-technical teammates safely view, monitor, and manage contracts without writing scripts or touching raw chain operations directly.

  • Python and/or TypeScript experience preferred (for building tooling and automation).
  • Strong technical grasp and excellent judgment on task prioritization.
  • Strong emphasis on understanding the "why" behind requirements and a commitment to defining the "minimum scope."

What we offer

Requirements

jobs.description:
CloudLinux and TuxCare ship operating system updates, security patches and software libraries to servers at hosting companies and enterprises around the world. Every one of those servers reaches us through a chain of package repositories, mirrors, a CDN and artifact registries. When that chain fails, our customers cannot install or patch, and their own customers notice.

Learn more about CloudLinux:

Learn more about TuxCare:

We're looking for a Staff-level Engineer to bring our global software distribution infrastructure to 99.99% availability. You'll join a small, hands-on team where you own the solutions you design and build.

We work without a shift rota. Engineers respond directly to critical failures in the services they own, with a focus on eliminating root causes rather than repeatedly fighting fires.

You will be responsible for

  • Own the reliability of the delivery path end to end: publishing, mirror synchronisation, mirror lists, DNS load balancing, CDN, authentication and artifact registries.
  • Define service level objectives and measure them from the customer's side, with synthetic clients in several regions that do what a real package manager does.
  • Build detection that finds a customer-visible failure within two minutes, and alerts that people act on. Remove the noise.
  • Design automatic failover and one-step mitigations, so that customers are served again within ten minutes of an alert.
  • Make publishing and planned work safe: consistent metadata, staged rollouts, changes gated by outside checks.
  • Write the software this needs in Go or Python: probes, health checkers, sync and failover tooling.
  • Lead incident reviews and turn each one into a fix for every service that shares the weakness.
  • Raise the practice of the team through runbooks, recovery drills and review.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • Staff or Principal-level experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or infrastructure engineering.
  • 8+ years of experience in infrastructure, SRE, or software engineering, including at least 4 years of direct ownership of the reliability of a high-traffic distributed service.
  • Proven experience bringing a globally distributed, high-traffic service to 99.99% availability (four nines), with the ability to explain how it was achieved.
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale content or software distribution systems, such as game patch and content delivery, CDNs, package registries, OS distributions, streaming platforms, or app stores.
  • Deep knowledge of HTTP, DNS, TLS, caching, CDN behaviour, load balancing, and Linux in production environments.
  • Practical experience with SLOs, error budgets, and observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus-style metrics, Loki, or similar).
  • Experience leading production incident response, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving post-incident improvements.
  • Strong hands-on coding skills in Python for building infrastructure tooling, automation, and reliability solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform and configuration management tools.
  • Strong written English communication skills.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with RPM and DEB repositories and an understanding of how package management clients (dnf, yum, and apt) behave.
  • Experience with Sonatype Nexus or another artifact registry at scale.
  • Experience with global traffic management and content delivery at scale, including DNS-based load balancing with health checks, multi-origin failover, CDN caching, and purge behaviour.
  • Experience with rsync-based mirroring, distributed filesystems, and object storage.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • The opportunity to shape the reliability of a global software distribution infrastructure, with technical autonomy, end-to-end ownership, and a direct impact on customers worldwide.
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
  • Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
  • Compensation for private medical insurance.
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
  • Budget for education.
  • The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.

The opportunity

We're seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer who views infrastructure as a product and operational excellence as an engineering discipline. You'll take end-to-end ownership of the cloud platforms, deployment systems, observability, automation, and infrastructure that enable TechnologyAdvice engineers to deliver reliable software quickly and safely.

As an individual contributor on our distributed team, you'll independently identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, security, cost efficiency, developer experience, and operational effectiveness. You'll own initiatives from problem discovery and architecture through implementation, rollout, measurement, documentation, and ongoing improvement. You'll make sound technical decisions with minimal direction, even when problems are ambiguous or established solutions don't exist.

This is not a role focused solely on responding to tickets or keeping existing infrastructure running. We expect our Senior DevOps Engineers to understand where operational friction exists, identify recurring problems that should be engineered away, challenge unnecessary complexity, and proactively improve how TechnologyAdvice builds and operates software.

AI-assisted engineering is an expected part of how we work. You'll use modern AI tools to accelerate infrastructure development, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, incident investigation, and operational analysis while applying the systems judgment necessary to evaluate technical correctness, security, and operational risks before they affect production.

Success in this role isn't measured by the number of infrastructure tickets completed or alerts resolved. It's measured by improvements in system reliability, engineering velocity, operational efficiency, security, cost effectiveness, and your ability to independently identify and deliver high-value platform improvements.

Employment Level: Pro 4 - Senior

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines

Working Hours: 4 PM to 1 AM PHT

What you'll do

  • Own and continuously improve the cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities that support TechnologyAdvice's applications, data systems, and engineering teams.
  • Independently identify opportunities to improve system reliability, scalability, security, performance, cost efficiency, developer experience, and operational effectiveness.
  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable cloud infrastructure using modern infrastructure-as-code and cloud-native engineering practices.
  • Engineer away repetitive operational work by building automation, self-service capabilities, reusable infrastructure patterns, and platform tooling.
  • Improve Kubernetes and container-based infrastructure to make application deployment, scaling, recovery, and operations increasingly standardized and reliable.
  • Own and evolve CI/CD and GitOps workflows that allow engineers to ship changes quickly, consistently, and safely.
  • Partner directly with Software Engineers, Product Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and other Technology teams to understand operational friction and build platform solutions that increase engineering leverage.
  • Improve observability across applications and infrastructure through effective monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards, and actionable service health indicators.
  • Lead technical investigation during complex production incidents, diagnose root causes across interconnected systems, restore services safely, and implement preventive improvements.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve resilience, disaster recovery, backup strategies, security controls, access management, and infrastructure risk.
  • Evaluate cloud infrastructure and architecture for cost efficiency and proactively identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary spend without compromising reliability or engineering effectiveness.
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering practices to accelerate infrastructure development, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, automation, documentation, and operational workflows while maintaining rigorous standards for production safety.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and long-term platform strategy, balancing immediate business needs with reliability, security, scalability, simplicity, and maintainability.
  • Define, document, and champion engineering standards, operational practices, reusable patterns, and platform capabilities that improve how TechnologyAdvice Engineering operates.
  • Mentor other engineers and help raise the organization's standards for infrastructure ownership, automation, reliability, and operational excellence.

Who you are

Ownership & Engineering Impact

  • Demonstrated ability to independently identify infrastructure and operational problems, determine their root causes, design solutions, and drive improvements through implementation and measurable results.
  • Proven track record of owning business-critical production infrastructure and complex platform initiatives with minimal oversight, including responsibility for major technical decisions and production outcomes.
  • Strong bias toward eliminating recurring operational work through automation, platform improvements, and systemic fixes rather than repeated manual intervention.
  • Strong judgment in balancing reliability, security, engineering velocity, cost, complexity, and business needs when making infrastructure decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve the effectiveness of other engineers through better platforms, tooling, automation, documentation, and self-service capabilities.
  • Ability to operate effectively during production incidents while maintaining clear communication, disciplined investigation, and ownership through resolution and follow-up.

AI-Native DevOps Engineering

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to improve infrastructure development, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, incident analysis, and engineering productivity.
  • Strong systems and architectural judgment to critically evaluate AI-generated infrastructure, scripts, configurations, troubleshooting recommendations, and operational changes before applying them to production environments.
  • Curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and how they can improve infrastructure operations, observability, incident response, developer experience, and engineering leverage.

DevOps & Platform Engineering Excellence

  • Deep experience designing, operating, troubleshooting, and improving highly available production systems in cloud environments.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, containerization, and modern cloud-native infrastructure, including troubleshooting production issues involving workloads, nodes, networking, and resource constraints.
  • Strong experience designing and managing infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, OpenTofu, or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, GitOps, automated deployment practices, and modern software delivery workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience improving production observability through monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and incident-management practices.
  • Strong understanding of reliability engineering, including failure modes, resilience, capacity, recovery, and operational risk.
  • Experience implementing secure infrastructure patterns, access controls, secrets management, system hardening, and other cloud security practices.
  • Strong Linux and systems troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex problems across applications, containers, networks, infrastructure, and cloud services.

Technology Stack

  • Our environment includes AWS, Cloudflare, Kubernetes/EKS, Docker, Terraform/OpenTofu, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Datadog, Linux, Python/Bash, networking and application-delivery technologies (DNS, CDN/WAF, load balancing, TLS), and data systems such as MySQL, Redis, and Redshift.
  • Exact experience with every tool isn't required. We prioritize production ownership, engineering fundamentals, systems judgment, and the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain infrastructure risks, incidents, architectural decisions, and technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with Software Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Product, Security, and other teams while maintaining clear ownership of platform outcomes.
  • Self-driven, highly autonomous, and comfortable operating in a remote-first environment while managing competing priorities and consistently delivering results.
  • Ability to challenge existing approaches constructively, influence technical direction, and advocate for improvements based on business impact rather than technology preference.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, share knowledge, and raise engineering standards across a team.

Our DevOps Engineering Philosophy at TechnologyAdvice

  • We engineer away toil — Repetitive operational work is a signal that something can be improved. We automate recurring tasks, build reusable capabilities, and continuously reduce the amount of manual intervention required to operate our systems.
  • We own reliability — Reliability isn't someone else's responsibility, and incident resolution isn't complete when the alert stops. We understand root causes, improve the system, and reduce the likelihood and impact of future failures.
  • We build platforms, not bottlenecks — DevOps should make engineers more capable, not create another queue they have to wait in. We invest in self-service capabilities, reusable patterns, automation, and guardrails that allow teams to move quickly and safely.
  • We embrace AI — We expect thoughtful use of AI-powered tools to accelerate infrastructure development, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, incident analysis, and operational work while maintaining rigorous standards for security, reliability, and production safety.
  • We automate with judgment — Automation isn't valuable simply because something can be automated. We prioritize the problems where automation creates meaningful improvements in reliability, engineering velocity, cost, or operational efficiency.
  • We optimize for outcomes — We measure success by healthier systems and more effective engineering teams—not infrastructure tickets completed. Reliability, deployment speed, recovery time, operational toil, security, cost, and developer experience are all outcomes we can improve.
  • We design for failure — Production systems will eventually fail. We build observable, resilient systems with appropriate redundancy, recovery strategies, backups, and operational practices so failures are detected quickly and have limited impact.
  • We continuously improve — Infrastructure is never finished. We challenge unnecessary complexity, modernize systems thoughtfully, reduce technical debt, evaluate emerging capabilities, and leave the platform better than we found it.

**The duties and responsibilities listed above describe the post as it is in general terms and are not definitive. The job holder is expected to accept any reasonable alterations that may from time to time be necessary.**

What we offer you

  • Career Growth: Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives.
  • Flex Fridays: Adjust your 40-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays.
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from the comfort of your home.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 14 days of annual paid time off, plus all regular Philippine government-declared holidays to unwind and recharge. Plus 5 additional days after 1 year.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: Full enrollment in Philippine statutory benefits: SSS, PhilHealth, and HDMF.
  • Healthcare: Corporate HMO Plan for all full-time PH employees upon completion of two months of tenure.
  • De Minimis Allowance: Enjoy a monthly rice subsidy, following government guidelines.
  • Wellness Perks: Access the Headspace app to support your well-being.
  • Speaker Series Bonus: Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus.

Work authorization

Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the Philippines at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the Philippines throughout their employment with our company.

Salary Range
We seek to hire top-tier individuals and intend for our compensation to be at a rate that allows us to recruit and retain individuals who align with our core values, purpose, mission, and vision. Final total compensation is based on a multitude of factors including, but not limited to, skill level, relevant experience to the position, and cost of labor.

Monthly Pay Range
₱120,000—₱175,000 PHP

EOE statement

We believe that our differences make us stronger, and thus foster a diverse and inclusive culture where people feel safe being themselves. TechnologyAdvice is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law.

Pre-employment screening required.

TechnologyAdvice does not engage with external staffing agencies. Any candidates introduced by such firms will not be eligible for compensation. We never recruit via Teams, WhatsApp, or similar apps, and we will never request money, gift cards, or personal financial details during hiring.

Azure Senior Cloud Infrastructure Consultant

Location: Johannesburg preferred

Work arrangement: Remote

Salary: R110 000 – R120 000 per month

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Cloud Infrastructure Consultant to design, implement and maintain secure, scalable and resilient cloud solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform.

You will work closely with clients, project teams and developers to architect complex Azure environments, optimise existing solutions and advise on the most appropriate cloud technologies. This role requires deep expertise across Azure infrastructure, networking, databases, security, automation and application architecture.

You will also champion DevOps and DevSecOps practices, contribute to data engineering initiatives and explore how AI can improve operational efficiency within Azure environments.

Key responsibilities

Azure architecture and infrastructure

  • Architect secure, scalable and highly available Azure environments across compute, storage, networking and database services.
  • Design Azure networking solutions that support high availability and disaster recovery.
  • Interpret existing solution architectures and recommend improvements to reliability, recoverability, monitoring, security and cost efficiency.
  • Advise development teams on the most suitable Azure technologies for application performance, scalability and resilience.
  • Support hybrid-cloud integrations between Azure and on-premises environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex Azure networking configurations, including VPNs, DNS, load balancers and firewalls.

Security and compliance

  • Develop and enforce cloud security and compliance policies.
  • Implement security controls using Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud and related Azure security services.
  • Collaborate with security teams to identify, manage and mitigate cloud risks.
  • Apply data governance and lifecycle-management principles to Azure solutions.
  • Develop controls to secure AI agents operating within client environments.

DevOps and automation

  • Automate the deployment, scaling and management of Azure resources.
  • Implement infrastructure as code using Bicep and ARM templates, with Terraform experience advantageous.
  • Champion DevOps and DevSecOps practices across client and project environments.
  • Use PowerShell, Python or similar scripting languages to automate infrastructure and operational tasks.

Data and AI

  • Provide technical guidance on databases, data warehousing and data engineering initiatives.
  • Work with Azure data technologies such as Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Explore and implement AI-driven automation for operational tasks.

Consulting and leadership

  • Lead client workshops and project meetings to gather requirements and drive implementations.
  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear, stakeholder-friendly recommendations.
  • Mentor junior team members on Azure technologies and cloud best practices.
  • Maintain accurate technical and environmental documentation.
  • Support presales activities, including solution design, cost estimation, competitive analysis and client demonstrations.

Minimum requirements

  • At least 7 years' experience implementing or administering Microsoft technologies.
  • At least 3 years' hands-on experience implementing Microsoft Azure solutions across multiple resource types beyond virtual machines.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing secure, scalable Azure environments.
  • Strong infrastructure, networking and database expertise.
  • Advanced knowledge of Azure application architecture and service dependencies.
  • Experience with Azure networking, high availability and disaster-recovery solutions.
  • Practical experience with Azure DevOps, automation and DevSecOps methodologies.
  • Experience using Bicep and ARM templates for Azure deployments.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working with hybrid-cloud environments and on-premises integrations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong client-facing consulting, workshop facilitation and presentation experience.

Required Azure certifications

Applicants must hold the following certifications:

  • AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate
  • AZ-305: Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert

Advantageous certifications

  • AZ-204: Microsoft Azure Developer Associate
  • AZ-400: Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions
  • AZ-500: Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate
  • AZ-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
  • AI-102: Designing and Implementing a Microsoft Azure AI Solution
  • DP-100: Microsoft Azure Data Scientist Associate
  • DP-203: Data Engineering on Microsoft Azure
  • DP-600: Implementing Analytics Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
  • SC-100: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect
  • SC-200: Microsoft Security Operations Analyst Associate
  • SC-300: Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator
  • SC-400: Microsoft Information Protection and Compliance Administrator
  • A diploma or degree in IT Engineering, Computer Science or a related field would be advantageous.

If you are an experienced Azure consultant who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, advising clients and building secure, future-ready cloud environments, we would like to hear from you.

Artificial Intelligence Innovation:

Join Netsurit at the forefront of AI transformation—where technology meets ambition. Help us design, implement, and scale intelligent solutions that empower our clients to automate processes, uncover insights, and accelerate growth. Leverage tools like Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, and custom machine learning models to turn data into meaningful business outcomes. jobs.description:
At Hugging Face, we're on a journey to democratize good AI. We are building the fastest growing platform for AI builders with over 20 million users who collectively shared over 4 million models, 1 million datasets & 1.5 million apps. Our open-source libraries have more than 700,000 stars on Github.

About the Role

Hugging Face hosts millions of models, datasets and Spaces, and serves a very large community of developers. With that scale comes automated abuse: fake accounts, scraping, spam, and bots gaming downloads, likes and trending signals. We're building a small, dedicated bot-detection effort inside our Trust & Safety team, and we're looking for an engineer to own the data and modeling side of it.

You'll turn large volumes of traffic, account and behavioral data into reliable decisions about what is human, what is automated, and what is abusive. You'll work hand-in-hand with our signals-focused bot-detection engineer, from raw telemetry all the way to production detection and enforcement.

What you'll do

  • Build and run detection pipelines on large-scale traffic and activity data (requests, sessions, accounts, repo interactions, API usage)
  • Develop and deploy detection models and heuristics: anomaly detection, clustering of coordinated activity, graph-based approaches, supervised classifiers where labels exist
  • Define features from client and network signals together with the signals engineer, and measure how robust they are as attackers adapt
  • Build the feedback loops: labeling, evaluation, false-positive monitoring, dashboards, alerting
  • Investigate live campaigns end-to-end (fake account waves, metric inflation, large-scale scraping) and turn what you learn into durable detections
  • Keep things proportionate and privacy-respecting, and minimize impact on legitimate users and automated-but-legitimate workloads (CI, research crawlers, integrations)

Requirements

  • You have strong experience applying data science or ML to adversarial problems in production: bot detection, fraud, abuse, spam, security analytics or similar
  • You're fluent in Python and SQL, and comfortable with large-scale data tooling (Spark, ClickHouse, BigQuery, or similar)
  • You've taken models or detection logic from exploration to production and kept them working over time
  • You understand web traffic and network data well enough to reason about what a signal really means and how it can be spoofed
  • You think in terms of precision/recall trade-offs, attacker adaptation and operational cost, not just offline metrics
  • You're pragmatic, autonomous, and you enjoy working closely with one or two people in a fast-moving team

Nice to have

  • Published work on bot detection, web measurement or adversarial ML (a PhD is welcome but not required, as long as you want your work running in prod)
  • Experience with graph analytics or streaming detection
  • Familiarity with the ML/open-source ecosystem and the Hugging Face Hub

One more thing

At Hugging Face we believe great AI shouldn't require a massive cluster, we build for everyone, especially the GPU-poor. And because we read every application, here's a small sign that you read this one too: start your answer to the first application question with the words “GPU-poor and proud 🤗”. No trick, no catch, it just tells us a real person is on the other side.

Benefits

More about Hugging Face

We are actively working to build a culture that values diversity, equity, and inclusivity. We are intentionally building a workplace where people feel respected and supported—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We believe this is foundational to building a great company and community. Hugging Face is an equal opportunity employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We value development. You will work with some of the smartest people in our industry. We are an organization that has a bias for impact and is always challenging ourselves to continuously grow. We provide all employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education.

We care about your well-being. We offer flexible working hours and remote options. We offer health, dental, and vision benefits for employees and their dependents. We also offer parental leave and flexible paid time off.

We support our employees wherever they are. While we have office spaces in NYC and Paris, we're very distributed and all remote employees have the opportunity to visit our offices. If needed, we'll also outfit your workstation to ensure you succeed.

We want our teammates to be shareholders. All employees have company equity as part of their compensation package. If we succeed in becoming a category-defining platform in machine learning and artificial intelligence, everyone enjoys the upside.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing multimodal agents with a focus on real-world, interactive deployment. Your work will span the full agent development lifecycle - from data curation, interactive sandbox environments, and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building multimodal agentic models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy locally at scale.

You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating perception, reasoning, and tool execution across digital environments, applying state-of-the-art research to improve visual grounding, multi-step task completion, and adaptability to unseen interfaces. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly.

You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal agentic AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on multimodal agentic models capable of perceiving, reasoning, and acting across real-world digital environments - including desktop operating systems, web browsers, and mobile devices.

  • Design and scale post-training and online reinforcement learning pipelines (SFT, multi-turn GRPO/PPO) across multi-node GPU infrastructure, covering asynchronous rollouts, reward design, deterministic/learned verifiers, and safeguards against reward hacking.

  • Architect high-concurrency interactive sandboxes (VMs, containers, and emulators) with fast snapshotting, deterministic resets, and reproducible evaluation frameworks to measure multi-step task completion and visual grounding.

  • Build and optimize local agentic harnesses that coordinate multi-model orchestration, memory, planning, and cross-device task execution.

  • Research and implement test-time adaptation and continual learning methods to enable rapid generalization to unseen applications and dynamic user interfaces.

  • Develop scalable multimodal agentic datasets, including synthetic trajectory generation, fine-grained UI grounding, and automated trajectory filtering and verification.

  • Drive model efficiency and local deployability on consumer hardware via knowledge distillation, quantization, and runtime optimization without degrading grounding or reasoning accuracy.

  • Translate frontier multimodal agentic research into production improvements, contribute to open-source ecosystems, and publish findings in top-tier AI conferences where applicable.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (MS/PhD preferred), or equivalent practical research and engineering experience.

  • Strong hands-on experience training or post-training multimodal/vision-language models (SFT, distillation, or online RL such as GRPO/PPO) with measurable gains on agentic, visual grounding, or reasoning benchmarks.

  • Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and distributed training or high-throughput rollout/inference infrastructure (e.g., FSDP/Megatron, Slurm, verl, vLLM/SGLang).

  • Deep hands-on in one or more of: online agentic RL & verifiers, high-concurrency OS/browser/mobile sandboxing, local agentic harnesses or test-time adaptation.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

jobs.description:
About the role

This is a hands-on senior role. You will write the core code, set the engineering standard for how we build agents, and work directly with clients to turn their workflows into acceptance criteria an agent can be tested against.

If you have shipped a LangGraph system to production and can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it, we want to talk to you.

What you'll build

The runtime

  • Design and build reusable agent runtimes in Python on LangGraph and LangChain, with clean interfaces for models, tools, memory, and integrations.

  • Build stateful workflows with conditional routing, parallel branches, subgraphs, and human approval steps. Add multiple agents only when evaluation results justify the complexity.

Reliability

  • Implement durable checkpointing, pause and resume, timeouts, and cancellation.

  • Make retries safe with idempotency keys, deduplication, and reconciliation when the outcome of an external action is unknown.

Tools, context, and memory

  • Build tool integrations with validated schemas, scoped permissions, authentication, and structured error handling across enterprise APIs and data systems.

  • Engineer context and memory: retrieval, summarization, context selection, token budgets, retention, and tenant isolation.

Evaluation and observability

  • Build evaluation datasets and automated checks for business outcomes, tool-use correctness, policy compliance, and recovery, allowing for valid alternative execution paths.

  • Gate every model, prompt, tool, and graph change on regression results.

  • Instrument agents with LangSmith or equivalent tracing, then use traces to improve task success, latency, and cost per completed workflow.

Security

  • Implement prompt-injection defenses, authorization checks, secrets handling, audit trails, and approval controls for sensitive actions. Sandbox code execution where required.

Delivery and leadership

  • Own production delivery with backend and platform teams: APIs, streaming, containers, CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, and runbooks.

  • Review code, mentor engineers, and translate client workflows into testable acceptance criteria.

What you bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering, including owning production systems from design through operation and hands-on AI/ML application work.

  • 2+ years building LLM applications with LangChain, and at least one LangGraph system you shipped and ran in production. You can explain its architecture, how it failed, how you evaluated it, and what improved.

  • Deep LangGraph knowledge: state schemas, reducers, nodes and edges, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointers, interrupts, and persistence. Fluent in current LangChain APIs for tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, and middleware.

  • Agent harness experience: extending Deep Agents or a comparable harness, including middleware, planning, subagents, filesystem access, and sandboxed execution.

  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): building and securing MCP tool servers, integrated with enterprise identity and access controls.

  • Retrieval engineering: permission-aware RAG, hybrid search, reranking, and retrieval evaluation.

  • Strong Python: async, typing, testing, API design, and maintainable service architecture.

  • Backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: PostgreSQL, queues, concurrency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Real experience with LLM failure modes: unreliable tool calls, context limits, nondeterminism, rate limits, and regressions after model or prompt changes. You have used evals and traces to find and fix them.

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry instrumentation alongside LangSmith or equivalent agent tracing.

  • Cloud delivery: Docker, automated testing, and CI/CD on AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • AI-native development: you work in an AI-enabled software development lifecycle, using coding agents for design, implementation, testing, and review, with the judgment to verify their output and the habits to make a team faster with them.

  • Clear communication: you can explain tradeoffs to engineers and clients and own delivery without close supervision.

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation.

Who we're looking for:

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you!

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.

The role:

Drive Applied AI Research & Model Development

  • Research, develop, train, and fine-tune machine learning and LLM models to solve complex challenges within the manufacturing and product sustainability domain.

  • Explore and evaluate new AI/ML methodologies, translating research and experimentation into practical, scalable solutions.

Data Extraction & Pipeline Development

  • Extract, consolidate, process, and contextualise complex data from customer ERP, PLM, and third-party databases to support AI model development.

  • Design robust, reproducible, and extensible data pipelines to support model training, evaluation, and delivery.

  • Address data quality, gaps, and complexity across both standardised and customer-specific AI use cases.

Translate Research into Production

  • Take AI research and experimentation through to production-ready solutions, collaborating with engineering and product teams to integrate models into Makersite's platform.

  • Evaluate model performance and drive iterative improvements in accuracy, scalability, and practical application.

Advance Makersite's AI Strategy

  • Contribute to the evolution of Makersite's AI strategy, identifying opportunities to improve existing models, processes, and capabilities.

  • Research emerging AI approaches and propose improvements to our AI stack and model development practices.

Collaborate & Provide Technical Leadership

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and other stakeholders to translate complex business challenges into AI-driven solutions.

  • Share research findings and provide technical guidance, taking ownership of complex problems from exploration through to delivery.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, AI research, or a related field.

  • Research-oriented background in AI/ML, with demonstrable research contributions such as publications or technical papers.

  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and optimising ML models and LLMs.

  • Strong Python skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Pandas.

  • Proven experience taking AI/ML solutions from research and experimentation through to production-level delivery.

  • Strong understanding of data extraction, processing, and pipeline development for AI/ML model training.

  • Manufacturing domain knowledge and experience working with complex B2B or enterprise datasets.

  • Experience collaborating within AI/ML teams and with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in Germany or the UK.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with ERP, PLM, manufacturing, supply chain, or sector-specific databases.

  • Experience developing customer-specific AI models and taking AI products or solutions to market.

  • Experience contributing to AI strategy or the development of AI capabilities within an organisation.

  • Background in B2B SaaS, manufacturing, or sustainability.

Key Attributes

  • Research-driven and naturally curious, with a passion for exploring and developing new AI approaches.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with complex, ambiguous challenges.

  • Ownership-driven, entrepreneurial, and focused on delivering outcomes.

  • Pragmatic, balancing research and innovation with business constraints and real-world application.

  • Strong communicator and collaborator, able to share insights and work effectively across teams.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value.

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent).

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development.

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel.

The Experience:

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of.

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect.

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life.

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters.

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.
